english: "Why should I forgive you? Your children have forsaken me and sworn by gods that are not gods. I supplied all their needs, yet they committed adultery and thronged to the houses of prostitutes.

ekegusii: Naende esegi ekaba n’Abafilisti; Elihanani, mosinto o Yairi, agaita Lahami, omomura omwabo Goliato korwa Gati, oria orotanga rwe ritimo riaye rwareng’aine omwaro omonene.
english: In another battle with the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver's rod.

ekegusii: Amang’ana akorua ase omonwa bw’omonto nigo anga buna amache e chindiba, ensoko y’obong’aini nigo enga buna amache ’orooche akominyoka.
english: The words of a man's mouth are deep waters, but the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook.

ekegusii: Erio bakabwata omoruoti oria, bakamoira ase omoruoti o Babeli agwo ase omochie o Ribula, ase ense ya Hamati, na ere akamonachera ekina.
english: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced sentence on him.

ekegusii: Obo nabwo obobe ase aya onsi agokorekana aiga inse y’erioba, ng’a egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi; chinkoro chia mwanyabanto nigo chiichire obobe na obobarimo ekero bare moyo, na nyuma y’ayio nigo bakogenda ase abakure.
english: This is the evil in everything that happens under the sun: The same destiny overtakes all. The hearts of men, moreover, are full of evil and there is madness in their hearts while they live, and afterward they join the dead.

ekegusii: “Oyo otamanyeti amange, tiga ache aa!” Na ase oyore omoriri bwateba:
english: "Let all who are simple come in here!" she says to those who lack judgment.

ekegusii: Rusia egetambaa kia motwe amo negutwa. Amang’ana takogenderera koba buna are bono. Ayio konya akeeigwe naimokererigwe igoro, na ayio konya aimokererigwe igoro nakeeigwe. Nabo Omonene Nyasae agoteba.
english: this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Take off the turban, remove the crown. It will not be as it was: The lowly will be exalted and the exalted will be brought low.

ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene Yeso Kristo, na obwanchani bwa Nyasae na okobwatana kw’Omoika Omochenu bibe amo nainwe mwensi.
english: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

ekegusii: And the cows that were ugly and gaunt ate up the seven sleek, fat cows. Then Pharaoh woke up.
english: Agwo chiombe chiria chimbe chindeu chikaria chiria chingiya chinoru. Erio Farao akaboka.

ekegusii: korende inche nabatebirie: Timobaisa koamererania noyore omobe. Korende omonto karagoake orosea rwa borio, omoonchorere norw’okobee.
english: But I tell you, Do not resist an evil person. If someone strikes you on the right cheek, turn to him the other also.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebio bibere na ekeng’ese, barabwo konya banyorire omwando obo moocha ya Yorodan, kororia Yeriko.”
english: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan of Jericho, toward the sunrise."

ekegusii: Naki ere konya obarirwe amo naintwe, akanyora ensemo y’oboteneneri bwabo.
english: he was one of our number and shared in this ministry."

ekegusii: Yeroboamu konya otomire abarwani baetanane na koumokera Abayuda korwa magega; igo abarwani baye b’esegi bakaba bosio bw’Abayuda na baria batometwe nigo barenge magega yabo.
english: Now Jeroboam had sent troops around to the rear, so that while he was in front of Judah the ambush was behind them.

ekegusii: korwa engaki eria nachorete abagambi igoro ase abanto baane Abaisraeli. Boigo nimbue ababisa bao bonsi. Na bono nigo ngokomanyia ng’a inche Omonene ninkoagachere enyomba.
english: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also subdue all your enemies. "'I declare to you that the LORD will build a house for you:

ekegusii: Na igo egachaka korama Nyasae, ekarama na erieta riaye, na obomenyo bwaye, na abwo bamenyete igoro,
english: He opened his mouth to blaspheme God, and to slander his name and his dwelling place and those who live in heaven.

ekegusii: Erio Isi‐Boseti agatoma abanto barusie omokungu oria korwa ase Palitieli, omosacha oye, mosinto o Laisi.
english: So Ish-Bosheth gave orders and had her taken away from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.

ekegusii: Erio orobebe rokaonchoka gochia bosongo goika Asinoti‐Tabori, na korwa agwo rokagenderera goika Hukoki, rogatwomera orogongo rw’egesaku gia Sabuloni ensemo ya sugusu, na orw’egia Aseri ensemo ya bosongo, na orw’ekia Yuda ensemo ya moocha ase Yorodan.
english: The boundary ran west through Aznoth Tabor and came out at Hukkok. It touched Zebulun on the south, Asher on the west and the Jordan on the east.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio takoba omonda, obotenenku bwaye tibokogenderera kobao, gose tibokobucha ase ense.
english: He will no longer be rich and his wealth will not endure, nor will his possessions spread over the land.

ekegusii: Abakori emeremo be Hekalu nabwo aba: Abanto be chiamate chia Siha, na Hasufa, na Tabaoti;
english: The temple servants: the descendants of Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth,

ekegusii: Nogwancha kwaye oyontomete nakwo oko, ng’a kera oyokorigereria Omwana na komwegena, nabe nobogima bwa kare na kare, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.”
english: For my Father's will is that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day."

ekegusii: Erio nario oramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Inche naigure amang’ana ao ay’okorama gwakwanire mamincha y’ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, kogoteba: Biasarigwe biabeire bosa, biabekirwe ase amaboko aito tobirie.
english: Then you will know that I the LORD have heard all the contemptible things you have said against the mountains of Israel. You said, "They have been laid waste and have been given over to us to devour."

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria oyore kerama igoro, na ebinto biaye bire nyomba ime, taika abibogorie; nere oyore mogondo naboigo tairana inka.
english: On that day no one who is on the roof of his house, with his goods inside, should go down to get them. Likewise, no one in the field should go back for anything.

ekegusii: Erio abageni bonsi b’Adonia bakaiguswa ase omoondoko, bakaimoka, na kera omonto akagenda enchera yaye.
english: At this, all Adonijah's guests rose in alarm and dispersed.

ekegusii: Nigo bakoong’anya korigia endagera, batayenyoreti nigo bakogeesa bokia.
english: They wander about for food and howl if not satisfied.

ekegusii: Morende mono na koigwera amachiko aya Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abaete; mwanche Omonene, Nyasae oino, na motaare ase chinchera chiaye chionsi. Moigwere amachiko aye, mobe abegenwa asare, na momokorere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi.”
english: But be very careful to keep the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you: to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to obey his commands, to hold fast to him and to serve him with all your heart and all your soul."

ekegusii: Ense neichorigwe nokomanya kw’obonene bw’Omonene buna chinyancha chiichire namache.
english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

ekegusii: "I am God, the God of your father," he said. "Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.
english: Erio akamotebia, “Inche ninche Nyasae, Nyasae o iso; tobaisa kwoboa gotirimboka gochia Misiri, ekiagera ningokore obe egesaku ekenene aroro.

ekegusii: Inyora abwo basibire ase echela, buna nainwe mosibire amo nabarabwo, naende barabwo mbakoreretwe bobe, ekiagera naboigo nainwe more nomobere.
english: Remember those in prison as if you were their fellow prisoners, and those who are mistreated as if you yourselves were suffering.

ekegusii: Nkabatiga bagesoyia ase ogotacheneka goetera ase ebiegwa biabo, nkabatiga bagasamba abana babo bonsi abatangi bakaba ebing’wanso. Nigo nakorete ayio ase okobaondokia, banyare komanya ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: I let them become defiled through their gifts-- the sacrifice of every firstborn--that I might fill them with horror so they would know that I am the LORD.'

ekegusii: Akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Sela. Yuda nere nao arenge aria Kisibo ekero amoiborete.
english: She gave birth to still another son and named him Shelah. It was at Kezib that she gave birth to him.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara nomonto omosacha buna okorara nomokungu; obwo nobonyaka obobe bw’okogechia.
english: "'Do not lie with a man as one lies with a woman; that is detestable.

ekegusii: Ee, aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebinto ebi bionsi ebinge twarure ase okoagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riao richenu nigo bikorwa ase okoboko kwao, na bionsi nebiao aye omonyene.
english: O LORD our God, as for all this abundance that we have provided for building you a temple for your Holy Name, it comes from your hand, and all of it belongs to you.

ekegusii: Akabirua buna Musa achigete biruegwe ase kera Rituko Richenu: Chisabato, na Emetienyi Emeyia, na Amatuko Amanene ara gatato ase omwaka: Amatuko Amanene ay’Emegati etabekiri memera, na Amatuko Amanene e Chichuma, na Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.
english: according to the daily requirement for offerings commanded by Moses for Sabbaths, New Moons and the three annual feasts-- the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of Tabernacles.

ekegusii: Amaiso aane agerire nabeire nomoichano ase omoyo one ase engencho y’abaiseke bonsi b’omochie one.
english: What I see brings grief to my soul because of all the women of my city.

ekegusii: Eema amo nebinto bionsi biare gokorerwa ase ogosasima naboigo are kobinyororokeria amanyinga.
english: In the same way, he sprinkled with the blood both the tabernacle and everything used in its ceremonies.

ekegusii: Ebedi‐Meleki Omoetiopia, omosomba bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, akaigwa ng’a abagambi baria babekire Yeremia ime ase engoro eria. Ekero ekio omoruoti nigo aikaransete ase Egeita kia Benjamin.
english: But Ebed-Melech, a Cushite, an official in the royal palace, heard that they had put Jeremiah into the cistern. While the king was sitting in the Benjamin Gate,

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya abere nagochere mobosokano ase rituko erimo; abana bao mbakwe, na omosacha oo akwe, obe omoboraka; ayio onsi nagochere, nonya oborogi bwao, na oboringoria bwao, bire ebinge mono.
english: Both of these will overtake you in a moment, on a single day: loss of children and widowhood. They will come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and all your potent spells.

ekegusii: Nabakwe ase engencho y’enchara ne riberera rikorura, nabariegwe namarwaire amabe agoita. Nimbatomere ching’iti chi’orosana chire namaino amooge chibarwanie, ne ching’iti chingenda inse chire nobosongo, chibarome.
english: I will send wasting famine against them, consuming pestilence and deadly plague; I will send against them the fangs of wild beasts, the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

ekegusii: Daudi akagenda goika Baali‐Perasimu, akababua agwo. Erio akabora, “Nyasae okoroorire ababisa baane goetera ase okoboko kwane, buna chiooro chi’amache are nemerindo chigokoroora.” Ase ayio bakaroka aase aria Baali‐Perasimu.
english: So David and his men went up to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, "As waters break out, God has broken out against my enemies by my hand." So that place was called Baal Perazim.

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge morito, akarera nobororo bw’okobina, ekiagera achandegete ase okoibora.
english: She was pregnant and cried out in pain as she was about to give birth.

ekegusii: Ing’a chinguru buna kwarire eira, erinde imbe moyo, tobaisa gontiga indore obosooku ase ogosemeria kwane.
english: Sustain me according to your promise, and I will live; do not let my hopes be dashed.

ekegusii: “Nenyare koba ng’a omonto nabwate omwana omomura omobe, omoenenu, otari koigwera ise gose ng’ina, nonya bateemire komoa egesusuro ase okomorongeyia, ere tari kobaigwera.
english: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father and mother and will not listen to them when they discipline him,

ekegusii: “Onye omokungu oria takonyara konyora eng’ondi, rirorio arente amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na erinde eki’ebibe. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omokungu oyio, na omokungu oyio nabe ochenekire.”
english: If she cannot afford a lamb, she is to bring two doves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and the other for a sin offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for her, and she will be clean.'"

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akabatebia, “Mokore enyomba yane ebe eyetachenegeti; moichorie chiraaro chiaye nebitondo bi’abanto. Nyuma y’ayio mosoe ase omochie” Ase ayio bagasoa ase omochie, bagaita abanto.
english: Then he said to them, "Defile the temple and fill the courts with the slain. Go!" So they went out and began killing throughout the city.

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia akaimokia ebuku ende, akayea Baruku omoriki, mosinto o Neria; nere akarika ase ebuku eyio amang’ana aya Yeremia akwanete. Akarika amang’ana onsi aria arenge ase ebuku eria entang’ani, eria Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, asambete ase omorero. Boigo amang’ana ande amange buna ayio namentetwe ase ebuku eyio.
english: So Jeremiah took another scroll and gave it to the scribe Baruch son of Neriah, and as Jeremiah dictated, Baruch wrote on it all the words of the scroll that Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire. And many similar words were added to them.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ekiagera aye kwarengereirie ng’a nigo ore omong’aini buna Nyasae,
english: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'Because you think you are wise, as wise as a god,

ekegusii: Whoever rebels against your word and does not obey your words, whatever you may command them, will be put to death. Only be strong and courageous!"
english: Monto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amachiko ao na taigwa amang’ana okomotebia, goika aitwe akwe. Aye otenene bokong’u, obe omoremu!”

ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo barenge abateneneri ase ebisaku ebio biabo, naende abatang’ani be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bachoretwe korwa ase omoganda bwonsi.
english: These were the men appointed from the community, the leaders of their ancestral tribes. They were the heads of the clans of Israel.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli b’ekegori eke, igwera ring’ana riane, inche Omonene. Inee! Inche nigo nabeire buna erooro asemore? Gose nigo nabeire buna ense y’omosunte ekerima asemore? Nase ki inwe abanto baane mogoteba ng’a mobwate obosibore, na timorigeti kong’iranera inche?
english: "You of this generation, consider the word of the LORD: "Have I been a desert to Israel or a land of great darkness? Why do my people say, 'We are free to roam; we will come to you no more'?

ekegusii: Omonene ong’akanire, ekiagera ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera aroche ng’a amaboko aane achenekire.
english: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

ekegusii: This has been my practice: I obey your precepts.
english: Oko nakwo ogosesenigwa kwane, ng’a nabeire indendete amachiko ao.

ekegusii: Aonchorerie chianga chiria abegete ekero oosetwe, na agenderere kobeera agwo enka y’omonto oyio, abe okoreera ise na ng’ina ase engaki y’omotienyi omogima. Nyuma yaye omonto oria amotware abe mokaye.
english: and put aside the clothes she was wearing when captured. After she has lived in your house and mourned her father and mother for a full month, then you may go to her and be her husband and she shall be your wife.

ekegusii: Mbamenyete Yerusalemu Abayahudi abasigete Nyasae, abanto korwa ase kera egesaku inse y’erioba.
english: Now there were staying in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.

ekegusii: Omotomwa otari omwegenwa nigo akogwa ase emechando, korende oyore omwegenwa nigo akogwenia.
english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy brings healing.

ekegusii: Erio aire eeri eyio isiko y’egetwori, ayesambere aroro, buna asambete eeri eria ye ritang’ani. Ekio nekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho y’omoganda bwonsi.
english: Then he shall take the bull outside the camp and burn it as he burned the first bull. This is the sin offering for the community.

ekegusii: Bakaanga koigwera, gose tibarengereretie na koinyora amakumia gwakorete ase egati yabo; bagakong’ia ebigoti, bagachora omoraai abatang’ane koirana gochia Misiri ase obosomba. Korende aye naye Nyasae bw’okwabera, nigo ore omuya, naende omonyene amabera, tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, aye nigo ore nobwanchani obonge botari koera, gose tikwabatigete.
english: They refused to listen and failed to remember the miracles you performed among them. They became stiff-necked and in their rebellion appointed a leader in order to return to their slavery. But you are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love. Therefore you did not desert them,

ekegusii: Naki ere oyogochena amo nabwo bagochenwa nigo bakorwa ase oyomo. Ase ayio, takorora obosooku kobaroka abamwabo,
english: Both the one who makes men holy and those who are made holy are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.

ekegusii: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.
english: Kobakorire iga, bakanyora chinswe chinyinge mono, na ekero ebionga biabo biachaka gotandoka,

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, imoka ochiche aase ao ogotimokera, aye amo n’Esanduku eria ekworokia okobua kwao.
english: arise, O LORD, and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.

ekegusii: “Okoruegwa konde gwonsi kw’endagera bakonduera inche Omonene tigokoroiseranigwa nememera. Timobaisa gosamba ememera, gose obooke, bibe okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero asende.
english: "'Every grain offering you bring to the LORD must be made without yeast, for you are not to burn any yeast or honey in an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: “Omonene naremie Sayoni, naremie abatigarete bare ase amaturi. Naroisie aase aye abete erooro, abe buna omogondo o Edeni, na ense enyomo yaye ebe buna omogondo bw’Omonene. Omogoko na omochengo mbibe bikoigweka ime yaye, boigo okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, na amatera ay’ogotogia, mbibeo.
english: The LORD will surely comfort Zion and will look with compassion on all her ruins; he will make her deserts like Eden, her wastelands like the garden of the LORD. Joy and gladness will be found in her, thanksgiving and the sound of singing.

ekegusii: Akabeka abarendi bakorenda ebiita bi’enyomba y’Omonene na gotanga omonto onde bwensi otachenegete tasoa ime.
english: He also stationed doorkeepers at the gates of the LORD's temple so that no one who was in any way unclean might enter.

ekegusii: Furugia na Pamfulia, Misiri ne chinsemo chia Libia ya Kurene, amo nabageni korwa Rumi,
english: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome

ekegusii: na Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana, momura omwabo Yakobo, akabaroka erieta Boanergi, engencho yaye: Abana b’enkoba;
english: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (to them he gave the name Boanerges, which means Sons of Thunder);

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana aya nimbateeme: Amaene, buna Farao are moyo, timokorua aa mogende, oria omino omoke ataracha aa.
english: And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you will not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.

ekegusii: Naende agantebia, “Banera amauga aya, oyatebie: Inwe amauga amomo, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!
english: Then he said to me, "Prophesy to these bones and say to them, 'Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!

ekegusii: Korende ogende ase omochie o tata, ase eamate yane, orentere omwana one omokungu korwa aroro.
english: but go to my father's family and to my own clan, and get a wife for my son.'

ekegusii: Mwanyabanto nigo agokora emeroberio ase enkoro yaye, korende aya oromeme rokoiraneria nigo akorwa ase Omonene.
english: To man belong the plans of the heart, but from the LORD comes the reply of the tongue.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire gochika aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere, akaimoka korwa aria, akagenda kworokereria na korandia ase emechie yabo.
english: After Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he went on from there to teach and preach in the towns of Galilee.

ekegusii: Kwanania ase okonyunyuntana ase obochenu.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Eriogi riaigurwe Rama, okorera na okweumia nobororo. Raeli nkobareera are abana baye; tancheti aremigwe ase engencho y’abana baye, ekiagera tibaiyo.”
english: This is what the LORD says: "A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because her children are no more."

ekegusii: naende asibore abwo bonsi barenge abasomba ase obogima bwabo bwonsi, ekiagera bairogete amakweri.
english: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.

ekegusii: gose abanto baino tibarakora onsi aya Omonene achikire goetera ase Musa, gochakera rituko riria Omonene aruete amachiko, na kogenderera ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: any of the LORD's commands to you through him, from the day the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come--

ekegusii: Inche nigo nachayirwe ase engencho yao, obosooku bwatubire obosio bwane.
english: For I endure scorn for your sake, and shame covers my face.

ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi, abe omosacha gose omokungu, oragende ase omoruoti ase egoora ime atarangeiri, goika aitwe akwe. Okwo nogochika. Abasomba bonsi b’omoruoti na abanto bonsi be chingongo chi’oboruoti mbamanyete amang’ana ayio. Enchera neyemo yoka ogotooreka: erarente onye omoruoti abe okomworotera enyimbo yaye y’oboruoti eroisirie korwa ase etahabu, ebe ekemanyererio ng’a rirorio natigwe abe moyo. Korende bono tindarangerigwa kogenda ase omoruoti ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato.”
english: "All the king's officials and the people of the royal provinces know that for any man or woman who approaches the king in the inner court without being summoned the king has but one law: that he be put to death. The only exception to this is for the king to extend the gold scepter to him and spare his life. But thirty days have passed since I was called to go to the king."

ekegusii: Bono genda, orike amang’ana ayio ase ebao agwo ase amasio abo, na oyarike ime ase ebuku, erinde abe kirori ase amatuko agochi‐gocha goika kare na kare.
english: Go now, write it on a tablet for them, inscribe it on a scroll, that for the days to come it may be an everlasting witness.

ekegusii: Abakerubi abwo nigo baramborete chimbaba chiabo igoro y’aase aria Esanduku eria yarenge, bagatuba Esanduku eria amo nemiaro yaye yare kobogorerigwa.
english: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its carrying poles.

ekegusii: Ekero ebirengererio biane biarenge koraagwa nobong’aini, nkagania kogokia omobere one nekenyugwa ki’edivai, nkarigia kobwatia oboriri obwo, erinde ndore ayare amaya agwenerete mwanyabanto bakore inse y’erioba, ase amatuko ayio amake bagendererete koba moyo.
english: I tried cheering myself with wine, and embracing folly-- my mind still guiding me with wisdom. I wanted to see what was worthwhile for men to do under heaven during the few days of their lives.

ekegusii: “Omonene agantebia: Timobaisa gochegia abanto ba Moabu, gose korwana nabarabwo, ekiagera tinkobaa ensemo ende yonsi y’ense yabo ebe eyaino. Naeire abanto b’ororeria rwa Loti omochie o Ari obe oyobo.” (
english: Then the LORD said to me, "Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any part of their land. I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as a possession."

ekegusii: Nabo omokungu oria agatiga enyongo yaye, akagenda omochie, agatebia abanto,
english: Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,

ekegusii: Osambere chinyama echi chionsi chi’emingichi ase egesasimero igoro. Eke nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene, ekeng’wanso ki’omorero kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
english: Then burn the entire ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti konya ochorire omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani esegi, ere omonyene egenete, abe omorendi bw’egeita. Abanto bakamotindachera agwo ase egeita goika agakwa, buna omonto oria o Nyasae atebete ekero omoruoti achete asare.
english: Now the king had put the officer on whose arm he leaned in charge of the gate, and the people trampled him in the gateway, and he died, just as the man of God had foretold when the king came down to his house.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi mbairoke, babe bakoraria emeremo ya Nyasae na komanya mono ayakorire.
english: All mankind will fear; they will proclaim the works of God and ponder what he has done.

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene aroche ng’a Musa oikire ang’e arore, akamorangeria korwa ase egetutu ime, “Musa! Musa!” Musa agaitaba, “Nao inde aa.”
english: When the LORD saw that he had gone over to look, God called to him from within the bush, "Moses! Moses!" And Moses said, "Here I am."

ekegusii: Ekero Yoabu aroche ng’a esegi nigo ere bosio bwaye na nyuma, agachora abanto abakong’u abamanyete korwana esegi, akabaroberia barwane n’Abasiiria.
english: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.

ekegusii: Ekaba ng’a narenge agwo Giligali omonto omoomboganu, ore korokwa Seba, mosinto o Bikiri bw’egesaku kia Benjamin. Ere akabugia egetureri, akabora, “Ngetari ki tobwate ase Daudi? Titori nomwando na mosinto o Yese! Inwe Abaisraeli, genda kera omonto bwoye!”
english: Now a troublemaker named Sheba son of Bicri, a Benjamite, happened to be there. He sounded the trumpet and shouted, "We have no share in David, no part in Jesse's son! Every man to his tent, O Israel!"

ekegusii: Ase igo Isaka akamenya Gerari.
english: So Isaac stayed in Gerar.

ekegusii: Goetera ase abasomba bao gwachecheirie Omonene ekero gwatebire iga: Nase chigari chiane chinyinge nariinire goika ebichuria bi’ebitunwa, goika igoro kegima ya Lebanoni. Ngatema emecharake yaye yare emetambe goetania eyende, na emetarakwa yaye emiya mono. Ngasoa ase ebinunchi biaye ime, na ime ase rinani rinoru.
english: By your messengers you have heaped insults on the Lord. And you have said, 'With my many chariots I have ascended the heights of the mountains, the utmost heights of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its pines. I have reached its remotest heights, the finest of its forests.

ekegusii: “Naichanire ekiagera nabegete Saulo koba omoruoti, ere oonchokire, otigire konyigwera na tabwateti amachiko aane.” Ayio akamoichania Samweli, erinde akaba okorera ase Omonene obotuko obogima ng’a akonywe.
english: "I am grieved that I have made Saul king, because he has turned away from me and has not carried out my instructions." Samuel was troubled, and he cried out to the LORD all that night.

ekegusii: Gidioni akabatebia, “Baria nigo barenge bamura baminto, abamura ba baba. Amaene, buna Omonene are moyo, onye mwabatigete babe moyo, inche nanga tinabaita inwe!”
english: Gideon replied, "Those were my brothers, the sons of my own mother. As surely as the LORD lives, if you had spared their lives, I would not kill you."

ekegusii: “Enchera ya Nyasae neng’ikeranu; amang’ana aye ateemirwe na gotenena. Ere nenguba ase bonsi abakomotamera.
english: "As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield for all who take refuge in him.

ekegusii: Erio kobwachia gokia mambia, abakuani abanene bagakora ekina amo nabagaaka na aborokia b’amariko, na ekegambero ekegima. Bagasiba Yeso, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato.
english: Very early in the morning, the chief priests, with the elders, the teachers of the law and the whole Sanhedrin, reached a decision. They bound Jesus, led him away and handed him over to Pilate.

ekegusii: Naende bagakora chibonyi chinde chie chitahabu, bagachibeka ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.
english: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.

ekegusii: Ekiagera kwabeire na kerokio asende, na oboenenu bwao bwaikire ase amato aane, nimbeke ekegobanio ase chimioro chiao ime, na egento kiane ki’ogokoraa ase omonwa oo, ninkoiranie ogendere enchera eria gwacherete.
english: Because you rage against me and because your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.

ekegusii: Korende kerabe ng’a tagokiri nomokungu oyio, amoe ribaga agende aande onsi ase aranche, korende tamoonia chibesa gose komokorera buna agokorera omosomba, ekiagera igo amobetereretie koba nere, na akamoa obosooku.
english: If you are not pleased with her, let her go wherever she wishes. You must not sell her or treat her as a slave, since you have dishonored her.

ekegusii: Nyasae, buna koreng’ana erieta riao rikumete, naboigo nogotogigwa kwao gokumete goikera chinsinyo chi’ense. Okoboko kwao gw’okorio nigo goichire noboronge.
english: Like your name, O God, your praise reaches to the ends of the earth; your right hand is filled with righteousness.

ekegusii: Korende onye more namang’ana ande, nigo araroisigwe nabagambi ba botambe.
english: If there is anything further you want to bring up, it must be settled in a legal assembly.

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, karie egento ekio kwaeirwe; karie ebuku eye, erio ogende gokwana n’Abaisraeli.”
english: And he said to me, "Son of man, eat what is before you, eat this scroll; then go and speak to the house of Israel."

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akagenda, agatebia omonto oria o Nyasae amang’ana ayio. Nere agatebia omokungu oria. “Genda, oonie amaguta ayio, oakane esira yao, na echiratigare nchigoisane aye na abana bao.”
english: She went and told the man of God, and he said, "Go, sell the oil and pay your debts. You and your sons can live on what is left."

ekegusii: Ekero Gidioni aigeteo, akaigwa omonto oyomo ogotebia omogisangio oye buna arotire, ogoteba, “Nigo narota okorota, narora omogati bw’esairi ogoturunkana gocha aiga ase egetwori giaito, oaka eema, oyeonchorana, oyeiyeria inse.”
english: Gideon arrived just as a man was telling a friend his dream. "I had a dream," he was saying. "A round loaf of barley bread came tumbling into the Midianite camp. It struck the tent with such force that the tent overturned and collapsed."

ekegusii: Nkaimokia amaiso aane naende, nkarora ebuku eringanirie ekoiruruka.
english: I looked again-- and there before me was a flying scroll!

ekegusii: Na Yeso akabatebia, “Inwe mwensi inamogochwe na gontiga, naki arikire: Ning’ake omorisia, ne ching’ondi nachiserebekane.
english: "You will all fall away," Jesus told them, "for it is written: "'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.'

ekegusii: Na abasomba ba Senakeribu bakamenta korama Omonene Nyasae na Hezekia, omosomba oye.
english: Sennacherib's officers spoke further against the LORD God and against his servant Hezekiah.

ekegusii: Obonetu bw’enyasi ya isiko y’ebinyomba biria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano, na ensemo y’oboroso boria yasogete isiko yatigetwe nigo yarenge nobogare bw’obotambe bw’amaboko atano.
english: The outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits thick. The open area between the side rooms of the temple

ekegusii: Isaka ise akamoboria, “Naye ng’o?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Ninche Esau omwana oo omotangi.”
english: His father Isaac asked him, "Who are you?" "I am your son," he answered, "your firstborn, Esau."

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Kai tata! Onde taiyo omochi' oyo? Ase engaki y' egiateko n' enchara, Abagusii nabo twarenge gotiga chiika chiato, twagenda aare, gosuma endagera. Amatuko amake aerire, omogaka sokoro ominto nigo antebetie buna nonya Abagusii twarenge abakongu ase oboremi n' obotugi ase amatuko amakoro, egiateko ngocha kiarenge, goikera enchara yaba. Nigo omogaka antebetie buna oboremeru bw' embura eyio yarenge kwamia endagera, nigo bwarenge kogera abanto bakora ebinto batarenge gocha gokora. Nabo abange barenge kogenda aare, erinde gosuma endagera. Komenta nayio, nonya n' oboibi nkomentekana bwarenge, ekero ki' egiateko. Ogotayaya nkwarengeo, ase amatuko ayio amakoro Buna omogaka sokoro agoteba, nabo yabete igo, ekero gie enchara yabete enene, n' abanto bagatayaya gochia aare kegima korigia endagera. Bono ayaiga kaba, Omogusii omokoro akamanya goteba buna Enda N'Embe, Yarusetie Ekeongo Igoro, Kegaika Nse. Ayie! Ekeonge kiagaika nse rero Bono Ekeongo ninki sokoro? Nche naboretie omogaka. Nigo sokoro antebetie buna Ekeongo n' enyoni eri yanchete koiruruka aaria amare igoro, korwa maambia echuni, goikera bwaira. Ekero ki' omobaso omotindi n' enchara, nario rioka enyoni eye egoika gochia nse, erinde nero nario eranyore gento ebeke mboto! Ase ogoteba omobayeno oyo, Abagusii nigo babwekanetie mwanyabanto buna Ekeongo, ekiagera enchara nero ekogera omonto otayaya gochia chinse chiaare, erinde nere gose nanyore endagera, takwa. Bono korora iga, Abagusii abakoro bagateba buna Enda N'Embe, Yarusetie Ekeongo Igoro, Kegaika Nse. Korwa ase omogaka sokoro ominto, oyo noro omobayeno oito for this week. Motware chingaki chingiya, and thank you for listening.
english: These are the words: Hey my friend! Where did the sun hide today? Because we have finished harvesting, the Gusii people also have gathered in their farms, we have traveled far, completing the task. The seeds have sprouted, the leader thinks about the people and remembers that the Gusii people have strong warriors who fear war and peace because of the good seeds, finishing well, making the farm beautiful. And the leader remembers that the rain which fell was enough to water the farms, and they have told the people to work hard so they don’t lack anything. And others have gone far, protecting the completion of the task. Comment on this, because even evil comments will be heard, just like finishing well. It is very important, because of those good seeds. When the leader thinks, and he has seen it, just like the farm has grown big, and the people rejoice going far to finish the task quickly. But these days, the great Gusii person knows when Enda N'Embe, Yarusetie Ekeongo Igoro, Kegaika Nse will come. Oh! Ekeongo comes now then. But what does Ekeongo mean? I asked the leader. He remembered that Ekeongo and the bird flew high in the sky during the evening, carrying messages everywhere, making noise. Just like the youth and the farm, it seems the bird flies coming now, protecting everything from being stolen! Because of the good news, the Gusii people agreed among themselves that Ekeongo would make the farm prosper and the people rejoice greatly, protecting everything until it is completed, truly. But repeat again, the old Gusii people remember Enda N'Embe, Yarusetie Ekeongo Igoro, Kegaika Nse. Carrying the thought of the leader about the people, this is good news for this week. Take this message, and thank you for listening.

ekegusii: Erio kegima, ekero Ahabu aigwete ng’a Naboti okure, akaimoka akagenda ase omogondo oria bw’emesabibu o Naboti Omoyesireeli, akayoira okaba oyoye.
english: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, he got up and went down to take possession of Naboth's vineyard.

ekegusii: Oyabeke ase ebitwang’a bi’amareko bi’egesibao keria ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Naboigo Haroni abogorie amarieta abo ase amareko aye abere, abe ekeinyorio ase obosio bw’Omonene botambe.
english: and fasten them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear the names on his shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana twaigwete korwa asare, na tokobarareria inwe, ng’a Nyasae nomobaso, gose mosunte onde bwonsi tori ime asare.
english: This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light; in him there is no darkness at all.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eye nainwe morentere Omonene okoruegwa kwaino, okwo mokorusia korwa ase ensemo ya ikomi eria mokonyora korwa ase Abaisraeli. Na okoruegwa okwo gw’ensemo ya ikomi okore kw’Omonene, moe Haroni omokuani.
english: In this way you also will present an offering to the LORD from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites. From these tithes you must give the LORD's portion to Aaron the priest.

ekegusii: na ekiagera baonchokire na gotiga komobwatia, gose tibari korengereria igoro ye chinchera chiaye nonya ng’ake.
english: because they turned from following him and had no regard for any of his ways.

ekegusii: Ogochika okwo gw’Esteri eting’ana kogakong’ia amang’ana a Purimu, na ayio akarikwa ase ebuku.
english: Esther's decree confirmed these regulations about Purim, and it was written down in the records.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti oyio o irianyi arabe osiririe omoganda oria, enkoro yaye inayeimokererie igoro, korende naisa goita chilifu chinyinge, takonyara kobua.
english: When the army is carried off, the king of the South will be filled with pride and will slaughter many thousands, yet he will not remain triumphant.

ekegusii: Abaetiopia na Abamisiri batarenge korengeka nabwo barenge chinguru chiaye; Abaputi na Abalibia nabwo barenge koyokonya.
english: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were among her allies.

ekegusii: Naki nigo ngosasoka mono ase omoyo one ase engencho y’amachiko a Nyasae,
english: For in my inner being I delight in God's law;

ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto omong’aini nagwenerete airanerie amang’ana are buna omwaga okogusa, na goichoria enda yaye nomwaga okogusa korwa moocha?
english: "Would a wise man answer with empty notions or fill his belly with the hot east wind?

ekegusii: Ere oyogoteba ng’a nigo are ase omobaso ime, naende ogechete oyomwabo, nigo are ase omosunte ime nonya mbono,
english: Anyone who claims to be in the light but hates his brother is still in the darkness.

ekegusii: Nere oitete abana abatangi ba Misiri, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo.
english: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, the firstborn of men and animals.

ekegusii: The devil said to him, "If you are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread."
english: Saitani akamotebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, tebia rigena eri ribe omogati.”

ekegusii: Nase ki rende mwabeire mogochaya na koba ne ribero ase ebing’wanso biane, na okoruegwa kwane, nachigete birentwe ase Obomenyo bwane? Aye Eli kwaeire abamura bao ogosika kong’etania ase okobaa ribaga kwenoria ase eyere enoru mono kobua, ase kera ekeng’wanso abanto baane Abaisraeli bakonduera.
english: Why do you scorn my sacrifice and offering that I prescribed for my dwelling? Why do you honor your sons more than me by fattening yourselves on the choice parts of every offering made by my people Israel?'

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Rora, obobe ngocha bore, obobe borabe bogoetania bonde bwonsi.
english: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Disaster! An unheard-of disaster is coming.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Mariamu.” Ere akeonchora, akamotebia ase Ekeibirania, “Raboni!” (Okoonchorwa kwaye, Omworokia).
english: Jesus said to her, "Mary." She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, "Rabboni!" (which means Teacher).

ekegusii: rirorio Omonene narente asemore, na igoro ase abana baino, amaakwa are amanene na amatindi aragenderere ase engaki entambe.
english: the LORD will send fearful plagues on you and your descendants, harsh and prolonged disasters, and severe and lingering illnesses.

ekegusii: Amunoni agachandeka mono ase okomogania Tamari, omoiseke omwabo, goika agekora buna nomorwaire are. Omoiseke oria nigo arenge omwekungi; Amunoni agasinywa komokorera buna aganetie.
english: Amnon became frustrated to the point of illness on account of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed impossible for him to do anything to her.

ekegusii: goika asire kare na kare, buna obonyira bwaye bogosira. Abwo bamoroche mbaborie; Omonto oria, ng’ai are?
english: he will perish forever, like his own dung; those who have seen him will say, 'Where is he?'

ekegusii: Obee! Naki rituko riria rire rinene! Rinde tiriri ringa buna rirorio. Eyio nengaki y’emechando y’abanto ba Yakobo, korende nonya naboigo mbatoorigwe korwa ase emechando eyio.”
english: How awful that day will be! None will be like it. It will be a time of trouble for Jacob, but he will be saved out of it.

ekegusii: Yehosafati agatenena ase egati y’omosangererekano oria bw’Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu agwo ase eraaro enyia y’enyomba y’Omonene,
english: Then Jehoshaphat stood up in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem at the temple of the LORD in the front of the new courtyard

ekegusii: Nagosabire, koranche ong’e ribaga nyamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodan, indore ense eria engiya y’ebitunwa amo na Lebanoni.
english: Let me go over and see the good land beyond the Jordan-- that fine hill country and Lebanon."

ekegusii: Ekero emechando eyio erabachere, abanto ba Nyasae nabanyore ogokonywa ogoke. Abanto abange mbabwatane nabarabwo ase obong’ainereria bw’okweansia.
english: When they fall, they will receive a little help, and many who are not sincere will join them.

ekegusii: Onye eng’iti eyemo y’echio ekwete keragwere embusuro egosimekwa, embusuro eyio negenderere koba echenegete.
english: If a carcass falls on any seeds that are to be planted, they remain clean.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio chisokoro chiaito chikaanga koinoigwera, chikamosukeria are. Na ase ebirengererio biabo bakairana Misiri,
english: "But our fathers refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.

ekegusii: Hezekia agatebia Isaya, “Ring’ana ri’Omonene aye gwakwanire nerigiya”. Nigo arengereretie ng’a onye rioka omorembe na oborendi obuya biare gochia konyorekana ase obogima bwaye.

ekegusii: Goetania emiaka chirifu 4, chiaetire, Nyasae akamoorekera Abraham aaria Mesopotamia na komotebia, "Imoka orwe ense yao, na ase egesaku kiao, na ase enyomba ya’iso, ogende ase ense indakoorokie. Nainche ningokore egesaku ekenene." Abraham akamoigwera Omenene na kogenda ase ense ya Kaanani ase amenyete na momura’oye Isaka na mochokor’oye Yakobo, oyochete korokwa “Israeli.” Israeli na bamura baye 12 bagatirimboka gochia ense ya Misri ase’engencho enchara yachete ase ense ya Kaanani, naabwo bakamentekana na koba egesaku ekenene mono. AbaMisiri bagasogwa no’obwoba ase’enencho ye’egesaku eke ekenene kiamenyete amo na’barabwo, erio bakabakora abasomba na kobakoria chigasi chinkong’u. Nyuma ye’emiaka chimii inye ne’emerongo etato (430) ase ense ya Misri, Musa akabaraaa korwa ase obosomba, bagatamboka Enyancha Embariri na gosoa Bw’Arabu, ase Nyasae abaerete amachiko ase Egetunwa gia Sinai. Ekiare kia’Abaisraeli kiarwete Misiri na Musa tigiancheretwe gosoa Ense yo’Omwando ase’eng’encho getabwate okwegena ase Omonene. Gekaragaya ase eroro ase emiaka 40 goikera ekiare ekeyia kiabwate okweegena ase Omonene gegakina na gosoa ense yo’Omwando na Yoshua. Ase emiaka ang’e chimii inye (400), ebisaku 12 bia’Israeli bikagamberwa na’Abagambi buna Richiko ria Musa riare goteba. Ekero bagania koba no’Omoruoti buna ebisaku binde, Nyasae akabaa Sauro abe Omoruoti obo; nere akabagambera ase emiaka 40; akabwatiwa na Daudi, oyoogambete emiaka 40, nere akabwatigwa na momura oye Solomoni oyoogambete emiaka 40. Ekero gia Solomoni, nario Omoruotu bw’Abaisraeli arenge neesiko enene, na Ekaru entang’ani ekaagachwa; korende enkoro yo’omoruoti Solomoni ekamogechia Nyasae ase obogotu bwaye; Nyasae akamotebia buna; ebisaku 10 biaIsraeli tibikogamberwa na momura oye nainde. Ekero Solomoni akwa, oborwoti bwa Israeli bokabagekana, na ebisaku 10 bia’sugusu bikagamberwa na baruoti ababe, batarenge b’ororeri rwa Daudi na Solomoni. Oborwoti obo bwa’sugusu bokagenderera kweroka Israeli na gokora Samaria omochie oye omonene. Oborai oboke bwa’Irianyi bokaba nabwo Yuda, na Jerusalem Omochie oye omonene na kogamberwa no’ororeri rwa Daudi. Gochakera Abaruoti ya kabere 16, abanto boboruoti bwa Irianyi bakamanyekana buna “Abayaudi” ase’eng’encho yo’oboruoti bwa Yuda. Ase eng’encho ye’ebibe bia Israeli ya Mocha, bakarwanigwa na gokobugwa na gokorwa abasomba na Abaasuri. Abaisraeli bari batigarete bakasoanana na abanto bebisaku batamwegenete Omenene abachete komenya nabwo. Aba nabwo bachete korokwa Abasamaria, erio ebisaku 10 bia’ Mocha bigasira pi. Nyuma yaye, Oboruoti bwa’Irianyi bwa Yuda bokairwa obosomba ase ense ya Babiloni buna egesusuro giogosasima chinyae chinde, na Ekaru egasarigwa, koronde nyumba ye’emiaka 70, Abayaudi bakairana Yuda, bakaagacha Ekaru Jerusalem na kogenderera kogamberwa na abaruoti bo’ororeri rwa Daudi Ase engaki ya Yeso, egesaku kia Yuda ekiamanyekanete bua Judea na ekiagambeire na Abarumi. Yeso O’Kristo na abatomwa baye bakarandia Enchiri Judea bakorigia ching’ondi chinsiru chie’enyomba ya Israeli. Nyuma ye’emiaka 3 na enusu, abayaudi bakamokana Yeso buna Omoboria obo na komokora omogabana o’Rumi komobamba. Amatuko 3 keraeta, akaboka korwa ase abakurena kobaorokera abatomwa baye, ataratira gochia Igoro ase bono aikaransete ase okoboko okorio gwa Tata. Ekero egeke atarabambwa, yeso akabana ing’a Jerusalem nesambwe buna amaakwa yaokomokana, Ekaru nesarigwe, na Abayaudi mbasebererekane ase ense yonsi. Obobani obo bogaikerana ase omwaka bwe’70 A.D. ekero omoruoti bw’Abarumi Tito asoete Jerusalem. Ase emiaka 1800, Abayaudi bagasebererekana ase ense yonsi. Ase omwaka elfu eyemo, chimii kianda na emerengo ene ne’etano etato (1948), egetakageire gekaba. Ense ya’Israeli ekabekwa, erio naende abayaudi bakairana ase Ense yo’Omwando. Abakristo abange batebire ing’a oko nogwancha kwa Nyasae, korende, naboo gose echi nechinguru chio’Omosunte? Esinema eye nebwate richibu.
english: God commanded his angel 4, to appear, God remembered Abraham from Mesopotamia and told him, "Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father's house, and go to the land I will show you. I will make your descendants a great nation." Abraham obeyed the Lord and went to the land of Canaan where he lived and had a son named Isaac and begot Jacob, who was also called “Israel.” Israel and his twelve sons migrated to the land of Egypt because of famine, and they settled there in the land of Canaan, but they multiplied and became a great nation. The Egyptians were afraid of their numbers and mistreated them severely, so they enslaved them and made them work hard. After four hundred and thirty years in Egypt, Moses arose as a deliverer, leading the Israelites out of Egypt and across the Red Sea, and God brought them to the mountains of Sinai. The journey of the Israelites from Egypt with Moses led them across the Wilderness and through the land promised to them by the Lord. They wandered in the desert for forty years until the generation that did not obey the Lord died off, and Joshua led them across the Wilderness. After another four hundred years, the twelve tribes of Israel were judged by judges, starting with Deborah after the death of Moses. Later they asked for a king, and God chose Saul as their first king; he reigned for forty years; he was succeeded by David, who reigned for forty years, and he was succeeded by his son Solomon who reigned for forty years. During the reign of Solomon, the kingdom of Israel reached its greatest glory, and the Temple was built; therefore the king’s palace for Solomon pleased God greatly; God spoke to him saying; the ten tribes of Israel would not be ruled by his son. When Solomon died, the kingdom of Israel divided, and the ten northern tribes were ruled by rebellious leaders, who did not follow the example of David and Solomon. That rebellious leadership led to the downfall of Israel and the destruction of Samaria. But the tribe of Judah remained loyal, and Jerusalem remained the capital and was ruled by the line of David. From those sixteen kings, the people of the rebellious kingdom were known as “Jews” and the kingdom of Judah. During the time of the division of the kingdoms of Israel and Judah, they were attacked, conquered, and exiled by Assyrians. The Israelites had repeatedly turned away from the Lord and worshiped false gods. Those people were called Samaritans, and the ten tribes of the north disappeared completely. Later, the kingdom of Judah was taken captive to Babylon because of their continued sinfulness, and the Temple was destroyed, resulting in seventy years of exile. The Jews returned to Judah, rebuilt the Temple in Jerusalem, and continued to be ruled by the descendants of David. At the time of Jesus, the region of Judah was known as Judea and was under Roman rule. Jesus Christ and his disciples traveled throughout Judea preaching the good news of the Kingdom of God. After three and a half years, the Jews condemned Jesus as a blasphemer and handed him over to the Romans to be crucified. Three days later, he rose from the dead and appeared to his disciples, instructing them to preach the gospel to all nations. But before being arrested, Jesus predicted the destruction of Jerusalem and the Temple, and the scattering of the Jews. This event happened in AD 70 when the Roman general Titus destroyed Jerusalem. For eighteen hundred years, the Jews have been scattered among all nations. In the twentieth century, in 1948, this prophecy came true. The nation of Israel was reestablished, and once again the Jews returned to the Land of Promise. Christians around the world rejoice and praise God, but still, why is there so much suffering in the world? This story has a purpose.
