english: Aye nogochwa mobaso na botuko, na omobani agochwe amo naye. Inche ninsirie nyoko.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo arigetwe na kobekwa erieta ri’omoruoti Ahaswero, na akabekwa ekemanyererio ki’ebonyi yaye. Erio amarube ayio akairwa nabariini be chibarasi chiare kominyoka bwango chiarwete ase obweri bwe chibarasi chi’omoruoti.
english: Mordecai wrote in the name of King Xerxes, sealed the dispatches with the king's signet ring, and sent them by mounted couriers, who rode fast horses especially bred for the king.

ekegusii: Ninkore oroiboro rwao rogenderere koba ne chinguru botambe, nintenenie ekerogo kiao ki’obonene kebe ase ebiaare bionsi.”
english: 'I will establish your line forever and make your throne firm through all generations.'" Selah

ekegusii: korende agekora buna tarenge nobonene, akaimokia ekieni ki’omosomba, akaba omogwekano o mwanyabanto.
english: but made himself nothing, taking the very nature of a servant, being made in human likeness.

ekegusii: Natebire aya ase okobakonya; tari ng’a nkobabekera nde egetango, korende ase engencho y’ayio abagwenerete, erinde monyare gokorera Omonene motang’usiri namang’ana ande.
english: I am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but that you may live in a right way in undivided devotion to the Lord.

ekegusii: mogende ase obwanchani, buna Kristo atwanchete intwe, naende akerua ere omonyene ase engencho yaito, akaba esadaka na ekeng’wanso, bire ogotioka okuya ase Nyasae.
english: and live a life of love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us as a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God.

ekegusii: “Rora, omosomba one oyonachorire, omwanchwa one, omoyo one ogokirie nere. Nimobekere Omoika one, nere nararerie abanto b’Ebisaku ekina.
english: "Here is my servant whom I have chosen, the one I love, in whom I delight; I will put my Spirit on him, and he will proclaim justice to the nations.

ekegusii: Moabu negetaabo kiane ngoisabera, nindute egekoroto kiane igoro ase Edomu, ning’ake eriogi ri’okobua igoro y’ense y’Abafilisti.”
english: Moab is my washbasin, upon Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."

ekegusii: Nimanyete ng’a amatuko ng’ang’e are ndarue ase obomenyo obo. Aya naro Omonene oito Yeso Kristo anyorogetie.
english: because I know that I will soon put it aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.

ekegusii: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah;
english: Reuben na Simeoni, Lawi na Yuda;

ekegusii: Erio abanto baria batano bakarua aroro, bakagenda goika omochie o Laisi. Na agwo bakarora buna abanto bamenyete bare nobogima botari nobwoba, buna abanto ba Sidoni. Nigo barenge abanto abatoereru na ab’omorembe, bataremeiri gento korwa ase riroba. Nigo bamenyete are korwa ase Abasidoni, naende tibarenge gosanga nabanto bande.
english: So the five men left and came to Laish, where they saw that the people were living in safety, like the Sidonians, unsuspecting and secure. And since their land lacked nothing, they were prosperous. Also, they lived a long way from the Sidonians and had no relationship with anyone else.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akarua korwa ase chitugo chiaye ching’iti chiare koruegwa ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ebia mambia na ebia mogoroba, na ebie Chisabato, na ebi’Emetienyi Emeyia, na ebi’Amatuko Amanene ande achikire ase amachiko ’Omonene.
english: The king contributed from his own possessions for the morning and evening burnt offerings and for the burnt offerings on the Sabbaths, New Moons and appointed feasts as written in the Law of the LORD.

ekegusii: Agwo ase momenyete ase emechie yaino timobaisa korierao ensemo ya ikomi y’endagera yaino, gose ey’edivai, gose ey’amaguta ’amazeituni, gose chintangi chiaino chie chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ne chimbori, gose ebi mwarierete Omonene eira komoruera, gose okoruegwa kwaino kw’ogwancha, gose okoruegwa konde gwonsi.
english: You must not eat in your own towns the tithe of your grain and new wine and oil, or the firstborn of your herds and flocks, or whatever you have vowed to give, or your freewill offerings or special gifts.

ekegusii: Oyo o kabere Kileabu, omwana bw’Abigaeli, oyotigetwe omoboraka, orenge moka Nabali o Karimeli; na oyo o gatato Abisalomu o Maaka, mosubati o Talimai, omoruoti o Gesuri.
english: his second, Kileab the son of Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel; the third, Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Usieli: Aminadabu, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na ikomi na babere (112).
english: from the descendants of Uzziel, Amminadab the leader and 112 relatives.

ekegusii: Aye togechigwa ase engencho y’abagokora amabe, gose tobaisa koba ne ribero ase abakori amabe.
english: Do not fret because of evil men or be envious of the wicked,

ekegusii: Inwe renta ensemo ya ikomi eng’ikeranu ase ekungo y’enyomba yane, erinde endagera ebe ase enyomba yane. Ase enchera eyio inwe monteeme gose tinkobaigorera ebibao bia igoro mbaumorere ogosesenigwa okonge mono gotari korengeka. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteba.
english: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house. Test me in this," says the LORD Almighty, "and see if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing that you will not have room enough for it.

ekegusii: Inee! Omonene naagete Abaisraeli buna aagete ababisa babo? Gose Abaisraeli mbaitetwe buna ababisa babo baitetwe?
english: Has [the LORD] struck her as he struck down those who struck her? Has she been killed as those were killed who killed her?

ekegusii: “Ayio naro agerete bare bosio bw’ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae, na barabwo nigo bakomokorera omobaso na obotuko ase Hekalu yaye; ere oyoikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene igo aramenye amo nabarabwo na kobarenda.
english: Therefore, "they are before the throne of God and serve him day and night in his temple; and he who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.

ekegusii: Erio akarua agwo, akagenda ebitunwa ebire ensemo ya moocha ya Beteli, agatenenia eema yaye aroro. Korwa aase agwo Beteli nigo orenge ensemo ya bosongo, na Ai ensemo ya moocha. Na agwo akaagachera Omonene egesasimero akarangeria erieta ri’Omonene.
english: From there he went on toward the hills east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the name of the LORD.

ekegusii: “Naeire Abalawi ensemo ya ikomi, eye Abaisraeli bakorua, ebe eyabo, ebe eng’eria ase emeremo eye barabe bagokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: "I give to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance in return for the work they do while serving at the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Korende Sulemani nere omoagacherete enyomba.
english: But it was Solomon who built the house for him.

ekegusii: Okoboko kwane nigo kwairete chinibo chi’abanto buna ebiswa bie chinyoni bikoirwa. Nigo nkobongania ense yonsi buna amagena e chinyoni atigirwe akobonganigwa; onde tanyegeretie orobaba rwaye, gose komaanora omonwa oye, gose kwemunyia.”
english: As one reaches into a nest, so my hand reached for the wealth of the nations; as men gather abandoned eggs, so I gathered all the countries; not one flapped a wing, or opened its mouth to chirp.'"

ekegusii: Na bono, omonene one omoruoti, amaiso ’abanto bonsi b’Abaisraeli naye arigereretie, obatebie ng’a ning’o oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki’oboruoti, aye omoruoti one, nyuma gokwarureo.
english: My lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, to learn from you who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, imoka, ogambie ense ekina, ekiagera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nabao.
english: Rise up, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are your inheritance.

ekegusii: “Igo enga buna omonto ore kogenda orogendo, akarangeria abasomba baye, akabeka enibo yaye asebare.
english: "Again, it will be like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted his property to them.

ekegusii: Korende Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Tinagotebia ng’a amang’ana onsi Omonene agontebia, ayio naro ndakore?”
english: Balaam answered, "Did I not tell you I must do whatever the LORD says?"

ekegusii: Daudi agatiga ise na ng’ina bare agwo ase omoruoti o Moabu; barabwo bakagenderera komenya agwo ase engaki yonsi Daudi abete bwebisete ase rikuruma.
english: So he left them with the king of Moab, and they stayed with him as long as David was in the stronghold.

ekegusii: Ekero Isaka akoorire gosesenia Yakobo, na Yakobo karure ase obosio bwa Isaka ise, Esau omwabo agacha korwa ase obotwari bwaye.
english: After Isaac finished blessing him and Jacob had scarcely left his father's presence, his brother Esau came in from hunting.

ekegusii: Erio agetweka ebitonga biria, akairana omochie, akorokia ng’ina biara eyio achorete. Naende akamoa endagera eria yatigarete ekero ariete akaigota.
english: She carried it back to town, and her mother-in-law saw how much she had gathered. Ruth also brought out and gave her what she had left over after she had eaten enough.

ekegusii: Amorokererio ’omonto omong’aini nigo are ensoko y’obogima, ekiagera nigo agokonya omonto tabwatwa noboreba bw’amakweri.
english: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.

ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akabeka amang’ana ase ebirengererio biane gosangereria abanene abasikire, na abatang’ani, na abanto bonsi, erinde barikwe ase omoroberio bwe chinderia chi’abachete ritangani. Abwo nigo barikire iga:
english: So my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles, the officials and the common people for registration by families. I found the genealogical record of those who had been the first to return. This is what I found written there:

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Obobe nabotuboke korwa sugusu, erinde bobachere abanto bonsi bare ase ense eye.
english: The LORD said to me, "From the north disaster will be poured out on all who live in the land.

ekegusii: Nigo ainyorete ng’a barabwo mwanyabanto bagosira, nigo banga buna embeo egoeta na tekoirana.
english: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.

ekegusii: “Bara Abalawi enyomba ase enyomba, na eamate ase eamate. Orike kera omonto omosacha okoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania.”
english: "Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every male a month old or more."

ekegusii: Bagakora emeremo yabo, kera oyomo aase aye, koreng’ana namachiko a Musa, omonto o Nyasae. Abakuani bakanyororokeria amanyinga aria banyorete korwa ase amaboko ’Abalawi.
english: Then they took up their regular positions as prescribed in the Law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood handed to them by the Levites.

ekegusii: Bono nakoagacheire enyomba y’obonene, ebe obomenyo bwao aase oramenye kogenderera botambe.”
english: I have built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever."

ekegusii: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
english: Enosu akaibora Kenani, na Kenani akaibora Mahalaleli, na Mahalaleli akaibora Yaredi;

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni bw’egesaku gia Sabuloni, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the third day, Eliab son of Helon, the leader of the people of Zebulun, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Ekero morabugie ekerombeta ase eriogi ri’ogotabobora, abanto bare ase ebitwori bi’ensemo ya moocha baimoke bachake orogendo rwabo.
english: When a trumpet blast is sounded, the tribes camping on the east are to set out.

ekegusii: naende omosomba tari komenya nyomba botambe, korende omobiare nigo akomenya botambe.
english: Now a slave has no permanent place in the family, but a son belongs to it forever.

ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko ebiita biao mbibe biigoire botambe, tibigosiekwa, na abanto mbabe bagokorentera obotenenku bw’ebisaku, na abaruoti babo babe bakobatang’ana.
english: Your gates will always stand open, they will never be shut, day or night, so that men may bring you the wealth of the nations-- their kings led in triumphal procession.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baruete abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, bakaba ebing’wanso ase ebirecha.
english: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

ekegusii: Nigo akoa abanto abwo bamoirogete endagera; nabe ogendererete koinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania goika kare na kare.
english: He provides food for those who fear him; he remembers his covenant forever.

ekegusii: Barabwo nabana b’abanto abariri na ab’abakayayu; nigo baseretigwe nemecharichi barue ase ense.
english: A base and nameless brood, they were driven out of the land.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti aigwete amang’ana ’omokungu oria, agatandora chianga chiaye. Ere nigo arenge gotaara ase orwaki igoro, na abanto barenge ang’e bakarora obegete chianga chie chigunia korwa ime ase omobere oye.
english: When the king heard the woman's words, he tore his robes. As he went along the wall, the people looked, and there, underneath, he had sackcloth on his body.

ekegusii: Raeli akabora, “Ase okoamererania okonene nabeire nkoamererania na mosubati ominto, nabuire.” Ase igo akamoroka Nafutali.
english: Then Rachel said, "I have had a great struggle with my sister, and I have won." So she named him Naphtali.

ekegusii: Naki konya tibaramanya ririko, ng’a nemogwenerete koboka korwa ase abakure.
english: (They still did not understand from Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.)

ekegusii: (Ogotera gw’Esabato) Nigo ere buya gokoakera aye Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, na gotera ase ogotogia erieta riao, aye Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.
english: A psalm. A song. For the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD and make music to your name, O Most High,

ekegusii: Na barabwo bakarua ase ekegambero keria, bagogete ekiagera konya babarirwe ng’a bagweneire korenterwa obosooku ase engencho y’Erieta eri.
english: The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing because they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.

ekegusii: Naboigo Haroni arabogorie amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase egesembe keria gi’ekina igoro y’enkoro yaye ekero agosoa ime y’Aase Aachenu, ayarente abe ekeinyorio botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: "Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he will bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of decision as a continuing memorial before the LORD.

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bakagenda ase Farao, bagakora buna Omonene abachigete. Haroni akaruta enyimbo yaye bosio bwa Farao na bw’abasomba baye, na ero ekaonchoka ekaba eng’iti.
english: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and did just as the LORD commanded. Aaron threw his staff down in front of Pharaoh and his officials, and it became a snake.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Ibrahimu akaigwera Nyasae ekero arangeretigwe kogenda goika aase aria achiete konyora abe omwando oye, akaimoka akagenda, tamanya aase agochia.
english: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, even though he did not know where he was going.

ekegusii: Yehu agatoma amang’ana ase Abaisraeli bonsi, na abakoreri ba Baali bonsi bagacha, goika nonya nomonto oyomo tatigara otachete. Bagasoa enyomba ya Baali, na enyomba eria egaichora nabanto churi.
english: Then he sent word throughout Israel, and all the ministers of Baal came; not one stayed away. They crowded into the temple of Baal until it was full from one end to the other.

ekegusii: Igoro chionsi nechi’Omonene, korende ense ero oyeire mwanyabanto.
english: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth he has given to man.

ekegusii: Ere nabe ne ribaga ri’okoria okoruegwa kw’endagera gokoruegwa asende inche Nyasae oye, okoruegwa okore ogochenu, amo nokore ogochenu mono.
english: He may eat the most holy food of his God, as well as the holy food;

ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto ba Dani bagachora korwa ase chiamate chiabo abarwani batano, korwa ase omochie o Sora, na obw’Esitaoli, bakabatoma bagende koroota ense, na koyerata. Ekero abanto baria chirooti baigete ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu bakagenda ase enyomba ya Mika, bakarara aroro.
english: So the Danites sent five warriors from Zorah and Eshtaol to spy out the land and explore it. These men represented all their clans. They told them, "Go, explore the land." The men entered the hill country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micah, where they spent the night.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Genda ase omochie ase omonto gete, momotebie: Omworokia otebire: Engaki yane yaikire ang’e; nyomba mwao nao ndariere Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane.”
english: He replied, "Go into the city to a certain man and tell him, 'The Teacher says: My appointed time is near. I am going to celebrate the Passover with my disciples at your house.'"

ekegusii: Yehu akarigereria gochia ase ekebao, akaboria, “Ning’o ore ase ensemo yane? Ning’o?” Abasacha bagombaetigwe babere, gose batato, bakamorigereria gochia isiko.
english: He looked up at the window and called out, "Who is on my side? Who?" Two or three eunuchs looked down at him.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one kwang’orokeirie inche omosomba oo, ng’a nong’agachere enyomba. Ase ayio inche, omosomba oo, nabeire noboremu ase enkoro yane kogosaba ogosaba oko.
english: "You, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build a house for him. So your servant has found courage to pray to you.

ekegusii: Adonia na abageni bonsi baria barenge amo nere, ekero bakoorire omoyega obo, bakaigwa amariogi aria. Na ekero Yoabu ayaigwete amo nebiroria, akaboria, “Ninki engencho y’amariogi aya amanene are ase omochie?”
english: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they were finishing their feast. On hearing the sound of the trumpet, Joab asked, "What's the meaning of all the noise in the city?"

ekegusii: “Obwatane na Nyasae, nario orabe nomorembe; korakore igo, nonyore amaya.
english: "Submit to God and be at peace with him; in this way prosperity will come to you.

ekegusii: Amaiso ao nigo ararore amang’ana amageni, na ebirengererio biao mbibe ebikorekanu.
english: Your eyes will see strange sights and your mind imagine confusing things.

ekegusii: “Naende ngwakorete obonyaka n’Abaasuri, ekiagera tigwaisanegete, ee, ngwakorete obotayayi nabarabwo, nonya naboigo tigwaisanegete.
english: You engaged in prostitution with the Assyrians too, because you were insatiable; and even after that, you still were not satisfied.

ekegusii: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito obogetie Yeso, ere inwe mwaitete, mokamosunga ase omote.
english: The God of our fathers raised Jesus from the dead-- whom you had killed by hanging him on a tree.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Yona akaimoka, akagenda Nineva buna Omonene amochigete. Omochie oria nigo orenge omonene mono, oisaine orogendo rw’amatuko atato ase okoyobutokania.
english: Jonah obeyed the word of the LORD and went to Nineveh. Now Nineveh was a very important city-- a visit required three days.

ekegusii: Abanto baria batano, abarootete ense eria ritang’ani, bagasoa enyomba eria, bakaimokia omogwekano oria obaachire, na egesibao keria ki’obokuani, na ebinyasae biria, na omogwekano oria onyititoire na kobombwa, na omokuani oria agatenena ase egeita amo nabanto baria amagana atano na rimo babogoretie ebirwanero bi’esegi.
english: The five men who had spied out the land went inside and took the carved image, the ephod, the other household gods and the cast idol while the priest and the six hundred armed men stood at the entrance to the gate.

ekegusii: Bono ngasangereria abanto abwo ase orooche rogotirimbokera gochia ase Ahawa, na agwo togatoora, tokabeera aroro ase amatuko atato. Ekero naitaaete abanto amo nabakuani, tinanyorete Abalawi aroro nonya noyomo.
english: I assembled them at the canal that flows toward Ahava, and we camped there three days. When I checked among the people and the priests, I found no Levites there.

ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nabeire ne risemi asore aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ekiagera Abaisraeli batigire okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania, batagoire ebisasimero biao, na baitire ababani bao nomoro, na inche bweka natigaire, nabarabwo igo bakorigia obogima bwane babosirie.”
english: He replied, "I have been very zealous for the LORD God Almighty. The Israelites have rejected your covenant, broken down your altars, and put your prophets to death with the sword. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me too."

ekegusii: Abafarisai na Abasadukai bagacha ase ogoteema Yeso, bakamosaba aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro.
english: The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus and tested him by asking him to show them a sign from heaven.

ekegusii: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
english: na Obali, na Abimaeli, na Seba,

ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bakamanora na koimoka korwa Elimu, na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o kabere nyuma kobarure ense ya Misiri, bagaika ase erooro ya Sini, eyio ere egati y’Elimu na Sinai.
english: The whole Israelite community set out from Elim and came to the Desert of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they had come out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Omorero okarua ase Hesiboni, chimeme chi’omorero korwa omochie o Sihoni, ogasaria Ari, omochie o Moabu, ogasamba abanene b’ebigoro bi’Arinoni.
english: "Fire went out from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It consumed Ar of Moab, the citizens of Arnon's heights.

ekegusii: Komorasabe kende gionsi ase erieta riane, ekio ningekore.
english: You may ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it.

ekegusii: Nerikire nababani: Bonsi naborokererigwe na Nyasae. Kera oyoigure na kworokererigwa na Tata, nigo agocha asende.
english: It is written in the Prophets: 'They will all be taught by God.' Everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him comes to me.

ekegusii: Ase obogima obo bwane obore bosa narorire kera egento; narorire omonto omonyaboronge ogosira ore ase oboronge bwaye, na omonyabibe okogenderera koba moyo amatuko amange ore ase ebibe biaye.
english: In this meaningless life of mine I have seen both of these: a righteous man perishing in his righteousness, and a wicked man living long in his wickedness.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, kaimokererigwe igoro ase ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae, naende kanyorire korwa ase Tata Omoika Omochenu oria arieretwe eira oiteire ayamwarorire na koyaigwa.
english: Exalted to the right hand of God, he has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.

ekegusii: Amagoro ayio onsi nigo areng’aine. Ebieni biabo nigo biarenge buna berulo, rigena rikomeka‐meka. Kera okogoro nigo kwaroisirie kogasoanigwa nokonde.
english: This was the appearance and structure of the wheels: They sparkled like chrysolite, and all four looked alike. Each appeared to be made like a wheel intersecting a wheel.

ekegusii: “Chituoni chiaitirwe ase esegi! Yonathani nao araire ase ebigoro igoro, oitire.”
english: "How the mighty have fallen in battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.

ekegusii: Abigail lost no time. She took two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five dressed sheep, five seahs of roasted grain, a hundred cakes of raisins and two hundred cakes of pressed figs, and loaded them on donkeys.
english: Erio agwo Abigaeli agasangereria emegati amagana abere na ebirandi bibere bi’amasankwa biichire nedivai, ne chinyama chie ching’ondi isano chiyekire, na ebigara bisambire ebitita ebinene bitano, na amasabibu amomo amabomba rigana erimo, na amako amomo amabomba amagana abere. Erio akabiberekia chitigere.

ekegusii: Buna abatomwa ba Kristo anga ntwabaritoerete, korende nigo tware abororo ase egati yaino, buna omokungu akorera abana baye.
english: but we were gentle among you, like a mother caring for her little children.

ekegusii: Ekiriri ki’omosabibu oyio nigo giatubete ebitunwa, ne chinsagia chiaye chikaranda gochia aase emecharake ya Nyasae ere.
english: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaba amo nomwana oria. Ere akamenya ase erooro, akaba omomanyi bw’okorasa nemegwe.
english: God was with the boy as he grew up. He lived in the desert and became an archer.

ekegusii: Rero inwe mwabeire mamincha y’enyomba ya tata, na mwaiteire abana baye abamura, abanto emerongo etano na ebere, ase rigena erimo igoro, naende mwabekire Abimeleki, omwana bw’omosomba oye omokungu, obeire omoruoti bw’abanto ba Sekemu, ekiagera are momura omino.
english: (but today you have revolted against my father's family, murdered his seventy sons on a single stone, and made Abimelech, the son of his slave girl, king over the citizens of Shechem because he is your brother)--

ekegusii: Korwa Sayoni Omonene narambore enyimbo yao y’obogambi ere nokobua, atebe, “Gamba ase egati y’ababisa bao.”
english: The LORD will extend your mighty scepter from Zion; you will rule in the midst of your enemies.

ekegusii: akamoboria, “Nomoiseke o ng’o ore? Naende ontebie gose ribaga ndire mwa iso toranyare korara botuko.”
english: Then he asked, "Whose daughter are you? Please tell me, is there room in your father's house for us to spend the night?"

ekegusii: Abanto baria batakwete bakariegwa namagumba, bakarera, na ekerero kiabo kegaika igoro.
english: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.

ekegusii: onye kogotuguta ebibe bire ase amaboko ao, na togotiga obobe bomenye ase eema yao,
english: if you put away the sin that is in your hand and allow no evil to dwell in your tent,

ekegusii: This is the account of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.
english: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeria rwa Tera. Tera akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani. Harani akaibora Loti.

ekegusii: nigo baare komoboria atebe “Shibolet”. Onye orenge goteba “Sibolet”, ekiagera tarenge konyara gwatora ring’ana riria boronge, nigo barenge komobwata, bamoitera agwo ase ebiambokero bia Yorodan. Ase engaki eria Abaefraimu chilifu emerongo ene bagaitwa.
english: they said, "All right, say 'Shibboleth.'" If he said, "Sibboleth," because he could not pronounce the word correctly, they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. Forty-two thousand Ephraimites were killed at that time.

ekegusii: Inchuo ang’e asende, omboorie, nsibore korwa ase ababisa baane!
english: Come near and rescue me; redeem me because of my foes.

ekegusii: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
english: Ibuhari na Eliasama, na Elifeleti,

ekegusii: tibokogokera obobe, korende bogokera ekeene.
english: Love does not delight in evil but rejoices with the truth.

ekegusii: onye naakanire omosani one amabe, gose nasakoire ebinto bi’omobisa one engencho ende etaiyo,
english: if I have done evil to him who is at peace with me or without cause have robbed my foe--

ekegusii: Agaichana ase omoika oye, akabora, “Naki ekegori eke gekorigia egekone? Ekeene nabatebirie: Ekegori eke tigekoegwa egekone buna eke.”
english: He sighed deeply and said, "Why does this generation ask for a miraculous sign? I tell you the truth, no sign will be given to it."

ekegusii: “Abaedomu nao bakare amo nabaruoti babo, na abagambi babo bonsi. Nonya barenge nokobua nigo baraire amo na baria baitetwe nemioro, batarogeti bagendete ase chimbeera.
english: "Edom is there, her kings and all her princes; despite their power, they are laid with those killed by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the pit.

ekegusii: Omosacha oria akaimoka ore nomosomba oyomo ne chitigere ibere, akagenda kogamba nere ase obwororo, agateema komoebereria airane nere. Omokungu oria akamosoyia nyomba mwa ise, na ise akamoroisia ase omogoko.
english: her husband went to her to persuade her to return. He had with him his servant and two donkeys. She took him into her father's house, and when her father saw him, he gladly welcomed him.

ekegusii: The lot came up for the tribe of Benjamin, clan by clan. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:
english: Obomera bwe ritang’ani bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamin. Orogongo rwabo rokaba egati y’orogongo rw’egesaku kia Yuda na orw’ekia Yusufu.

ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baane bagonchecheria, nigo nkoigwa buna amauga aane akonyatia. Nigo bagendererete kona‐komboria, “Nyasae oo, ng’ai are?”
english: My bones suffer mortal agony as my foes taunt me, saying to me all day long, "Where is your God?"

ekegusii: Ekero bambokire bagaika ense ya Genesareti, bakabeka ekerochi.
english: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and anchored there.

ekegusii: na Yonathani akamotebia Daudi. “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, abe kirori ase aya. Ase chinsa buna echi, ankio gose ankio ende, nindigie komanya ebirengererio bia tata buna bire igoro yao, na kondabimanye, ningotomere amang’ana, erinde obimanye.
english: Then Jonathan said to David: "By the LORD, the God of Israel, I will surely sound out my father by this time the day after tomorrow! If he is favorably disposed toward you, will I not send you word and let you know?

ekegusii: bakorera mono ekero bachia korora erioki ri’okoyia kwaye, bagateba, “Omochie ki ogwekaine omochie oyio omonene?”
english: When they see the smoke of her burning, they will exclaim, 'Was there ever a city like this great city?'

ekegusii: Omonene, koranche ontoorie! Omonene, oche bwango onkonye!
english: Be pleased, O LORD, to save me; O LORD, come quickly to help me.

ekegusii: Amang’ana akwanirwe kera aase ng’a obotomani mbore ase egati yaino, naende obotomani buna obwo tibwana kororekana nonya nase abanto b’Ebisaku, ng’a oyomo oino namenyaine na moga ise,
english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that does not occur even among pagans: A man has his father's wife.

ekegusii: Okwemurungania okonene gokaba ase egati y’omoganda ase engencho yaye. Abande bakabora, “Nigo are omonto omuya,” na abande bakabora, “Taibo, korende nigo agotantania omoganda.”
english: Among the crowds there was widespread whispering about him. Some said, "He is a good man." Others replied, "No, he deceives the people."

ekegusii: Ebirecha biria bigasoka korwa ase omonto oria, bigasoa chimbeche. Riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano goika chikagwa enyancha ime, chikarimera.
english: When the demons came out of the man, they went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.

ekegusii: “Obobe bwaino nabobarentere egesusuro; okogwa kwaino korwa ase okwegena nkogere motogonyerwe. Goika momanye na korora ng’a mwerenteire obobe na obororo ekero mwantigire inche Omonene, Nyasae oino, na timonyirogeti.” Nabo Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, atebire.
english: Your wickedness will punish you; your backsliding will rebuke you. Consider then and realize how evil and bitter it is for you when you forsake the LORD your God and have no awe of me," declares the Lord, the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Naende akaagacha emerobiri ase erooro, na agakunya chinsoko chinyinge, ekiagera nigo abwate amaicho amange agwo ase ense omweya na ase ense eimokererete igoro eraire, Boigo nabwate abaremi abange, na abakori emeremo b’emegondo y’emesabibu agwo ase chinse chi’ebigoro na ase chinse chintobu, ekiagera nigo anchete oboremi.
english: He also built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns, because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain. He had people working his fields and vineyards in the hills and in the fertile lands, for he loved the soil.

ekegusii: Barabwo goika baimokie amanyinga aria, bayagindie emetobwa ebere ya gesieri na omoribo o igoro bw’emetobwa, ase kera enyomba barayeriere emanwa eria.
english: Then they are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs.

ekegusii: Ase igo abasomba baye bakamotebia, “Tiga aye omonene oito omoruoti origerigwe omoiseke omwekungi; ere abe ogokorenda na kogokorera. Boigo abe ogokorarisia, akobekere riberera.”
english: So his servants said to him, "Let us look for a young virgin to attend the king and take care of him. She can lie beside him so that our lord the king may keep warm."

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Manase bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Manasseh: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: Ekero babasokirie isiko, oyomo obo akabatebia, “Tama, motoorie obogima bwaino; timorigereria nyuma, gose timotenena aande onsi ase ense eraire. Motame gochia ase ebitunwa, timobaisa gosira.”
english: As soon as they had brought them out, one of them said, "Flee for your lives! Don't look back, and don't stop anywhere in the plain! Flee to the mountains or you will be swept away!"

ekegusii: nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na ibere, na amagana atano na abere (62,700).
english: The number from the tribe of Dan was 62,700.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano, na amagana ane (45,400).
english: These were the clans of Naphtali; those numbered were 45,400.

ekegusii: Omonda na omotaka nigo bamenyete ase obogima obomo; Omonene nere omotongi o bonsi.
english: Rich and poor have this in common: The LORD is the Maker of them all.

ekegusii: Korende karache Omokonyi, oyo ndabatomere korwa ase Tata, Omoika bw’Ekeene okorwa ase Tata, ere nambere kirori.
english: "When the Counselor comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who goes out from the Father, he will testify about me.

ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora ng’a nigo airaneria ase obong’aini, akamotebia, “Aye tori are korwa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.” Korwa erio monto onde tanyara komoboria ring’ana naende.
english: When Jesus saw that he had answered wisely, he said to him, "You are not far from the kingdom of God." And from then on no one dared ask him any more questions.

ekegusii: Akanyenya boigo eeri amo nemingichi, chikaba ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase engencho y’abanto. Abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga ’ebing’wanso ebio, nere akayasiarera ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: He slaughtered the ox and the ram as the fellowship offering for the people. His sons handed him the blood, and he sprinkled it against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: Bono nigo are maiso marore, ng’a onde tari oranyore oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase amachiko; ekiagera nigo arikire, “Omonyene oboronge nabe moyo ase okwegena.”
english: Clearly no one is justified before God by the law, because, "The righteous will live by faith."

ekegusii: Samison akaba omogambi bw’Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, ekero Abafilisti baare kogambera ense eria.
english: Samson led Israel for twenty years in the days of the Philistines.

ekegusii: Abanto mbabe bakoraria ogokora kwao okonene gw’okoirokia, nainche nimbe nkoraria obonene bwao.
english: They will tell of the power of your awesome works, and I will proclaim your great deeds.

ekegusii: Gasamu, na Usa, na Pasea;
english: Gazzam, Uzza, Paseah,

ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akobeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y’endagera, orosa gokobogoria gocha ase omonwa oye.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

ekegusii: Kera omonto oyobwegenete ng’a Yeso nere Kristo oiboirwe na Nyasae, na kera oyoramwanche omoibori, omwanchire na oyoiboirwe nere.
english: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone who loves the father loves his child as well.

ekegusii: Ekero baria barigetwe chinsa ikomi nemo bachete, bakanyora kera oyomo edinari eyemo.
english: "The workers who were hired about the eleventh hour came and each received a denarius.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okomenta oborori bwao igoro yane, na kwamentera ekeririanda igoro yane. Nigo okona‐kondetera ababisa bakondwania.
english: You bring new witnesses against me and increase your anger toward me; your forces come against me wave upon wave.

ekegusii: Mbatugute chifeta chiabo ase chinchera; chitahabu chiabo nchibarwe chibe buna egento ki’eubi. Chifeta ne chitahabu chiabo tichikonyara kobatooria ase rituko ri’endamwamu y’Omonene. Ebinto ebio tibigoisanekia okogania kwabo, gose tibikobaigotia, ekiagera nigo biabete ebigocha bikagera bagakora ebibe.
english: They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will be an unclean thing. Their silver and gold will not be able to save them in the day of the LORD's wrath. They will not satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs with it, for it has made them stumble into sin.

ekegusii: Ahieseri orenge omonene obo, naende Yoashi; aba babere mbasinto ba Semaa korwa Gibea; Yesieli na Peleti basinto b’Asimaweti; Beraka na Yehu korwa Anatoti;
english: Ahiezer their chief and Joash the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah, Jehu the Anathothite,

ekegusii: Na rora, eriogi rikorwa igoro rigateba, “Oyo nere Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie nere.”
english: And a voice from heaven said, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased."

ekegusii: Ontomire ase abwo baichanete bare Sayoni, mbabekere chigutwa chi’ebisicha ase emetwe yabo ribaga rie ribu, na mbaake amaguta ay’omogoko ribaga ri’omoichano, naende mbabekere chingobo chi’amasikani ribaga ri’emeika yairianyekire. Erio barokwe “Emete y’oboronge”, mbabe ebimeri Omonene asimegete, erinde atogigwe.
english: and provide for those who grieve in Zion-- to bestow on them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of gladness instead of mourning, and a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair. They will be called oaks of righteousness, a planting of the LORD for the display of his splendor.

ekegusii: Ring’ana erio nario Omonene akwanete igoro y’ense ya Moabu agwo kare.
english: This is the word the LORD has already spoken concerning Moab.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria emechando emenene egacha igoro ase ekanisa ya Yerusalemu; bonsi bagaserebanigwa gochia chinse chia Boyahudi na Samaria, otatiga abatomwa bataserebanetigwe.
english: And Saul was there, giving approval to his death. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church at Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.

ekegusii: Omwana one, ing’a enkoro yao, na amaiso ao tiga agokere chinchera chiane.
english: My son, give me your heart and let your eyes keep to my ways,

ekegusii: Kera oyomo bw’abaagachi nigo eboeranetie omoyio oye o birende kenema kiaye ekero agendererete koagacha; na omobugia egetureri nigo ateneine ang’e nainche.
english: and each of the builders wore his sword at his side as he worked. But the man who sounded the trumpet stayed with me.

ekegusii: Chinyasi chia ime chie Hekalu enyene agachituba ne chibao chi’emetarakwa, naende agachiooma ne chitahabu chingiya, agachichabera nemegwekano y’emekendo na ey’ebinyuri.
english: He paneled the main hall with pine and covered it with fine gold and decorated it with palm tree and chain designs.

ekegusii: “Mobare chichuma isano na ibere korwa ase rituko rigotunyana eri’Esabato, rituko riria mokorentera Omonene riboa ri’ogotongora rigosungusigwa.
english: "'From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, count off seven full weeks.

ekegusii: Ase obogima bwaye bwonsi nigo abeire okoria endagera ore ase omosunte, obeire ogwechanda ore nobororo na okogechigwa.
english: All his days he eats in darkness, with great frustration, affliction and anger.

ekegusii: Eboeranie oborori, na obeke amachiko aane ekemanyererio, ime ase chinkoro chi’aborokigwa baane.
english: Bind up the testimony and seal up the law among my disciples.

ekegusii: Boigo akaagacha emechie ase ense y’ebigoro, na ase amanani akaagacha chiburi na emerobiri.
english: He built towns in the Judean hills and forts and towers in the wooded areas.

ekegusii: Moakere Nyasae o igoro ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: Give thanks to the God of heaven. His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Ase ogoita okwo kwe ritang’ani, okwo Yonathani na omomura oria bakorete, nigo baitete abanto koreng’ana emerongo ebere ase egetii kiarenge keng’ana ekeng’ese ki’omogondo oremire ne chiombe ibere ase rituko erimo.
english: In that first attack Jonathan and his armor-bearer killed some twenty men in an area of about half an acre.

ekegusii: Inche tingokiri nogokwa kw’omonto onde bwensi; ase ayio oonchoka mobe moyo. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Sovereign LORD. Repent and live!

ekegusii: Aye gwekoreire abanto bao Abaisraeli babe abanto bao kare na kare, naye Omonene kwabeire Nyasae obo.
english: You made your people Israel your very own forever, and you, O LORD, have become their God.

ekegusii: Naki ebirwanero biaito bi’esegi tibiri ebia mwanyabanto, korende mbire nokobua kwa Nyasae koiyeria chindwaki.
english: The weapons we fight with are not the weapons of the world. On the contrary, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.

ekegusii: Chingongo chi’omogambi nigo chirabebekane norw’Abalawi na orw’omochie, naende chibe ase egati y’orw’Abayuda na orw’Ababenjamin.
english: So the property of the Levites and the property of the city will lie in the center of the area that belongs to the prince. The area belonging to the prince will lie between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin.

ekegusii: Who knows the power of your anger? For your wrath is as great as the fear that is due you.
english: Ning’o omanyete okobua kw’endamwamu yao, na ogw’ekeririanda kiao, erinde akoiroke?

ekegusii: ere abakore mobe abaikeranu ase kera ogokora okuya, monyare gokora obwanchani bwaye, naende akore ime yaino ayagwenerete ase obosio bwaye goetera ase Yeso Kristo. Asare ere obonene bwa kare na kare. Amina.
english: equip you with everything good for doing his will, and may he work in us what is pleasing to him, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria Omonene atabarereti ebibe biaye.”
english: Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord will never count against him."

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bakwomania Musa na Haroni; bonsi bagakwana “Nigo anga yaba buya onye ntwakwerete Misiri, gose ase erooro eye.
english: All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole assembly said to them, "If only we had died in Egypt! Or in this desert!

ekegusii: Nonya nabana abake banchayire; ekero ngotenena nigo bagonkwana bobe.
english: Even the little boys scorn me; when I appear, they ridicule me.

ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’Abaisraeli nigo bobaberete kirori. Abaisraeli na Abaefraimu mbagochwe bagwe ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, na Abayuda mbagwe amo nabarabwo.
english: Israel's arrogance testifies against them; the Israelites, even Ephraim, stumble in their sin; Judah also stumbles with them.

ekegusii: Abayahudi amo nabatang’ani babo abarenge koragera amo nainche nigo barenge rigana erimo, na emerongo etano. Naende abanto b’ebisaku binde abamenyete ase chinsemo chiaito chionsi nigo barenge gocha baragera amo nainche.
english: Furthermore, a hundred and fifty Jews and officials ate at my table, as well as those who came to us from the surrounding nations.

ekegusii: Bono nkoboria nde, “Inee! Nigo bagochirwe goika bagure kegima?” Yaya, taibo! Korende ase ogosaria kwabo ogotooreka gwaikeire abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde Abaisraeli bakorwe babe ne ribero.
english: Again I ask: Did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Not at all! Rather, because of their transgression, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel envious.

ekegusii: Korende tinkogochanda kobua, nagosoroire ototegerere ase amang’ana amake ase ogwancha kwao.
english: But in order not to weary you further, I would request that you be kind enough to hear us briefly.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani amorenge naende, na onye richoncho riria tiriesiarereti ase risankwa, na tirikoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio ochenekire, ase igo asibie chianga chiaye, abe oyochenegete kegima.
english: On the seventh day the priest is to examine the itch, and if it has not spread in the skin and appears to be no more than skin deep, the priest shall pronounce him clean. He must wash his clothes, and he will be clean.

ekegusii: Abanyene ense eria, ekero barora eng’iti eria esung’unaine ase okoboko kwaye, bagatebania, “Takomocha omonto oyo koba omoiti, nonya otooregete korwa ase enyancha, oboronge tibokomotiga abe moyo.”
english: When the islanders saw the snake hanging from his hand, they said to each other, "This man must be a murderer; for though he escaped from the sea, Justice has not allowed him to live."

ekegusii: Ninde nobwoba ase engencho y’amariogi ’ababisa baane, na ase engencho y’obobe bw’abakori amabe. Abanto abwo nigo bakondetera amaakwa, bakongecha bare nendamwamu.
english: at the voice of the enemy, at the stares of the wicked; for they bring down suffering upon me and revile me in their anger.

ekegusii: Imomanyete buya mono korigia abanchi, nonya nabakungu abanyaka begire chinchera chiaino chimbe.
english: How skilled you are at pursuing love! Even the worst of women can learn from your ways.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya nkarora abamalaika bane bateneine ase chinsemo inye chi’ense, bagotanga chimbeo inye chi’ense, erinde embeo tegusa igoro ase ense, nonya nigoro ase enyancha gose ase omote onde bwonsi.
english: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth to prevent any wind from blowing on the land or on the sea or on any tree.

ekegusii: Musa agachika abanto ase rituko erio erio, agakwana,
english: On the same day Moses commanded the people:

ekegusii: Omoruoti, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, nigo agoteba iga: Ekeene, buna inde moyo, oyomo onga buna Tabori ase egati y’ebitunwa binde na onga buna Karimeli, egetunwa kere ang’e nenyancha, ngocha are.
english: "As surely as I live," declares the King, whose name is the LORD Almighty, "one will come who is like Tabor among the mountains, like Carmel by the sea.

ekegusii: Ekero esukuru enene ya Gusii eraagachwe seito Gusii, nigo erarete obuya obonene seito. Obunge o Nyaribari Masaba,Sam Ongeri natebete omwaka oyo oera inga tiga toagache esukuru enene aaria ase omogongo o Simbauti ase ensemo ya Borabu. Dr. John Akama, Vice Chachellor, Kisii University College Eyunivasiti ya Gusii (Kisii University College) nigo erarete amagenderero amange buna: - Amabaga ande amange nigo aratoke ya abana baito gosoma chisemi chinene. Bono iga abana abange tibari gosoma buna batagete nonya baetire amatemwa ase engencho ya amabaga gotatoka. - Ekero eyunivasiti eraagachwe, nigo erarente chigasi chinyinge ase Gusii yaito. Nigo esukuru eyio erarike abarimu amo na abakori emeremo be chinamuna chinyinge. Abaremi baito nabarabwo nigo baratware ase bakoonia chindagera. - Esukuru enene koagachwa negere chibara chinyinge chirosigwe amo no omorero kong’uswa. Ekero omochango oraanse, tiga tobwaterane toagache eyunivasiti yaito.
english: This great school of Gusii was established by the people of Gusii, and it has grown into a large school. It started as a primary school and then a secondary school, but we haven't reached university level yet. The Member of Parliament for Nyaribari Masaba, Sam Ongeri, helped greatly that year to build this big school for the children of Simbauti and the residents of Borabu. Dr. John Akama, Vice Chancellor, Kisii University College The Gusii University (Kisii University College) was established with the following objectives: - These courses were created so that many children can get a good education. This helps those children who didn't manage to study because they lacked resources to benefit from the available courses. - This university was established to provide higher education to the people of Gusii. That school attracts teachers and workers who contribute significantly. Many graduates are employed in various sectors. - The big school was built with a lot of effort and resources. This development plan aims to help develop this university.
