ekegusii: With the bulls, rams and lambs, prepare their grain offerings and drink offerings according to the number specified.
english: Mochirue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochikire koruegwa amo ne chieri chiria, ne chimingichi chiria, ne chimanwa chiria, koreng’ana nomobaro obo. Boigo mochirue koreng’ana nomoroberio ochikire.

ekegusii: Ase ayio arente korwa ase riicho riaye emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha. Naye oyekorere rigori. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’okomocha koria akorire mosiabano atancheti, na omonto oria naaberwe.
english: He is to bring to the priest as a guilt offering a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value. In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the wrong he has committed unintentionally, and he will be forgiven.

ekegusii: Korende ekero bayerengete ase ebirengo, oyosangereretie enyinge tatigaria kende, na ere oyosangereretie enke taremeretwe gento. Kera oyomo konya osangereirie buna okoria kwaye kwang’ana.
english: And when they measured it by the omer, he who gathered much did not have too much, and he who gathered little did not have too little. Each one gathered as much as he needed.

ekegusii: Ne chinswe chire ase orooche ime inachikwe, chigunde, na orooche narotioke bobe, na Abamisiri nabasinywe konywa amache aria.”
english: The fish in the Nile will die, and the river will stink; the Egyptians will not be able to drink its water.'"

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaito! Ning’o oratotoorie korwa ase amaboko e chinyasae echio chire nokobua gotoetania?
english: Woe to us! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? They are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the desert.

ekegusii: Agachia koyaigwa, akabatebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omorwaria, otatiga abarwarete.
english: On hearing this, Jesus said, "It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.

ekegusii: Erio Ibrahimu agatebia abamura abarenge komo, “Ikaransa inwe aiga amo netigere! Inche amo nomwana oyo one nkogenda tore gochia aria, tosasime, erio toirane asemore naende.”
english: He said to his servants, "Stay here with the donkey while I and the boy go over there. We will worship and then we will come back to you."

ekegusii: The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and then those of the other.
english: Erio abarwani bakagenda, bakabuna amagoro abo, oyo bwe ritang’ani, na oyo o kabere, abwo babambetwe amo na Yeso.

ekegusii: “Inee! Omonene natotigire kegima? Tagotororera amabera rinde?
english: "Will the Lord reject forever? Will he never show his favor again?

ekegusii: “Otebie Abaisraeli ng’a omokungu karabe morito na aibore omwana omoisia nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, amatuko ang’ana buna ekero abwate omotienyi abe oyotachenegeti.
english: "Say to the Israelites: 'A woman who becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son will be ceremonially unclean for seven days, just as she is unclean during her monthly period.

ekegusii: Ningoke na gochenga ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera; aye igo ogwechandera emechando yane, na kondengereria mono ase ogochandwa kwane.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in your love, for you saw my affliction and knew the anguish of my soul.

ekegusii: Naama! Ninkore ring’ana riyia; ring’ana erio riachakire kooroka; Inee! Timorirochi? Nindoisie enchera ase erooro, nintubokie chindooche ase ense enyomo,
english: See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the desert and streams in the wasteland.

ekegusii: Korende rituko ria kabere mambia, Nyasae agachika rikonde rikaria omobono oria, erinde ogasusana.
english: But at dawn the next day God provided a worm, which chewed the vine so that it withered.

ekegusii: Ekero emeremo eria yaerete chibesa chiria chiatigarete chikarentwa ase omoruoti na Yehoyada. Korwa ase chibesa echio chie chifeta na echie chitahabu ebikorero bi’enyomba y’Omonene bikaroisigwa, ebitaabo na ebinto binde bigokorerwa ase omosangererekano, na ebi’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’ogosambera ubani. Abanto bakaba bakorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase enyomba y’Omonene kogenderera botambe ase obogima bwonsi bwa Yehoyada.
english: When they had finished, they brought the rest of the money to the king and Jehoiada, and with it were made articles for the LORD's temple: articles for the service and for the burnt offerings, and also dishes and other objects of gold and silver. As long as Jehoiada lived, burnt offerings were presented continually in the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Aye omoiseke, igwa! Ntegerera mono! Eba bono abanto baino na ab’enyomba ya iso.
english: Listen, O daughter, consider and give ear: Forget your people and your father's house.

ekegusii: Then Jesus said to them, "Give to Caesar what is Caesar's and to God what is God's." And they were amazed at him.
english: Yeso akabatebia, “Ebire bia Kaisari, moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae, moe Nyasae.” Bakamokumia mono.

ekegusii: Na ekero ekio abanto abange inabagwe korwa ase okwegena kwabo, inabasigaanane na kobekana ase ababisa babo, naende nabagechane,
english: At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other,

ekegusii: Erio bakaroisia amarondia ikomi na rimo ay’amanya e chigoree, akaba eema y’ogotuba Obomenyo boria.
english: They made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle-- eleven altogether.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Igo mwachire buna mokoimokera omouri nemioro ne chinungu, gocha kong’ira?
english: "Am I leading a rebellion," said Jesus, "that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me?

ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae aroche aya bakorete, buna baonchogete bagatiga ogokora kwabo kw’ebibe, ere akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, tabakorera aria konya atebire ng’a abakorere.
english: When God saw what they did and how they turned from their evil ways, he had compassion and did not bring upon them the destruction he had threatened.

ekegusii: Kobwachia gokia, tibamanya ense eria, otatiga baroche omosomo ore nengegu, bagatebania gosoyia emeeri aroro, keranyarekane.
english: When daylight came, they did not recognize the land, but they saw a bay with a sandy beach, where they decided to run the ship aground if they could.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya ng’a ngosoerana more inwe ase inwe nigo are ase okobugwa kwaino. Inki motanchereti gokorerwa bobe? Inki motanchereti kourwa ebi mobwate?
english: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means you have been completely defeated already. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be cheated?

ekegusii: Emanwa eria ende oyerue mogoroba; oyerue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa, buna gwakorete mambia, kobe ekeng’wanso ki’omorero kebe ne rimisu rigiya ase Omonene.
english: Sacrifice the other lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and its drink offering as in the morning-- a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe enyancha ime, kobua aragere oyomo bw’aba abake akore ebibe.
english: It would be better for him to be thrown into the sea with a millstone tied around his neck than for him to cause one of these little ones to sin.

ekegusii: Korende Esanduku eria ya Nyasae Daudi konya oyerentire korwa ase Kiriati‐Yearimu, goika aase aria ayeroiseretie, ekiagera konya oyeteneneirie eema agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Now David had brought up the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim to the place he had prepared for it, because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, oraite eng’iti y’orosana, gose enyoni eyancheire koriegwa, goika aitere amanyinga aye inse, erio ayatube amaroba.
english: "'Any Israelite or any alien living among you who hunts any animal or bird that may be eaten must drain out the blood and cover it with earth,

ekegusii: Korende aye, bweatanane korwa ase amaborio ’oboriri, ne chinderia chie chisokoro, na eriomana, na okoamererania igoro y’amachiko, ekiagera tibigokonya kende, naende tibiri nengencho.
english: But avoid foolish controversies and genealogies and arguments and quarrels about the law, because these are unprofitable and useless.

ekegusii: Omoika omonyene obeire kirori amo nemeika yaito, ng’a intwe nabana ba Nyasae.
english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are God's children.

ekegusii: Erio akamotebia, “Inche ninche Omonene, nakorusetie korwa ase Uru y’Abakalidayo, ninkoe ense eye ebe omwando oo.”
english: He also said to him, "I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to take possession of it."

ekegusii: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim)--fourteen towns and their villages.
english: na Saaraimu, na Aditaimu, na Gedera, na Gederotaimu, emechie ikomi na ene, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, nere orenge omochiki bw’emeganda y’abarwani, na Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.
english: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

ekegusii: Moise goteba: Nase nchera ki tokomochanda? Nigo mokorengereria ng’a ninche nagerire amabe onsi anyorire?
english: "If you say, 'How we will hound him, since the root of the trouble lies in him,'

ekegusii: Asafu nere orenge omotang’ani obo. Abaare komobwatia nabwo aba: Zakaria na Yeieli, Semiramoti na Yehieli, Matitia na Eliabu, Benaya na Obedi‐Edomu, na Yeieli, baria barenge kobugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa. Asafu agaakania chisani chiarenge kwoga.
english: Asaph was the chief, Zechariah second, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel. They were to play the lyres and harps, Asaph was to sound the cymbals,

ekegusii: Na Yohana nigo arenge kobeka chianga chi’amarionya ’engamia, na kweboeria orokini rwe riiyo kenema kiaye. Nigo arenge koria chingige na obooke bw’orosana.
english: John wore clothing made of camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.

ekegusii: Akamokuna okoboko kwaye. Esosera ekamotiga, na ere akaimoka akamokorera.
english: He touched her hand and the fever left her, and she got up and began to wait on him.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatoma Yeruba‐Baali, na Baraki, na Yefita, na inche Samweli, akabatooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baino babaetanaine, nainwe mokaba mokomenya ase obotoereru.
english: Then the LORD sent Jerub-Baal, Barak, Jephthah and Samuel, and he delivered you from the hands of your enemies on every side, so that you lived securely.

ekegusii: Ase chisemi chire, chiero chi’enyomba eyio nigo chigoichorigwa nebinto ao ao bi’engencho enene, na ebi’okogokia.
english: through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.

ekegusii: ere karairanie egento airete gekaba intenenera, naende airanie eki aureretie, na abwatie emeroberio echikire ey’obogima atari gokora ebibe, omonto oyio, ekeene nabe moyo, tagokwa.
english: if he gives back what he took in pledge for a loan, returns what he has stolen, follows the decrees that give life, and does no evil, he will surely live; he will not die.

ekegusii: Nimbairanie inka korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nimbasangererie korwa ase ense y’Asuri; mbabeke ase ense ya Gileadi na ase Lebanoni, mbaichore aroro goika baborwe aase bakomenya.
english: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon, and there will not be room enough for them.

ekegusii: Amo nayio nigo asemeretie ng’a naegwe chifeta na Paulo. Nabo akana‐komorangeria ekero ase ekero gokwana nere.
english: At the same time he was hoping that Paul would offer him a bribe, so he sent for him frequently and talked with him.

ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi gwatongete mbichiche, bitung’ame ase obosio bwao kogosasima, mbitogie erieta riao, aye Omonene.
english: All the nations you have made will come and worship before you, O Lord; they will bring glory to your name.

ekegusii: Ekiagera kwabekire Omonene obeire egekengano kiao, na Oyore Igoro Mono obotamero bwao,
english: If you make the Most High your dwelling-- even the LORD, who is my refuge--

ekegusii: Nigo akobooria obogima bwao korwa ase embeera na gokobekera egutwa y’obwanchani bogendererete botambe amo namabera.
english: who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion,

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio omoriki oria akagenda ase omoruoti, akamotebia, “Abasomba bao mbarusia chibesa chionsi chianyorekana ase enyomba, bakaa abakori emeremo abwo bare abateneneri b’emeremo egokorwa ase enyomba y’Omonene.”
english: Then Shaphan the secretary went to the king and reported to him: "Your officials have paid out the money that was in the temple of the LORD and have entrusted it to the workers and supervisors at the temple."

ekegusii: Ekaba nyuma amaakwa aria gaetire, Omonene agakwana na Musa na Eleazari, omomura o Haroni omokuani, akabatebia,
english: After the plague the LORD said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest,

ekegusii: Igo omochie oria okaba onaaririe goika omwaka o ikomi nomo bw’okogamba gwa Zedekia omoruoti.
english: The city was kept under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

ekegusii: Yusufu akamotebia, “Engencho y’okorota okwo nero eye: Chinsagia echio isato, ayio namatuko atato.
english: "This is what it means," Joseph said to him. "The three branches are three days.

ekegusii: Agatagora na akaiyeria inse ebisasimero biarenge igoro ase ekerama ang’e nakanyomba ka igoro k’Ahasi, biria abaruoti b’Abayuda baagachete, na biria Manase aagachete ase chiraaro ibere chi’enyomba y’Omonene. Akabinachana ebing’ese, erio akaruta orotu rwabo ase akarooche ga Kidironi.
english: He pulled down the altars the kings of Judah had erected on the roof near the upper room of Ahaz, and the altars Manasseh had built in the two courts of the temple of the LORD. He removed them from there, smashed them to pieces and threw the rubble into the Kidron Valley.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio nimoebererie, imoire ase erooro, erinde nkwane nere amang’ana amororo ay’obwanchani.
english: "Therefore I am now going to allure her; I will lead her into the desert and speak tenderly to her.

ekegusii: Buna Tata anyanchete inche, na inche nabanchire inwe, menya ase obwanchani bwane.
english: "As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arakwe, ekiagera angete ogokurerwa, na ase engencho y’oboriri bwaye obonene nasire.
english: He will die for lack of discipline, led astray by his own great folly.

ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi na rimo, Benaya korwa Piratoni bw’ororeria rw’Efraimu akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: Lea nere boigo agasuka gochia ang’e amo nabana baye, nabarabwo bagatung’ama inse. Nyuma kegima Yusufu na Raeli bagasuka gochia ang’e, nabarabwo boigo bagatung’ama inse.
english: Next, Leah and her children came and bowed down. Last of all came Joseph and Rachel, and they too bowed down.

ekegusii: Ebinto ebio boigo Daudi akabiatananera Omonene, buna akorete ne chifeta ne chitahabu biria asakorete korwa ase ebisaku binde bionsi, korwa ase Abaedomu, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafilisti, na Abaameleki.
english: King David dedicated these articles to the LORD, as he had done with the silver and gold he had taken from all these nations: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto mbarigie ogokonywa korwa ase Omotongi obo, mbabe namasikani ase Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
english: In that day men will look to their Maker and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: "'Whoever touches the man who has a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.
english: Na onde bwensi orakune omonto oyio omorwaire goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

ekegusii: Barabwo tiga babe buna obonyansi bore kerama igoro, bogosusana botarakina;
english: May they be like grass on the roof, which withers before it can grow;

ekegusii: Amasankwa ’emebere yaito nigo are ne riberera buna erie riko, ekiagera enchara nigo egotosamba buna omorero.
english: Our skin is hot as an oven, feverish from hunger.

ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ng’a obwate ring’ana eri erimo, na totiga neria kabere, ekiagera omonto omoirogete Nyasae namanye eki agokora ase kera ring’ana.
english: It is good to grasp the one and not let go of the other. The man who fears God will avoid all [extremes].

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, timwandangeretie, ee, inwe Abaisraeli, timwanyechanderete.
english: "Yet you have not called upon me, O Jacob, you have not wearied yourselves for me, O Israel.

ekegusii: “Omonene agatebia Omonene one: Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao?
english: "'The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet."'

ekegusii: Tinsabeti ng’a obarusie korwa ase ense, korende obarende korwa ase oria omobe.
english: My prayer is not that you take them out of the world but that you protect them from the evil one.

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Babeli akabaitera aroro agwo Ribula, ase ense ya Hamati, bagakwerao. Igo Abayuda bakarusigwa ase ense yabo bakairwa ase obosomba.
english: There at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king had them executed. So Judah went into captivity, away from her land.

ekegusii: Na igo Abaisraeli bonsi nabatoorigwe, buna erikire, “Ere Omosibori nache korwa Sayoni. Narusie obobe bore ase Yakobo;
english: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: "The deliverer will come from Zion; he will turn godlessness away from Jacob.

ekegusii: Na monto onde bwensi orakore emeremo ende yonsi ase rituko erio, oyio inche Omonene nimosirie korwa ase abanto baye.
english: I will destroy from among his people anyone who does any work on that day.

ekegusii: “Gose inse korenta ching’iti chi’orosana chintindi chichiche ase ense eyio chiyesarie ebe bosa, erinde monto onde tabaisa goeta ase ense eyio ase engencho ye ching’iti echio,
english: "Or if I send wild beasts through that country and they leave it childless and it becomes desolate so that no one can pass through it because of the beasts,

ekegusii: “Erio inwe mwensi mogacha asende, mogantebia: Totome abanto bagende koroota ense eria, erinde batorentere amang’ana buna ense eria ere, barore enchera togochia goetera, naende emechie eria togochia koira, buna ere.”
english: Then all of you came to me and said, "Let us send men ahead to spy out the land for us and bring back a report about the route we are to take and the towns we will come to."

ekegusii: Amaakwa nabe agotunyanwa na amaakwa ande, na amang’ana amabe nabe agotunyanwa nayande amabe. Abanto mbarigie amaroro korwa ase ababani; abakuani mbasinywe kworokereria amachiko, na abagaaka mbasinywe gosemia.
english: Calamity upon calamity will come, and rumor upon rumor. They will try to get a vision from the prophet; the teaching of the law by the priest will be lost, as will the counsel of the elders.

ekegusii: Ase igo akang’anyia abanto baye korwa ase ense eria bakaba bagochenga, abanto abwo baye achorete bakaba bagotera nomogoko.
english: He brought out his people with rejoicing, his chosen ones with shouts of joy;

ekegusii: Goika edivai egachia kobaremera, ng’ina Yeso akamotebia, “Tibari nedivai.”
english: When the wine was gone, Jesus' mother said to him, "They have no more wine."

ekegusii: Okogania gwaikeranigwe nigo kore ogwansu ase omoyo, korende okoonchoka gotiga amabe, okwo nigo kore okogechigwa ase abariri.
english: A longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

ekegusii: Erio barabwo mbakoreere, babokie amagombo batebe: “Aye omochie omenyire nabanto be chinyancha, naki gwasarigwe! Aye omochie omanyekanete mono, aye kwarenge ne chinguru ase enyancha, nigo gwaichanetie bonsi abamenyete ime yao na kobaondokia.
english: Then they will take up a lament concerning you and say to you: "'How you are destroyed, O city of renown, peopled by men of the sea! You were a power on the seas, you and your citizens; you put your terror on all who lived there.

ekegusii: Korende onye ngotebia omwana oria: Rigereria, emegwe eyio bosio bwao aaria moino, rirorio aye Daudi otame, ekiagera n’Omonene okogotebia ogende.
english: But if I say to the boy, 'Look, the arrows are beyond you,' then you must go, because the LORD has sent you away.

ekegusii: Omokungu gakobina ase okoibora, nigo are nomoichano, ekiagera ensa yaye yaikire; korende gaikire koibora omwana, tari koinyora obororo bwaye naende, ase engencho y’omogoko bw’okoiborwa kw’omonto ase ense.
english: A woman giving birth to a child has pain because her time has come; but when her baby is born she forgets the anguish because of her joy that a child is born into the world.

ekegusii: Korende Musa taete egesaku kia Lawi ensemo ende yonsi ebe omwando obo. Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nere obete omwando obo, buna abatebetie.
english: But to the tribe of Levi, Moses had given no inheritance; the LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he promised them.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Salima nabwo abanto ba Bethlehemu, na Abanetofa, na abanto b’Ataroti‐Beti‐Yoabu, na ekeng’ese ki’Abamanahati, nabwo Abasori,
english: The descendants of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,

ekegusii: Abamura baye bakamorentera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, egetari ase egetari, amo nomotwe, na ere akabisambera ase egesasimero.
english: They handed him the burnt offering piece by piece, including the head, and he burned them on the altar.

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nanyare koyebwata ekero ere ase riraro riaye? Gose nabochore chimioro chiaye ayesibe nengori?”
english: Can anyone capture him by the eyes, or trap him and pierce his nose?

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Eseki, momura omwabo, nabwo aba: Ulamu, omwana oye omotangi, na Yeusi, oyo o kabere, na Elifeleti, oyo o gatato.
english: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second son and Eliphelet the third.

ekegusii: Naende ngatandorana oboruoti, nkaborusia korwa ase enyomba ya Daudi, ngakoboa aye, korende aye tobeti buna Daudi, omosomba one arenge, oria orendete amachiko aane, na agantunyana nenkoro yaye yonsi. Ere agakora onsi ayare amaronge ase amaiso aane.
english: I tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you, but you have not been like my servant David, who kept my commands and followed me with all his heart, doing only what was right in my eyes.

ekegusii: Korende onye gwatomanire nomonto omoao ase ogotaba omwegenwa ase omosacha oo, na gwekorire omosaria,
english: But if you have gone astray while married to your husband and you have defiled yourself by sleeping with a man other than your husband"--

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Inche omonyene natianire ng’a omochie o Bosira nobe bosa. Ekero abanto bakoyorora mbaondoke na koyochecheria, naende babe bakoragereria ase erieta riaye. Na emechie yaye yonsi nesirigwe ebe amaturi kogenderera botambe.”
english: I swear by myself," declares the LORD, "that Bozrah will become a ruin and an object of horror, of reproach and of cursing; and all its towns will be in ruins forever."

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, bae eki ogwenerete kobaa, ogombayie chinda chiabo, ne chimbeere chiabo chiome pa.
english: Give them, O LORD-- what will you give them? Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that are dry.

ekegusii: Barabwo banchire komenya seito babe obomo naintwe, korende mbaganetie tokore ring’ana erimo, nario eri, ng’a kera omosacha ore asetore arokigwe buna barabwo barogete.
english: But the men will consent to live with us as one people only on the condition that our males be circumcised, as they themselves are.

ekegusii: Okore chibonyi chinde ibere chie chitahabu, ochibeke ase egesembe keria ase emego ebere ya inse korwa nyuma, echigete egesibao.
english: Make two gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece on the inside edge next to the ephod.

ekegusii: Wail, you ships of Tarshish; your fortress is destroyed!
english: Inwe abe chimeeri chia Tarisisi rera, ekiagera chiburi chiaino chiatagoirwe.

ekegusii: Korende mbuya mono ase Nyasae, ere oyogotoa okobua goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Na onye okoboko kwao gokogera okore ebibe, bonache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore ekerema, kobua koba namaboko abere, na kogenda ase omorero o kare na kare oyotakorimeka, [
english: If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life maimed than with two hands to go into hell, where the fire never goes out.

ekegusii: Gaki monto onde bwensi orasarie richiko erimo erire rike ase amachiko aya, na kworokereria abanto boigo, oyio narokwe omoke mono ase oboruoti bwa igoro, korende oyorayakore na koyorokereria, oyio nere orarokwe omonene ase oboruoti bwa igoro.
english: Anyone who breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do the same will be called least in the kingdom of heaven, but whoever practices and teaches these commands will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

ekegusii: Erio bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Amaene, ntwamocherete oyominto. Nigo twaroche ogochandeka kw’omoyo oye, na ekero atosororete titwamoigwete. Ase ayio nakio kiagerire obokong’u obo bwatonyorire.”
english: They said to one another, "Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw how distressed he was when he pleaded with us for his life, but we would not listen; that's why this distress has come upon us."

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo okagete ng’a inche nigo nachire korwania aase aiga na koasaria Omonene atancheti? Taibo. Omonene nere ontebia: Genda orwanie ense eria, oyesarie!”
english: Furthermore, have I come to attack and destroy this place without word from the LORD? The LORD himself told me to march against this country and destroy it.'"

ekegusii: Omoyo one nore namaiga amange kobeera ase chigoora chi’Omonene; enkoro yane na omobere one nigo bigoterera Nyasae ore moyo nomogoko omonene.
english: My soul yearns, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

ekegusii: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
english: Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, momura omwabo Kalebu, akaira omochie oyio, na Kalebu akamoa omoiseke oye, akaba mokaye.

ekegusii: Korende timogenda Beteli, gose timosoa Giligali, gose timogenda goika Beeri‐Seba, ekiagera abanto ba Giligali mbairwe ase obosomba, na Beteli nosirigwe kegima.”
english: do not seek Bethel, do not go to Gilgal, do not journey to Beersheba. For Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will be reduced to nothing."

ekegusii: Amaiso abo akaramokigwa. Yeso akabachika bokong’u, “Rigereria monto onde tabaisa komanya amang’ana aya.”
english: and their sight was restored. Jesus warned them sternly, "See that no one knows about this."

ekegusii: Oyio nigo ore omoroberio ochikire ase Abaisraeli, na aya Nyasae o Yakobo achikire.
english: this is a decree for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

ekegusii: Erio Musa agasoka komorotota, agatung’ama na komonyunyunta. Ekero bakwananirie bagasoa ase eema.
english: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and then went into the tent.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti oyio bw’Abaasuri agatoma Rabi‐Sake korwa Lakisi amo nabarwani esegi abange agende ase Hezekia agwo Yerusalemu. Rabi‐Sake agatenena ase omotaro bwe ritibo ria rogoro ase enchera ekogenda ase egetii ki’omosibia bw’ebitambaa bikoroisigwa chianga.
english: Then the king of Assyria sent his field commander with a large army from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. When the commander stopped at the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Washerman's Field,

ekegusii: Ekero Amasia airanete korwa ase ogoita Abaedomu, akarentana chinyasae chi’Abaedomu, agachisasima na gochiruera ebing’wanso.
english: When Amaziah returned from slaughtering the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the people of Seir. He set them up as his own gods, bowed down to them and burned sacrifices to them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio timoiroka, inche nigo inde amo nainwe, timoichana, inche ninche Nyasae oino; nimbabeke chinguru, mbakonye, nimbasiire nokoboko gw’okorio kw’oboronge bwane.
english: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.

ekegusii: Bono abanto babere, Elidadi na Medadi, barabwo bagatigara ase egetwori, na omoika ogacha igoro asebare. Igo barenge abamo b’abwo bachoretwe, korende tibagenda agwo ase Eema, na barabwo bakabanera agwo ase egetwori.
english: However, two men, whose names were Eldad and Medad, had remained in the camp. They were listed among the elders, but did not go out to the Tent. Yet the Spirit also rested on them, and they prophesied in the camp.

ekegusii: Yeso agachia koborigwa n’Abafarisai, “Oboruoti bwa Nyasae indi borache?” Akabairaneria, “Oboruoti bwa Nyasae tibori gocha ase ebimanyererio bikororekana,
english: Once, having been asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, "The kingdom of God does not come with your careful observation,

ekegusii: Naki buna omobere ore oyomo, oro nore nebiimo ebinge, na ebiimo bionsi bi’omobere oria, nonya bire ebinge, nigo bire omobere oyomo; naboigo na Kristo are.
english: The body is a unit, though it is made up of many parts; and though all its parts are many, they form one body. So it is with Christ.

ekegusii: Bwanyenyire ching’iti chiaye; bwochoganirie edivai yaye, bwariganirie emesa yaye.
english: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

ekegusii: Ere agatinyia ririko riria riarigetwe ase amachiko, riare gotosoera, eriarenge nobobisa asetore; akaritigeria ensemo, akariakerania ase omosalaba.
english: having canceled the written code, with its regulations, that was against us and that stood opposed to us; he took it away, nailing it to the cross.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase enyomba eria omosae oria Omolawi amenyete ase enka ya Mika, bakamoboria amang’ana aye buna agendererete.
english: So they turned in there and went to the house of the young Levite at Micah's place and greeted him.

ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae andusetie korwa ase omochie o tata kogenda gochia aaria na aaria ngatebia mokane: Aya naro amaya orankorere: kera aase toragende otebe igoro yane ng’a inche momura omino.”
english: And when God had me wander from my father's household, I said to her, 'This is how you can show your love to me: Everywhere we go, say of me, "He is my brother." '"

ekegusii: Ekero ekio omosangererekano bw’abanto chilifu chinyinge bagachia gosangerereka goika bagatachana. Yeso agachaka gotebia aborokigwa baye ritang’ani, “Mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai, engencho yaye nobong’ainereria.
english: Meanwhile, when a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling on one another, Jesus began to speak first to his disciples, saying: "Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

ekegusii: Korende twarorire ere, oyokorirwe koba omoke kobua abamalaika ase ekero egeke, nere Yeso, obekeirwe egutwa y’obonene na amasikani ase engencho y’ogochandwa kwaye kw’amakweri, erio ase obuya bwa Nyasae aigwe amakweri ribaga ria kera omonto.
english: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.

ekegusii: Akabatiga, akariina obwato naende, akamboka ng’umbu.
english: Then he left them, got back into the boat and crossed to the other side.

ekegusii: Give the people these instructions, too, so that no one may be open to blame.
english: Obachike ayio, erinde babe batari na komocha.

ekegusii: Boigo kera emambia orue ase Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera ebimunu bine, na egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese amaguta ochoganirie nobosie bw’okoruegwa koria kw’endagera. Oyo noro omoroberio ochikire orabe okogenderera botambe.
english: You are also to provide with it morning by morning a grain offering, consisting of a sixth of an ephah with a third of a hin of oil to moisten the flour. The presenting of this grain offering to the LORD is a lasting ordinance.

ekegusii: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
english: o Tahati, bw’Asiri, bw’Ebiasafu, o Kora,

ekegusii: Musa akarua o Farao, agasaba Omonene.
english: Moses then left Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonene akang’iraneria, agantebia, “Rika okorora okwo ase ebao namariko amaya, erinde oyo okoyasoma ayasome buya.
english: Then the LORD replied: "Write down the revelation and make it plain on tablets so that a herald may run with it.

ekegusii: “Ase emiaka etano nomo osimeke na kobusura endagera, na ogese ebiamire,
english: "For six years you are to sow your fields and harvest the crops,

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo aramborete ensemo ya sugusu aase arenge bosa, nigo asungete ense aase bosa etabwateti aande.
english: He spreads out the northern [skies] over empty space; he suspends the earth over nothing.

ekegusii: Aye gwatebire, “Indigie ondore obosio bwane.” Na enkoro yane nigo ekogotebia, “Omonene, inche igo nkorigia obosio bwao.”
english: My heart says of you, "Seek his face!" Your face, LORD, I will seek.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, agoteba: “Inwe Abaisraeli rora, nimbarentere abanto b’egesaku gete; barabwo mbabachande gochakera ase egesoero kia Hamati goikera ase akarooche g’Ekerubo Ekiomo.”
english: For the LORD God Almighty declares, "I will stir up a nation against you, O house of Israel, that will oppress you all the way from Lebo Hamath to the valley of the Arabah."

ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Oyokoigwa ring’ana riane, na komwegena ere oyontomete nare nobogima bwa kare na kare, gose tagoika ase ekina, korende oetire korwa ase amakweri, oikire ase obogima.
english: "I tell you the truth, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be condemned; he has crossed over from death to life.

ekegusii: “Naende naoroke omoruoti onde ase ribaga riaye, ere natome omobangi bw’ebango aete ase ense eria ere obonene bw’oboruoti bwaye, Ase engaki y’amatuko amake omoruoti oria naitwe, korende tari ase engencho y’endamwamu, gose ase esegi.
english: "His successor will send out a tax collector to maintain the royal splendor. In a few years, however, he will be destroyed, yet not in anger or in battle.

ekegusii: “Kera omwana omoisia omotangi nabe oyone, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo, chibe chieri gose chimingichi.
english: "The first offspring of every womb belongs to me, including all the firstborn males of your livestock, whether from herd or flock.

ekegusii: From there he went up to Beersheba.
english: Isaka akarua aroro, agatiira gochia Beeri‐Seba.

ekegusii: agatoma Yoramu, momura oye, ase omoruoti Daudi amokwanie na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri omobuirie. Hadadeseri nigo abete okona‐korwania Toi. Boigo Yoramu akairera Daudi ebinto bi’etahabu, na ebi’efeta, na ebi’etaai.
english: he sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Joram brought with him articles of silver and gold and bronze.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo beboyetie chigunia baichanete agwo ase chinchera, abande nigo bariinete ebirama igoro, na abande bare ase ebiraario; kera omonto nigo akweumia na koiyeria amariga.
english: In the streets they wear sackcloth; on the roofs and in the public squares they all wail, prostrate with weeping.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio Abayuda mbatoorigwe, na abanto ba Yerusalemu bamenye ase obotoereru. Na Omoseboka oyio nigo orarokwe: Omonene Nere Oboronge Bwaito.”
english: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will live in safety. This is the name by which it will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.'

ekegusii: Orobebe rokagenderera na rokaonchoka gochia irianyi, bosongo y’egetunwa keria kerochie Beti‐Horoni, rogaika Kiriati‐Baali (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), omochie bw’egesaku kia Yuda. Oro nigo rwarenge orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo.
english: From the hill facing Beth Horon on the south the boundary turned south along the western side and came out at Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim), a town of the people of Judah. This was the western side.

ekegusii: But Peter declared, "Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you." And all the other disciples said the same.
english: Petero akamotebia, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na aborokigwa bonsi bagateba boigo.

ekegusii: Na erioki ri’okoyia kw’abwo bagochandeka nigo rirachongororoke gochia igoro goika kare na kare. Na ogotimoka tikori omobaso gose obotuko ase abwo basasimete eng’iti eria na omogwekano oye, na kera oyonyorire ekemanyererio ki’erieta riaye.”
english: And the smoke of their torment rises for ever and ever. There is no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and his image, or for anyone who receives the mark of his name."

ekegusii: Beria na Sema nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chi’abanto bamenyete agwo Ayaloni, nabwo baseretie abanyene ense ya Gati.
english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of families of those living in Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath.

ekegusii: Agateba, “Rora, narorire igoro amaanokire, na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto oteneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.”
english: "Look," he said, "I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God."

ekegusii: Ase ching’iti echio chinke echio nchibe chitachenegeti asemore. Monto onde bwensi orachikune ekero chiakure nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: Of all those that move along the ground, these are unclean for you. Whoever touches them when they are dead will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: Omoroberio oyo obekirwe ase ebinto ebio oise korusigwa asende, ororeria rw’Abaisraeli nigo rorasire tirobao, tibakoba egesaku ase obosio bwane kogenderera botambe.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "Only if these decrees vanish from my sight," declares the LORD, "will the descendants of Israel ever cease to be a nation before me."

ekegusii: na omoganda oye nigo ore nabanto chilifu emerongo etano na isato, na amagana ane (53,400).
english: His division numbers 53,400.

ekegusii: “Bono omwana one, Omonene abe amo naye, erio obe nokogenderera okuya ase okoagacha enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oo, buna akwanete igoro yao.
english: "Now, my son, the LORD be with you, and may you have success and build the house of the LORD your God, as he said you would.

ekegusii: Akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, agasamunyora emegati eria, akaa aborokigwa baye babiterekere abanto, ne chinswe chiria ibere, akabagabera bonsi.
english: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to his disciples to set before the people. He also divided the two fish among them all.

ekegusii: Abana bao abamura mbabe ribaga rie chisokoro chiao, naye nobabeke babe abagambi igoro ase ense yonsi.
english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio mbachete aroro abanto bamotebetie amang’ana igoro y’Abagalili, baria Pilato asang’ananetie amanyinga abo nebing’wanso biabo.
english: Now there were some present at that time who told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abaremerwa mbabe nogosemeria, korende abakori amabe nigo barakirigwe‐kiri.”
english: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.

ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na gatato, Sibekai bw’ororeria rwa Husa Omozera akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na gatato. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoeyana, na omoika oye omecheeria igoro, ere nigo aitete nokoboko kwaye engiti eria yare gotama.
english: By his breath the skies became fair; his hand pierced the gliding serpent.

ekegusii: Ching’iti chinene inye chigatiira korwa ase enyancha ime; okororekana kwabo nigo kwarenge ao ao.
english: Four great beasts, each different from the others, came up out of the sea.

ekegusii: Naende esegi ekaba agwo Gati. Omonto omotambe narengeo, oyorenge nebiara bitano na ekemo ase kera okoboko, na bitano na ekemo ase kera okogoro; bionsi nigo biarenge emerongo ebere na bine. Ere boigo noyomo bw’amamonto orenge.
english: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot-- twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.

ekegusii: Abanto bagasiberia egari eria agwo ase ritibo ria Samaria, ne chisese chikamena amanyinga aye, na abakungu abatayayi bagesiberia ase ritibo riria, buna Omonene konya akwanire.
english: They washed the chariot at a pool in Samaria (where the prostitutes bathed), and the dogs licked up his blood, as the word of the LORD had declared.

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Baminto, nabasoroire, timokora bobe buna iga.
english: and said, "No, my friends. Don't do this wicked thing.

ekegusii: Nsabere ase Omonene. Chinkoba echi amo nembura y’amagena biatonyarire. Nimbae ribaga mogende, timogwenereti mobeere aa goetania.”
english: Pray to the LORD, for we have had enough thunder and hail. I will let you go; you don't have to stay any longer."

ekegusii: “Goika motware ebirengero bi’ekeene mokorengera oborito na obonge bw’ebinto bionsi.
english: You are to use accurate scales, an accurate ephah and an accurate bath.

ekegusii: Neko, omoruoti oyio o Misiri, akabeka Eliakimu, momura omwabo omoruoti oria arusetie, akaba omoruoti igoro ase Abayuda, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, na akaonchora erieta riaye, akamoroka Yehoyakimu. Neko akaira Yehoahasi, omomura omwabo Eliakimu, Misiri.
english: The king of Egypt made Eliakim, a brother of Jehoahaz, king over Judah and Jerusalem and changed Eliakim's name to Jehoiakim. But Neco took Eliakim's brother Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt.

ekegusii: Inche nigo ngosaria ebimanyererio bi’ababani b’oborimo na gokora abaringoria baba chiosi. Nigo nkoirania nyuma obong’aini bw’abang’aini na gokora okomanya kwabo kwaba oboriri.
english: who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners, who overthrows the learning of the wise and turns it into nonsense,

ekegusii: Egento kende gionsi omonto oria otachenegeti arakune nakerokio nakebe egetachenegeti. Omonto onde bwensi orakune egento keria nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.”
english: Anything that an unclean person touches becomes unclean, and anyone who touches it becomes unclean till evening."

ekegusii: Ekio gekagera mokabeera agwo Kadeshi ase amatuko amange.”
english: And so you stayed in Kadesh many days-- all the time you spent there.

ekegusii: Abanto bakoruba ne chindobio ase orooche rwa Naili mbarere na kobokia amagombo, na abwo bakoruta ebionga aroro mbaumate.
english: The fishermen will groan and lament, all who cast hooks into the Nile; those who throw nets on the water will pine away.

ekegusii: “Omonto aise gokora ebibe na gosaria asende inche Omonene ase okong’ainereria omogisangio oye ase okwanga koirania ebinto aetwe ase amaboko aye abirende, gose ase okomourereria, gose ase okomoibera ase okomorega,
english: "If anyone sins and is unfaithful to the LORD by deceiving his neighbor about something entrusted to him or left in his care or stolen, or if he cheats him,

ekegusii: Then Naomi took the child, laid him in her lap and cared for him.
english: Naomi akaimokia omwana oria, akamoagata, akaba okomorera.

ekegusii: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
english: Okorigereria kw’oboenenu, na oromeme rogokwana oborimo, na amaboko agoitera amanyinga atari na komocha;

ekegusii: Erio abakerubi bakarambora chimbaba chiabo, na amagoro arenge mbarabare yabo; na obonene bwa Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli bokaba igoro yabo.
english: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, spread their wings, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

ekegusii: Naki ase engencho eyio, ekero ntanyarete koremereria kobua, ngatoma Timotheo, erinde inyare komanya okwegena kwaino. Noboire ng’a omoteemi oria obateemire inwe na emeremo yaito ebe eya bosa.
english: For this reason, when I could stand it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith. I was afraid that in some way the tempter might have tempted you and our efforts might have been useless.

ekegusii: Korwa Aroeri, omochie oria ore ase engegu y’orooche rw’Arinoni, goika Gileadi, amo nomochie ore ase rikura, omochie onde torenge ne chindwaki chinkong’u totanyarete gotagora. Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo abegete emechie yonsi ase amaboko aito.
english: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the gorge, even as far as Gilead, not one town was too strong for us. The LORD our God gave us all of them.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya onsi atonyorire, nonya intwe titoraba togokweba, gose titorasaria okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania.
english: All this happened to us, though we had not forgotten you or been false to your covenant.

ekegusii: Amaroro ayio onsi ay’obobani ebei re asemore buna amang’ana ’ebuku emumekeirie na kobekwa ekemanyererio.
