ekegusii: Abagusii Culture And Customs CIV: Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya "Obokima Bw' Obori Tibwarenge Koguunda Nonya" Aya amwabo aya: Jared Nyaberi: Mbuya omono omongina Birundu ase ogotwara chingaki erinde otoe obosemia. Ase ogochakera, inee, noinyore buna omwaka norori ekero kwaiboretwe? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Ekero naiboretwe, nario konyora Abacheremani bachakire esegi korwa aaria Tanganyika. Nche nabo imanyete igo. Engaki eyio nario ebirwanero bia amasasi biaigete Gusii. Jared Nyaberi: Esegi eyio igo mwaka ki torayebekere gose? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Mochokoro ntwe ntware kobara miaka engaki eyio. Abagusii nigo twarenge komanya emiaka, kobwatekana ne ebinto biarenge gokorekana. Jared Nyaberi: Igo gaki tiga totebe buna nigo kwaiboretwe ase omwaka 1914. Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Eee igo mbuya mochokoro. Jared Nyaberi: Bono omongina karantebia igoro y' endagera y Abagusii. Ninki twakarire ase chingaki echio ekero kwaiboreretwe? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Obokima bw' obori nabwo bwarenge endagera enene y' Omogusii. Korwa kare, Obori nabwo bwarenge endagera enene, naende nero yatokinetie. Chibando tichiarenge ekemeri ki' Omogusii. Yaya. Chibando niigo chiarentetwe n' Omosongo. Niigo chiaigete Gusii bono ekero nabeire enyaroka. Aange nase emiaka 1930. Bono ase ritangani, chibando nigo chiagasimekirwe ase chingito goeta. Magega yaye, chigaansa gosimekwa ase emeraba ime. Keri keri Abagusii togachaka gosimeka chibando kera aase. Jared Nyaberi: Bono omongina, otagontebia buna obori bwagasimekirwe? Enchagwa tiyakabeire Gusii. Nigo enchagwa yachagete gocha ekero amaremo akaera. Jared Nyaberi ngotegerwa are omogano n' omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya, aaria Bomorenda, Bonchari, Kisii County. Photo na Abner Nyaberi, Gusii.com files. Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Mochokoro abwo kare, nigo chiinsana chiarenge kera aase. Bono nigo abamura be ekenyoro bakaimokire ekero ki' omorakera, basamba rinani. Engatiato [ January ] amo na Monuguna O Barema [ February ] nario chiinsana chiagasambirwe. Mochokoro tiga ngotebie buna engaki eyio nigo omogaso okarorire se. Nabo kware korigereria ekeng'umbu, go kwaora buna ense ekomakameka na koyia ase omogaso. Omogaso tari bono ochaka. Ritangani, nigo orosana rwagatongiigwe na koyia. Korwa abwo, obori bwamanya kobusurwa. Ase boigo, obori nigo bwarenge kobusurerwa aase aare. Bwamanya komera na gokonga bobwate ebigara ebinene kegima. Jared Nyaberi: Bono inee omongina, enchagwa ndiriri yarenge koba? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Ntwe Abagusii ntwagatwarire enchagwa. Nigo obori bwarenge kobusurerwa aare aare. Bwamanya gokina na kogeswa. Ko chinsana chiasambirwe, eubi ende nyinge tiyarenge komera, otatiga obori bwoka. Kwagera obori nkwarengeo. Enchagwa nigo yacha gochicha rero ekero amaremo akaera, n' obori kobusurerwa aamo. Jared Nyaberi: Bono magokoro, karantebia igoro y' okogesa obori. Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Ekero obori obo bwamire, nigo bwarenge kogeswa, bwabongororwa, na goserwa na amagoko. Chitinga chi ogosia tichiarenge aroro. Nonya n' chitinga chia amache, nigo chiachete gocha ekero omosongo aikire nka Gusii. Ekero obori bwamire na kogeswa, ogochengerwa nkwarengeo. Ritangani nigo amarwa arenge gosikwa ase ebiteera ime. Amarwa nabo arenge gosiikwa ase emekubio ene emegima! Aye tiga amarwa aya arero agosikwa ase rituko erimo. Bono amarwa amanya koengwa. Kayiire, amanya goterekwa na konywegwa. Amarwa tarenge goterekwa nonde bwensi. Yaya. Amarwa nigo arenge goterekwa no omongina oria onywometwe ase enyangi na kobekerwa ebitinge! Onye tikwabekeretwe ebitinge, nkwarenge gotereka amarwa. Korwa abwo, chimbori chianyenywa, n' abanto koragera. Nigo abanto barenge koragera goika obokima bonde bwatigara! Obokima bw' obori nabo bwarenge kobera ase ekeee ase omokubio omogima, botari koguunda! Mbwarenge gosareka noonya. Jared Nyaberi: Bono abwo kare onye amaremo arenge amanene, nigo abanto bakaagachire are are gose nigo barenge komenya aamo? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Mochokoro mbono amaremo aerire. Chingaki echio, abanto nigo bamenyete ase oboare mono. Nonya n' ekero omoiri asirire, nigo arenge gotindekwa ase obwango, erinde abamwabo bamanya komanyigwa magega yaye. Nonya nabo igo emeyega yo ogosira ero nigo yarenge kogenderera. Jared Nyaberi: Mbuya mono magokoro ase ogotwara engaki gotoa obomanyi buna twakamenyire. Bono inee, ninki oratebie abasae b' ekegori egeke ba Gusii? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Amasikani. Mochokoro amasikani n' egento ekiya. Korende naende, ka moranche timokweba ase morwete. Inyora ase morwete, na baria mwatigete magega. Mbuya mono.
english: Gusii Culture And Customs CIV: Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya "The Wealth of Our Ancestors Will Always Be Remembered" These are their words: Jared Nyaberi: My grandmother Omongina Birundu says that history protects our traditions and identity. Does it not seem so, indeed, that time passes quickly when one is enjoying themselves? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: It does pass quickly, but remember the Germans who came and colonized areas of Tanganyika. They also knew about this land. That history is also a source of strength for the Gusii people. Jared Nyaberi: What year did that colonization begin? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: I don't quite recall how many years ago that was. The Gusii have remembered for generations, because of the things they experienced during those times. Jared Nyaberi: This event happened around 1914, didn't it? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Yes, my grandmother remembers it well. Jared Nyaberi: Therefore, Omongina, tell me about the importance of the Gusii ancestors. How can we learn from that history which has been passed down? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: The wealth of our ancestors is also a great treasure for the Gusii people. In the past, the ancestors were also a great treasure, and today they still guide us. Many clans contribute to the richness of the Gusii people. Yes. That clan is led by the elders. It is a strong Gusii clan, but it became scattered. Around the 1930s. Then, the clan was organized with a specific purpose. Their gatherings were held in large numbers. Gradually, the Gusii began to organize the clan again. Jared Nyaberi: So Omongina, what caused the ancestors to become disorganized? Tradition has never left the Gusii. It is a tradition that has always remained, even until today. Jared Nyaberi is interviewing Omongina Bathseba Birundu, from Bomorenda, Bonchari, Kisii County. Photo by Abner Nyaberi, Gusii.com files. Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Long ago, it was a custom to remain together. But then, the young men started seeking ways to earn a living, and they dispersed. The months of January and February were traditionally months of celebration. I don't quite remember whether that history is a blessing. But they had skills, to ensure that everything worked out and was successful. Success wasn't easy. Nowadays, it is being sought through education. Because of this, the ancestors understood the importance of hard work. In the past, the ancestors were respected and honored for their achievements and contributions to life. Jared Nyaberi: Indeed, Omongina, what kind of respect did tradition command? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: We Gusii valued tradition greatly. The ancestors were respected and honored. They were feared and revered. During celebrations, sometimes many people didn't understand, but they still respected the ancestors. Tradition was very important. Tradition continued to remain, and the ancestors were honored accordingly. Jared Nyaberi: Thank you very much, can you explain the importance of respecting the ancestors? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Because those ancestors existed, they deserved respect, they were praised, and they were remembered by their children. Anything that brings shame should be avoided. And anything that is good, should remain and spread like the Gusii people. Because the ancestors existed and were respected, they were well cared for. Nowadays, things are different; there are no longer such traditions. Things are also changing, and life is becoming difficult! However, these things will eventually return to how they once were. But these things require effort. Sometimes, they are given freely and received willingly. These things shouldn't be taken for granted. Yes. These things should be given to the Omongina who have experience and wisdom, and kept secret! Anyone who hasn't been initiated shouldn't receive these things. Because of this, secrets are revealed, and people gossip. People often gossip about others, causing problems! Problems with the ancestors also deserve attention, so they don't disappear! I will continue to speak truthfully. Jared Nyaberi: But if those things are too important, why do people forget them and stop honoring them? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: It's because of the current generation. Today, people don't understand the meaning of things. But even when someone doesn't know something, it shouldn't be dismissed, so their relatives can learn from it later. Also, what seems insignificant today might become important tomorrow. Jared Nyaberi: Mother, thank you very much for sharing this knowledge with us. But now, who will teach our children the customs of the Gusii people? Omongina Bathseba Birundu Ateya: Let's wait. It's because we need time and patience. Continue working hard, and let everyone understand the truth. Thank you mother.

ekegusii: na endagera yarenge korentwa ase emesa yaye, na akarora buna abakonyi baye bamenyete aroro, na buna abasomba baye baare komokorera, ne chianga babegete, na ababogoria ebikombe baye, ne chianga babegete, na ebing’wanso biaye bi’ogosambwa aruete ase enyomba y’Omonene, agakumia na koumaata.
english: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, the cupbearers in their robes and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the LORD, she was overwhelmed.

ekegusii: Omonto obwate endamwamu nigo agoseegeta eriomana, na oyo okogechigwa nigo akorenta ogosaria okonge.
english: An angry man stirs up dissension, and a hot-tempered one commits many sins.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ngokorangeria nenkoro yane yonsi, inyigwe, na inche nimbwate emeroberio yao echikire.
english: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD, and I will obey your decrees.

ekegusii: Naende abakuani, abamura ba Haroni, babeke ebitari biria, amo nomotwe na ebitinya, igoro ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero bw’egesasimero.
english: Then Aaron's sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, on the burning wood that is on the altar.

ekegusii: How foolish! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
english: Omoriri oyo, eke ogosimeka aye, tikeri komera getakweti.

ekegusii: He will eat curds and honey when he knows enough to reject the wrong and choose the right.
english: Ekero omwana oyio arabe omanyire kwanga amabe na gochora amaya, nabe okoria amaguta ’amabeere na obooke.

ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo omanyete okogania kwane gwonsi, na ogochandeka kwane tikobisekaneti asore.
english: All my longings lie open before you, O Lord; my sighing is not hidden from you.

ekegusii: Ninde n'ekeene ng'a obomaene nigo bore bw'engencho kobua ebirengererio bi'abanto. Ebitabu biaito nigo bire bi'eritang'ani n'ebiekeene ase chingaki echi na bigokwana igoro yobobisi bore ime y'ebatiso y'Yeso eyio yakoretwe na Yohana omobatisi. Ekerisimasi tikiarenge aroro ase chikarne ibere chi'kanisa entang'ani korende Abakeristo b'ekanisa entang'ani amo n'aborokigwa ba Yeso, nigo bare koinyora rituko ri'abatiso y' Yeso yakoretwe na Yohana omobatisi aaria ase oroche rwa Jorodani ase omotienyi o Januari chitariki 6 ase kera omwaka, ninki kiagerete bakarikora rituko eri koba eriengencho mono ase okwegena kwabo? Ebitabu biaito nigo bikorwa obomaene ase riborio eri, n'obomaene nigo bore bw'engencho ase obokeristo bwaito mono. Ekerenga ekenene ki'ebitabu biaito nigo kere mono igoro y'ebatiso y'Yeso amo n'enchiri y'amache amo n'omoika (Yohana 3:5), eke tikeri ng'a negento kere ensemo yobokeristo bwaito, korende negento kere gi'ekerenga ekenene emia ase emia ase obokeresto bwaito. Ebitabu biaito nigo bikobeka abekeristo chinguru banyare koyiegena enchiri y'amache amo n'omoika. Enchiri y'egetabu eke tiga ebe ensemo yegento kiengencho ase okorigia ekeene kere ime y'ebuku.
english: Indeed, this story about baptism is important because it reminds us of the importance of repentance for all people. These scriptures also remind us of the significance of John the Baptist's ministry and the baptism of Jesus which was performed by John the baptizer. Christmas arrives quickly, and it is a time when the church gathers together, and Christians from the church gather and remember the baptism of Jesus performed by John the baptizer near the Jordan River and on January 6th each year, so why do they celebrate remembering this event and its meaning for their salvation? These scriptures are done in remembrance of this event, and this remembrance is important for our Christianity. The main point of these scriptures is the importance of the baptism of Jesus and the water and the Spirit (John 3:5), and it is not just a historical event, but an important point for our Christian faith, because it points to the main point of our Christian faith. These scriptures help Christians understand the importance of water and the Spirit. The message of the scripture is that there is hope for those who seek God and forgiveness for their sins through the book.

ekegusii: Ekero nkoba buna oyo okogireka, aye nomanyete ase ngoetera. Agwo ase ngoeta ababisa bambekeire amareba.
english: When my spirit grows faint within me, it is you who know my way. In the path where I walk men have hidden a snare for me.

ekegusii: Togoke na gochenga, tomotogie ase obonene bwaye, ekiagera rituko ri’enyangi y’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi riaikire, na omoriakari oye bwebekire ang’e.
english: Let us rejoice and be glad and give him glory! For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready.

ekegusii: rigotebia omomalaika o gatano na rimo, oyorenge negetureri, “Sibora abamalaika baria bane, abwo basibire ase orooche roria oronene rokorokwa Eufarati.”
english: It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."

ekegusii: Ara gatano na kabere ase rituko nigo nkogotogia, ase engencho y’emeroberio yao echikire.
english: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.

ekegusii: Titotiga gosangererekana amo, buna engencho y’abande ere, korende toremanie intwe ase intwe, kobua mono ekiagera moroche ng’a Rituko riria riaikire ang’e.
english: Let us not give up meeting together, as some are in the habit of doing, but let us encourage one another-- and all the more as you see the Day approaching.

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo akoorire kobaboka ase okobana, agatiira gochia ase ekegoro aase ebing’wanso biare koruerwa.
english: After Saul stopped prophesying, he went to the high place.

ekegusii: Na Petero akamotunyana korwa nyuma ore egeka, goika ime ase egoora y’omokuani omonene, agaikaransa amo nabasomba gwota omorero.
english: Peter followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. There he sat with the guards and warmed himself at the fire.

ekegusii: Korende nabatebirie aya, erio engaki eria egocha, moyainyore ng’a inche nabatebetie. “Tinabatebetie aya korwa omochakano, ekiagera narenge amo nainwe.
english: I have told you this, so that when the time comes you will remember that I warned you. I did not tell you this at first because I was with you.

ekegusii: “Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kanani, eyio ndabae ebe eyaino, na kondarente ukoma ase enyomba gete agwo,
english: "When you enter the land of Canaan, which I am giving you as your possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in that land,

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro arikire ase rirube riria omoruoti Aritasasita aete Ezara, omokuani na omworokia bw’amariko, oyo bworokereretigwe na omanyete mono amachiko ’Omonene na emeroberio yaye echikire ase Abaisraeli:
english: This is a copy of the letter King Artaxerxes had given to Ezra the priest and teacher, a man learned in matters concerning the commands and decrees of the LORD for Israel:

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaimoka korwa agwo Misipa, bakabwatia Abafilisti goika Beti‐Kari, bakabaitera inchera.
english: The men of Israel rushed out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, slaughtering them along the way to a point below Beth Car.

ekegusii: Ase ayio aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, bono kora aya kwarierete omosomba oo Daudi tata eira, ogateba: Takoborwa nonya ng’ake omonto korwa ase ororeria rwao oraikaranse ase obosio bwane, ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti ki’Abaisraeli, onye rioka abana bao bagochia korenda chinchera chiabo, erinde babwatie ogochika kwane, buna aye kwabeire gokobwatia ogochika okwo ase obosio bwane.
english: "Now LORD, God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, 'You shall never fail to have a man to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your sons are careful in all they do to walk before me according to my law, as you have done.'

ekegusii: Bakaba bagotoora ase ense y’Abaisraeli, erio basaria chindagera chiabo goika chimbebe chia Gasa. Tibaare gotigareria Abaisraeli ching’ondi, gose chiombe, gose chitigere, nonya ngento kende gionsi Abaisraeli baare koria.
english: They camped on the land and ruined the crops all the way to Gaza and did not spare a living thing for Israel, neither sheep nor cattle nor donkeys.

ekegusii: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.
english: Nonya Yusufu omanyete abamwabo, barabwo tibamomanyete ere.

ekegusii: Ekero nabogete mambia ngonkie omwana one, nkanyora ng’a okure, korende ekero narigereretie omwana oria buya ase emambia eyio, nkarora ng’a oyo tari omwana oria naiborete.”
english: The next morning, I got up to nurse my son-- and he was dead! But when I looked at him closely in the morning light, I saw that it wasn't the son I had borne."

ekegusii: Nyasae orire eira korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, ogoteba, “Ase omochengo ninyatanane Sekemu, na ense omweya ya Sukoti inyiate chincherere.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.

ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akonakweoncha‐onchora buna egesieri gekona‐koonchorwa ase chimbata gesibeire.
english: As a door turns on its hinges, so a sluggard turns on his bed.

ekegusii: obaake amaguta buna oraake ise, na barabwo nababe abakuani baane. Ogoakwa kw’amaguta kwabo nkobanyorere obokuani boragenderere botambe ase ororeria rwabo, ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
english: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so they may serve me as priests. Their anointing will be to a priesthood that will continue for all generations to come."

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku, inchuo ang’e, motegerere moigwe; inwe abanto, igwera! Tiga ense etegerere amo na bionsi ebireo, ee, oboiko bwonsi na ebigosoka korwao.
english: Come near, you nations, and listen; pay attention, you peoples! Let the earth hear, and all that is in it, the world, and all that comes out of it!

ekegusii: Ekero abegete igoro ekabao, na ekero abegete chinsoko chigosokia amache korwa ase chindiba ne chinguru,
english: when he established the clouds above and fixed securely the fountains of the deep,

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasogete ase ogotooria abanto bao, ee, okarentera omoakwa amaguta oo ogotooreka. Nigo gwasenyentete ekerama ki’enyomba y’omokori amabe, okayetagora korwa ase oboroso goika ase egechuria.
english: You came out to deliver your people, to save your anointed one. You crushed the leader of the land of wickedness, you stripped him from head to foot. Selah

ekegusii: Egento kende gionsi narenge korora na gokegania tinare gwetanga gokenyora, gose tinarinete enkoro yane omogoko onde bwensi, ekiagera enkoro yane nigo yagokerete aya onsi nechanderete, na omogoko oyio noro orenge eng’eria yane y’emeremo yonsi nechanderete.
english: I denied myself nothing my eyes desired; I refused my heart no pleasure. My heart took delight in all my work, and this was the reward for all my labor.

ekegusii: Korende ere oyobwatanigwe n’Omonene igo obeire omoika oyomo nere.
english: But he who unites himself with the Lord is one with him in spirit.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobwanchani obonge, na amabera amange; tari omwango ase okoba nendamwamu, nigo aichire nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.
english: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in love.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli agaseegeta omoika o Puli, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri (nere Tiligati‐Pileseri), na Puli oyio akaira abanto b’ororeria rwa Reuben, na ab’orwa Gadi, na ekeng’ese ki ’egesaku kia Manase goika Hala na Habori, na Hara, na goika ase orooche rwa Goseni; nao bare goika rero iga.
english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria), who took the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. He took them to Halah, Habor, Hara and the river of Gozan, where they are to this day.

ekegusii: Onye moroche ng’a ense eye mwaeirwe ebe eyaino tegwenereti mogosasimerao, imoka mwamboke gochia ase ense y’Omonene, ase obomenyo bwaye boteneine, moegwe chingongo chiaino agwo ase egati yaito. Timobaisa kwanga koigwera Omonene, gose kwanga gotoigwera intwe ase okweagachera egesasimero kiaino ekeao goetania eki’Omonene, Nyasae oito.
english: If the land you possess is defiled, come over to the LORD's land, where the LORD's tabernacle stands, and share the land with us. But do not rebel against the LORD or against us by building an altar for yourselves, other than the altar of the LORD our God.

ekegusii: Ere nigo agotogonyera enyancha, amache asira, nigo agosiria amache e chindooche chionsi. Ense ya Basani nigo egosusana, na egetunwa gia Karimeli boigo; oboseera bwa Lebanoni nigo bokogoyana.
english: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; he makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither and the blossoms of Lebanon fade.

ekegusii: Jehoram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
english: Yehosafati akaibora Yehoramu, na Yehoramu akaibora Ahasia, na Ahasia akaibora Yoashi;

ekegusii: “Omobisa agateba,” “Nimbabwatie, mbaikeere, mbiatanane ebi ndasakore, omoyo one oisaneke; ninsomore omoyio one o birende, k nimbasirie nokoboko kwane.”
english: "The enemy boasted, 'I will pursue, I will overtake them. I will divide the spoils; I will gorge myself on them. I will draw my sword and my hand will destroy them.'

ekegusii: Korende eriso ria Nyasae obo nigo riarenge ririgereretie abagaaka b’Abayahudi, na abanto baria tibabatangete goika amang’ana aria amoikere Dario. Nyuma y’ayio bairanerigwe ase rirube igoro y’amang’ana ayio.
english: But the eye of their God was watching over the elders of the Jews, and they were not stopped until a report could go to Darius and his written reply be received.

ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana atari nengencho amentekanire, ne chindoto chiamentekanire, obobe nigo bokoba obonge; korende aye omoiroke Nyasae.
english: Much dreaming and many words are meaningless. Therefore stand in awe of God.

ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’ese egiatungete omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, Musa agaatanana oyomo bw’abanto emerongo etano, na eyemo ye ching’iti emerongo etano, akaa Abalawi baria barenge gokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene, buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: From the Israelites' half, Moses selected one out of every fifty persons and animals, as the LORD commanded him, and gave them to the Levites, who were responsible for the care of the LORD's tabernacle.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli na Abayuda, baria bamenyete ase emechie y’Abayuda, bakarenta ensemo ya ikomi ye chiombe na eye ching’ondi, ebinto baatananete ase Omonene, Nyasae obo; ebio bakabibeka amo, bikaba chitui.
english: The men of Israel and Judah who lived in the towns of Judah also brought a tithe of their herds and flocks and a tithe of the holy things dedicated to the LORD their God, and they piled them in heaps.

ekegusii: Adonia akamotebia, “Nomanyete ng’a oboruoti nobwane bwarenge, na Abaisraeli bonsi igo baganetie mbagambere, korende nonya naboigo, oboruoti bokaonchoka bokaba obwa momura ominto, ekiagera igo bwaba obwaye ase ogwancha kw’Omonene.
english: "As you know," he said, "the kingdom was mine. All Israel looked to me as their king. But things changed, and the kingdom has gone to my brother; for it has come to him from the LORD.

ekegusii: na Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Haroni nigo arenge gokora emeremo y’obokuani ase Esanduku eria.) Abaisraeli bakaboria Omonene, “Natonyare naende kogenda korwana esegi n’Ababenjamin baminto, gose bono ngotiga tore?” Omonene akairaneria, “Imoka mogende, ekiagera ankio nimbeke abanto abwo ase amaboko aino.”
english: with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, ministering before it.) They asked, "Shall we go up again to battle with Benjamin our brother, or not?" The LORD responded, "Go, for tomorrow I will give them into your hands."

ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, akamotebia, “Oire amo naye abagaaka bande b’Abaisraeli, amo nenyimbo yao, eria kwaagete orooche, motang’ane abanto mogende.
english: The LORD answered Moses, "Walk on ahead of the people. Take with you some of the elders of Israel and take in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.

ekegusii: Omonene oria oikaransete aaria igoro, nigo agoseka na kobakorera echeche.
english: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord scoffs at them.

ekegusii: Tell Shemaiah the Nehelamite,
english: Amang’ana aya naro oratebie Semaya, omonto o Nehelamu:

ekegusii: Rigereria, timomwanga ere oyogokwana. Naki onye baria tibetooretie baria bamwangete ere oyobakurerete ase ense, kobua mono intwe titogwetooria onye tokomwanga ere oyogotokurera korwa igoro.
english: See to it that you do not refuse him who speaks. If they did not escape when they refused him who warned them on earth, how much less will we, if we turn away from him who warns us from heaven?

ekegusii: Rituko erio naribe asemore rituko ri’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka kegima, na inwe namweng’ate na gweitia. Ase rituko ria kianda ase omotienyi oyio, chinsa chia mogoroba, mochake korenda Esabato yaino, na mogenderere goika omogoroba onde.”
english: It is a sabbath of rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. From the evening of the ninth day of the month until the following evening you are to observe your sabbath."

ekegusii: Abafilisti bakabwatia Saulo na abamura baye, bagaita Yonathani, na Abinadabu, na Malikisua, abamura ba Saulo.
english: The Philistines pressed hard after Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab and Malki-Shua.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Ninchiche asore inde ase riire ririto ime, erio abanto aba baigwe kongokwana naye, na barabwo bakwegene botambe.” Erio Musa agatebia Omonene amang’ana abanto bairaneretie.
english: The LORD said to Moses, "I am going to come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear me speaking with you and will always put their trust in you." Then Moses told the LORD what the people had said.

ekegusii: Abwo babere bagatomwa n’Omoika Omochenu, bagatirimboka gochia Selukia, na korwa agwo bakaamboka nemeeri gochia Kuporo.
english: The two of them, sent on their way by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.

ekegusii: Omokuani oria akamotebia, “Omoyio o Goliato, Omofilisti oria gwaitete agwo ase ense omweremo ya Ela, nore aa, oboire egetambaa na kogachwa magega y’egesibao ki’obokuani. Onye koyoganetie yoire, ekiagera onde omoao tori aa.” Daudi agateba, “Onde tori onga buna oyio, yong’e”.
english: The priest replied, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, is here; it is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you want it, take it; there is no sword here but that one." David said, "There is none like it; give it to me."

ekegusii: Yoela na Sebadia, basinto ba Yerohamu, korwa Gedori.
english: and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.

ekegusii: Naende agatebia Uria, “Genda bwoo, bwesibie amagoro otimoke.” Uria akarua nyomba mw’omoruoti, na Daudi akamotunyaneria ekeegwa.
english: Then David said to Uriah, "Go down to your house and wash your feet." So Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

ekegusii: Inche nigo ngokora ring’ana ri’omosomba one riaba ne chinguru na goikerania emeroberio y’abatomwa baane. Ninche ngoteba igoro ya Yerusalemu ng’a nomenywe, na igoro y’emechie y’Abayuda ng’a neagachwe naende; ninche ndatenenie amaagacho ayio agwete inse.
english: who carries out the words of his servants and fulfills the predictions of his messengers, who says of Jerusalem, 'It shall be inhabited,' of the towns of Judah, 'They shall be built,' and of their ruins, 'I will restore them,'

ekegusii: Abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inabairwe nabanto b’egesaku ekeao ekero morigereretie, erio mobe mochandegete, ne rituko ase rituko mobe namaiga ase abana baino, korende timokonyara gotanga tibairwa.
english: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, and you will wear out your eyes watching for them day after day, powerless to lift a hand.

ekegusii: Omobani oria omogotu akamotebia, “Nainche igo inde omobani buna aye, na omomalaika nigo achigetwe n’Omonene agantebia: Genda omoiranie ache amo naye goika nyomba mwao, arie endagera na konywa amache.” Korende igo amotebetie oborimo.
english: The old prophet answered, "I too am a prophet, as you are. And an angel said to me by the word of the LORD: 'Bring him back with you to your house so that he may eat bread and drink water.'" (But he was lying to him.)

ekegusii: Omoruoti oyio nigo agoteba: “Ase chinguru chi’amaboko aane nakorire ayio, boigo nase obong’aini bwane, ekiagera nimbwate okomanya. Nasukirie chimbebe chi’abanto na kobaura chinibo chiabo, na ase chinguru chiane chire buna echi’eeri nabeire nkoiyeria abagambi korwa ase ebirogo biabo.
english: For he says: "'By the strength of my hand I have done this, and by my wisdom, because I have understanding. I removed the boundaries of nations, I plundered their treasures; like a mighty one I subdued their kings.

ekegusii: Ebiita biaye biarimeire ase riroba, emekorogoto yaye yabunirwe na gosarigwa. Omoruoti oye, na abagambi baye, nigo bamenyete ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku bitabwati amachiko, na ababani baye tibari konyora amaroro korwa ase Omonene.
english: Her gates have sunk into the ground; their bars he has broken and destroyed. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and her prophets no longer find visions from the LORD.

ekegusii: Asa omoruoti akarusia Maaka ng’ina taba eting’ana, ekiagera konya otenenirie omote bw’okogechia, oroiseretigwe Asera, enyasae eria enkungu. Asa akayobutorana akayoiyeria inse, akayosenyenta na akayosambera agwo ase akarooche ga Kidironi.
english: King Asa also deposed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive Asherah pole. Asa cut the pole down, broke it up and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

ekegusii: Omonene, aye nomanyete okoong’anya kwane, nigo osangereretie amariga aane okayabeka ase egetono kiao. Inee! Ayio onsi tarikiri ase ebuku yao?
english: Record my lament; list my tears on your scroll--are they not in your record?

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Ahihudi, mosinto o Selomi;
english: Ahihud son of Shelomi, the leader from the tribe of Asher;

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Rora, obobe naboche ase egesaku ekemo, bogende ase ekende, na ekembugu‐mbugu nageche korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Look! Disaster is spreading from nation to nation; a mighty storm is rising from the ends of the earth."

ekegusii: Naboigo nabatebirie, nobe omogoko igoro ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire, kobua ase abanyene oboronge emerongo kianda na kianda, abatarigeti okoonchoka.
english: I tell you that in the same way there will be more rejoicing in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who do not need to repent.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Inwe igoro chionsi, kumia ase ayio, kabe nobwoba, moiroke na koiguswa!
english: Be appalled at this, O heavens, and shudder with great horror," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti akaa Danieli amasikani amanene, na ebiegwa ebinene ebinge, naende akamobeka akaba omogambi igoro ase orogongo rwonsi rwa Babeli na omoteneneri omonene igoro y’abang’aini bonsi ba Babeli.
english: Then the king placed Daniel in a high position and lavished many gifts on him. He made him ruler over the entire province of Babylon and placed him in charge of all its wise men.

ekegusii: Korende ebitii bi’oborisia bietanaine emechie yabo tibikoonigwa, ekiagera ebio nebiabo kogenderera botambe.
english: But the pastureland belonging to their towns must not be sold; it is their permanent possession.

ekegusii: Nigo ebwate emenwa, korende teri gokwana, nebwate amaiso, korende teri korora,
english: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but they cannot see;

ekegusii: Omonto ogokonya abataka takoremerwa, korende oyo ogotuba amaiso aye ng’a tarora abataka nanyore okoragererigwa okonge.
english: He who gives to the poor will lack nothing, but he who closes his eyes to them receives many curses.

ekegusii: Chinchera chiabo nigo chire chinkorekanu, nigo bagotaara ase chinchera chire borogochi.
english: whose paths are crooked and who are devious in their ways.

ekegusii: Abanto abasacha, aba konya bakoorire omotiengi oyomo na goetania, nigo barenge chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana atano (7,500).
english: The number of all the males a month old or more who were counted was 7,500.

ekegusii: Nebe ase engaki eyio abana kwauretwe barakwane ase oigwete, batebe: Aase aiga naagote mono, togareerie tonyore aase tokomenya.
english: The children born during your bereavement will yet say in your hearing, 'This place is too small for us; give us more space to live in.'

ekegusii: Magadieli na Iramu. Abwo nabwo barenge abagambi b’Abaedomu.
english: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.

ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agakwa gakoorire emiaka rigana erimo na ikomi (110). Bakamoaka amariogo, tabaisa kogunda, bakamobeka ase esanduku ime aaria Misiri.
english: So Joseph died at the age of a hundred and ten. And after they embalmed him, he was placed in a coffin in Egypt.

ekegusii: So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous and good.
english: Naboigo amachiko namachenu, na ogochika nogochenu, na okwa boronge, na okuya.

ekegusii: Egesasimero keagachwe ne chibao, ime getigwe giasaime. Okeroisie buna kworogetigwe ase egetunwa.”
english: Make the altar hollow, out of boards. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: "Abana mbaragera?" Nabo tata akaboririe mama, gaiikire nka morogoba. Ntwe ebimwana nigo twakarageire ritang'ani, twabutiara. Go twabutiarire, twagenda isiko gotiena. Tata omanya koragera. Petronillah Ogoti nigo atebetigwe na ng'ina koro buna, "Tata N' omochobeeri. Agachobeera Akareta Baba". Bono igo ninki aase Ekegusii? Ase ogototebia igoro y' omoino oyo, ngina koro Petronillah natoete omogano. Kobwatekana na ng'ina koro, eye n' enywomo yatogetigwe ase omobayeno oyo oito. Enywomo eyio yabete, nigo yaagerete omwana oyomo akaba n' omogoko, na gotogia ise. Nigo ise omomura oyo arenge omogaka bwanchire ase enka amo n' ekenyoro kiaye. Bono omomura oyo gakiina na koba omonto omonene, akainyora obwanchani boria bwarenge ase enka yaye. Obwanchani boria bwachakerete gati y' ise na ng'ina, eyio yaagerete akaiborwa. Bono kaare n' omogoko, omomura oyo akainyora buna goetera ase ise konywoma ngina, akaiborwa. Kainyora iga, agatera omoino oyo ase enchera y' omobayeno. Tari igo rioka. Korora ebiinto ebiya ise amokorerete, omomura oyo akarora buna tiga amotogie, ase eng'encho nere ogerete abeire omomura egesora ase ekenyoro. Goetera ase omomura oyo, Abagusii bakabwatera abwo n' omobayeno oyo ogoteba buna"Tata N' omochobeeri. Agachobeera Akareta Baba". Oyo noro omoino oito for this week, naende Happy Father's Day ase abatata bonsi babeta. Monywe mache maya and thank you for listening. Happy Fathers Day 2012. Omwana omino, Fanuel Sedekia oyio.
english: These are their words: "Are the children enough?" And her father scolded her mother, reminding her like a foolish person. We children, we would argue constantly, we would fight. As we fought, we went outside together. Our father didn't know how to scold. Petronillah Ogoti was greeted by eight people, saying, “Father, you are a good man. The good man is Akareta Baba.” What does this mean in Ekegusii? It means she has experienced life, those eight people including Petronillah have agreed. To be associated with those eight people, and the wealth they possess is great. That wealth existed, and it helped the child who had problems and lacked respect, and it benefited them. And now this story continues to spread around about the past and the present. This story also involves a large amount of money, and it reminds people of the things they did in the past. Those things were shared among everyone, and those eight people helped. This time with problems and respect, this story reminds them to avoid being disrespectful to others, helping. It reminds them again, causing life to flourish through the help of others. Time passes quickly. Repeating the good deeds that our ancestors did, this story will continue until it reaches the ears of those who understand the importance of respecting elders. Because of this story, the Gusii people remember the relationship between fathers and children which says, “Father, you are a good man. The good man is Akareta Baba.” This is a good thing for life this week, and I wish Happy Father's Day to all fathers who exist. Have a nice day and thank you for listening. Happy Fathers Day 2012. This child, Fanuel Sedekia.

ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri omoganda oyo omobe oremurunganie asende? Naigure Abaisraeli banyemurunganeirie.
english: "How long will this wicked community grumble against me? I have heard the complaints of these grumbling Israelites.

ekegusii: Ekaba nyuma y’emiaka ene koyaerire, Abisalomu agatebia omoruoti, “Koranche ong’e ribaga ngende Heburoni goikerania eira yane narierete Omonene.
english: At the end of four years, Absalom said to the king, "Let me go to Hebron and fulfill a vow I made to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero abarendi barenge goetanana omochie koyorata, bakanyora inche, bakang’aka chingoma; bakang’ura egetambaa gi’okwambara, abarendi baria barendete chindwaki.
english: The watchmen found me as they made their rounds in the city. They beat me, they bruised me; they took away my cloak, those watchmen of the walls!

ekegusii: Korende ekiagera chisokoro chiaito chiagerete Nyasae o igoro akaba nendamwamu, ere akabeka abanto baria ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro Omokalidayo, omoruoti o Babeli, oria osaretie enyomba eye na akaira abanto Babeli.
english: But because our fathers angered the God of heaven, he handed them over to Nebuchadnezzar the Chaldean, king of Babylon, who destroyed this temple and deported the people to Babylon.

ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ang’e na Yerusalemu, bagaika Betifage na Bethania, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, agatoma babere b’aborokigwa baye,
english: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples,

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nere kirori one, buna inde namaiga ase inwe mwensi nobwanchani bokorwa ase Kristo Yeso.
english: God can testify how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Bono imokia ebikorero bi’omorisia oyio otagwenereti kende.
english: Then the LORD said to me, "Take again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

ekegusii: Erio Akisi akarangeria Daudi, akamotebia, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, nigo ndoche buya ng’a ogende amo nainche ase esegi. Korwa ekero gwachete asende goika rituko ria rero tinana korora okomocha asore, korende nonya naboigo, abanene aba tibagwancheti.
english: So Achish called David and said to him, "As surely as the LORD lives, you have been reliable, and I would be pleased to have you serve with me in the army. From the day you came to me until now, I have found no fault in you, but the rulers don't approve of you.

ekegusii: Nigo aboria ribaga ri’ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa nyuma y’abagesi, na korwa mambia goika bono nigo agendererete gochora ebigara, taratimoka rinde otatiga bono ase engaki ensinini akendererete ase ekegutu keria.”
english: She said, 'Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves behind the harvesters.' She went into the field and has worked steadily from morning till now, except for a short rest in the shelter."

ekegusii: “Ekero Hezekia arenge omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Mika korwa Mosereti nabanete, agatebia Abayuda bonsi: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire:” “Sayoni noremwe buna omogondo okoremwa Yerusalemu nobe chitui chi’amaturi, na egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene nkebe egetunwa kie rinani.
english: "Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. He told all the people of Judah, 'This is what the LORD Almighty says: "'Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.'

ekegusii: Mbarengeo Mariamu Magidalena na Mariamu onde, baikaransete bosio bw’oboina.
english: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.

ekegusii: Mwerende inwe abanyene amo ne riicho riria Omoika Omochenu obabegete mobe abarendi korisia ekanisa y’Omonene, eye enyorerete namanyinga aye omonyene.
english: Keep watch over yourselves and all the flock of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers. Be shepherds of the church of God, which he bought with his own blood.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omoruoti Yoramu akarua Samaria, akaroberia Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: So at that time King Joram set out from Samaria and mobilized all Israel.

ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatano akabugia egetureri kiaye. Erio nkarora eng’enang’eni konya yagure korwa igoro gocha ase ense. Eng’enang’eni eria ekaegwa ekeigorero gi’ekeronga ki’eora y’abakure.
english: The fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the shaft of the Abyss.

ekegusii: “Na bono aye Omonene, ikerania onsi aya kwariete eira igoro yane inche omosomba oo, na igoro y’ororeria rwane, na okore aya gwatebete ng’a noyakore,
english: "And now, LORD, let the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house be established forever. Do as you promised,

ekegusii: Korende aye ngwantebetie: Ningokorere amaya, ninkore ororeria rwao robe buna omokenye o nyancha, otanyare kobareka, ekiagera nomonge.”
english: But you have said, 'I will surely make you prosper and will make your descendants like the sand of the sea, which cannot be counted.'"

ekegusii: Ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso, inwe ekero morasangererekane, na omoika one nao ore amo nokobua kw’Omonene oito Yeso,
english: When you are assembled in the name of our Lord Jesus and I am with you in spirit, and the power of our Lord Jesus is present,

ekegusii: Ondorere amabera, erinde imbe moyo; inche nigo ngokerete amachiko ao.
english: Let your compassion come to me that I may live, for your law is my delight.

ekegusii: Ere konya oroiseirie Tobia enyomba engare agwo aase konya barenge kogacha okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ubani, na ebikorero, ne chinsemo chia ikomi chi’endagera, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, ebinto biachikeretwe Abalawi, na abateri, na abarendi b’ebiita. Boigo ebiegwa biachikeretwe abakuani, nao biare kogachwa.
english: and he had provided him with a large room formerly used to store the grain offerings and incense and temple articles, and also the tithes of grain, new wine and oil prescribed for the Levites, singers and gatekeepers, as well as the contributions for the priests.

ekegusii: ng’a abanto bande ababe batarochi inchera barure ase egati yaino, bang’usire abanto b’omochie obo, na kobasiria, bagoteba: Inchuo togende gosasima chinyasae ching’ao konya motana gosasima rinde.
english: that wicked men have arisen among you and have led the people of their town astray, saying, "Let us go and worship other gods" (gods you have not known),

ekegusii: Erio ogwatananekana kogasoa ase omoganda ase engencho yaye.
english: Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.

ekegusii: Naende ototeneneirie Omotooria bw’okobua ase eamate ya Daudi, omosomba oye.
english: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

ekegusii: Na emeganda y’esegi ere igoro ekamotunyana, na abwo bariinete chibarasi chindabu, babekeire chianga chi’egatani engiya endabu.
english: The armies of heaven were following him, riding on white horses and dressed in fine linen, white and clean.

ekegusii: Omonto nigo akogenda ase rinani ogecha emecharake, gose bwechorera emete ao ao enga buna emetontera, oyetiga egokina agwo ase rinani, gose bwesimekera omobunduki, embura yaba ekoyokinia.
english: He cut down cedars, or perhaps took a cypress or oak. He let it grow among the trees of the forest, or planted a pine, and the rain made it grow.

ekegusii: Naende nkaboria omomalaika oria, “Emezeituni eye ebere, oyomo ore ensemo y’okorio na oyonde ensemo y’okobee y’ekebekerero keria gie chitaya, neya ki?”
english: Then I asked the angel, "What are these two olive trees on the right and the left of the lampstand?"

ekegusii: Taibo, intwe abasomba bao titware gokora bo. Inee! Chibesa chiria twanyorete igoro y’endagera ase chigunia chiaito ime, titwagochiiraneria naende korwa ase ense ya Kanani? Naki tware gokora toibe efeta gose etahabu korwa ase enyomba y’omonene oo?
english: We even brought back to you from the land of Canaan the silver we found inside the mouths of our sacks. So why would we steal silver or gold from your master's house?

ekegusii: Daudi akarigereria akarora omomalaika oria bw’Omonene oteneine gati y’ense na igoro; ere nabwate omoyio o birende ase okoboko kwaye okoramborete gochia igoro ya Yerusalemu, na Daudi na abagaaka babegete chianga chie chigunia, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.
english: David looked up and saw the angel of the LORD standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand extended over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorangeria abare ase omochie, na omonto oirogete erieta riaye nere omong’aini. Eriogi riaye nigo rigoteba: “Igwa igoro y’egesusuro na ning’o ogechikire.
english: Listen! The LORD is calling to the city-- and to fear your name is wisdom-- "Heed the rod and the One who appointed it.

ekegusii: Na omorero ogaika korwa ase Omonene, okabasamba, barabwo bakayia, bagakwera agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: So fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed them, and they died before the LORD.

ekegusii: Give us today our daily bread.
english: Otoe intwe rero endagera yaito.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, ekero narangeretigwe ngacha, tinaanga. Nkoboria nde: Ing’ana ki mwandangereretie?”
english: So when I was sent for, I came without raising any objection. May I ask why you sent for me?"

ekegusii: Naende bogoria ekegogwa gi’ekioma ki’ogotooreka, na omoro bw’Omoika, noro ring’ana ria Nyasae.
english: Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ogokwa kwa Gidioni, Abaisraeli bagatiga koba abegenwa ase Omonene, na bagasasima chinyasae chiria Baali. Bagachora Baali‐Beriti ekaba enyasae yabo,
english: No sooner had Gideon died than the Israelites again prostituted themselves to the Baals. They set up Baal-Berith as their god and

ekegusii: Onye intwe twabeire moyo ase Omoika, togenderere boigo ase Omoika.
english: Since we live by the Spirit, let us keep in step with the Spirit.

ekegusii: Naki Musa konya oeire ebisaku binde bibere na ekeng’ese ense ere ng’umbu, moocha ya Yorodan, ebe omwando obo, korende Abalawi barabwo tibaetwe ense ase egati yabo, ebe omwando obo.
english: Moses had granted the two-and-a-half tribes their inheritance east of the Jordan but had not granted the Levites an inheritance among the rest,

ekegusii: na oborito bwe chitahabu chi’ebibekerero bie chitaya na echie chitaya chiria, na obwa kera ekebekerero gie chitaya ao ao, na oborito bwe chifeta chia kera ekebekerero gie chitaya, ne chitaya chiria, koreng’ana nemeremo ya kera ekebekerero,
english: the weight of gold for the gold lampstands and their lamps, with the weight for each lampstand and its lamps; and the weight of silver for each silver lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;

ekegusii: Naende oimokie inke igo korwa ase eyio, oyerute ase omorero oyesambe, na korwa ase eyio omorero norueo bwesiarere gochia ase Abaisraeli bonsi.”
english: Again, take a few of these and throw them into the fire and burn them up. A fire will spread from there to the whole house of Israel.

ekegusii: Enchera y’omonto omworo nigo enga buna orobago rw’amagwa, korende ey’abanyene oboronge nigo ere enene erongeete.
english: The way of the sluggard is blocked with thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.

ekegusii: Kerabe omonto okwerigeria ogosesenigwa ase ense, oyio nandigie inche Nyasae bw’ekeene imosesenie, na onde bwensi ase ense eye orabe ogotiana, nabe ogotiana asende inche Nyasae bw’ekeene; rirorio nebe ng’a emechando emetang’ani yebirwe na kobiswa korwa ase amaiso aane.
english: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the God of truth; he who takes an oath in the land will swear by the God of truth. For the past troubles will be forgotten and hidden from my eyes.

ekegusii: akayobeka ase oboina bwaye oboyia, obwabachete ase egetare; naende agaturunkania rigena rinene gochia ase egesieri ki’oboina, akagenda.
english: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.

ekegusii: Rituko riria Musa akandiera eira na gotiana, agateba: Ekeene, ense eyio amagoro ao atachete nigo erabe omwando oo, na oyo bw’ororeria rwao botambe, ekiagera kwaigwerete Omonene, Nyasae one.
english: So on that day Moses swore to me, 'The land on which your feet have walked will be your inheritance and that of your children forever, because you have followed the LORD my God wholeheartedly.'

ekegusii: “Abanto b’egesaku kiao nigo bagoteba: Chinchera chi’Omonene tichiri echi’ekeene, korende chinchera chiabo nachio chitari echi’ekeene.
english: "Yet your countrymen say, 'The way of the Lord is not just.' But it is their way that is not just.

ekegusii: Erio Omoika ogasoa ime yane, ogantenenia, na Omonene agakwana nainche, agantebia, “Genda bwesiekere nyomba mwao.
english: Then the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet. He spoke to me and said: "Go, shut yourself inside your house.

ekegusii: I will place over them one shepherd, my servant David, and he will tend them; he will tend them and be their shepherd.
english: Ninchibekere omorisia oyomo achirisie, nere Daudi, omosomba one. Ere nachirisie, abe omorisia obo.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso amoigwa agakumia, agatebia abamotunyanete, “Nekeene nabatebirie: Nonya nase Abaisraeli tindanyora okwegena okore buna oko.
english: When Jesus heard this, he was astonished and said to those following him, "I tell you the truth, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, Inee, nonachere omochie oiteire amanyinga ’abanto abange ekina? Onye nabo, yworokie ebibe biaye bionsi bi’okogechia,
english: "Son of man, will you judge her? Will you judge this city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her detestable practices

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Nainche nimbaborie ring’ana erimo, nainwe mong’iranerie, erio nimbatebie ase okobua ki ngokorera aya.
english: Jesus replied, "I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebikong’u asende kobimanya, naende nebinge mono bitanyare kobareka.
english: How precious to me are your thoughts, O God! How vast is the sum of them!

ekegusii: Ase ayio inche omonyene ninsangererie abatigari be riicho riane, mbarusie korwa chinse chionsi agwo ase nabasiarerete gochia; nimbairanie gocha ase obweri bwabo, na barabwo nabaibore na komentekana.
english: "I myself will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them and will bring them back to their pasture, where they will be fruitful and increase in number.
