ekegusii: “Ekero orabe gokobara Abaisraeli ase okorikwa kwabo, kera omonto arue ekeegwa ase Omonene, kebe embooria ase obogima bwaye, tibabaisa konyora amaakwa ekero bakorikwa.
english: "When you take a census of the Israelites to count them, each one must pay the LORD a ransom for his life at the time he is counted. Then no plague will come on them when you number them.

ekegusii: Nigo nakorire ayio ase engencho yane, ee, ase engencho yane inche omonyene, tingotiga erieta riane rikorwe ribe eritachenegeti. Tinkoa onde obonene bwane.”
english: For my own sake, for my own sake, I do this. How can I let myself be defamed? I will not yield my glory to another.

ekegusii: Motabasereti, rirorio nimbakore inwe buna konya narengereirie gokora barabwo.”
english: And then I will do to you what I plan to do to them.'"

ekegusii: ng’a aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Naama! Ebirwanero ebio mobwate ase amaboko aino korwaneria omoruoti o Babeli na Abakalidayo, abwo babanaaririe isiko ye chindwaki, inche omonyene nimbionchore na mbisangererie amo gati‐gati y’omochie oyio.
english: 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I am about to turn against you the weapons of war that are in your hands, which you are using to fight the king of Babylon and the Babylonians who are outside the wall besieging you. And I will gather them inside this city.

ekegusii: Omonene akang’iraneria, agantebia, “Ebibe bi’Abaisraeli na Abayuda nigo bire ebinene mono. Ense nigo eichire nogoiterwa kw’amanyinga, na omochie nigo oichire nobokorekanu bw’ogosaria amachiko, ekiagera abanto nigo bagoteba: Omonene otigire ense eye, ere tari korora kende.
english: He answered me, "The sin of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great; the land is full of bloodshed and the city is full of injustice. They say, 'The LORD has forsaken the land; the LORD does not see.'

ekegusii: agatung’ama, akarora ebitambaa bireo, korende tasoa ime.
english: He bent over and looked in at the strips of linen lying there but did not go in.

ekegusii: Na Omonene akabeka Lakisi ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, erio bakayobwata rituko ria kabere, bagaita nemioro abanto bonsi b’omochie, buna bakorete agwo Libuna.
english: The LORD handed Lachish over to Israel, and Joshua took it on the second day. The city and everyone in it he put to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.

ekegusii: Abasiiria bagakora oboonchoreria naye, ekiagera kwabwate ebinto ebinge bi’obotenenku; bagakorentera amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa alimasi, na erangi emonyinga, na ebitambaa bi’ebieni ao ao, na egatani engiya, na amakorongote, na amagena akorokwa agati, bakagora ebinto biao.
english: "'Aram did business with you because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple fabric, embroidered work, fine linen, coral and rubies for your merchandise.

ekegusii: Natebire aya ase okobasookia. Inee! Onde tari ase egati yaino ore ne chisemi chiisaine oranyare konacha amang’ana are ase egati y’abamwabo?
english: I say this to shame you. Is it possible that there is nobody among you wise enough to judge a dispute between believers?

ekegusii: Intwe twensi konya twasirire buna ching’ondi chinsiru; kera omonto nigo abwatetie enchera yaye omonyene, na Omonene omotwekire obobe bwaito intwe twensi.
english: We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo are amo naintwe, Nyasae o Yakobo nere obotamero bwaito.
english: The LORD Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

ekegusii: "You see the people crowding against you," his disciples answered, "and yet you can ask, 'Who touched me?'"
english: Aborokigwa baye bakamotebia, “Kwarorire omoganda buna okomigete, na aye gokoboria: Ning’o onkuna?”

ekegusii: Description Dorothy Jebet nabwate obomanyi obuya botanetie emiaka 18. Ere okorire emeremo ase chinyomba chia abariki ao ao buna Nation Media, The Standard, Eria Yaereretwe Kenya Times, The Star na Kass FM ase ebitambokero ao ao. Nigo abwate obomanyi oboagare ase abariki banucha ense engima, obomo bwabo n’ekero gete akorerete enyomba y’abariki ekorokwa “US Congressional” chingaki chia Bill Clinton arenge koraa Amerika. Emeremo ya Dorothy nemegare, eyende nigo yasaneretwe na chinse chia maiko. Omogano oye igoro y’eywomo yaberete omoiseke bw’Emiaka 18, nigo yamobwerete ekegwa kiogosoma bosa korwa SIDA (Swedish International Development Agency) igoro y’obosera bwa mwanyabanto na oborai ase Eyunibasiti ya Lund, Sweden.
english: Description Dorothy Jebet acquired knowledge at a young age of 18 years. She worked in various media houses such as Nation Media, The Standard, Kenya Times, The Star and Kass FM among others. She gained experience from journalists who had covered stories about prominent people, her work and career reaching the level of covering the "US Congressional" visit of Bill Clinton and his tour of America. Dorothy's career progressed, and she was later sent on assignment by the government. This girl, upon completing 18 years, was awarded a scholarship to study at SIDA (Swedish International Development Agency) for a course in public health and research at Lund University, Sweden.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo bagesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo, bagakora obonyaka tibaba abegenwa.
english: They defiled themselves by what they did; by their deeds they prostituted themselves.

ekegusii: Ekero konya amorusirie oyo, akaimokereria Daudi igoro koba omoruoti obo. Akabatebia igoro yaye: Nanyorire Daudi, mosinto o Yese; nere omonto ongweneire ase enkoro yane, naende nere oranyare gokora ogwancha kwane gwonsi.
english: After removing Saul, he made David their king. He testified concerning him: 'I have found David son of Jesse a man after my own heart; he will do everything I want him to do.'

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Sulemani agaikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Daudi ise, na oboruoti bwaye bokaba ne chinguru chinene mono.
english: So Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his rule was firmly established.

ekegusii: Ekero achia gosansora ekemanyererio kia gatano, nkarora inse y’egesasimero emeika y’abwo baitetwe ekiagera barenge koraria ring’ana ria Nyasae, na koba abegenwa ase oborori bwabo.
english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain because of the word of God and the testimony they had maintained.

ekegusii: Na ekero abanto baroche Samison, bagatogia enyasae yabo, bagateba, “Enyasae yaito yabekire omobisa oito ase amaboko aito, omobisa oria osaririe ense yaito na oitire abanto baito abange.”
english: When the people saw him, they praised their god, saying, "Our god has delivered our enemy into our hands, the one who laid waste our land and multiplied our slain."

ekegusii: (agwo omokuani abeke omokungu oyio inse y’okoragererigwa gw’okomotiania) rirorio Omonene nagere abanto bao bakoragererie na kogochaya, karakore enda yao egombae na kobimba.
english: here the priest is to put the woman under this curse of the oath-- "may the LORD cause your people to curse and denounce you when he causes your thigh to waste away and your abdomen to swell.

ekegusii: Agachora abakuani baye b’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, na ab’ebirecha, na ab’emegwekano ye chimori chiria aroisetie.
english: And he appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat and calf idols he had made.

ekegusii: Onye kwanyorire obooke, karie ekerengo kegoisaine; oise kogeetania nigo oraboroke.
english: If you find honey, eat just enough-- too much of it, and you will vomit.

ekegusii: Ekero agambigwe ekina, tiga abarerwe okomocha, nonya nogosaba kwaye kobarwe ng’a nebibe.
english: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayers condemn him.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi ekero Saulo atomete abanto bamoite) Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane, indende korwa ase abanto aba banyimokeire gonkora bobe.
english: For the director of music. [To the tune of] "Do Not Destroy." Of David. A miktam. When Saul had sent men to watch David's house in order to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O God; protect me from those who rise up against me.

ekegusii: Omonene oria ore egetari kia Yakobo tagwekaini emegwekano eyio. Ere nere otongete ebinto bionsi. Abaisraeli nigo bare egesaku kere omwando oye; Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye.
english: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including Israel, the tribe of his inheritance-- the LORD Almighty is his name.

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana nainche agantebia, “Genda ogore enyongo korwa ase omokori chinyongo. Ogende nabagaaka b’abanto, na abagaaka b’abakuani,
english: This is what the LORD says: "Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take along some of the elders of the people and of the priests

ekegusii: Toma abanto abwo bachete Yerusalemu korora Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, erinde baire ebinto ebio ase omoruoti bw’Abaedomu, na oyo bw’Abamoabu, na oyo bw’Abaamoni, na oyo o Turo, na oyo o Sidoni.
english: Then send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre and Sidon through the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.

ekegusii: Isaac then made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
english: Erio Isaka akabakorera omoyega, bakaria na bakanywa.

ekegusii: Oise koboorokia, na omonto onde aise koigwa ayio, nigo aragosookie, na erieta riao risareke kogenderera botambe.
english: or he who hears it may shame you and you will never lose your bad reputation.

ekegusii: Nase ki inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu mogendererete gontiga iga? Mwancheranire nokong’ainererigwa, na mwangire kong’iranera.
english: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akairana korwa agwo aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agwo Gibeoni, korwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, akagenda Yerusalemu na akaba okogambera Abaisraeli.
english: Then Solomon went to Jerusalem from the high place at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting. And he reigned over Israel.

ekegusii: Naende akarora ng’a Yakobo oigwereire ise na ng’ina ogendire Padan‐Aramu.
english: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and had gone to Paddan Aram.

ekegusii: Omonto oria akamotebia, “Imoka, tochake orogendo!” Korende omokungu oria tamoiraneria. Erio akamoimokia, akamobeka ase etigere igoro, agachaka orogendo rwaye gochia inka bwoye.
english: He said to her, "Get up; let's go." But there was no answer. Then the man put her on his donkey and set out for home.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli bakamanora, bakagenda, na ase rituko ria gatato bagaika emechie yabo: Gibeoni, na Kefira, na Beroti, na Kiriati‐Yearimu.
english: So the Israelites set out and on the third day came to their cities: Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth and Kiriath Jearim.

ekegusii: Ekero morabe mogoeta ase amache ime, nimbe amo nainwe; namoba mogoeta ase chindooche, tichikobamera. Namoete ase omorero, timogosambwa, gose omorero ekebemberi tokobasiria.
english: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you pass through the rivers, they will not sweep over you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned; the flames will not set you ablaze.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ogokwa kwa Ibrahimu, Nyasae agasesenia Isaka, omwana oye. Na Isaka akamenya ang’e nensoko yare korokwa Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi.
english: After Abraham's death, God blessed his son Isaac, who then lived near Beer Lahai Roi.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo obwo Belisasari, omoruoti bw’Abakalidayo, agaitwa agakwa,
english: That very night Belshazzar, king of the Babylonians, was slain,

ekegusii: Na omokungu oria nigo arenge oboirie eanga emonyinga na embariri mono, na ochabeire chitahabu, na amagena e rigori rinene, ne chiruru. Ere nigo arenge negekombe gi’etahabu koboko kwaye, geichire okogechia na eubi y’obotomani bwaye.
english: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and was glittering with gold, precious stones and pearls. She held a golden cup in her hand, filled with abominable things and the filth of her adulteries.

ekegusii: Na Nyasae bw’oboremereria na bw’okoremia abakonye mobe nomoyo oyomo inwe ase inwe ase omogwekano o Kristo Yeso;
english: May the God who gives endurance and encouragement give you a spirit of unity among yourselves as you follow Christ Jesus,

ekegusii: Ayio nigo arakoreke, erinde mote onde bwensi ore ase amache tobaisa kweenenia ase obotambe bwaye, gose gwetambeyia gochia igoro ase amare; gose emete ende yonsi ekonyora amache tekina gochia igoro yeenenie, ekiagera yonsi yachikeirwe ogokwa esoe inse ye riroba ase mwanyabanto bakure basoete.
english: Therefore no other trees by the waters are ever to tower proudly on high, lifting their tops above the thick foliage. No other trees so well-watered are ever to reach such a height; they are all destined for death, for the earth below, among mortal men, with those who go down to the pit.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge takonyegerigwa, korende omokori amabe takogenderera komenya ase ense.
english: The righteous will never be uprooted, but the wicked will not remain in the land.

ekegusii: na ngakurera Abayahudi na Abagiriki baonchokere Nyasae, na komwegena Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: I have declared to both Jews and Greeks that they must turn to God in repentance and have faith in our Lord Jesus.

ekegusii: “Inee! Ng’ara karenga chitaya chi’abakori amabe chikorimigwa? Ng’ara karenga emechando ekobachera? Inee! Nyasae nkobaa are emechando ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye?
english: "Yet how often is the lamp of the wicked snuffed out? How often does calamity come upon them, the fate God allots in his anger?

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani agatenena bosio bw’egesasimero ki’Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, akarambora amaboko aye gochia igoro,
english: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly of Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven

ekegusii: Akagenda naende, agasaba, ogokwana amang’ana aria amatang’ani.
english: Once more he went away and prayed the same thing.

ekegusii: Amo na Finehasi bagatoma abatang’ani ikomi, oyomo bwa kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli; kera oyomo nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’eamate ase egesaku kiaye.
english: With him they sent ten of the chief men, one for each of the tribes of Israel, each the head of a family division among the Israelite clans.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaboria Omonene, “Inee! Ndagenda korwania Abafilisti? Nobabeke ase amaboko aane gose?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee genda, nimbabeke ase amaboko ao.”
english: so David inquired of the LORD, "Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you hand them over to me?" The LORD answered him, "Go, for I will surely hand the Philistines over to you."

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera gokina ase chinchera chiaye. Ebina biao okonacha nigo bire igoro mono, takobimanya; nigo agochaya ababisa baye bonsi.
english: His ways are always prosperous; he is haughty and your laws are far from him; he sneers at all his enemies.

ekegusii: Gaki komokoria, gose mokonywa gose mogokora ing’ana rinde rionsi, kora onsi ase obonene bwa Nyasae.
english: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.

ekegusii: Inwe igoro chionsi, tera nomogoko, ekiagera Omonene oikeranirie ayio; naye ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omochengo! Inwe ebitunwa, na amanani, na kera omote ore aroro, tera nechinguru chinyinge, ekiagera Omonene obooririe abanto ba Yakobo, neorokie ase egati y’Abaisraeli ore nobonene.
english: Sing for joy, O heavens, for the LORD has done this; shout aloud, O earth beneath. Burst into song, you mountains, you forests and all your trees, for the LORD has redeemed Jacob, he displays his glory in Israel.

ekegusii: Nagochikeire amatuko amagana atato, na emerongo kianda (390); amatuko ayio nigo anga buna emiaka y’egesusuro ki’obobe bwabo, eyio nero engaki orabe kobogoretie obobe bw’Abaisraeli.
english: I have assigned you the same number of days as the years of their sin. So for 390 days you will bear the sin of the house of Israel.

ekegusii: Omwana omomura ogosangereria chindagera engaki ye rigesa nigo are omong’aini, korende oyo okorara engaki eyio nigo akorenta obosooku.
english: He who gathers crops in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.

ekegusii: Naki erioba korikooroka nomobaso omororo, nigo rigosamba na kwomia obonyansi. Egesicha ki’obonyansi kiaroroka, na obuya bw’ekieni kiaye bwasira. Naboigo nomonda nere arasire kagendererete kwerigeria.
english: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its blossom falls and its beauty is destroyed. In the same way, the rich man will fade away even while he goes about his business.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoiraneria: “Aya nigo akorekanire, ekiagera batigire ogochika kwane nabaete, bangire konyigwera na kobwatia chinchera chiane.
english: The LORD said, "It is because they have forsaken my law, which I set before them; they have not obeyed me or followed my law.

ekegusii: Nase ki gwachayire ring’ana riane inche Omonene, na gwakorire amabe ase obosio bwane? Gwaitire Uria Omohiti; okamorua, na Abaamoni bakamoita nomoro, naende kwairire mokaye koba mokao.
english: Why did you despise the word of the LORD by doing what is evil in his eyes? You struck down Uriah the Hittite with the sword and took his wife to be your own. You killed him with the sword of the Ammonites.

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Ela, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ime ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Elah's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Erio Saitani akamotiga, na rora, abamalaika bagacha, bakamokorera.
english: Then the devil left him, and angels came and attended him.

ekegusii: Na omomalaika onde agasoka korwa ase Hekalu ya igoro, nere boigo narenge nomoyio okogesa.
english: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.

ekegusii: Obong’aini obo tari boria bogocha korwa igoro, korende nobw’ense, na obwe chingencho chia mwanyabanto, na echi’ebirecha,
english: Such "wisdom" does not come down from heaven but is earthly, unspiritual, of the devil.

ekegusii: Ere nigo anchete koragereria, bono tiga okoragereria okwo komoiranere. Ere tanchete gosesenia, ase ayio ogosesenigwa kobe aare asare.
english: He loved to pronounce a curse-- may it come on him; he found no pleasure in blessing-- may it be far from him.

ekegusii: Abimeleki amo nabanto bonsi barenge komo bakaimoka botuko, bakebisa, bakaboera Sekemu, bare ebiombe bine.
english: So Abimelech and all his troops set out by night and took up concealed positions near Shechem in four companies.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Nindete omoro orwanie Gogi agwo ase ebitunwa biane bionsi, erio kera omonto aite oyomwabo nomoro.
english: I will summon a sword against Gog on all my mountains, declares the Sovereign LORD. Every man's sword will be against his brother.

ekegusii: Omokuani ataaere amaguta ase oroe rw’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.
english: The priest is to pour some of the oil into the palm of his own left hand,

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakoimoka mambia chuni, baminyoka gochia konywa ebinyugwa bigotindia, abwo bakogenderera kobeera agwo goika obotuko bokia, erinde edivai eyio yabasamba na kobaonchorana.
english: Woe to those who rise early in the morning to run after their drinks, who stay up late at night till they are inflamed with wine.

ekegusii: “Oroisie emesa ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
english: "Make a table of acacia wood-- two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto baria bamanoire kogenda, rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akaorokera Yusufu ase chindoto, akamotebia, “Imoka korwa aa, oire omwana na ng’ina, otame gochia Misiri, omenye aroro goika ngotebie, ekiagera Herode narigie omwana oyo anyare komoita.”
english: When they had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. "Get up," he said, "take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the child to kill him."

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio kera rituko, ase amatuko atano na abere, mobe mokoruera Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera. Morue okoruegwa okwo amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochikire.
english: In this way prepare the food for the offering made by fire every day for seven days as an aroma pleasing to the LORD; it is to be prepared in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yehu, mosinto o Hanani, rigakwana mamincha ya Baasa, rigateba,
english: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha:

ekegusii: Abayuda bonsi bakaba nomochengo ase emuma eria bariete, ekiagera nigo batiananetie ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi, na bakarigia Omonene ase okogania kwabo gwonsi. Omonene akanyorekana asebare, na akabaa obotoereru ase chinsemo chiabo chionsi.
english: All Judah rejoiced about the oath because they had sworn it wholeheartedly. They sought God eagerly, and he was found by them. So the LORD gave them rest on every side.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ekero gwatang’anete abanto bao na ogotaara ase erooro,
english: When you went out before your people, O God, when you marched through the wasteland, Selah

ekegusii: onye bagweitia na koonchoka ase ebirengererio biabo bionsi na ase chinkoro chiabo chionsi, ekero bare ase ense eria ase boosetwe gochia, na aroro agwo bagosabe barigereretie gochia ase ense yabo, eria kwaete chisokoro chiabo, na barigererie omochie oyo gwachorire na enyomba eye naagachire ase ogosasima erieta riao,
english: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their captivity where they were taken, and pray toward the land you gave their fathers, toward the city you have chosen and toward the temple I have built for your Name;

ekegusii: Erio nkarora ekerogo ki’obonene, ekenene, ekerabu, amo noyogeikaranserete. Korwa ase obosio bwaye ense na igoro bigatama, na aase abo tarorekana ase bakobeera.
english: Then I saw a great white throne and him who was seated on it. Earth and sky fled from his presence, and there was no place for them.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi bakoorire gosarwa, bakabeera aase abo ase egetwori goika bakagwena.
english: And after the whole nation had been circumcised, they remained where they were in camp until they were healed.

ekegusii: Minto FM: Maangi oboririe abagusii mbaaba na ebiama ebinge bia gesiasa Omokonyi bwo Omogavana bwe Ecounty ya Kisii Joash Maangi otebire buna esegi mamicha yo obokurumi nigo eranyarekana ekero oboisati naboigo obweene bokobwateraniwa ase esegi eywoo,gokwana amo na minto fm nigo maangi atebire buna ekero siasa ekobwateriniwa no obokurumi nigo erabee akongu gokora embwaa eywooo ime ye ense.
english: Minto FM: Governor Maangi addresses the Gusii people on development and ongoing projects. County Governor of Kisii County Joash Maangi has stated that the road construction work will be completed soon and the remaining sections will be done properly, adding that Minto FM reports that Maangi said the project will be completed and the road construction will continue, and he also added that this road is very important for the residents of this area.

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, ngento ki Omonene, Nyasae oino, aganetie korwa asemore? Goika moiroke Omonene, Nyasae oino, momoigwere na kobwatia chinchera chiaye chionsi; momwanche na komokorera Omonene, Nyasae oino, ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi.
english: And now, O Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

ekegusii: “Namosimeke chimbusuro chinyinge ase emegondo, korende mogese endagera ensinini, ekiagera chingige nachirie chindagera chiaino.
english: You will sow much seed in the field but you will harvest little, because locusts will devour it.

ekegusii: Aye Samaria, omogwekano oria bw’emori ore ase egati yao yabeire okogechia asende. Endamwamu yane nigo egwoka igoro y’abanto abwo. Ngoika ririri baragenderere koba iga bataracheneka?
english: Throw out your calf-idol, O Samaria! My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of purity?

ekegusii: Naki intwe ase eye iga togwechanda, ntore namaiga koboyigwa obomenyo bwaito bokorwa igoro.
english: Meanwhile we groan, longing to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling,

ekegusii: Ebinyomba biria biaetanaine Hekalu nigo biaagachetwe iga: Ebia inse nigo biarenge ebinyerere, korende ebia gati‐gati na ebia igoro bikagareigwa kobwatia ebitambokero biria. Ase rikere rie Hekalu ebiriinero mbiarengeo ebiare koriinerwa gochia ase rirongo ria gatato goetera ase eria kabere.
english: The side rooms all around the temple were wider at each successive level. The structure surrounding the temple was built in ascending stages, so that the rooms widened as one went upward. A stairway went up from the lowest floor to the top floor through the middle floor.

ekegusii: Na Yehoasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, agatoma amang’ana ase Amasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akamotebia, “Rigeri erimo ria Lebanoni rigatoma amang’ana ase omocharake ore Lebanoni, rigateba: Ing’a omoiseke oo, omwana one omomura amonyuome. Erio eng’iti y’orosana ya Lebanoni egaeta aase agwo egatiringera inse rigeri riria.
english: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: "A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, 'Give your daughter to my son in marriage.' Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.

ekegusii: Omonto orure ase orogongo rwa Dani, orentire amang’ana neriogi rinene, nigo akoraria obobe korwa ase ense y’Efraimu.
english: A voice is announcing from Dan, proclaiming disaster from the hills of Ephraim.

ekegusii: Nigo yasibeire chinkini ase ebinema biabo na emetwe yabo nigo yanareire ebitambaa ebiya mono. Abasacha baria bonsi nigo baare kororekana ng’a nabarwani abanene. Ekero aroche emegwekano eyio y’abanto ba Babeli, ababiare b’ense ya Kalidayo,
english: with belts around their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like Babylonian chariot officers, natives of Chaldea.

ekegusii: Aye omong’ianereria, rusia ritang’ani omoribo ore ase eriso riao, nario orarore buya omanye korusia ekeogoto korwa ase eriso ri’oyomino.
english: You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother's eye.

ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bagateba, “Chinguru chi’abakobogoria chigurube chiorobire, na amaoomo namange mono ase okogokomora, goika twasinyirwe gokora emeremo y’okoagacha orwaki.”
english: Meanwhile, the people in Judah said, "The strength of the laborers is giving out, and there is so much rubble that we cannot rebuild the wall."

ekegusii: Since that time he waits for his enemies to be made his footstool,
english: Erio oganyete goika ababisa baye babekwe inse y’amagoro aye.

ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baito bonsi baigwete ayio, na abanto b’ebisaku bionsi biatoetanaine bayaroche, bakaba nobwoba obonene, bagechaya na gwesookera abanyene, ekiagera nigo bamanyete ng’a emeremo eyio nigo yakoretwe na goikeranigwa ase ogokonywa kwa Nyasae oito.
english: When all our enemies heard about this, all the surrounding nations were afraid and lost their self-confidence, because they realized that this work had been done with the help of our God.

ekegusii: Inse y’eaanga eria kera egetongwa nigo kiaramborete chimbaba chiaye ibere chigakunana nechi’ekende, na kera ekemo kegatuba omobere oye ne chimbaba chinde ibere.
english: Under the expanse their wings were stretched out one toward the other, and each had two wings covering its body.

ekegusii: Bakabora, “Omonene nayeganetie.”
english: They replied, "The Lord needs it."

ekegusii: Omonene nanyare kobatooria abwo bamoirogete korwa ase ogoteemwa, na kogacha abatari noboronge inse y’egesusuro goika rituko ri’ekina,
english: if this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue godly men from trials and to hold the unrighteous for the day of judgment, while continuing their punishment.

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Omonto ataiboiri ase amache na Omoika, takonyara gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
english: Jesus answered, "I tell you the truth, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.

ekegusii: Korende onye omonto omonyene oganetie kobooria eng’iti eria, rirorio aakane rigori riria ribekire, na amente eyemo ya isano ase rigori erio.
english: If the owner wishes to redeem the animal, he must add a fifth to its value.

ekegusii: “Aye nobe nomogoko na ogosasoka, na abanto abange nabagokere okoiborwa kwaye,
english: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth,

ekegusii: Ere nere ogotogia kwaino, nere Nyasae oino, okorire ebinto ebinene na amakumia asemore, ebio mwarorire.
english: He is your praise; he is your God, who performed for you those great and awesome wonders you saw with your own eyes.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Tari Musa obaete omogati oria orwete igoro, korende n’Tata one ore kobaa omogati bw’ekeene okorwa igoro.
english: Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, it is not Moses who has given you the bread from heaven, but it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.

ekegusii: Emechie eyio morachore ebe ey’obotamero nigo erabe etano nomo.
english: These six towns you give will be your cities of refuge.

ekegusii: Ing’ana ki rire rikong’u riramosinye Omonene? Engaki ndairane asore ase omwaka ogocha, engaki enga buna eye, ninyore ng’a Sara onyorire omwana omoisia.”
english: Is anything too hard for the LORD? I will return to you at the appointed time next year and Sarah will have a son."

ekegusii: Gose inki mwachiete korora isiko? Omonto bweboyetie chianga chinterere? Rigereria, abakweboyia chianga chinterere nigo bamenyete ase chinyomba chi’abaruoti.
english: If not, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? No, those who wear fine clothes are in kings' palaces.

ekegusii: “Echela nigo twayenyora esiekire buya kegima, na abarendi bateneine bisieri, korende twachia koigora titwanyora monto onde ime.”
english: "We found the jail securely locked, with the guards standing at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside."

ekegusii: Na intwe ase obosio bwa Nyasae Tata oito titori gotiga koinyora emeremo yaino ase okwegena, na ogwechanda kwaino ase obwanchani, na oboremereria bwaino ase okomosemeria Omonene Yeso Kristo.
english: We continually remember before our God and Father your work produced by faith, your labor prompted by love, and your endurance inspired by hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Nabo omoganda omonene bw’Abayahudi bakamanya ng’a ere nao are aria; bagacha, tari ase engencho ya Yeso yoka, korende barore Lazaro, oyio Yeso abogetie korwa ase abakure.
english: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews found out that Jesus was there and came, not only because of him but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.

ekegusii: Bakanyoisia ise edivai ase obotuko boria; omoiseke oria omotangi agachia, akarara nere, ise tamanya ekero arara, gose ekero aboka.
english: That night they got their father to drink wine, and the older daughter went in and lay with him. He was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akamoiraneria, “Chimanwa echi chisigiti isano na ibere nigo nagochieire korwa ase okoboko kwane, erinde chibe kirori asende, ng’a ensoko eye ninche nayeremete.”
english: He replied, "Accept these seven lambs from my hand as a witness that I dug this well."

ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase ense y’Abayuda; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Yerusalemu.”
english: I will send fire upon Judah that will consume the fortresses of Jerusalem."

ekegusii: Gaki aye omoruoti, omonene one, tobaisa kwegena amang’ana ayio ng’a abamura bao bonsi mbaitire; Amunoni bweka nere okure.”
english: My lord the king should not be concerned about the report that all the king's sons are dead. Only Amnon is dead."

ekegusii: Korwa ase basinto ba Hamori, ise Sekemu, Yakobo akagora oboremo obwo ase rigori rie chifeta rigana erimo, agwo ase atenenetie eema yaye.
english: For a hundred pieces of silver, he bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, the plot of ground where he pitched his tent.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaba bakorenda agwo ase Egeita ki’Omoruoti, ensemo ya moocha, goika engaki eye. Kare nabwo barenge abarendi b’egetwori ki’Abalawi.
english: being stationed at the King's Gate on the east, up to the present time. These were the gatekeepers belonging to the camp of the Levites.

ekegusii: Tiga abanto banga buna abwo bamanye, ng’a buna tokorika ase amarube aito ekero totari aroro, naboigo togokora gatoreo.
english: Such people should realize that what we are in our letters when we are absent, we will be in our actions when we are present.

ekegusii: Omogambi naoroke korwa ase egati y’abanto ba Yakobo asirie abanto batameire emechie banyore oborendi.”
english: A ruler will come out of Jacob and destroy the survivors of the city."

ekegusii: Isaac trembled violently and said, "Who was it, then, that hunted game and brought it to me? I ate it just before you came and I blessed him-- and indeed he will be blessed!"
english: Erio Isaka agakumia mono na koiguswa, akabora, “Ning’o oria ocha ondetera endagera engiya, na inche naria yonsi ekero otaracha, namosesenia?—Ee, nere nabe osesenirie.”

ekegusii: Nun his son and Joshua his son.
english: na Nuni omomura oye, na Yoshua omomura oye.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kianda ri’omotienyi o kane, enchera ekaba enene mono ase omochie oria ime, goika endagera akabora kegima ey’abanto bakoria.
english: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli na Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, nigo baikaransete ase ebirogo biabo bi’oboruoti agwo ase ekeooreri ang’e negeita gia Samaria, babegete chianga chiabo chi’obonene, na ababani baria bonsi nigo barenge korua obobani bwabo ase amasio ’abaruoti baria.
english: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.

ekegusii: Inee! Aye omonene one tikwana gotebigwa eke nakorete ekero Yesebeli aitete ababani b’Omonene, buna nabisete ababani b’Omonene rigana erimo ase ebiombe bi’emerongo etano etano ase rikuruma ime, naende nkaba nkobarageria na kobaa amache?
english: Haven't you heard, my lord, what I did while Jezebel was killing the prophets of the LORD? I hid a hundred of the LORD's prophets in two caves, fifty in each, and supplied them with food and water.

ekegusii: Uphold me, and I will be delivered; I will always have regard for your decrees.
english: Nsiire bokong’u, indende buya, inyare gosika botambe emeroberio yao echikire.

ekegusii: Agachika egari eria etenene, na bonsi babere, Filipo na oria omogomba, bagatirimboka gochia ase amache ime, erio Filipo akamobatisa.
english: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water and Philip baptized him.

ekegusii: Korende rora, Omonene nayoure chinibo chiaye, na atugute okobua kwaye ase enyancha, na omochie oyio omonyene nosambwe nomorero.
english: But the Lord will take away her possessions and destroy her power on the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.

ekegusii: Korende Yusufu tagorete amaremo ’abakuani, ekiagera abwo konya bachikeirwe endagera baare konyora korwa ase Farao, nero baare koria. Ase igo tibagwenerete koonia amaremo abo.
english: However, he did not buy the land of the priests, because they received a regular allotment from Pharaoh and had food enough from the allotment Pharaoh gave them. That is why they did not sell their land.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio obong’aini bwane bokang’iranera, na obonene bw’oboruoti bwane, na obw’amasikani aane, bikang’iranera boigo. Abasemia baane, na abanto baane abanene bagacha kondigia, na inche nkairanerigwa oboruoti bwane, na nkamenterwa okobua okonene goetania.
english: At the same time that my sanity was restored, my honor and splendor were returned to me for the glory of my kingdom. My advisers and nobles sought me out, and I was restored to my throne and became even greater than before.

ekegusii: Obotutukanu igoro yo ogokwa kwo omwana oiborwa Nyamira Obotutukanu imbwaenekigwa omogaso orero ase enyagitari enene ya Nyamira magega ye eamate eyemo korwa ase ekenyoro gia kiabiraa ime ya west mugirango ecounty ya Nyamira goteba buna eyaegwa omwana okwete otari obo magega yo omosubati obo koibora omwana ase enyagitari eyio. Korengana na Alice mongare oyio ore ngina biara omosubati oyio oiborete ase enyagitari eyio, abanyagitari be enyagitari eyio ebabaonchoreria omwana oyio na goteba tibatebiri kende igoro yo ogokwa kwo omwana oyio orenge moyo chingaki aiboretwe goetera enchera yo okobarwa obotuko bwo ogokiera rero. Boigo Edwin mongare oyio ore ise omwana oyio nigo ayegania eserekari gwesoia gati koenekia buna inkonyora bare oboene. Nonya nabo omonyagitari omonene ase ecounty eyio Dr silas Ayunga nigo akanaa amangana ayio na goteba omwana oyio nigo abwate omochaando bwo okweyana ekero aiboretwe ase abanyagitari batemete gokonya obogima bwaye korende agakwa ekero abekire chimachine chio obogwenia ime ase korende ancherana buna ebanyoretwe kobamanyia abanto be eamate eyio igoro yo ogokwa kwo omwana oyio emambi ya rero.
english: The incident happened yesterday when a child was born in Nyamira. The unfortunate event occurred in the morning, and people were shocked by the large size of the newborn baby in Nyamira, causing great concern among those who saw it, especially the residents of West Mugirango in Nyamira County, who feared the child might die due to its unusual size and the challenges faced during delivery. Speaking to Alice Mongare, she said her sister gave birth to the baby, and the midwives attending to the baby expressed their surprise and fear, stating they had never witnessed such a situation before, hoping the baby would survive despite the difficulties encountered during childbirth. However, Edwin Mongare stated that he is the father of the child and believes there is something wrong because of the pain his wife experienced. Moreover, the prominent doctor in the county, Dr. Silas Ayunga, declined to comment on the matter, stating that the child survived through God's grace and the efforts of the midwives who worked tirelessly to save its life, adding that he could not disclose further details about what happened to avoid alarming the public regarding the condition of the newborn baby at the time of its birth.

ekegusii: Abanene b’oboruoti boria bakagechigwa mono ase Yeremia; bakamoaka mono, bakamosiekera ase enyomba ya Yonathani omoriki, eyio konya yakorirwe ebe echela,
english: They were angry with Jeremiah and had him beaten and imprisoned in the house of Jonathan the secretary, which they had made into a prison.

ekegusii: Amachiko nigo are goteba ng’a ang’e ebinto bionsi bichenwe namanyinga, na amanyinga ataiteiri, okwaberwa kw’ebibe tigokobao.
english: In fact, the law requires that nearly everything be cleansed with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.

ekegusii: Erioba riao tirikorimera nonya ng’ake, gose omotienyi oo togosira, ekiagera Omonene nere orabe omobaso oo o kare na kare, na amatuko ao ay’omoichano naere.
english: Your sun will never set again, and your moon will wane no more; the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will end.

ekegusii: “Kera omonto okoragereria ise gose ng’ina, oyio goika akwe. Ekiagera oragereirie ise na ng’ina, okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye nigo korabe okwaye.
english: "'If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother, and his blood will be on his own head.

ekegusii: Moruere Omonene ebiegwa. Kera omonto oyore nomoyo bw’ogwancha aruere Omonene ebinto ebi: Etahabu, na efeta, na etaai;
english: From what you have, take an offering for the LORD. Everyone who is willing is to bring to the LORD an offering of gold, silver and bronze;

ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Gerisomu: Yoeli, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na emerongo etato (130);
english: from the descendants of Gershon, Joel the leader and 130 relatives;

ekegusii: Omonwa bw’omonyene oboronge nigo ogokwana ay’obong’aini, korende oromeme rokong’ainereria ndosirigwe.
english: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.

ekegusii: Aya onsi agakoreka, erinde anyare goikeranigwa ayatebetwe nomobani, ogoteba,
english: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:

ekegusii: Moyarike ase emetobwa na emeriibo y’ebisieri bie chinyomba chiaino, na ase ebiita biaino.
english: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates.

ekegusii: “Sabuloni nigo aramenye ase enyancha mbarabare, agwo ase chimeeri chigotenenigwa, orobebe rwaye rosinyane norw’Abasidoni.
english: "Zebulun will live by the seashore and become a haven for ships; his border will extend toward Sidon.

ekegusii: Bakabogorigwa goika Sekemu, bagatindekwa ase embeera eria Ibrahimu agorete ase chifeta korwa ase abana ba Hamori, aaria Sekemu.
english: Their bodies were brought back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a certain sum of money.

ekegusii: Ase igo nkoboria nde: Inee! Nyasae igo aangete abanto baye? Yaya, taibo! Inche omonyene n’Omoisraeli nde, oyomo bw’oroiboro rwa Ibrahimu, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Benjamin.
english: I ask then: Did God reject his people? By no means! I am an Israelite myself, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.

ekegusii: Rora, nigo namobegete abe kirori one ase abanto, naende abe omoraai na omochiki igoro ase abanto.
english: See, I have made him a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander of the peoples.

ekegusii: “Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, ekero mwakoorire rigesa ri’emegondo yaino, namorende Amatuko Amanene atano na abere ase Omonene. Rituko rie ritang’ani naribe rituko ri’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka kegima, naboigo nase rituko ria gatano na gatato.
english: "'So beginning with the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the crops of the land, celebrate the festival to the LORD for seven days; the first day is a day of rest, and the eighth day also is a day of rest.

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamin, Paliti, mosinto o Rafu;
english: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoiraneria, “Onye Omonene takogokonya, naki inche ndagokonye? Nkorwa ase ekeooreri, gose nkorwa ase egeteera gi’okomitera edivai?”
english: The king replied, "If the LORD does not help you, where can I get help for you? From the threshing floor? From the winepress?"

ekegusii: Ase ayio, na intwe abanyene nigo togwetogia ase engencho yaino ase chikanisa chia Nyasae, ase engencho y’oboremereria bwaino, na okwegena more nakwo ase ogochandwa kwaino gwonsi, na emechando eye moremereretie.
english: Therefore, among God's churches we boast about your perseverance and faith in all the persecutions and trials you are enduring.

ekegusii: “Kora omobaro bw’omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba. Orike amarieta ’abanto bonsi abasacha, omonto ase omonto.
english: "Take a census of the whole Israelite community by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.

ekegusii: Onye omonto ase egati yaino obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogosokia embusuro yaye y’oroiboro botuko, oyio asoke gochia isiko y’egetwori; tabaisa gosoa ime aroro.
english: If one of your men is unclean because of a nocturnal emission, he is to go outside the camp and stay there.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Rengereria amang’ana aya! Rangeria abakungu abamanyete kobokia amagombo bachiche! Toma abanto barangerie abakungu abegerete ayio bachiche!”
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Consider now! Call for the wailing women to come; send for the most skillful of them.

ekegusii: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
english: na Eloni, na Timuna, na Ekironi,

ekegusii: Ababenjamin bakairana ase engaki eria, na Abaisraeli bakaa abaiseke baria korwa Yabesi o Gileadi, bataitetwe babe abakungu babo; korende abwo tibabaisanete abasacha b’Ababenjamin.
english: So the Benjamites returned at that time and were given the women of Jabesh Gilead who had been spared. But there were not enough for all of them.

ekegusii: Abana baye tibakonyora ogokonywa, nigo bakomionogorerwa geita, gose monto onde tari okobatooria.
english: His children are far from safety, crushed in court without a defender.

ekegusii: Ase ring’ana eri twamanyire ng’a twabanchire abana ba Nyasae ekero twamwanchire Nyasae, na kobwata amachiko aye.
english: This is how we know that we love the children of God: by loving God and carrying out his commands.

ekegusii: Onye nomwana bw’omotienyi oyomo goika emiaka etano, rigori riaye nigo rirabe, ase omomura chisekeli isano, na ase omoiseke chisekeli isato.
english: If it is a person between one month and five years, set the value of a male at five shekels of silver and that of a female at three shekels of silver.

ekegusii: Natanaeli akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, aye n’Omwana o Nyasae, naye Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.”
english: Then Nathanael declared, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the King of Israel."

ekegusii: Jediael son of Shimri, his brother Joha the Tizite,
english: Yediaeli, mosinto o Simuri, na Yoha, momura omwabo, omonto o Tisi;

ekegusii: Bakamorentera abana abake, erinde anyare kobakuna; aborokigwa baye bakabatanga.
english: People were bringing little children to Jesus to have him touch them, but the disciples rebuked them.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene okwanire iga: “Inee! Tinkobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora okwo? Tinkweruseria egesiomba igoro ase egesaku kegokora amang’ana buna ayio?
english: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the LORD. "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?

ekegusii: Onye omonto okonyuoma omokungu aire na ng’ina biara abasang’ananie, obwo nobonyaka obobe. Omosacha oria amo nabakungu baria babere basambwe nomorero bakwe, erinde obonyaka buna obwo tiboba ase egati yaino.
english: "'If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is wicked. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that no wickedness will be among you.

ekegusii: Mbamenye nobotoereru ase ense eyio; baagache chinyomba, naende basimeke emesabibu ase emegondo. Barabwo mbamenye nobotoereru, ekero ndanachere abanto bonsi babaetanaine ekina, abwo babachayete. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.”
english: They will live there in safety and will build houses and plant vineyards; they will live in safety when I inflict punishment on all their neighbors who maligned them. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.'"

ekegusii: Risemi riane riandire, ekiagera ababisa baane bebire ring’ana riao.
english: My zeal wears me out, for my enemies ignore your words.

ekegusii: Naama! Ase rituko ria rero nagokong’irie obe buna omochie ogiteire chindwaki, na buna esiiro y’ekioma, naende buna chindwaki chi’etaai. Nigo orabe kogotenena bokong’u, tokobugwa nense eye yonsi, gose nabaruoti b’Abayuda, gose abanene b’oboruoti boria, gose abakuani b’aroro, gose abanto bonsi b’ense eye.
english: Today I have made you a fortified city, an iron pillar and a bronze wall to stand against the whole land-- against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests and the people of the land.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, mwana one, toiroka, ekiagera abanto bonsi ase omochie oyo nigo bamanyete ng’a aye nomokungu omweriti. Ningokorere ande onsi oraganie.
english: And now, my daughter, don't be afraid. I will do for you all you ask. All my fellow townsmen know that you are a woman of noble character.

ekegusii: Cabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish,
english: na Kaboni, na Lamasi, na Kitilisi,

ekegusii: Aye ore noromeme rw’obong’ainereria, nigo bwanchete gokwana amang’ana agosaria.
english: You love every harmful word, O you deceitful tongue!

ekegusii: Rora, aye nigo oganetie ekeene ase enkoro ime; ase ayio inyorokererie obong’aini bwao ase enkoro yane ime.
english: Surely you desire truth in the inner parts; you teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

ekegusii: Morigererie buna ense eria ere, naende morore gose abanto bareo mbare ne chinguru, gose naboro bare, gose nabake, gose nabange.
english: See what the land is like and whether the people who live there are strong or weak, few or many.

ekegusii: Omonene oria akabeka abasibwa bonsi abwo barenge echela ime ase amaboko a Yusufu; na onsi ayare gokoreka ase echela, ere akaba okoyakora.
english: So the warden put Joseph in charge of all those held in the prison, and he was made responsible for all that was done there.

ekegusii: Those who heard this asked, "Who then can be saved?"
english: Na abwo abayaigwete bakabora, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”

ekegusii: Agasaba naende, igoro ekarenta embura, na ense ekama okwama kwaye.
english: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth produced its crops.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agaika gocha inse arore omochie na omorobiri oyio mwanyabanto baagachire.
english: But the LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the men were building.

ekegusii: Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Monunguno O Barema (February) 15, 2011. Aya amwabo aya: "Nintagete kogenda bware" Ebimura binde can't wait kogenda iburu. Iburu, maguta motwe no okwaroka na amarieta ye Ekegusii yo ogosara. Abaisia ki baikire emiaka ikomi mbaka ikomi ne ebere nigo bare goisanera kogenda iburu. Mara enyinge, iburu nigo yare gochiegwa ase engaki yo omotienyi bwe Egesunte kende (December) ase kera omwaka. Abaisia nigo bare kwearigania ase omoyega oyo buna ekobwatia. Nigo bare korigia chingoko bagochia konyenya ne ebitugi bio ogouta omorero ekero bare nyomba. Inyora inga morero bwo omware tonya korima. Omosari nigo arenge koba oyomo ase ekenyoro ekegima na abasae bataranywoma nabwo bare kobira abaisia ekero bare gochia iburu. Obotuko bwo ogokiera rituko rie enyangi ya iburu, aba be enyangi nigo bare korara na abamura barie bachiete iburu banyenya chingoko. Mambia maaambia, nigo abaisia aba bare koirwa roche gwesibia amache amakendu na korurwa ne chinyanduri ne risa egere beariganie ase enyangi eye. Abasegi nigo bare kobogoria amatimo na kweboyia amayo. Egetono nigo kiare korosigwa kiamanya koruma buna endo. Aaiga, nigo bare gotebigwa buna endo igo yare kobamera nande yabaroka. Ekero kio ogosarwa gwaikire nigo oyo ore kogenda iburu are gotarera omote gochia magega egere tarora amanyinga buna agoiteka. Korwa aiga amatera yo obware aterwa kwagachia ase omware are koirwa. Omorero nigo ore gosegeswa bwoka amatuko onsi pi omware are nyomba. Ki yare komochani orime, nigo yare koba chimuma naende yare kobetereria okorerane chisokoro. Omware nigo are gosoa saiga na korwa gesieri korende tare koirorera goeta gesieri eke. Korwa bono, nigo are gotumia etirisa. Omware nao agasokeire etirisa ochia gwota ensakia korende kera rituko nigo are kweyaka ribu. Mware tare korora gose gwesibia mache mpaka arwe nyomba. Abare nigo bare kobeka egesena. Abwo nyomba, nigo bare gokora emekubio ene. Engaki eyio ye emekubio ene kiyaerire, nigo yare gokagerwa buna omware obwenire na korwa nyomba. Ekero akorwa nyomba, mware tare gweeta gesierie keri asoerete. Nigo are kogenda roche bwesibia na kweboyia buya. Korwa aiga mware tare korara saiga aria ase arenge nyomba. Nigo are korara ase eamate amatuko abere omanya koirana sobo. Goansera aiga omware bono nigo are no obosiborwe bwo ogotumia gesieri kende gionsi gia saiga. Bono gochakera engaki eye, momura bwarogete tare gosoa ase abaibori bare korara. Echio ne chimuma. Inee rero enyangi eye nereo?
english: By Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. February 15, 2011. These are the words: "One who doesn't hurry won't get far." The elders say they can't wait to get old. Old age, wisdom comes with gray hair and experience in the Ekegusii language of our ancestors. People often live for many years, up to eighty or ninety years, before they prepare to become old. But nowadays, old age is celebrated during the month of December at the end of the year. People strive for good health so that it may benefit them. They build houses and acquire possessions and livestock so that their homes are beautiful. A home without wealth is not admirable. The community gathers to help those who are sick and the youth assist the elderly in preparing for old age. The tradition of honoring the months of old age, those months are when people and relatives visit the aged and share stories. Truly speaking, it is the elderly who remember past events and are reminded through songs and dances about the months of old age. The young ones respect traditions and appreciate gifts. Poverty is said to prevent someone from understanding things fully. Sometimes, they are given assistance so that they may recover and become strong. Before something valuable is lost, it is better to prepare to become old and strengthen oneself to gather knowledge so that it remains. Work done by women and men is carried out to improve the home. Wealth should be used wisely to ensure that everything is well within the home. If it is not managed properly, it will diminish and disappear quickly. A person should work hard and diligently, always striving to achieve success. Work alone, however, is not enough; one must also have blessings. A person who has blessings receives gifts and remembers the past. A home should be protected against thieves until it becomes established. People often save money. That savings, when used to rebuild the home, ensures that the home is secure and work continues. Before starting new work, a person should first assess their resources. They should then begin slowly and carefully. Work done by a person who plans ahead is successful because they know how to manage their time. Preparing for tomorrow requires a person to be diligent and work consistently, always striving to succeed. Work today, therefore, is important.

ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria akamotebia, “Kanywe, omonene one!” Agatoora enyongo yaye bwango, akayebeka koboko kwaye, akamoa, na ere akanywa.
english: "Drink, my lord," she said, and quickly lowered the jar to her hands and gave him a drink.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene agantebia, “Bono ninkoe ribaga okoroiseria endagera yao igoro y’omorero bw’obwoyo obwomo bwe chiombe ribaga ri’omorero bw’obonyira bwa mwanyabanto.”
english: "Very well," he said, "I will let you bake your bread over cow manure instead of human excrement."

ekegusii: Aye gwaikeranirie eira eria kwarierete omosomba oo Daudi tata. Aria gwakwanete nomonwa oo kwayaikeranirie nokoboko kwao rituko ria rero.
english: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it-- as it is today.

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli na Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, bakagenda korwania Ramoti o Gileadi.
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

ekegusii: Omwana one, nase ki okogokigwa nomokungu omonyaka? Nase ki okoboania omokungu bw’omonto omoao?
english: Why be captivated, my son, by an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another man's wife?

ekegusii: Buna twakabeire na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Ebwagi [June] 9, 2012. Ntwe ntomanyeti buna ninki kiagerete bagateba amangana aya na koyaereria korwa ekegori ekemo, gochia aase ekegori kende. Aya na amang'ana gete y' Abagusii, ayio eise koba buna kwayakorire, nigo arenge koba mamincha y' Ekegusii. Emegiro.Abagusii nigo babagete amang'ana ayio, emegiro aase eng'encho arenge koba mamincha y' oboseera bw' Omogusii. Tari igo rioka. Abagusii nigo beegenete buna oise koyakora, n' chimuuma. Nigo ebinto, gose chinkore gete chiimbe, chiare gocha koba, gose kogokorekanera. Aya amwabo aya: Abagusii Culture And Customs XXVII: Emegiro Y' Ekegusii [ I ] Abagusii Culture And Customs XXXIX: Emeyega Ao Ao Y' E Ekegusii Abagusii Culture And Customs LXXI: "Okwo N' Ogoturutumba Ekegusii" Omogaka Sokoro Ominto Aase amatuko amake aerire, ntwasomete igoro y' emegiro y' Ekegusii, etano n' ebere, aase Emegiro y' Ekegusii [ I ]. Ase okoinyora, nigo omongina magokoro baba ominto atebete buna kera egesaku aase ense eye nkiabwate emegiro. Ase boigo, nigo baba atebete buna kobwatekana n' abagaka n' abangina abakoro, gokora amang'ana ayio nigo yarenge koba mamincha y' Ekegusii. Ase rituko ria rero, magokoro nigo atagete kogenderera n' enkwana eyio. Kobwatekana na baba ominto, emegiro ende y' Ekegusii nigo ere buna iga: 8. Mosacha mogima bori: Aase Ekegusii, monto mosacha mogima tarenge gosoa irongo. Yaya. Nigo yare koba chimuuma, aise korina engasi kwagachia gose gosoa irongo riinde rionsi. Ase boigo, inyora buna chimuma chia Abagusii nigo chiare gocha n’ amaakwa amanene. Amasikani aase iso biara. Obori bori bogocha gosiegwa ,erinde sokoro aroiseririgwe erongori nao bore irongo. Sokoro tagosoa irongo ime. Yaya. Irongo n' ya magokoro. Kona gotakuna obori aange na iso biara nkwarengeo. Below: Ekee k' obokima bw' Omogusii. 9. Ebimwana ebike: Omwana omoke tarenge koegwa enyama y' riini erinde arie. Yaya. Gaise koegwa riini, aye rirorio nario okwerorera. Nigo akamwana buna akwo karenge koba agatamu, naende akamwenu ekianda gia ikomi! Omwana buna oyio, nkware komotoma gose komoboria akore kende. 10. Abasacha baria banchete kona gotirigoyia na kona goita abakungu babo bokaira: Ekero omosacha are goita omokungu oye bw’ enywomo, omokungu oyo nigo arenge gotama gochia irongo, gose nyaaro. Tari igo rioka Bosibori ominto. Omokungu oyo okona goitwa aaise koba buna okunire chimbere chiaye, omosacha oyo oye tarenge komoaka. Yaya. Eye nigo yarenge kobwekana buna ogosaba amabera. Omosacha oyo nyagotwanga mokaye arenge goaka omokungu oyo naende gakunire chimbere, echio n' chimuuma aase Ekegusii! Komenta nayio, omokungu oyo nyagotwangwa arenge kobwata omwana kwaa, ekero agoitwa, nigo are gotiga goitwa ekiagera okwo nakwo okwoorikia buna osabire okwabera. 11. Nyomenda nkobugia are omorori: Korwa bokoro ase Ekegusii, mokungu tarenge kobugia morori. Aaise gokora igo, omokungu oyo nigo arenge kogera omosacha oye aanse koema, na gokwa! 12. Moka momura ngotakuna are endagera: Moka momura tatakeire gotakuna obori aase ise biara are. Yaya nonya. Okwo nigo kwarenge ogosaria Ekegusii. Eng’encho ende, omokungu buna oyio, nigo arenge kong’ong’ori ise biara. Amasikani aera. Bobe mono. Omongina magokoro nao akorera abwo aase rero. Ntooche togenderere n' emegiro eende, chingaki chiinde. Korwa ase baba ominto, mbuya mono, and thank you for listening.
english: We greet Petronillah Ogoti well. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. June 9, 2012. It is good to say that people who respect traditions and customs are honored, and they cherish their heritage greatly. These traditions belong to the Abagusii people, and it is important to remember that they strengthen the Ekegusii language. Traditions. The Abagusii people respect traditions very much, and these traditions help maintain the dignity of the Omogusii community. Time passes quickly. The Abagusii people have always been known for their hospitality and kindness. It is true that sometimes things happen unexpectedly, but they strive to overcome them. These are the topics: Abagusii Culture And Customs XXVII: The Traditions Of Ekegusii [ I ] Abagusii Culture And Customs XXXIX: The Ways Of Life Of Ekegusii Abagusii Culture And Customs LXXI: “The Land And The History Of Ekegusii” By Elder Sokoro Ominto Those who come from afar, let us examine the importance of the traditions of Ekegusii, both old and new, especially the Traditions of Ekegusii [ I ]. Also, let us understand that wise elders teach young people about the value of tradition. Also, they teach them to associate with elders and leaders, so that they can learn more about the Ekegusii culture. But sometimes, wise people may not want to share their knowledge. Associating with elders, and the traditions of Ekegusii, ensures that they remain alive: 8. A strong man does not fall: Among the Ekegusii, a strong man never forgets his roots. Indeed, it is said that strength comes from remembering one's origins. Also, know that the character of the Abagusii people is defined by their strong foundations. Generations pass, but the foundation remains. A strong root should not be uprooted, lest its branches wither. An elder should not forget his ancestors and his past. Below: Look at the history of the Omogusii. 9. Children are precious: A child should not be denied meat on a special occasion. Indeed, allowing a child to enjoy such occasions brings blessings. A child who behaves well deserves praise, and a younger sibling should respect an older sibling! A child who cries should be comforted so that they don't feel neglected. 10. Servants should not speak ill of their masters or reveal their secrets: A servant should not disclose the master's plans to others, because doing so would be disrespectful and harmful. Time passes quickly, my friends. That master should be respected so that he can protect his property, and the servant should not betray his trust. Indeed, it is important to avoid causing trouble. That servant who gossips will eventually face consequences, and will regret revealing the master's secrets – this is the way of the Ekegusii! Furthermore, that servant who is disloyal may be dismissed, and anyone who does wrong will be punished accordingly, so that they learn to behave. 11. A widow should not remarry too soon: It is customary among the Ekegusii for a widow to wait before remarrying. Respect this tradition, and the master will honor the woman who honors her late husband, and rejoice! 12. A good name is better than wealth: A good reputation is more valuable than possessions for generations to come. Indeed, it is what defines being an Ekegusii. Therefore, a master who acts like this will be remembered by future generations. Generations pass, and stories endure, leaving a lasting legacy. Respect our fathers and mothers, and thank you for listening.

ekegusii: tobaisa kororwa nabanto ng’a mbweng’atete, korende ororekane ase Iso oo ore bobisi, na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane.”
english: so that it will not be obvious to men that you are fasting, but only to your Father, who is unseen; and your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

ekegusii: “Onde tari ore omochenu buna Omonene, onde tari buna ere, egetare kende tikeri buna Nyasae oito.
english: "There is no one holy like the LORD; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.

ekegusii: Orooche rwa Kisoni rokabaira, orwo norooche rwa kare rwa Kisoni. Omoyo one, genderera ne chinguru!
english: The river Kishon swept them away, the age-old river, the river Kishon. March on, my soul; be strong!

ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene ogacha igoro ase Yahasieli, mosinto o Zakaria o Benaya, o Yeieli, o Matania, Omolawi bw’ororeria rw’Asafu, ekero ateneine gati‐gati y’omosangererekano.
english: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite and descendant of Asaph, as he stood in the assembly.

ekegusii: Akarangeria abanto ikomi korwa ase abasomba baye, akabaa ebirengo ikomi bie chiropia, akabatebia: Biire mobionchorerie goika ekero nkoirana.
english: So he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. 'Put this money to work,' he said, 'until I come back.'

ekegusii: Abana babo nigo bagotomwa isiko banga buna amaicho, nigo bakoba bagotenga na gocharacharara.
english: They send forth their children as a flock; their little ones dance about.

ekegusii: Aba batato nabwo barenge abana ba Nuhu, na korwa ase abwo mwanyabanto bakaranda ase ense engima.
english: These were the three sons of Noah, and from them came the people who were scattered over the earth.

ekegusii: Erio abana babo konya bataramanya amachiko aya, bayaigwe na kweorokereria komoiroka Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekero morabe mogendererete komenya ase ense eria ng’umbu ya Yorodan, eyio mogochia koira ebe eyaino.”
english: Their children, who do not know this law, must hear it and learn to fear the LORD your God as long as you live in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess."

ekegusii: “Naboigo moraaterane ense eyio koreng’ana buna inwe ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli more.
english: "You are to distribute this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: Omonto ogotogonyera oyo oiranire nyuma ase okomorongeyia nanyore ogwancherwa kobua oria okomong’aina namang’ana amansu.
english: He who rebukes a man will in the end gain more favor than he who has a flattering tongue.

ekegusii: “Oise komoa singo omonto onde one omotaka ore ase egati yaino, tobaisa gokora buna abwo bakoa abanto singo na koboria ebitoki ebinge; tobaisa komoboria ebitoki.
english: "If you lend money to one of my people among you who is needy, do not be like a moneylender; charge him no interest.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio amache are moyo nasoke korwa Yerusalemu. Ekeng’ese ki’amache ayio agende gochia ase Enyancha ya Moocha, na ekeng’ese kende gochia ase Enyancha ya Bosongo. Nagenderere goeta ase chingaki chie riberera na echi’obokendu.
english: On that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem, half to the eastern sea and half to the western sea, in summer and in winter.

ekegusii: Ase ayio titorara chitoro buna abande bagokora, korende torende na kwerita.
english: So then, let us not be like others, who are asleep, but let us be alert and self-controlled.

ekegusii: Korende abasaria na abanyabibe nigo barasirigwe amo; na abwo batigire Omonene mbasirigwe boigo.
english: But rebels and sinners will both be broken, and those who forsake the LORD will perish.

ekegusii: Abayuda nabarabwo tibabwatete amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae obo, korende bakabwatia chingencho chiria Abaisraeli barentete.
english: and even Judah did not keep the commands of the LORD their God. They followed the practices Israel had introduced.

ekegusii: Agachora ikomi na babere, banyare, koba amo nere, erinde anyare kobatoma bagende korandia,
english: He appointed twelve-- designating them apostles--that they might be with him and that he might send them out to preach

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Chinsa chi’omobaso tichiri ikomi na ibere? Omonto karagende mobaso takogochwa, ekiagera aroche omobaso bw’ense eye.
english: Jesus answered, "Are there not twelve hours of daylight? A man who walks by day will not stumble, for he sees by this world's light.

ekegusii: “Ande, nigo banyorire ebisakorwa bakare gwatanana ase egati yabo, kera omonto aire omoiseke oyomo, gose babere; Sisera ere aire ebitambaa bi’ebieni ebiya, egetambaa keroisirie ekiya, ekemo gose bibere, bibe ebisakorwa ase rigoti riaye.”
english: 'Are they not finding and dividing the spoils: a girl or two for each man, colorful garments as plunder for Sisera, colorful garments embroidered, highly embroidered garments for my neck-- all this as plunder?'

ekegusii: Aye gwatananire omwanchwa one na omosani one bambeereire aare, na omosunte obeire omogisangio one.
english: You have taken my companions and loved ones from me; the darkness is my closest friend.

ekegusii: Giddel, Gahar, Reaiah,
english: Gideli, na Gahari, na Reaya:

ekegusii: Na ekero riime riakamokire, bakarora inse aria ase erooro ebinto binga buna amagoocho, bikarorekana buna obosie oborabu.
english: When the dew was gone, thin flakes like frost on the ground appeared on the desert floor.

ekegusii: Abagambi baito babwatirwe na gosungwa, na abagaaka baito tibasikiri.
english: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders are shown no respect.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Omonene akang’anyia emeganda yonsi y’Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
english: And on that very day the LORD brought the Israelites out of Egypt by their divisions.

ekegusii: Korende Petero akaimoka, akagenda bwango ase oboina, agatung’ama, akarigereria ime, akarora ebitambaa biria bireo bioka, akairana bwoye, okumetie ase aya akorekire.]
english: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. Bending over, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.

ekegusii: Akabora, “Oyore namato akoigwera tiga aigwe.”
english: Then Jesus said, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear."

ekegusii: Inwe mwaimokirie chifeta ne chitahabu chiane, na mwairire ebinto biane ebiya bingwenerete gochia ase chihekalu chiaino.
english: For you took my silver and my gold and carried off my finest treasures to your temples.

ekegusii: Ase ayio agakoora amatuko abo, akayasiria, na emiaka yabo ekaera ase okoondokia.
english: So he ended their days in futility and their years in terror.

ekegusii: Aba nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo ase ebiaare biabo; nigo barenge abaraai abanene. Abwo nigo bamenyete Yerusalemu.
english: All these were heads of families, chiefs as listed in their genealogy, and they lived in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Inamonyare gotiga abarangerigwa b’enyangi beng’ate ekero omonyuomi are amo nabarabwo?
english: Jesus answered, "Can you make the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?

ekegusii: Ekero Abasiiria baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagatoma abanto korangeria Abasiiria, abarenge ng’umbu y’Eufarati, bache batang’anwe na Sofaki, omochiki bw’abarwani esegi ba Hadadeseri.
english: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they sent messengers and had Arameans brought from beyond the River, with Shophach the commander of Hadadezer's army leading them.

ekegusii: abanto 21 gokwa ase omobasokano bwepara Tharaka Nithi Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 25, 2022 Omobaro bwabanto bakuure kobwatekana nomobasokano oikire 33 maega yegari ebus barinete ya Modern Coast kobwateranigwa nomobasokano bwepara. Koreng’ana naroboti, egari eyio yabogoretie abiria korwa Maua gochia Mombasa abwo igoro magoroba, eyanyorete omobasokano ase edaraja ya Tharaka Nithi. Egari eyuo nigo yabutogete chibreki egasiria oboroso na gotwoma eyende, egento kiairerete ekagwa ase edaraja eyuo chimita 40 gochia inse. Koreng’ana nabanyanyimbo baigete ensemo eyio, baria batigeretwe chingoma ebaminyogetigwe ase chinyagitari ya Chuka amo na Chogoria. Omocounty Commissioner o Tharaka Nithi Nobert Komora oenekirie buna abanto 10 ebare nechingoma chintindi ase chinyagitari.
english: Abanto 21 were involved in an accident involving a Modern Coast bus in Tharaka Nithi. Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 25, 2022 The driver of the Abanto bus lost control and collided with a matatu at around 33 meters from the Modern Coast bus station. According to witnesses, the vehicle was traveling from Maua towards Mombasa when it crashed near the Tharaka Nithi bridge. The vehicle reportedly failed brakes and had a high speed, causing it to fall off the bridge about 40 kilometers from the center. Witnesses said several people were injured in the incident, some seriously, at the Chuka and Chogoria junctions. The County Commissioner of Tharaka Nithi, Norbert Komora, confirmed that 10 people died in the accident.
