english: Kwamanyire amachiko: Toita, Totomana, Toiba, Toteba oborimo, Tong’aina, Sika iso na nyoko.”

ekegusii: Ab’egesaku kia Yuda nigo barenge chilifu ikomi na ibere ababekirwe ekemanyererio, ab’egesaku kia Reuben chilifu ikomi na ibere, ab’egesaku kia Gadi chilifu ikomi na ibere,
english: From the tribe of Judah 12,000 were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben 12,000, from the tribe of Gad 12,000,

ekegusii: korende onye nokoboria igoro ase amang’ana, na amarieta, na amachiko aino, yarigererie inwe abanyene. Inche tindigeti koba omotorania bw’amang’ana ayio.”
english: But since it involves questions about words and names and your own law-- settle the matter yourselves. I will not be a judge of such things."

ekegusii: Nigo narengereretie ng’a ngochia gokwa inde ase emiaka y’oboke bwane; ningende ase ebiita bi’aase abakure, naurirwe emiaka yane yatigarete.
english: I said, "In the prime of my life must I go through the gates of death and be robbed of the rest of my years?"

ekegusii: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.
english: Monto onde bwensi aise gokuna ebirarero bi’omonto oyio goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

ekegusii: Omonene nateneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’omotaka, ase okomotooria korwa ase abwo bakomonachera ekina ki’ogokwa.
english: For he stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save his life from those who condemn him.

ekegusii: Korende Yehu tarendete na kobwata amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nenkoro yaye yonsi. Tatigete gokora ebibe biria Yeroboamu akorete, akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
english: Yet Jehu was not careful to keep the law of the LORD, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit.

ekegusii: Abanto bagasangererekana agwo Misipa, bakabuucha amache, bakayaumora agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakeng’ata ase rituko erio, bagakwana aroro agwo, “Twakorire ebibe ase Omonene.” Erio Samweli akaba okogambera Abaisraeli agwo Misipa.
english: When they had assembled at Mizpah, they drew water and poured it out before the LORD. On that day they fasted and there they confessed, "We have sinned against the LORD." And Samuel was leader of Israel at Mizpah.

ekegusii: Oboronge bw’abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbobatoorie, korende abasaria nigo barabwatwe nokogania kwabo okobe.
english: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the unfaithful are trapped by evil desires.

ekegusii: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,
english: Abahivi na Abaariki, na Abasini;

ekegusii: Oroisie endagera yao buna emegati y’esairi, oyeroiserie ase abanto baroche igoro y’omorero bw’obonyira obwomo bwa mwanyabanto.”
english: Eat the food as you would a barley cake; bake it in the sight of the people, using human excrement for fuel."

ekegusii: Agwo Nyasae akamotebia, “Erieta riao n’Yakobo, bono tokorokwa naende Yakobo, korende nigo orarokwe Israeli.” Ase igo akamoroka Israeli.
english: God said to him, "Your name is Jacob, but you will no longer be called Jacob; your name will be Israel." So he named him Israel.

ekegusii: Ere agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, nkogotoma inde gochia ase Abaisraeli, egesaku ekio getari koigwera, ekio giantigire inche. Abanto abwo amo ne chisokoro chiabo babeire bagosaria asende nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: He said: "Son of man, I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me; they and their fathers have been in revolt against me to this very day.

ekegusii: Na omwana bw’omokungu oyo agakwa botuko, ekiagera igo amorarerete.
english: "During the night this woman's son died because she lay on him.

ekegusii: Abagaaka baria na abanto bande bonsi abarenge ase etureti agwo ase egeita ki’omochie bakairaneria, “Ee, mbirori tore. Tiga Omonene asesenie omokungu oyio orache ase enka yao abe buna Raeli na Lea, abwo baiborerete Israeli abana abange bakaba egesaku. Aye osesenigwe ase egati y’Abaefarati na omanyekane ase Bethlehemu.
english: Then the elders and all those at the gate said, "We are witnesses. May the LORD make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel. May you have standing in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.

ekegusii: Erio abarendi b’egeita bakararia amang’ana ayio nonya ngoikera ase enyomba y’omoruoti.
english: The gatekeepers shouted the news, and it was reported within the palace.

ekegusii: “Ekero twairanete ase tata, omosomba oo, tokamotebia amang’ana ao, omonene one.
english: When we went back to your servant my father, we told him what my lord had said.

ekegusii: Inee! Tiyamogwenerete Kristo konyora emechando eye ritang’ani atarasoa ase obonene bwaye?”
english: Did not the Christ have to suffer these things and then enter his glory?"

ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu nigo bakongamba na gokwana oborimo igoro yane, korende inche nigo ndendete amachiko ao nenkoro yane yonsi.
english: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep your precepts with all my heart.

ekegusii: Aye kwarengire enkoro yane, nonya nase obotuko nigo ogonteema, kwauna‐unirie na tonyoreti gento, amabe are ase enkoro yane tinkoyakwana.
english: Though you probe my heart and examine me at night, though you test me, you will find nothing; I have resolved that my mouth will not sin.

ekegusii: Ekiagera batabete abegenwa ase Omonene, Sisaki, omoruoti o Misiri, agacha akarwania Yerusalemu ase omwaka o gatano bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Rehoboamu.
english: Because they had been unfaithful to the LORD, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem in the fifth year of King Rehoboam.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Yuda bagaaka amariogi amanene ay’esegi; na ekero Abayuda barenge kwoga, Nyasae akabua Yeroboamu na Abaisraeli bonsi, ase obosio bw’Abiya na ase Abayuda.
english: and the men of Judah raised the battle cry. At the sound of their battle cry, God routed Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

ekegusii: Onye omosacha okorara nomosacha onde buna akorara nomokungu, abwo bonsi babere bakorire okogechia okobe; goika baitwe bakwe, na okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo korabe okwabo.
english: "'If a man lies with a man as one lies with a woman, both of them have done what is detestable. They must be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

ekegusii: Erio Ezara akaimoka, akaboria abakuani abarenge abatang’ani, na Abalawi, na Abaisraeli bonsi, koria eira na gotiana ng’a mbakore buna batebetigwe. Ase ayio bakaria eira, bagatiana.
english: So Ezra rose up and put the leading priests and Levites and all Israel under oath to do what had been suggested. And they took the oath.

ekegusii: Enyomba omonto oyio araagache nigo erabe buna ey’oronyambobe, na buna ekegutu omorendi akoagacha.
english: The house he builds is like a moth's cocoon, like a hut made by a watchman.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, tebia Abaisraeli ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae akoboria: Inee! Nainwe nigo mwesoirie ase ogotacheneka ase okobwatia chingencho chie chisokoro chiaino na gokora obokayayu ase ogosasima emegwekano yabo y’okogechia?
english: "Therefore say to the house of Israel: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Will you defile yourselves the way your fathers did and lust after their vile images?

ekegusii: Chikanisa chiria chikoira amaremo yeserikali ase ekaunti ya Nyamira, chiakureirwe nabateneneri bechikanisa chio koborigwa kobwatia amachiko Chikanisa chiria chikoira amaremo yeserikali ase ekaunti ya Nyamira, chiakureirwe nabateneneri bechikanisa chio koborigwa kobwatia amachiko, chingaki bare nomoroberio bwokwagacha gose meroberio ende yonsi Ayio inkorengana nomokomishona bwe Kaunti ya Nyamira Amos Mariba oyio otebire buna nigo amaremo yechisukuru chiechiprimary mono naro akunirwe, ase airire nechikanisa eserikali etamanyeti Nigo boigo amoganiri omotenenri omonene bwechiabisi chiokorikia amaremo ase ekaunty eyio, gotugutera are chititle deed chitari chingikeranu, buna enchera eyemo yokorenda amaremo yeserikali
english: Investigate the matter of the dog that bit a government official in Nyamira County, which was reported by investigators investigating the issue of stolen property. Investigate the matter of the dog that bit a government official in Nyamira County, which was reported by investigators investigating the issue of stolen property, stating that their number has increased greatly and completely. That injustice and oppression in Nyamira County Amos Mariba said that he is a government school teacher who was also injured, due to an investigation by the government. They then discussed important issues regarding the theft of property from that county, providing a title deed that was incomplete, so that they could continue investigating government property.

ekegusii: Korende Petero agatenena amo na baria ikomi nomo, agaaka eriogi riaye, akabatebia, “Inwe abasacha ba Boyahudi, na inwe mwensi abamomenyete Yerusalemu, tiga ring’ana eri rimanyekane asemore, tegerera amang’ana aane.
english: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, raised his voice and addressed the crowd: "Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem, let me explain this to you; listen carefully to what I say.

ekegusii: Naende nairokire, ng’a inse gocha naende, Nyasae one nankeyie inse asemore, nimbaichanere mono ase abwo bamochete kare, abataonchogete korwa ase eubi, na obotomani, na obonyaka obwo bare kwenaria.
english: I am afraid that when I come again my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of the impurity, sexual sin and debauchery in which they have indulged.

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia omobani agatebia Hanania omobani, “Aye Hanania, tegerera oigwe, Omonene tagotometi aye, korende kwaeire abanto ribaga begene oborimo.
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, "Listen, Hananiah! The LORD has not sent you, yet you have persuaded this nation to trust in lies.

ekegusii: Amo nere natomire Onesimo, oyominto omwegenwa, omwanchwa, oyore oyomo oino. Barabwo nababamanyie onsi ayare aiga asetore.
english: He is coming with Onesimus, our faithful and dear brother, who is one of you. They will tell you everything that is happening here.

ekegusii: Yosia agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, akabwatia chinchera chionsi chia Daudi sokoro yaye; taonchogete gochia aande onsi, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in all the ways of his father David, not turning aside to the right or to the left.

ekegusii: Ninkore ororeria rwao robe buna orotu rw’ense rotanyare kobareka; onye omonto okonyara kobara orotu rw’ense, rirorio nanyare kobara ororeria rwao narororwo.
english: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if anyone could count the dust, then your offspring could be counted.

ekegusii: Inee! Amachiko nigo are mamincha e chiira chia Nyasae? Yaya, taibo! Naki onye amachiko aruetwe ayaranyare koa abanto obogima, anga oboronge nigo bwanyorekanete ase amachiko.
english: Is the law, therefore, opposed to the promises of God? Absolutely not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come by the law.

ekegusii: Naomi akamoboria, “Ng’ai kware gochora ebigara rero? Nase omogondo o ng’o kware gokora emeremo? Nyasae asesenie omonto oyio ogwechandera kogokonya!” Rutu agatebia Naomi ng’a nigo arenge gokora emeremo ase omogondo bw’omonto ore korokwa Boazi.
english: Her mother-in-law asked her, "Where did you glean today? Where did you work? Blessed be the man who took notice of you!" Then Ruth told her mother-in-law about the one at whose place she had been working. "The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz," she said.

ekegusii: They set fire to God's temple and broke down the wall of Jerusalem; they burned all the palaces and destroyed everything of value there.
english: Agasamba enyomba ya Nyasae na agatagora chindwaki chia Yerusalemu, agasamba ne chinyomba chionsi chi’oboruoti na agasaria ebikorero bionsi bie rigori rinene biarengeo.

ekegusii: Demazane akarosa kobera ere bweka ase ekerongo keria kera rituko. Igo rituko erimo, ekero momura omwabo asogete isiko gochia koinda na gotega emenyama, agasoka nere korora. Akanyora oroche agasoa ime gochiesa, na korina emete igoro. Akaigwa buya koba isiko ye’kerongo keria. “Oranyore,” banto tibaiyo bakoria abande. Gose onyore buna tata moke nigo arenge gototebia igo erinde tooboe.”
kiswahili: Demazane alichoka sana kukaa pangoni peke yake. Basi siku moja kakake alipoondoka, naye Demazane alitoka na kwenda matembezi. Aliona mto mdogo akaogelea kwa furaha sana. Pia alipanda miti akaendelea kustarehe. Alifurahia uhuru wa kucheza. “Labda hakuna majitu,” aliwaza. “Pengine mjomba alisema kuna majitu ili kututisha tu.”

ekegusii: Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you wish, I will put up three shelters-- one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah."
english: Petero agatebia Yeso, “Omworokia, mbuya intwe koba aiga; onye ngwancha, ninkore aiga ebigutu bitato, ekemo ekiao, ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija.”

ekegusii: Ase okomaanorerwa natebetigwe obobisi boria buna nabarikera rero iga ase amang’ana amake.
english: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.

ekegusii: kera oyomo oino, arusie ogotongora gw’okwama kw’endagera aragese korwa ase omogondo bw’ense eria. Erio ayebeke ase egetonga ime, ayeire goika aase aria Omonene, Nyasae oino, arachore abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye.
english: take some of the firstfruits of all that you produce from the soil of the land the LORD your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana ’omorandia mosinto o Daudi, omoruoti o Yerusalemu.
english: The words of the Teacher, son of David, king in Jerusalem:

ekegusii: Sulemani agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, tamotunyanete ase obwegenwa, buna Daudi ise arenge gokora.
english: So Solomon did evil in the eyes of the LORD; he did not follow the LORD completely, as David his father had done.

ekegusii: Okogwenigwa tikori ase ogoakwa kwao, eriote riao riabeire riibe, tirikogwena. Abanto bonsi abaraigwe aya akonyorire nigo baraake chinkobi ase engencho y’okogwa kwao. Inee! Onde nare otanyoretwe nobobe bwao bwa botambe?
english: Nothing can heal your wound; your injury is fatal. Everyone who hears the news about you claps his hands at your fall, for who has not felt your endless cruelty?

ekegusii: Rituko riria Abasadukai bakamochiera, baria bakobora ng’a okobokigwa tikori, bakamoboria,
english: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.

ekegusii: erio omokuani amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a oborwaire boria bwatubire omobere bwonsi bw’omonto oria, rirorio atebe ng’a ochenekire. Onye omobere bwonsi obeire omorabu, omonto oria obeire oyochenegete.
english: the priest is to examine him, and if the disease has covered his whole body, he shall pronounce that person clean. Since it has all turned white, he is clean.

ekegusii: Abwo bagatotanga titokwana nabanto b’Ebisaku amang’ana ayaranyare kobarentera ogotooreka. Ase enchera eyio baikeranie botambe ekerengo ki’ebibe biabo. Korende endamwamu ya Nyasae yabaikeire omoerio.
english: in their effort to keep us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved. In this way they always heap up their sins to the limit. The wrath of God has come upon them at last.

ekegusii: “Korwa ase engaki eyio ebing’wanso bia kera rituko mbirusigwe aroro, na okogechia kw’ogosaria ngotenenigweo, nabe amatuko elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo kianda (1,290).
english: "From the time that the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination that causes desolation is set up, there will be 1,290 days.

ekegusii: Inche tinkoba ase ense ime naende, korende aba nao bare ase ense ime, na inche ngocha nde asore. Tata Omochenu, obarende ase okobua kw’erieta riao baria kwang’ete, babe abamo buna intwe tore oyomo.
english: I will remain in the world no longer, but they are still in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, protect them by the power of your name-- the name you gave me-- so that they may be one as we are one.

ekegusii: Agwo Gibeoni Omonene akaorokera Sulemani ase chindoto botuko, Nyasae akamotebia, “Boria egento oganetie nkoe.”
english: At Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon during the night in a dream, and God said, "Ask for whatever you want me to give you."

ekegusii: Rahabu nigo amenyete ase enyomba yaagachetwe ekabwateranigwa norwaki rw’omochie. Ere akabaikeria nengori goetera ase ekebao,
english: So she let them down by a rope through the window, for the house she lived in was part of the city wall.

ekegusii: Naama! Chinyasae echio chionsi mbosa. Emeremo eyio y’abanto nigo ere bosa kegima, ee, emegwekano eyio abanto babombete nigo enga embeo bosa.”
english: See, they are all false! Their deeds amount to nothing; their images are but wind and confusion.

ekegusii: Motugute ogosaria kwaino gwonsi, okwo mwakorire asende, mwenyorere chinkoro chinyia na omoika omoyia. Inwe Abaisraeli, nase ki moganetie gokwa?
english: Rid yourselves of all the offenses you have committed, and get a new heart and a new spirit. Why will you die, O house of Israel?

ekegusii: Aya igo akoregete, ekiagera Abaisraeli bakorete ebibe ase Omonene, Nyasae obo oyobarusetie ase ense ya Misiri na korwa ase okoboko gwa Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, na ekiagera bakorerete chinyasae ching’ao.
english: All this took place because the Israelites had sinned against the LORD their God, who had brought them up out of Egypt from under the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt. They worshiped other gods

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Abalawi abatigarete, chiamate chia Merari, bakaegwa emechie ya Yokinamu, na Karita,
english: The Merarite clans (the rest of the Levites) were given: from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam, Kartah,

ekegusii: Naende nigo bakworokereria chingencho chitari boronge ng’a tochianche gose gochienaria, ekiagera intwe n’Abarumi tore.”
english: by advocating customs unlawful for us Romans to accept or practice."

ekegusii: Narure Abalawi babe ekeegwa ase Haroni na abamura baye korwa ase Abaisraeli, erinde bakore emeremo ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Boigo bakore okobwatanigwa asebare, erinde nintange amaakwa tabanyora ekero bagoika ang’e n’Aase Aachenu.”
english: Of all the Israelites, I have given the Levites as gifts to Aaron and his sons to do the work at the Tent of Meeting on behalf of the Israelites and to make atonement for them so that no plague will strike the Israelites when they go near the sanctuary."

ekegusii: “Erio tokaimoka, tokarua ase abaminto, abanto b’ororeria rw’Esau, abwo bamenyete Seiri, togatiga enchera y’Ekerubo Ekiomo, na Elati, na Esioni‐Geberi. Erio tokaonchoka, tokagenda gochia ase erooro ya Moabu.”
english: So we went on past our brothers the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We turned from the Arabah road, which comes up from Elath and Ezion Geber, and traveled along the desert road of Moab.

ekegusii: Abaruoti barenge nokobua babeire bakogambera Yerusalemu na orogongo rwonsi rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na abwo babeire bakorenterwa ebango na echogo y’ebinto na eye chinchera.
english: Jerusalem has had powerful kings ruling over the whole of Trans-Euphrates, and taxes, tribute and duty were paid to them.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagakora bo. Haroni akarambora okoboko kwaye, agaaka riroba nenyimbo yaye, na orotu rokaonchoka rokaba chinsona, na chirochio chikaroma mwanyabanto ne chitugo. Orotu rwonsi rwe riroba rokaonchoka rokaba chinsona.
english: They did this, and when Aaron stretched out his hand with the staff and struck the dust of the ground, gnats came upon men and animals. All the dust throughout the land of Egypt became gnats.

ekegusii: Rora, Omonene nabwate oyomo ore nokobua ne chinguru; oyio nigo anga buna embura y’amagena, na buna omwaga omotindi ogosaria, na buna omoubera ore nembura enyinge oraiyerie ebinto bionsi inse ne chinguru.
english: See, the Lord has one who is powerful and strong. Like a hailstorm and a destructive wind, like a driving rain and a flooding downpour, he will throw it forcefully to the ground.

ekegusii: Tiga aonchore orosea rwaye gochia ase oyio okomoaka, na oyio aisaneke noborami.
english: Let him offer his cheek to one who would strike him, and let him be filled with disgrace.

ekegusii: Farao akaroka Yusufu Safenati‐Panea; akamonyuomeria omokungu, nere Asenati, omoiseke o Potifera, omokuani bw’Oni. Yusufu akagenda aaria na aaria korigereria ense yonsi ya Misiri.
english: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-Paneah and gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph went throughout the land of Egypt.

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Yotamu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Jotham's reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Agatoma naende oyo o gatato, bakamoaka chingoma, bakamotuguta isiko.
english: He sent still a third, and they wounded him and threw him out.

ekegusii: Chindooche chionsi nigo chikogenda ase enyancha, korende tiyana goichora. Amache ayio nigo akoirana gochia ase chindooche echio chiachakerete, naende agenderera kogenda.
english: All streams flow into the sea, yet the sea is never full. To the place the streams come from, there they return again.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagateba ase emioyo yabo, “Goika tobasirie kegima.” Nigo basambete aase onsi abanto ba Nyasae bagosangererekana.
english: They said in their hearts, "We will crush them completely!" They burned every place where God was worshiped in the land.

ekegusii: Elija akamoiraneria, “Ee, ninche. Genda otebie omonene oo ng’a inche Elija nao inde aiga.”
english: "Yes," he replied. "Go tell your master, 'Elijah is here.'"

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Inaki mogoichana? Naende inaki ogosiereria kwaimokire ase chinkoro chiaino?
english: He said to them, "Why are you troubled, and why do doubts rise in your minds?

ekegusii: For whatever is hidden is meant to be disclosed, and whatever is concealed is meant to be brought out into the open.
english: Naki ring’ana tiriri ribisegete ritache koorokigwa, gose eria bobisi ritache koorokigwa maiso marore.

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia igoro y’Abayahudi bonsi bamenyete ase ense ya Misiri, agwo ase emechie ya Migidoli, na Tapanesi, na Memifisi, na ase orogongo rwa Patirosi, rigateba:
english: This word came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews living in Lower Egypt-- in Migdol, Tahpanhes and Memphis-- and in Upper Egypt:

ekegusii: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, Ramoth Negev and Jattir;
english: Naboigo abitomerete abagaaka ba Beteli na Ramoti agwo Negebu, na abwo b’emechie ya Yatiri,

ekegusii: Ekero Atalia, ng’ina Ahasia, aroche ng’a omwana oye okure, akaimoka, agaita ab’enyomba yonsi y’omoruoti bw’Abayuda.
english: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the whole royal family of the house of Judah.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi na abanto baria barenge komo bagaaka amariogi abo, bakarera mono goika chinguru chikabaerera.
english: So David and his men wept aloud until they had no strength left to weep.

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Misiri: Rora, Omonene nigo ariinete riire rikominyoka bwango ogocha Misiri. Erio agwo emegwekano egosasimwa y’Abamisiri nenyegerigwe ase obosio bwaye, ne chinkoro chi’Abamisiri nigo chirairianyeke.
english: An oracle concerning Egypt: See, the LORD rides on a swift cloud and is coming to Egypt. The idols of Egypt tremble before him, and the hearts of the Egyptians melt within them.

ekegusii: Erio abanto baria Batato bakabinya‐binyia egati y’Abafilisti aase batoorete, bakabuucha amache korwa ase ensoko eria yarenge ase egeita kia Bethlehemu, bakayairera Daudi. Korende Daudi tayanywa otatiga ayaumorete akaba okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa ase Omonene,
english: So the Three broke through the Philistine lines, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem and carried it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out before the LORD.

ekegusii: Nere boigo akabwatia chinchera chi’enyomba y’Ahabu, ekiagera ng’ina nere orenge komosemia akore ayare amabe.
english: He too walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother encouraged him in doing wrong.

ekegusii: Naki oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ng’a mobe abachenu, na mweatanane korwa ase obotomani.
english: It is God's will that you should be sanctified: that you should avoid sexual immorality;

ekegusii: Ase ayio, timobaisa koigwera ababani baino, gose abaringoria, gose abarogi bande bonsi, abwo bakobatebia ng’a timogochia komokorera omoruoti o Babeli.
english: So do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your interpreters of dreams, your mediums or your sorcerers who tell you, 'You will not serve the king of Babylon.'

ekegusii: “Abakungu abange bakorire ayare amaya mono, korende aye kwababuire bonsi.”
english: "Many women do noble things, but you surpass them all."

ekegusii: Ekero ekio akarenterwa omonto obwatire nekerecha; ere nomouko orenge, naende nigo arenge rimama. Akamogwenia, goika oria orenge omouko ne rimama agakwana na korora.
english: Then they brought him a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute, and Jesus healed him, so that he could both talk and see.

ekegusii: Naki eramanyekane ng’a inche na abanto bao twanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, onye tokogenda amo naintwe? Koragende amo naintwe, natororekane ng’a twachorirwe korwa ase abanto bande b’ense eye.”
english: How will anyone know that you are pleased with me and with your people unless you go with us? What else will distinguish me and your people from all the other people on the face of the earth?"

ekegusii: Na genda bwango, motebie aborokigwa baye ng’a obokire korwa ase abakure; na rora, obatang’aneire kogenda Galili; agwo nao moramorore. Rora, inche nabatebirie ayio.”
english: Then go quickly and tell his disciples: 'He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.' Now I have told you."

ekegusii: Erooro na ense enyomo nchibe nomogoko; ee, erooro nechenge na gosicha buna ebisicha ebiya.
english: The desert and the parched land will be glad; the wilderness will rejoice and blossom. Like the crocus,

ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ogoteba: “Roisia enchera y’Omonene ase erooro; rongeyia enchera enene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, agwo ase erooro.
english: A voice of one calling: "In the desert prepare the way for the LORD; make straight in the wilderness a highway for our God.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria rero kwaorokirie buna gwakorire amaya asende, ekiagera otang’ita ekero Omonene ambeka ase okoboko kwao.
english: You have just now told me of the good you did to me; the LORD delivered me into your hands, but you did not kill me.

ekegusii: Saulo akamoboria, “Nase ki aye na mosinto o Yese mwabeire mamincha yane? Aye nkwamoa endagera, na omoyio o birende naende okaboria Nyasae ase engencho yaye? Ere obeire mamincha yane na okomboera buna ere rero iga.”
english: Saul said to him, "Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, giving him bread and a sword and inquiring of God for him, so that he has rebelled against me and lies in wait for me, as he does today?"

ekegusii: Na abanto aba nabagende ase egesusuro gia kare na kare, korende abanyene oboronge nabagende ase obogima bwa kare na kare.”
english: "Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life."

ekegusii: Korende Daudi akamotebia, “Ninki inde nainwe, abana b’omokungu Seruya? Nigo moganetie koba mamincha yane. Bono ninche inde omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, na onde tari ase Abaisraeli oraitwe rero.”
english: David replied, "What do you and I have in common, you sons of Zeruiah? This day you have become my adversaries! Should anyone be put to death in Israel today? Do I not know that today I am king over Israel?"

ekegusii: Erio Yehoasi, mosinto o Yehoahasi, akaira naende korwa ase Beni‐Hadadi, mosinto o Hasaeli, emechie eyio ere konya airire korwa ase Yehoahasi ise ekero gi’esegi. Yehoasi akabua Beni‐Hadadi ara gatato, akairania emechie y’Abaisraeli.
english: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recaptured from Ben-Hadad son of Hazael the towns he had taken in battle from his father Jehoahaz. Three times Jehoash defeated him, and so he recovered the Israelite towns.

ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore aye Nyasae ore moyo. Ndiriri ndachiche ndore obosio bwao, aye Nyasae?
english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When can I go and meet with God?

ekegusii: Amagwa namere ase chinyomba chi’oboruoti, amasa na amageri mbimere ase chiburi chi’aroro. Nabe obomenyo bwe chisese chi’orosana ne chisagero.
english: Thorns will overrun her citadels, nettles and brambles her strongholds. She will become a haunt for jackals, a home for owls.

ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria ase ogotiana, agateba, “Iso igo amanyete buya ng’a aye nonyanchete mono, na ororire ng’a tari buya akomanyie ring’ana erio, ekiagera nigo riragoichanie mono. Korende ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, na buna aye ore moyo, ngetigarete egetambokero ekemo gioka egati yane na amakweri.”
english: But David took an oath and said, "Your father knows very well that I have found favor in your eyes, and he has said to himself, 'Jonathan must not know this or he will be grieved.' Yet as surely as the LORD lives and as you live, there is only a step between me and death."

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwane, mbagende gochia inse kegima y’ense.
english: They who seek my life will be destroyed; they will go down to the depths of the earth.

ekegusii: Ase engencho yabo nigo ainyorete okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, akabarorera amabeebe, ekiagera are nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.
english: for their sake he remembered his covenant and out of his great love he relented.

ekegusii: Emeremo yonsi omonto akwerosia gokora nokonyora egento akoria, korende nonya naboigo tari koigota.
english: All man's efforts are for his mouth, yet his appetite is never satisfied.

ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na gatato ri’omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, noro omotienyi bw’Adari, rigaika. Ase rituko riria ogochika kw’omoruoti kware gocha goikeranigwa, ababisa b’Abayahudi nigo basemeretie ng’a mbababue, korende amang’ana konya aonchokire ng’a Abayahudi mbabue ababisa babo.
english: On the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, the edict commanded by the king was to be carried out. On this day the enemies of the Jews had hoped to overpower them, but now the tables were turned and the Jews got the upper hand over those who hated them.

ekegusii: Pilato akamoboria naende, akabora, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Rora amang’ana aya amange bagosoeire.”
english: So again Pilate asked him, "Aren't you going to answer? See how many things they are accusing you of."

ekegusii: ende egwekaine emeuru, na emebeno amo, erinde abanto mbarore na komanya, naende mbarengererie bamanye bonsi amo, ng’a nokoboko kw’Omonene gwakorire ayio, ee, ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nere otongete ebio bionsi.”
english: so that people may see and know, may consider and understand, that the hand of the LORD has done this, that the Holy One of Israel has created it.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Naki motaramanya?”
english: He said to them, "Do you still not understand?"

ekegusii: “Esagero nigo egosamunsa chimbaba chiaye chioga; korende, Inee, chimbaba echio nchibwate obwanchani?
english: "The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, but they cannot compare with the pinions and feathers of the stork.

ekegusii: Ekero arenge ase omochie oyomo, rora, narengeo omonto omosacha oichire noborwaire bwa ukoma. Ere agachia korora Yeso, akagwa maumama, akamosorora, okomotebia, “Omonene, onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”
english: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, "Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean."

ekegusii: The sayings of Agur son of Jakeh-- an oracle: This man declared to Ithiel, to Ithiel and to Ucal:
english: Aya naro amang’ana ’Aguri, mosinto o Yake o Masa. Omonto oyio agatebia Itieli na Ukali:

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, inyora amang’ana aya, ekiagera inwe nabasomba baane. Inwe Abaisraeli, tinkobeeba.
english: "Remember these things, O Jacob, for you are my servant, O Israel. I have made you, you are my servant; O Israel, I will not forget you.

ekegusii: Naki goetera asare intwe twensi twanyorire enchera y’okomoika ang’e Tata, ase Omoika oyomo.
english: For through him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit.

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Edomu. Omonto nkondangeria are korwa Seiri, okoboria, “Omorendi, mang’ana ki igoro y’obotuko? Omorendi, mang’ana ki igoro y’obotuko?”
english: An oracle concerning Dumah: Someone calls to me from Seir, "Watchman, what is left of the night? Watchman, what is left of the night?"

ekegusii: Erio bagateba, “Rora, ndire Rituko ri’Omonene ria kera omwaka agwo Silo, sugusu ya Beteli, irianyi ya Lebona, moocha y’enchera ere gati ya Beteli na Sekemu.”
english: But look, there is the annual festival of the LORD in Shiloh, to the north of Bethel, and east of the road that goes from Bethel to Shechem, and to the south of Lebonah."

ekegusii: Of Gershon: Libni his son, Jehath his son, Zimmah his son,
english: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Gerisomu: Libini omomura oye, na Yahati omomura oye, na Sima omomura oye,

ekegusii: Asare ere oboagacho bwonsi bwabwatanigwe amo, na gokina, bobe Hekalu Enchenu ase Omonene.
english: In him the whole building is joined together and rises to become a holy temple in the Lord.

ekegusii: They replied, "Your servant our father is still alive and well." And they bowed low to pay him honor.
english: Bakamoiraneria, “Ee, omosomba oo tata mbuya are. Nabo moyo are.” Barabwo bagatureka emetwe yabo inse.

ekegusii: Karayerenge na arore ng’a egetamase nkere ase enyasi y’enyomba eyio kere nekieni buna obonyansi, gose ekebariri, naende giakorire engoro gochia ime goetania rioomo,
english: He is to examine the mildew on the walls, and if it has greenish or reddish depressions that appear to be deeper than the surface of the wall,

ekegusii: Daudi agoosa chigari elifu eyemo (1,000), na abariini chibarasi chilifu isano na ibere (7,000), na abarwani abaare kogenda namagoro chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000). Erio akabutora chibarasi chionsi chinteng’e otatiga chibarasi rigana erimo chikaba chikong’usa chigari.
english: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.

ekegusii: Naki chinguru chi’ogochika koria kwe ritang’ani nigo chiasiretigwe ase engencho y’oboreu bwaye na ogotaisanera kwaye.
english: The former regulation is set aside because it was weak and useless

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane, inche omosomba oo, amo nogosaba kw’abasomba bao, abwo bare nomogoko ase okoiroka erieta riao. Insesenia inche, omosomba oo, rituko ria rero, inyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’omonto oyo.” Ase engaki eyio nigo narenge omobogoria bw’ebinyugwa bi’omoruoti.
english: O Lord, let your ear be attentive to the prayer of this your servant and to the prayer of your servants who delight in revering your name. Give your servant success today by granting him favor in the presence of this man." I was cupbearer to the king.

ekegusii: Korende ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, bw’Elisama bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, agacha amo nabanto ikomi, agaaka Gedalia, akamoita. Boigo agaita Abayuda na Abakalidayo baria barenge amo nere agwo Misipa.
english: In the seventh month, however, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was of royal blood, came with ten men and assassinated Gedaliah and also the men of Judah and the Babylonians who were with him at Mizpah.

ekegusii: Oyorenge omosani one nigo aramborete okoboko kwaye, akore bobe ase abakorete omorembe nere, osaririe okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.
english: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.

ekegusii: Erio Danieli akarentwa ase obosio bw’omoruoti, na omoruoti akamoboria: “Inee! Naye Danieli oria, oyomo bw’abanto baria boosetwe korwa ase ense y’Abayuda, oria omoruoti tata arentete korwa ase ense eria?
english: So Daniel was brought before the king, and the king said to him, "Are you Daniel, one of the exiles my father the king brought from Judah?

ekegusii: Aroro agasoa rikuruma ime, akararao ase obotuko boria. Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asare, rikamoboria, “Elija, ninki ogokora ime aa?”
english: There he went into a cave and spent the night. And the word of the LORD came to him: "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

ekegusii: Rigereria, ngocha are namare, na kera eriso narimorore, nonya nabwo bamoitete, na abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bi’ense nabeng’ererie ase engencho yaye. Ee, nabo. Amina.
english: Look, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, even those who pierced him; and all the peoples of the earth will mourn because of him. So shall it be! Amen.

ekegusii: Abafarisai abarenge abanchi enibo bakaigwa amang’ana aya onsi, bakamosekereria.
english: The Pharisees, who loved money, heard all this and were sneering at Jesus.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli bagatoma abanto gochia ase chiamate chionsi chia Benjamin, bakabora, “Nobokayayu bore naki, obo bwakorekanire ase egati yaino?
english: The tribes of Israel sent men throughout the tribe of Benjamin, saying, "What about this awful crime that was committed among you?

ekegusii: Ase rituko erimo Peka, mosinto o Remalia, agaita abanto chituoni chilifu rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere (120,000) agwo ase ense ya Yuda. Aya nigo akoregete bo, ekiagera Abayuda batigete Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo.
english: In one day Pekah son of Remaliah killed a hundred and twenty thousand soldiers in Judah-- because Judah had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers.

ekegusii: “Mosakore, moire chingamia chiabo, ne chiombe chiabo chibe echiaino. Abanto abwo bakogingira chitukia chiabo nimbaserie mbasiarere gochia ase kera ensemo y’ense. Nimbarentere emechando korwa ase kera ensemo. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: Their camels will become plunder, and their large herds will be booty. I will scatter to the winds those who are in distant places and will bring disaster on them from every side," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Aye Gogi, nochiche korwania Abaisraeli, abanto baane. Noche buna riire otube ense eyio. Ase amatuko agochigocha ninkorente orwanie ense yaane, erinde abanto b’ebisaku bamanye inche, ekero ndeorokie ase amaiso abo ng’a inche inde omochenu ase egati yaino.
english: You will advance against my people Israel like a cloud that covers the land. In days to come, O Gog, I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when I show myself holy through you before their eyes.

ekegusii: Goika obotuko bwa ikomi na kane bogachia goika tokairwa gochia aria na aria ase enyancha y’Adiria. Botuko gati abagendia b’emeeri bagakaga ng’a baikire ang’e ase ense enyomo.
english: On the fourteenth night we were still being driven across the Adriatic Sea, when about midnight the sailors sensed they were approaching land.

ekegusii: bakagenda ase Musa, na Eleazari omokuani, na ase abaraai b’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, bakabatebia,
english: So they came to Moses and Eleazar the priest and to the leaders of the community, and said,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ase rituko ria ikomi na gatato, ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, abariki b’omoruoti bakarangerigwa, barike amang’ana ’ogochika koria omoruoti aruete. Amarube akarikwa gochia ase abagambi abanene b’oboruoti, na ase abagavuna, na ase abanene b’abanto be chingongo chionsi ase oboruoti bwaye, ase kera orogongo ase okorikwa kw’engencho y’amariko abo, na ase kera egesaku ase omonwa obo. Amang’ana ayio nigo arigetwe akabekwa erieta ri’omoruoti Ahaswero amo nekemanyererio ki’ebonyi eria yaye.
english: Then on the thirteenth day of the first month the royal secretaries were summoned. They wrote out in the script of each province and in the language of each people all Haman's orders to the king's satraps, the governors of the various provinces and the nobles of the various peoples. These were written in the name of King Xerxes himself and sealed with his own ring.

ekegusii: Ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, ang’e na Yorodan, kororia Yeriko, Omonene agkwana na Musa, akamotebia,
english: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,

ekegusii: Agachia koba nkomochiera are ekerecha keria gekamoigusia na komoiyeria. Yeso agakania ekerecha keria, akagwenia omwana oria, akamoirania ase ise.
english: Even while the boy was coming, the demon threw him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the evil spirit, healed the boy and gave him back to his father.

ekegusii: Naki amaiso ’Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ogosaba kwabo. Korende obosio bw’Omonene nigo bore igoro ase abwo bagokora amabe.”
english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their prayer, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil."

ekegusii: Korende abwo bare isiko, Nyasae nabagambie, “Seria omonto oyio omobe arue asemore.”
english: God will judge those outside. "Expel the wicked man from among you."

ekegusii: gose omonto ore nesukubi ase omogongo oye, gose ore oboengere, gose oyore na kemocho ase eriso, gose oyo obosisa boriete, gose oborwaire bonde ase risankwa, gose omosacha chingetia chiaye chisaregete.
english: or who is hunchbacked or dwarfed, or who has any eye defect, or who has festering or running sores or damaged testicles.

ekegusii: “Abayahudi bonsi mbamanyete obogima bwane korwa obosae bwane buna bwarenge korwa omochakano, ase egesaku kiane na ase Yerusalemu.
english: "The Jews all know the way I have lived ever since I was a child, from the beginning of my life in my own country, and also in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagesiarera ase ense yonsi ya Misiri na kwerigeria obonyansi ribaga rie chimboba.
english: So the people scattered all over Egypt to gather stubble to use for straw.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akebisa mogondo na ekero ki’Omotienyi Omoyia omoruoti agaikaransa koragera.
english: So David hid in the field, and when the New Moon festival came, the king sat down to eat.

ekegusii: Erio Labani akaira abamwabo, bakamobwatia orogendo rw’amatuko atano na abere, akamoikeera ase ebitunwa bia Gileadi.
english: Taking his relatives with him, he pursued Jacob for seven days and caught up with him in the hill country of Gilead.

ekegusii: Buna Tata are moyo antomete, na inche inde moyo ase engencho ya Tata, naboigo oyokondia, nabe moyo ase engencho yane.
english: Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so the one who feeds on me will live because of me.

ekegusii: Ere natware ebuku eyio abe ogosoma amachiko ayio onsi ase amatuko ’obogima bwaye bwonsi, erio neorokererie komoiroka Omonene, Nyasae oye, na korenda amang’ana onsi ay’ogochika okwo na ay’emeroberio echikire, na koyakora.
english: It is to be with him, and he is to read it all the days of his life so that he may learn to revere the LORD his God and follow carefully all the words of this law and these decrees

ekegusii: Nkarora abanto bonsi abamenyete inse y’erioba bakobwatia omosae oria ogochia kobekwa oboruoti ribaga ri’oria orengeo.
english: I saw that all who lived and walked under the sun followed the youth, the king's successor.

ekegusii: Erio agwo omoerio ochiche, ekero arae Nyasae Tata oboruoti, nyuma gasaririe kera obogambi na kera okobua ne chinguru.
english: Then the end will come, when he hands over the kingdom to God the Father after he has destroyed all dominion, authority and power.

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika gotenenerete ching’iti ne chinyoni, na kera egetongwa kere moyo kegoetanana ase amache ime, na ebitongwa ebisinini bigoetanana ase ense,
english: "'These are the regulations concerning animals, birds, every living thing that moves in the water and every creature that moves about on the ground.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakamotebia, “Aya naro Hezekia agoteba: Rituko ria rero neri’obororo na egesusuro, na ogochaywa. Abana babeire ang’e baiborwe, korende chinguru chi’okobasukia basoke chiaborire.
english: They told him, "This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace, as when children come to the point of birth and there is no strength to deliver them.

ekegusii: Erio kobasangererekanire, Pilato akababoria, “Norori morigetie mbasiborere, Baraba gose Yeso, oyo okorokwa Kristo?”
english: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, "Which one do you want me to release to you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?"

ekegusii: tatiga monto abogorie gento ase egati ye Hekalu.
english: and would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.

ekegusii: Bwachia koba botuko, Aburamu agaatanana abanto baye, erinde barwanie ababisa babo, akababua akabaseria goika Hoba, sugusu ya Damesiki.
english: During the night Abram divided his men to attack them and he routed them, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.

ekegusii: Aye bwerende korwa asare, ekiagera nigo aengereretie okworokereria gwaito.
english: You too should be on your guard against him, because he strongly opposed our message.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibanyara komoiraneria ase amang’ana aria.
english: And they had nothing to say.

ekegusii: Naende Rutu, Omomoabu oria, akamotebia, “Amo nayio ere nigo antebia ng’a mbeere amo nabasomba baye goika bakoore rigesa riaye rionsi.”

english: For when they counted the people, they found that none of the people of Jabesh Gilead were there.

english: They were stoned; they were sawed in two; they were put to death by the sword. They went about in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, persecuted and mistreated--

english: Agripa agatebia Festo, “Nainche omonyene nindigetie koigwa omonto oyio.” Akabora, “Noche omoigwe ankio.”

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Minto Mwamogusii, mbuya mono ase Omonene Tata Nyasae, ase ogotoikia omwaka o 2012. Nigo nyegenete ng'a nakera oyomo nare n' obote bw' okwarigania omwaka omoyia buna omosubati okoarigania omwana okoiborwa. Naintwe aiga Gusii.com ntori gotigwa magega yaye. Naintwe nkoyochengera tore. "Ntakana ekebwata bobe egasira, ntakana ekebwata buya ekaba aroro". Tiga ntwe abana ba Mwanyagetinge twebwate buya in 2012, erinde tochabumbe. Happy new year 2012, ase abana baminto mwensi Bono nigo tokoganeria mwensi amaya na omorembe O' Yeso obe nainwe ne chiamate chiano chionsi, Gusii yaito, n' ense engima. N' omogoko omonene buna twabwaterana twensi ase okogokera buna egekoro giato kiare ase omwaka oyo oera. naende ntogenderere gosemanian ase omwaka oyo o 2012. Nigo tokobasaba togenderere kobwaterana nario omonwa oito oragenderere. Omwana gakonya gokina nigo akonya kong'ainia ake ake. Naintwe nkonya gokina tore. Nigo tososaba buna tiga togenderere gokina aamo. Abagusii baminto tiga tobwaterane twensi toegokere na koinyorerani buna twakabeire. Teri igo rioka. Tiga Ekegusii giato gechabumbe gaki nonya emenwa ende yachiire nguma. Aya takoba ,otaiyo buna omwana ominto. 2012 n'omwaka bw'obochori seito Kenya. Tiga tosabe omorembe oichore egati yaito twensi ekiagera abakoro mbatebete buna, "Ntakana ekebwata bobe egasira, ntakana ekebwata buya ekaba aroro". Tiga toebwate buya, tonya koba ororo. Aya na amaiga y' omwaka omuya 2012. Happy new year abana baminto Mwanyagetinge mwensi. Nyasae abe nainwe.
english: These are my words: Minto Mwamogusii, a child of mine who praised God, praised Him in the year 2012. It was a good day when I remembered and thought about the importance of raising a child well, like raising a young plant. I created Gusii.com so people could find information there. I continue to work on it diligently. “Don’t despise small beginnings, don’t despise humble origins.” This is what the children of Mwanyagetinge said in 2012, and it has remained true. Happy New Year 2012, to all the children of our clan. This is how we begin this year with peace and the love of Jesus Christ, whom we all know, Gusii people, and with all wisdom. And with great joy we will celebrate together and the year will end well. I also wish you blessings throughout the year 2012. We pray for blessings so we can continue to live and prosper. A strong child can become very successful. I hope this happens too. We ask that this blessing happen quickly. The Gusii people should always live together peacefully and help each other so we can progress. There is no time to waste. Let the Gusii language flourish and be known everywhere, and let it bring us honor. These words are true, they are important for every child. 2012 is a year of change for Kenya. We ask for peace to prevail during the elections so that people don’t fight, saying “Don’t despise small beginnings, don’t despise humble origins”. Let us embrace humility, and may we not be arrogant. These are the hopes for the year 2012. Happy New Year children of Mwanyagetinge clan. May God bless you.

ekegusii: Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
english: Komoramanye ayio, mosesenirie komorayakore.

ekegusii: Naende bayea oyotamanyeti gosoma, bamotebia: “Soma amang’ana ’ebuku eye,” nere nigo agokana, oteba, “Timanyeti gosoma.”
english: Or if you give the scroll to someone who cannot read, and say, "Read this, please," he will answer, "I don't know how to read."

ekegusii: “Imosesenirie inwe, ekero bakobarama na kobachanda, na kobatebera kera ring’ana riibe ase oborimo, ase engencho yane.
english: "Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of me.

ekegusii: Ere nakwane amang’ana are mamincha y’Oyore Igoro Mono, naende narosie abachenu b’Oyore Igoro Mono na kobachanda; narengererie koonchora ebiro, na amachiko. Abachenu mbabekwe ase okoboko kwaye ase ekero ekemo, na ebiro bibere, na ekeng’ese gi’ekero.
english: He will speak against the Most High and oppress his saints and try to change the set times and the laws. The saints will be handed over to him for a time, times and half a time.

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Soka ogende, otenene ase egetunwa igoro agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene!” Erio Omonene agaeta agwo, na omwaga ore ne chinguru ogatandora ebitunwa na gwata amagena ’ebitare agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, korende Omonene tarenge ime ase omwaga oria. Na ekero omwaga oerire, omotengecho bw’ense ogacha, korende Omonene tarenge ase omotengecho oria.
english: The LORD said, "Go out and stand on the mountain in the presence of the LORD, for the LORD is about to pass by." Then a great and powerful wind tore the mountains apart and shattered the rocks before the LORD, but the LORD was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake, but the LORD was not in the earthquake.

ekegusii: Nigo akweboyia chinguru buna orokini, okora emeremo emekong’u namaboko aye.
english: She sets about her work vigorously; her arms are strong for her tasks.

ekegusii: Erio Musa akagenda akarangeria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli amo, akabatebia amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene amochigete.
english: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all the words the LORD had commanded him to speak.

ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha ase egati yabo oyo konya okoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania nigo abaretwe. Barabwo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isato (23,000). Abanto aba tibabaretwe amo n’Abaisraeli bande, ekiagera tibaetwe omwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli.
english: All the male Levites a month old or more numbered 23,000. They were not counted along with the other Israelites because they received no inheritance among them.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’Esabato omogambi arue ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene, chimanwa chie ching’ondi isano nemo, na emingichi eyemo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: The burnt offering the prince brings to the LORD on the Sabbath day is to be six male lambs and a ram, all without defect.

ekegusii: Gaki onkorere inche, omosomba oo, amaya, ekiagera gwakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania amo nainche ase obosio bw’Omonene. Korende onye okomocha kore asende, rirorio aye omonyene ong’ite? Nase ki okong’ira ase iso, erinde ere ang’ite?”
english: As for you, show kindness to your servant, for you have brought him into a covenant with you before the LORD. If I am guilty, then kill me yourself! Why hand me over to your father?"

ekegusii: Okwama kwaino nakobe okonene, na mogenderere koora goika engaki y’ogotora amasabibu eike, na mogenderere gotora amasabibu goika engaki y’ogosimeka eike; na inwe namonyore endagera enyinge, naende momenye ase ense yaino ase obotoereru.
english: Your threshing will continue until grape harvest and the grape harvest will continue until planting, and you will eat all the food you want and live in safety in your land.

ekegusii: Boigo Sulemani akaroisia ebinto binde bionsi biare kobekwa ase enyomba y’Omonene; egesasimero gi’etahabu, na emesa y’etahabu ase emegati yare koruegwa ase Nyasae yare kobekwa.
english: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in the LORD's temple: the golden altar; the golden table on which was the bread of the Presence;

ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto oria takonyara konyora eng’ondi, gose embori, rirorio andetere inche Omonene amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, abe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye ase engencho y’ebibe akorire. Erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
english: "'If he cannot afford a lamb, he is to bring two doves or two young pigeons to the LORD as a penalty for his sin-- one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

ekegusii: Rora buna ogoichanigwa okwo kore ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae kwabarenteire omokia, na ogwekengera, na okobea, okoiroka na amaiga amange, ogwetigana na egesiomba! Ase kera enchera mweorokererie koba motari na komocha ase ring’ana erio.
english: See what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what concern, what readiness to see justice done. At every point you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.

ekegusii: Erio Yonathani agatebia Daudi, “Ankio ne Rituko Rinene ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ekiagera togochi‐gocha koba ase omoyega, ekerogo kiao nigo keratigare bosa.
english: Then Jonathan said to David: "Tomorrow is the New Moon festival. You will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato Musa akarangeria Haroni amo nabamura baye, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli.
english: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaegwa eanga entambe endabu, bagatebigwa batimoke engaki ende enke goika omobaro bw’abasomba abamo, na abamwabo, oikeranigwe, abwo barache goitwa boigo buna barabwo abanyene baitetwe.
english: Then each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to wait a little longer, until the number of their fellow servants and brothers who were to be killed as they had been was completed.

ekegusii: Na rora, ase obosio bwaye narengeo omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okobimbia omobere.
english: There in front of him was a man suffering from dropsy.

ekegusii: Nkagokinia okamenteka okaba chilifu ne chilifu, buna ebimeri bire ase riroba. Ogakina okaba omonene na omonyakieni: chimbeere chiao chigakina, na etukia yao boigo; korende nonya naboigo, nigo kwarenge getirianda, tikwabegete kende.
english: I made you grow like a plant of the field. You grew up and developed and became the most beautiful of jewels. Your breasts were formed and your hair grew, you who were naked and bare.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Reueli nabwo aba: Nahati na Zera, Sama na Miza.
english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.

ekegusii: "What are you arguing with them about?" he asked.
english: Akababoria, “Ninki mokoengererania nabarabwo?”

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaboria Danieli, oria orogetwe Beli‐Tesasari, “Inee! Aye nonyare gontebia chindoto echio narotete na engencho yaye?”
english: The king asked Daniel (also called Belteshazzar), "Are you able to tell me what I saw in my dream and interpret it?"

ekegusii: Tiga abansoeri abwo bamanye ng’a aya nigo arure ase okoboko kwao. Aye Omonene, naye gwakorire aya.
english: Let them know that it is your hand, that you, O LORD, have done it.

ekegusii: Korende emegondo y’omochie amo nebichie b’omochie oyio bakaa Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune.
english: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.

ekegusii: Naende abakungu bande ba seito nigo batoichanetie. Abwo barenge ase oboina mambia,
english: In addition, some of our women amazed us. They went to the tomb early this morning

ekegusii: Nigo ngechete abanyamenwa ebere, korende nigo inyanchete amachiko ao.
english: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakairaneria, “Amanyinga aye, tiga abe igoro asetore, na ase abana baito!”
english: All the people answered, "Let his blood be on us and on our children!"

ekegusii: Inee! Oko nakwo okweng’ata inche nganetie? Inee! Eye nero enchera endonge omonto agwekeyia? Ogwekumba omotwe buna risakwe, na kweboyia chigunia amo nokweaka ribu? Inee! Ayio naro mokoroka okweng’ata ne rituko rikomogwenera Omonene?”
english: Is this the kind of fast I have chosen, only a day for a man to humble himself? Is it only for bowing one's head like a reed and for lying on sackcloth and ashes? Is that what you call a fast, a day acceptable to the LORD?

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase rituko erio ndabe nabachenire korwa ase ebibe biaino bionsi, nindue ribaga emechie eyio emenywe, na amaagacho ayio atagoretwe aagachwe naende.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day I cleanse you from all your sins, I will resettle your towns, and the ruins will be rebuilt.

ekegusii: Korende ntore nobotenenku obo ime ase ebibekerero bi’amaroba, erinde aorokigwe ng’a okobua okonene gwe chinguru nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae, gose tikori korwa asetore intwe abanyene.
english: But we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this all-surpassing power is from God and not from us.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akaorokera Abimeleki botuko ase okorota, akamotebia, “Aye goika okwe, ekiagera omokungu oyo kwarentire nomokungu bw’omonto onde.”
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream one night and said to him, "You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken; she is a married woman."

ekegusii: Abanto abange bakaara chianga chiabo inchera; abande bakanacha chinsagia chi’emete na gochiaara inchera.
english: Many people spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut in the fields.

ekegusii: “Tebia Haroni na abamura baye amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi ng’a inche Omonene nachikire iga:
english: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: 'This is what the LORD has commanded:

ekegusii: Agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, akarangeria abwo arigetie ere omonyene; na barabwo bakamochiera.
english: Jesus went up on a mountainside and called to him those he wanted, and they came to him.

ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogotera okoyia; motogie korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense! Inwe abaeti ase enyancha amo nebinto bionsi bire imeo, inwe abamomenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, motogie Omonene!
english: Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise from the ends of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who live in them.

ekegusii: Kwana amang’ana ’obwororo ase Yerusalemu, moyorarerie ng’a emechando yaye yaerire, na ebibe biaye biabeirwe, naende ng’a Yerusalemu onyorire okwaberwa ara kabere korwa ase okoboko kw’Omonene ase ebibe biaye bionsi.
english: Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her hard service has been completed, that her sin has been paid for, that she has received from the LORD's hand double for all her sins.

ekegusii: Korende ase rituko erio nintige ensemo ya Goseni, ase abanto baane bamenyete; chingi echio tichigochiao, erio nomanye ng’a ninche Omonene bw’ense eye.
english: "'But on that day I will deal differently with the land of Goshen, where my people live; no swarms of flies will be there, so that you will know that I, the LORD, am in this land.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria ababani bagatirimboka korwa Yerusalemu gochia Antiokia.
english: During this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

ekegusii: bakaoonia chinibo chiabo na ebinto ebibarenge nabio, na kobigabera abanto bonsi koreng’ana buna kera oyomo aremeire.
english: Selling their possessions and goods, they gave to anyone as he had need.

ekegusii: Abaratooreke korwa ase emioro mbarue ase ense ya Misiri, bairane ase ense y’Abayuda, abanto abasinini mono ase omobaro. Abatigari bonsi b’Abayuda abagendete komenya ase ense ya Misiri nabamanye gose ring’ana neriang’o riragenderere koba eri’ekeene, eriane gose eriabo.
english: Those who escape the sword and return to the land of Judah from Egypt will be very few. Then the whole remnant of Judah who came to live in Egypt will know whose word will stand-- mine or theirs.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: “Koreng’ana buna narentete endamwamu yane enene igoro ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, naboigo ndayerente igoro asemore, ekero moragende Misiri. Inwe nigo morabe mogokwanwa ekero abanto barabe bakoragereria, na ekero abanto bakobarora nigo barakumie na goichana, naende mobe mogochecherigwa. Timokoirana gocha korora aase aiga naende.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: 'As my anger and wrath have been poured out on those who lived in Jerusalem, so will my wrath be poured out on you when you go to Egypt. You will be an object of cursing and horror, of condemnation and reproach; you will never see this place again.'

ekegusii: Korende eki more nakio kebwate goika nchiche.
english: Only hold on to what you have until I come.

ekegusii: Oyio ore omoenenu nagochwe na kogwa, gose monto onde takomogororokia. Nintongie omorero ase emechie y’ense eyio noro nosambe chinsemo chiaye chionsi.
english: The arrogant one will stumble and fall and no one will help her up; I will kindle a fire in her towns that will consume all who are around her."

ekegusii: Omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakoonchorana amang’ana aane; ebirengererio biabo bionsi nigo bire ebibe igoro yane.
english: All day long they twist my words; they are always plotting to harm me.

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasenyentete emetwe ya Leviatani, eng’iti eria enene y’okwoboyia, erio omobere oye okayoa ching’iti chi’erooro chikayoria.
english: It was you who crushed the heads of Leviathan and gave him as food to the creatures of the desert.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Usa, akamoaka, ekiagera akunete Esanduku eria ya Nyasae, na Usa agakwera agwo agwo.
english: The LORD's anger burned against Uzzah because of his irreverent act; therefore God struck him down and he died there beside the ark of God.

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bakarua o Farao, na Musa akaboria Omonene arusie ebioto ebio amorenterete Farao.
english: After Moses and Aaron left Pharaoh, Moses cried out to the LORD about the frogs he had brought on Pharaoh.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bagasangerereka ase Daudi agwo Heburoni bakamotebia, “Naama! Intwe nigo tore abamo naye, aba amanyinga ayamo, na omobere oyomo.
english: All Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, "We are your own flesh and blood.

ekegusii: ekiagera momanyete ng’a ekero okwegena kwaino kogoteemwa nigo mokweorokereria oboremereria.
english: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.

ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase ekeooreri gi’Atadi ng’umbu y’orooche rwa Yorodan, bakaba bakorera ebirero ebinene mono. Agwo Yusufu akagenderera komoreera ise ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: When they reached the threshing floor of Atad, near the Jordan, they lamented loudly and bitterly; and there Joseph observed a seven-day period of mourning for his father.

ekegusii: Naorokerete Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo buna Nyasae Omobui. Korende ase erieta riane Yahwe, gose Omonene, tinamanyekanete asebare.
english: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by my name the LORD I did not make myself known to them.

ekegusii: One of them, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining next to him.
english: Narenge aroro oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye, oyobweegegete Yeso egekuba kiaye, oyo Yeso anchete.

ekegusii: Na ase rituko riria akababeka babe bagwatia chinko na korenta amache ase omoganda na ase egesasimero ki’Omonene, aase aria Omonene achorete asasimerwe. Naboigo bagendererete gokora goika rero iga.
english: That day he made the Gibeonites woodcutters and water carriers for the community and for the altar of the LORD at the place the LORD would choose. And that is what they are to this day.

ekegusii: Nabwo batang’aine bakamokania, bakamotebia akire, korende ere akamenta mono goaka eriogi, “Omwana o Daudi, indorera amabera!”
english: Those who led the way rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"

ekegusii: Naki namobereire kirori, ng’a nare nomokia omonge mono ase engencho yaino, na ase engencho y’abwo bare Laodikia na Hieropoli.
english: I vouch for him that he is working hard for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.

ekegusii: Then Jesus' disciples said, "Now you are speaking clearly and without figures of speech.
english: Aborokigwa baye bakabora, “Rora, bono ngokwana ore maiso marore, gose tori gokwana omoreng’anio onde bwonsi.

ekegusii: Bakamoira oria orenge omouko ritang’ani ase Abafarisai.
english: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.

ekegusii: Korende omokori amabe karaonchoke atige ebibe akorire, na akore ayare amaya na ayare boronge, oyio natoorie omoyo oye.
english: But if a wicked man turns away from the wickedness he has committed and does what is just and right, he will save his life.

ekegusii: ase okobugia obokano bore ne chinga ikomi, na amakano ande are namariogi amaya.
english: to the music of the ten-stringed lyre and the melody of the harp.

ekegusii: Tibamanya ring’ana riria abatebia.
english: But they did not understand what he was saying to them.

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omosomba oo, ing’a okomanya, erinde imanye oborori bwao.
english: I am your servant; give me discernment that I may understand your statutes.

ekegusii: Herode agateba, “Yohana inamonachete omotwe, korende ning’o oyo rende naigure amang’ana are buna aya?” Akarigia komorora.
english: But Herod said, "I beheaded John. Who, then, is this I hear such things about?" And he tried to see him.

ekegusii: Na inwe abasacha, mwanche abakungu baino, timoba nobororo asebare.
english: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musa nabwo Gerisomu na Eliezeri.
english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

ekegusii: Ekero akwanete nainche, Omoika ogasoa ime yane, ogantenenia, erio nkamotegerera oria orenge gokwana nainche.
english: As he spoke, the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet, and I heard him speaking to me.

ekegusii: Na onye Saitani bweimokeire ere omonyene, na gweatanana, takonyara gotenena, korende nabe nomoerio.
english: And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.

ekegusii: They were startled and frightened, thinking they saw a ghost.
english: Bakegosa, bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagakaga ng’a nerirengari barorire.

ekegusii: Naki inwe moranyare goteba: Titori abatachenegeti, titwabwatetie chinyasae chikorokwa Baali? Rigereria chinchera chiaino ase amakura ime, inyora na komanya egento mwakorire; mwabeire buna engamia eaberi ekominyoka gochia aaria na aaria.”
english: "How can you say, 'I am not defiled; I have not run after the Baals'? See how you behaved in the valley; consider what you have done. You are a swift she-camel running here and there,

ekegusii: Nimbeke oboikaranso bwane bw’obonene agwo ase ense y’Abaelamu, nsirie omoruoti obo amo nabanene babo b’oboruoti. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: I will set my throne in Elam and destroy her king and officials," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio abarwani kobabambire Yeso, bakabogoria chianga chiaye, bagachiatanana chinsemo inye, kera omorwani anyore ensemo yaye. Bakabogoria eganchwa nero. Korende eganchwa eyio tiyasonire; igo yabwatanirie korwa igoro goika inse.
english: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes, dividing them into four shares, one for each of them, with the undergarment remaining. This garment was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara na nyoko moke, moga iso. Okwo nokomorentera iso obosooku.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with your father's wife; that would dishonor your father.

ekegusii: Kurera abanto b’ebisaku ng’a amabe ngocha are; raria ase Yerusalemu, motebe: Abagochia koboera ngocha bare korwa ase ense y’aare, bagoaka eriogi ase emechie y’Abayuda.
english: "Tell this to the nations, proclaim it to Jerusalem: 'A besieging army is coming from a distant land, raising a war cry against the cities of Judah.

ekegusii: Inche tinamomanyete; korende aorokigwe ase Abaisraeli, nabo ase ayio ngacha na kobatisa ase amache.”
english: I myself did not know him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that he might be revealed to Israel."

ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto okorua ekeng’wanso ase engencho y’eira ariete, gose neki’ogwancha kwaye, nakeriegwe ase rituko riria gekoruegwa, na ekegotigara keriegwe ase rituko ria kabere.
english: "'If, however, his offering is the result of a vow or is a freewill offering, the sacrifice shall be eaten on the day he offers it, but anything left over may be eaten on the next day.

ekegusii: Aye nokwere ase egetunwa ekio ase ogotiira gochia, osangererekane amo nabanto bao, buna Haroni momura omino akwerete ase egetunwa kia Hori, agasangererekana amo nabanto baye,
english: There on the mountain that you have climbed you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.

ekegusii: Korende ere oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akarigereria mono gochia igoro, akarora obonene bwa Nyasae, na Yeso oteneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.
english: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up to heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.

ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Aye nigo kwarusetie abanto aba korwa ase ense ya Misiri ne chinguru chinene. Ekero Abamisiri bonsi baraigwe aya gwakorire ase abanto aba,
english: Moses said to the LORD, "Then the Egyptians will hear about it! By your power you brought these people up from among them.

ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo amo nabamura be chinderia chiabo bakagenderera korenda ebiita bi’enyomba y’Omonene, nero Eema eria.
english: They and their descendants were in charge of guarding the gates of the house of the LORD-- the house called the Tent.

ekegusii: Na omokuani asiarere amanyinga ase egesasimero kiane agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, naende asambe ebitinya bibe rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
english: The priest is to sprinkle the blood against the altar of the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: He stilled the storm to a whisper; the waves of the sea were hushed.
english: Agachika ekembugu‐mbugu keria, kegakira‐kiri, na emerindo y’enyancha egatoerera.

ekegusii: “Korwa omoyega bw’Omotienyi Omoyia goika oyo bw’Omotienyi onde Omoyia, na korwa Esabato goika Esabato ende, abanto bonsi mbache gosasima ase obosio bwane.
english: From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come and bow down before me," says the LORD.

ekegusii: “Besaleli na Oholiabu amo nabaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene konya aeire obong’aini, abare nogwancha kw’ogokora emeremo ende yonsi egwenerete ase okoagacha Obomenyo Obochenu, goika bakore kera emeremo buna Omonene konya achikire.”
english: So Bezalel, Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the LORD has given skill and ability to know how to carry out all the work of constructing the sanctuary are to do the work just as the LORD has commanded."

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere Nyasae oyobuete chinyasae, na Omonene bw’abanene, nere Nyasae bw’obonene, na bw’okobua, na bw’okoirokia; tari nogwanchereria, na tari gwancha riaaki.
english: For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality and accepts no bribes.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene gwasesenirie egesaku, na kerokio kiabuchire, kwarure omogoko, na oro obeire omonge; abanto abwo nigo bare nomochengo ase obosio bwao, buna abanto bakoba nomochengo ase engaki ye rigesa, na buna bakogoka ekero bagwatanana ebisakorwa.
english: You have enlarged the nation and increased their joy; they rejoice before you as people rejoice at the harvest, as men rejoice when dividing the plunder.

ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika aroro bagasangereria ekanisa amo, bakaorokia amang’ana onsi Nyasae akorete nabarabwo, na buna aigoreire abanto b’Ebisaku egesieri gi’okwegena.
english: On arriving there, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them and how he had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.

ekegusii: "If he were not a criminal," they replied, "we would not have handed him over to you."
english: Bakairaneria, “Onye oyo atarenge omokori amabe, anga titwamorenta asore.”

ekegusii: Ekero bachia korwa ase amache, Omoika bw’Omonene ogataboria Filipo; omogomba oria tamorora naende, korende nigo agendete enchera yaye ore nomogoko.
english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away, and the eunuch did not see him again, but went on his way rejoicing.

ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi Esanduku eria yarenge gochaka kobogorigwa gotang’ana orogendo, Musa nigo arenge kobora, “Omonene, imoka, ababisa bao tiga baserigwe na goserebanigwa, na baria bakogechete tiga batame korwa ase obosio bwao.”
english: Whenever the ark set out, Moses said, "Rise up, O LORD! May your enemies be scattered; may your foes flee before you."

ekegusii: Obeke Abalawi babe bakorenda Obomenyo Obochenu obwo bore noborori, naende babe bakorenda ebinto bire ase Obomenyo boria ime, na ebikorero biaye. Nababe bakobobogoria amo nebinto biaye bionsi, na gokora emeremo imeo. Barabwo nigo baratenenie chiema chiabo chi’okomenya chietanane Obomenyo obwo.
english: Instead, appoint the Levites to be in charge of the tabernacle of the Testimony-- over all its furnishings and everything belonging to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they are to take care of it and encamp around it.

ekegusii: Erio Yehoyada omokuani akarenta esanduku enkong’u akayebochora akabao ase ekemumeko kiaye, akayebeka mbarabare y’egesasimero ensemo y’okorio, ase abanto bare gosoera enyomba y’Omonene. Na abakuani baria barendete agwo ase egesieri ki’enyomba, akabeka ime ase esanduku eria chibesa chionsi chiarentetwe ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid. He placed it beside the altar, on the right side as one enters the temple of the LORD. The priests who guarded the entrance put into the chest all the money that was brought to the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Miriamu na Haroni bagakwana amang’ana arenge mamincha ya Musa, ekiagera Musa konya onyuomire omokungu korwa ase Abaetiopia.
english: Miriam and Aaron began to talk against Moses because of his Cushite wife, for he had married a Cushite.

ekegusii: Korwa ase omonwa oye okaruao omoyio o birende ore omwoge, na ase oyio naake abanto b’ebisaku. Ere nabagambere nenyimbo y’ekioma, naende natiringe ekemitero ki’edivai y’endamwamu entindi ya Nyasae Omobui.
english: Out of his mouth comes a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations. "He will rule them with an iron scepter." He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God Almighty.

ekegusii: Omonto omonyaborimo nigo akona‐gotaara‐taaria amang’ana akorenta eriomana, na omogenki nigo akorenta obobisa ase abanto banchaine.
english: A perverse man stirs up dissension, and a gossip separates close friends.

ekegusii: Omonto gekwaneire ritang’ani nigo akororekana ng’a nekeene agokwana, korende omonto omoao gachire, nigo akoorokia amang’ana ayio buna are.
english: The first to present his case seems right, till another comes forward and questions him.

ekegusii: Ekiagera abakuani abwo batenenete ase amasio ’abanto gokorera emegwekano yabo bagosasima, na igo bakaba ekegocha ase Abaisraeli, bakagera barabwo bagakora ebibe, ase ayio inche Omonene Nyasae natianire ng’a egesusuro ki’ogosaria kwabo goika kebairanere.
english: But because they served them in the presence of their idols and made the house of Israel fall into sin, therefore I have sworn with uplifted hand that they must bear the consequences of their sin, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akaa Orinani etahabu y’oborito bwe chisekeli amagana atano na rimo agoakanera ekeooreri keria.
english: So David paid Araunah six hundred shekels of gold for the site.

ekegusii: Na baria abamosoeri ekero batenenete, tibamosoera ase ing’ana riibe, buna nakagete,
english: When his accusers got up to speak, they did not charge him with any of the crimes I had expected.

ekegusii: Pharaoh will think, 'The Israelites are wandering around the land in confusion, hemmed in by the desert.'
english: Farao narengererie ng’a Abaisraeli batantanire enchera bakogenda, na erooro yabatangire tibagenda.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obosooku nigo bore asetore, na ase abaruoti baito, na ase abagambi baito, na ase chisokoro chiaito, ekiagera twakorire ebibe asore.
english: O LORD, we and our kings, our princes and our fathers are covered with shame because we have sinned against you.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bana otebie ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli: Inwe ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!
english: "Son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, 'O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.

ekegusii: ekiagera Damesiki noro omochie omonene bw’Abasiiria, na Resini nere omogambi o Damesiki; na ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano, Abaefraimu mbasenyentwe basirigwe kegima, tibagenderera koba egesaku.
english: for the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is only Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim will be too shattered to be a people.

ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoegwa riaaki bobisi, erinde asarie chinchera chi’ekina.
english: A wicked man accepts a bribe in secret to pervert the course of justice.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibabarototete na kobarentera endagera na amache ekero mwarenge ase orogendo korwa Misiri, naende nigo barangeretie Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, korwa Petori ya Mesopotamia achiche kobaragereria inwe.
english: For they did not come to meet you with bread and water on your way when you came out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Aram Naharaim to pronounce a curse on you.
