ekegusii: Ayio nigo arabe ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Yakobo, na ebibe b’Abaisraeli. Inee! Ogosaria okwo kore ase abanto ba Yakobo nkoroki? Tari okwo gwa Samaria? Na ogosaria okwo kw’ogosasimera aase aimokererete igoro kore ase Abayuda nkoroki? Tari okwo kwa Yerusalemu?
english: All this is because of Jacob's transgression, because of the sins of the house of Israel. What is Jacob's transgression? Is it not Samaria? What is Judah's high place? Is it not Jerusalem?

ekegusii: Ekero abasomba baria barenge baganyete, Ehudi agatama. Ere konya oetire ase amagena arenge, aria abaachire are emegwekano, agatama gochia Seira.
english: While they waited, Ehud got away. He passed by the idols and escaped to Seirah.

ekegusii: Erio chindwaki chi’omochie chikabochorwa, na abanto bonsi b’esegi bagatama botuko, bagaetera ase egeita kiarenge gati‐gati ye chindwaki ibere, ang’e nomogondo bw’omoruoti, nonya Abakalidayo banaaretie omochie ase chinsemo chionsi. Bagatama gochia ase Ekerubo Ekiomo.
english: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled. They left the city at night through the gate between the two walls near the king's garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,

ekegusii: Ekero akwanete aya, kobarigereretie, akabogorigwa gochia igoro, riire rikamoira korwa ase amaiso abo.
english: After he said this, he was taken up before their very eyes, and a cloud hid him from their sight.

ekegusii: “Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, obegetwe nomonene oye igoro ase enyomba yaye, ae abanto endagera ase ekero ekeronge?
english: "Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of the servants in his household to give them their food at the proper time?

ekegusii: Omokuani okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosamwa ase engencho y’omonto onde, aire risankwa ri’ekeng’wanso keria ribe eriaye.
english: The priest who offers a burnt offering for anyone may keep its hide for himself.

ekegusii: Now Jehoiada was old and full of years, and he died at the age of a hundred and thirty.
english: Yehoyada akaba omogotu mono, agakwa ekero akoorire emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato.

ekegusii: Ninsirie ense eyio ebe bosa, ekiagera bakorire aya atari ay’obwegenwa. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: I will make the land desolate because they have been unfaithful, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Dani bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Dan: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: “Aye mwayabanto, bana mamincha y’ababani b’Abaisraeli, abwo bakobana amang’ana akorwa ase ebirengererio biabo abanyene, obatebie: Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!
english: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying. Say to those who prophesy out of their own imagination: 'Hear the word of the LORD!

ekegusii: Korende Yuda akamotebia, “Omonto oria nigo atochigete bokong’u, agatotebia: Timogocha kondora obosio bwane oyio omino atacheti amo nainwe.
english: But Judah said to him, "The man warned us solemnly, 'You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.'

ekegusii: Naende andetere inche Omonene ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye ase engencho y’ebibe ebio akorire; arente eng’iti eaberi, eng’ondi gose embori, ebe ekeng’wanso ekio ki’ebibe, na omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe ebibe biaye.
english: and, as a penalty for the sin he has committed, he must bring to the LORD a female lamb or goat from the flock as a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.
english: O house of Israel, trust in the LORD-- he is their help and shield.

ekegusii: ee, ekero obwoba borabachere buna ekembugu‐mbugu, na emechando buna ekerambauti, boigo ekero obokong’u na omoichano birabachere.
english: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster sweeps over you like a whirlwind, when distress and trouble overwhelm you.

ekegusii: korende namorie chinyama ase omotienyi omogima goika mochiroke chietere ase chimioro na kobagara‐garia moyo. Ayio nigo arakoreke, ekiagera mwangire Omonene oria omenyete ase egati yaino, mwarerire ase obosio bwaye na gokwana: Ninki kiagerete tokarua Misiri?”
english: but for a whole month-- until it comes out of your nostrils and you loathe it-- because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have wailed before him, saying, "Why did we ever leave Egypt?" '"

ekegusii: Ayio nigo akororekana ng’a nay’obong’aini ase ogosasima na okweororobia na goaka omobere, korende taisaneti gento kende ase ogotanga okogania gwe chingencho chi’obobe.
english: Such regulations indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-imposed worship, their false humility and their harsh treatment of the body, but they lack any value in restraining sensual indulgence.

ekegusii: Omonene otebire, “Nonya mbono ng’iranere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, ase okweng’ata, na okorera, na okweng’ereria.
english: 'Even now,' declares the LORD, 'return to me with all your heart, with fasting and weeping and mourning.'

ekegusii: Ase chingaki chiaino Omonene nabae oborendi obuya, na obonge bw’ogotooreka, na obong’aini, na okomanya; okomoiroka Omonene nakwo korabe enibo yaino.
english: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a rich store of salvation and wisdom and knowledge; the fear of the LORD is the key to this treasure.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bansesenetie, ekiagera nabaete chingobo chi’amarionya e ching’ondi chikorwa ase amaicho aane.”
english: and his heart did not bless me for warming him with the fleece from my sheep,

ekegusii: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun-- blue, purple or scarlet yarn or fine linen.
english: Na abakungu abaroisia abang’aini bagasisa namaboko abo chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na echi’egatani engiya, bagachirenta.

ekegusii: Korende intwe twensi abatokorigereria obonene bw’Omonene namaiso atatubiri, nigo tokorora buna ase ekerore obonene obwo. Nigo tokoonchorwa koba buna omogwekano oye, na kogenda korwa ase obonene goika ase obonene. Aya nigo agokorwa n’Omonene oyore Omoika.
english: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the Lord's glory, are being transformed into his likeness with ever-increasing glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.

ekegusii: Omongina oyomo naitwa Nyamira ase ogokagerwa koba omorogi abaobisa ba abanyanyimbo ime ya nyamira bachakire obotuki igoro yo ogokwa kwo omongina oyomo bwe emiaka 60 oitwa emambi ya rero na abanto bamokagera koba omorogi ase ekenyoro gia kenyambi bundo ime ya bogichora. koenekia egekore ekio omo commissioner bwe ecounty ya nyamira amos mariba nigo ateba buna nyagosira agnes kwamboka nyagwachi nigo asaganwa na gotigerwa chingoma chie emioro na abakagerwa abwo na magega yaye omobere oye onyorekana obware bwe chimita 50 korwa ase enka yaye. mariba nigo ateba buna omosacha bwo omongina oyio peter nyagwachi nyamongo nigo abatebia abanyanyimbo buna abanto amanyete buya mono nigo baika ase enka yaye chinsa 9 chie emambi ya rero na komosokia mokaye isiko ase korende atamanyeti ase baamoira goika emambi ya rero chingaki omobere oye onyorekana. omobere o nyagosira nigo oirwa ase enkendu ye enyagitari enene ya nyamira.
english: The story goes that a person named Nyamira once had a problem; people from Nyamira district came together and decided to build a house for this person, which took about 60 years, known as the elders and those who helped build the house, and it was built beautifully in Bogichora village. It emerged that the then commissioner of Nyamira county, Amos Mariba, found Agnes Kwamboka Nyagwachi, and she was accused of stealing iron sheets and those who were involved with her and her accomplices, the house appeared to be 50 meters away from her farm. Mariba found out that the owner of the house, Peter Nyagwachi Nyamongo, had informed the residents that people should come and see, and they went to his farm around 9 am, and he showed them the boundary, but they did not understand what he was showing them. The woman, Agnes, was taken to court over the large piece of land in Nyamira.

ekegusii: Daudi akaebereria abanto baye ase okobatebia amang’ana ayio, na tabaa ribaga baumokere Saulo. Erio Saulo akaimoka korwa ase rikuruma erio, akagenderera orogendo rwaye.
english: With these words David rebuked his men and did not allow them to attack Saul. And Saul left the cave and went his way.

ekegusii: Jesus stopped and said, "Call him." So they called to the blind man, "Cheer up! On your feet! He's calling you."
english: Yeso agatenena, akabora, “Morangerie!” Bakarangeria omouko oria, bakamotebia, “Remia enkoro yao, imoka, okorangeirie.”

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, rora, goetera ase ogokwa kwa mobosokano nindusie korwa asore oyore omogoko bw’amaiso ao; nonya naboigo tomoreera gose kobokia amagombo, gose amariga taiteka korwa ase amaiso ao.
english: "Son of man, with one blow I am about to take away from you the delight of your eyes. Yet do not lament or weep or shed any tears.

ekegusii: “Abakuani abwo tibagokigita chitukia chi’emetwe yabo, gose tibagochitiga chitambee, korende nigo barachinache chieng’ee.
english: "'They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but they are to keep the hair of their heads trimmed.

ekegusii: “Ekero egetunwa keria kiagendererete gwoka omorero, mokaigwa eriogi korwa ase egati‐gati y’omosunte oria, nainwe mwensi, abamore abatang’ani na abagaaka ase ebisaku biaino, mogacha asende.
english: When you heard the voice out of the darkness, while the mountain was ablaze with fire, all the leading men of your tribes and your elders came to me.

ekegusii: Bakagenda, bagaetanana ase emechie, bakorandia enchili, na kogwenia abanto chinsemo chionsi.
english: So they set out and went from village to village, preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere.

ekegusii: Nigo natebetie abanto b’omochie oyo ng’a goika banyiroke na banche amorokererio ay’okobarongeyia, erinde tinsiria aase abo bamenyete, buna nabachikerete. Korende nigo bagendererete koba ababe goetania ase ogokora kwabo gwonsi.”
english: I said to the city, 'Surely you will fear me and accept correction!' Then her dwelling would not be cut off, nor all my punishments come upon her. But they were still eager to act corruptly in all they did.

ekegusii: Eng’ombe nigo emanyete omonyene, na etigere nigo emanyete aase omonene oye akoyeera endagera, korende Abaisraeli tibamanyeti kende, ee, amaene, abanto baane tibamanyeti kende gionsi.”
english: The ox knows his master, the donkey his owner's manger, but Israel does not know, my people do not understand."

ekegusii: Bwerende, tobaisa gokora okobwatana nabanyene ense eria ase okogenda, babaise kobatega mogwe.
english: Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land where you are going, or they will be a snare among you.

ekegusii: Buna ebitunwa bietanaine Yerusalemu, naboigo n’Omonene aetanaine abanto baye korwa bono na goika kare na kare.
english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people both now and forevermore.

ekegusii: Korende bagachaya amang’ana aya, bakagenda, oyomo ase omogondo oye, na oyonde ase oboonchoreria bwaye;
english: "But they paid no attention and went off-- one to his field, another to his business.

ekegusii: Bono nigo ngokoboria onkorere ebinto bibere, nario ntebise korwa ase obosio bwao:
english: "Only grant me these two things, O God, and then I will not hide from you:

ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, “Omonto okorokwa Yeso okorete etintira, akang’aka amaiso aane, agantebia: Genda ase ritibo ria Siloamu, bwesibie; nabo nkagenda ngesibia, nkanyara korora.”
english: He replied, "The man they call Jesus made some mud and put it on my eyes. He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed, and then I could see."

ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakomentekana, ogosaria nigo gokomentekana, korende abanyene oboronge mbarore okogwa kw’abwo.
english: When the wicked thrive, so does sin, but the righteous will see their downfall.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okorenta embura ase chinchwara chi’emegondo y’ense; nigo okwarania aase aimokererete igoro, erio gwatoma embura yororobia riroba na gosesenia ebigokina ase emegondo.
english: You drench its furrows and level its ridges; you soften it with showers and bless its crops.

ekegusii: Ninkorentere ching’iti chire chinoru chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ninchirue amo nekeng’wanso gie chimingichi kere ne rimisu rigiya. Nindue ne chieri ne chimbori chibe ebing’wanso.
english: I will sacrifice fat animals to you and an offering of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah

ekegusii: Bono abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bakarua ogochika ng’a onye monto onde omanyete aase are, arente amang’ana, banyare komobwata.
english: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that if anyone found out where Jesus was, he should report it so that they might arrest him.

ekegusii: Onde tarenge ase baria baikaransete ase emesa omanyete engencho yagerete amotebetie iga.
english: but no one at the meal understood why Jesus said this to him.

ekegusii: Akariina obwato obomo obwarenge bwa Simion akamoboria abotigerie are ake korwa ase engegu. Agaikaransa, akorokereria omoganda korwa ase obwato.
english: He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.

ekegusii: Aroro agwo agasaba ase obosio bw’Omonene, agateba, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aye omenyete nobonene bwao igoro y’Abakerubi, aye naye Nyasae, naye bweka ore igoro y’amaruoti onsi ay’ense; naye gwatongete igoro na ense.
english: And Hezekiah prayed to the LORD: "O LORD, God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

ekegusii: Erio Abisalomu omwabo akamoboria, “Inee! Amunoni omino nagokoreire amang’ana ’obosooku? Aye moiseke ominto, kirakiri; oyio noyomino, toichana ase enkoro yao. Tamari akamenya bw’Abisalomu omwabo, akaba otang’ang’ete na goichana mono.”
english: Her brother Absalom said to her, "Has that Amnon, your brother, been with you? Be quiet now, my sister; he is your brother. Don't take this thing to heart." And Tamar lived in her brother Absalom's house, a desolate woman.

ekegusii: Kera egesieri nigo kiarenge nemerangwa ebere yare koigorwa korwa gati‐gati, yaringanigwa kera oyomo gochia ase ensemo yaye.
english: Each door had two leaves-- two hinged leaves for each door.

ekegusii: Ekero barenge nyomba mwa Mika, bakaigwa na komanya eriogi ri’omosae oria Omolawi, bakamoira ensemo, bakamoboria, “Ning’o okorenta aiga? Ngento ki ogokora aa? Emeremo yao nereri?”
english: When they were near Micah's house, they recognized the voice of the young Levite; so they turned in there and asked him, "Who brought you here? What are you doing in this place? Why are you here?"

ekegusii: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;
english: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane, tobaisa kwebisa toigwa ogosaba kw’ogosorora kwane.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bokia amagombo igoro y’omoruoti o Turo, omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye nigo kwarenge omoikeranu goetania ebitongwa bionsi bi’obonene; nigo gwaichire nobong’aini, naende kwarenge omosiani omoikeranu.
english: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning the king of Tyre and say to him: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'You were the model of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

ekegusii: Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Israeli, omosomba bw’Omonene, inwe abanto ba Yakobo, abachore b’Omonene, inyora ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia na amakumia aye amo nebina anachete.
english: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,

ekegusii: Tiga obonene bw’Omonene bogenderere kobao kare na kare; Omonene tiga agokere emeremo yaye.
english: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in his works--

ekegusii: na korwa Ekironi gochia Enyancha Enene emechie yonsi yarengeo ensemo y’Asidodi, amo nebichie biaye.
english: west of Ekron, all that were in the vicinity of Ashdod, together with their villages;

ekegusii: Na ekero Abimeleki arwanetie omochie rituko riria rigima, akayobwata na agaita abanto abamenyeteo. Erio akayoiyeria na koyoitororera omonyo.
english: All that day Abimelech pressed his attack against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he destroyed the city and scattered salt over it.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenda korwania Abafilisti. Barabwo bagatoora agwo Ebeni‐Eseri, na Abafilisti agwo Afeki.
english: And Samuel's word came to all Israel. Now the Israelites went out to fight against the Philistines. The Israelites camped at Ebenezer, and the Philistines at Aphek.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora ensoti ekoiruruka igoro gati, nkayeigwa egokwana neriogi rinene, egoteba, “Obobe, Obobe, Obobe nobwabo abamenyete ase ense ase engaki y’egeturi ki’ebitureri ebi bitigarete, ebi abamalaika batato bare ang’e kobugia!”
english: As I watched, I heard an eagle that was flying in midair call out in a loud voice: "Woe! Woe! Woe to the inhabitants of the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the other three angels!"

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana gwakwanete korwa ase omonwa oo akobwatire buna oboreba.
english: if you have been trapped by what you said, ensnared by the words of your mouth,

ekegusii: Tebia abanto bonsi b’ebisaku, “Omonene nere okogamba. Ense nigo eteneine bokong’u, tekonyegerigwa. Omonene nanachere abanto ekina atari gwanchereria.”
english: Say among the nations, "The LORD reigns." The world is firmly established, it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity.

ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abanto bao Abaisraeli, naende obarente gocha ase ense eye kwaete chisokoro chiabo.
english: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to them and their fathers.

ekegusii: Inee! Abaoonia mbakorerane rigori igoro yaye, gose bayebutorane ase okoyeoonerania?
english: Will traders barter for him? Will they divide him up among the merchants?

ekegusii: Mefiboseti nabwate omwana omomura ore korokwa Mika. Abanto bonsi abarenge o Siba bakaba abasomba ba Mefiboseti.
english: Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica, and all the members of Ziba's household were servants of Mephibosheth.

ekegusii: Omoiseke bw’omoruoti nigo are ime ase eero yaye ore nobonene, obegete eganchwa yaye eroiseirie etahabu.
english: All glorious is the princess within [her chamber]; her gown is interwoven with gold.

ekegusii: Agachia koimokia amaiso, aye, akarora Abaisraeli batoorete egesaku ase egesaku. Erio omoika o Nyasae ogacha igoro asare.
english: When Balaam looked out and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, the Spirit of God came upon him

ekegusii: “Ekeene, inche nigo inde omoriri otagwenereti korokwa omonto, gose timbwati obomanyi bwa mwanyabanto.
english: "I am the most ignorant of men; I do not have a man's understanding.

ekegusii: Korwa Sayoni, omochie omoikeranu bw’oboseera, Nyasae omorekire korwao.
english: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, timoiroka baria, ekiagera ing’ana rinde tiriri rimumekeirie ritache koorokigwa, gose eribisekanete ritache komanyekana.
english: "So do not be afraid of them. There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.

ekegusii: Ummah, Aphek and Rehob. There were twenty-two towns and their villages.
english: na Uma, na Afeki, na Rehobu, emechie emerongo ebere, na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene, bagoteba, “Twakorire ebibe asore, ekiagera twagotigire aye Nyasae oito, na gokorera chinyasae chiria Baali.”
english: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD, "We have sinned against you, forsaking our God and serving the Baals."

ekegusii: Ahabu agatebia Elija, “Inee! Aye omobisa one, nkwanyorire.” Elija akairaneria, “Ee, nakonyorire, ekiagera aye kweoonirie aye omonyene gokora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: Ahab said to Elijah, "So you have found me, my enemy!" "I have found you," he answered, "because you have sold yourself to do evil in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Narengeo omokuani o Midiani obwate abaiseke batano na babere. Barabwo bagacha kobuucha amache; bagaichoria chintuba amache banyoisie riicho ria ise.
english: Now a priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father's flock.

ekegusii: Arusie oboruoti korwa ase enyomba ya Saulo, abobeke ase Daudi, na Daudi abe omoruoti, agambere Abaisraeli na Abayuda korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba.”
english: and transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and establish David's throne over Israel and Judah from Dan to Beersheba."

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koigwa aya, akamotebia, “Egento ekemo ngekoremete; oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi ogabere abataka, na aye nobe nenibo igoro. Erio ochiche ontunyane.”
english: When Jesus heard this, he said to him, "You still lack one thing. Sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."

ekegusii: Inche imochiere mobosokano imogose ekero arosire na erusirie moyo. Abanto abwo bonsi bare komo mbatame, nainche ninyare goita omoruoti kare bweka.
english: I would attack him while he is weary and weak. I would strike him with terror, and then all the people with him will flee. I would strike down only the king

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Someri, omomura omwabo, nabwo aba: Roga, na Yehuba, na Aramu.
english: The sons of Shomer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah and Aram.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a ekero omonto onde bwensi korwa ase egati yabo akondetera inche Omonene eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso, ayerusie korwa ase chiombe gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When any of you brings an offering to the LORD, bring as your offering an animal from either the herd or the flock.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya ase onde bwensi omoganyete, ee, nomuya ase oyo okomorigia.
english: The LORD is good to those whose hope is in him, to the one who seeks him;

ekegusii: Ahasia akagenda amo na Yoramu, mosinto bw’Ahabu, korwania Hasaeli, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, agwo Ramoti o Gileadi. Abasiiria bagaaka Yoramu chingoma.
english: Ahaziah went with Joram son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram;

ekegusii: Nonya ngoika rero iga, ekero mokorua ebiegwa biaino, na gosamba abana baino babe ebing’wanso, nigo mogwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogosasima emegwekano yaino yonsi. Naende inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, ninyanchete momborie amang’ana? Ekeene buna inche inde moyo, tingwancha momborie. Ninche Omonene Nyasae natebire ayio.
english: When you offer your gifts-- the sacrifice of your sons in the fire-- you continue to defile yourselves with all your idols to this day. Am I to let you inquire of me, O house of Israel? As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will not let you inquire of me.

ekegusii: Abakuani tibabaisa gokora ebinto ebi ebichenu Abaisraeli bagwatanana na kobirua ase Omonene bibe ebitachenegeti,
english: The priests must not desecrate the sacred offerings the Israelites present to the LORD

ekegusii: Omokungu omwesiki nigo akogenderera gosikwa botambe, korende abanto abaurereria abatindi nigo bakonyora chinibo ase chinguru.
english: A kindhearted woman gains respect, but ruthless men gain only wealth.

ekegusii: Ababenjamin bagakora buna batebetigwe. Kera oyomo akaira omoiseke korwa ase baria baare gotenga agwo Silo, akaba mokaye. Erio bakairana, bakagenda ase emiando yabo, bakaagacha emechie yabo naende na komenya aroro.
english: So that is what the Benjamites did. While the girls were dancing, each man caught one and carried her off to be his wife. Then they returned to their inheritance and rebuilt the towns and settled in them.

ekegusii: Ninsarie emechie yonsi ere ase ense yaino, naende nintagore chindwaki chiaino echio mogwekengera.
english: I will destroy the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.

ekegusii: Na oyomo ase baria bateneine ang’e akang’usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw’omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.
english: Then one of those standing near drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

ekegusii: nanyorire chiombe, ne chitigere, ne ching’ondi, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke. Na bono, omonene one, nigo natomire abanto nkomanyie amang’ana ayio, inyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao.”
english: I have cattle and donkeys, sheep and goats, menservants and maidservants. Now I am sending this message to my lord, that I may find favor in your eyes.'"

ekegusii: Ekero Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, amo nabarwani baye bonsi, baroche abanene abwo bagatama botuko, bagasoka korwa ase omochie, bagaeta ase omogondo bw’omoruoti, bakagenda bagasokera egeita kiarenge gati‐gati ye chindwaki ibere. Bagatama gochia ase Ekerubo Ekiomo.
english: When Zedekiah king of Judah and all the soldiers saw them, they fled; they left the city at night by way of the king's garden, through the gate between the two walls, and headed toward the Arabah.

ekegusii: Boigo agaita Omomisiri orenge omonene obwate ritimo. Akamochiera nenyimbo, akamoura ritimo riare koboko kwaye, akamoitera neritimo riria riaye omonyene.
english: And he struck down a huge Egyptian. Although the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian's hand and killed him with his own spear.

ekegusii: Yoshua agachora abarwani chilifu isano, akababisa bosongo y’omochie, ase egati ya Beteli na Ai.
english: Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.

ekegusii: Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, nigo amanyekanete ase baria Batato; akarwania abanto amagana atato akabaaka ne ritimo riaye, akabaita, na igo akaba nerieta rinene ase egati ya baria Batato.
english: Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.

ekegusii: Akababekera amaboko aye, akaimoka korwa aroro, akagenda.
english: When he had placed his hands on them, he went on from there.

ekegusii: The musicians Heman, Asaph and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals;
english: Abateri baria Hemani na Asafu, na Etani babe bakobugia chisani chi’etaai chikobugigwa na kwoga.

ekegusii: Na Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa obosio ase obosio, buna omonto agokwana nomonto onde. Erio Musa aba okoirana gochia ase egetwori, korende Yoshua, omosomba oye omosae, mosinto o Nuni, tare korua ase Eema eria.
english: The LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young aide Joshua son of Nun did not leave the tent.

ekegusii: Na Abiya agatenena igoro ase egetunwa gia Semaraimu, agwo ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, akabora, “Aye Yeroboamu, nainwe Abaisraeli mwensi, ntegerera moigwe!
english: Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, "Jeroboam and all Israel, listen to me!

ekegusii: “na korandia omwaka bw’Omonene bwancheretwe.”
english: to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor."

ekegusii: agasamba emechie eyio, amo nense eyio yonsi eraire, na agasiria bonsi abamenyete imeo, na ebinto bionsi biare gokina ase ense eria.
english: Thus he overthrew those cities and the entire plain, including all those living in the cities-- and also the vegetation in the land.

ekegusii: Erio abauri babere bakabambwa amo nere, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.
english: Two robbers were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.

ekegusii: Inwe timwandeterete ching’ondi chiaino chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose timwansigete ase okonduera ebing’wanso biaino. Inche timbaroseti ase okonduera okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose timbachandeti ase ogonsambera ubani.
english: You have not brought me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with grain offerings nor wearied you with demands for incense.

ekegusii: Naki amagoro abo are amaseera, abwo bakorenta amang’ana amaya, bagoeta igoro ase ebitunwa, abwo bakoraria omorembe, na barenta obotomwa obore namang’ana amaya. Nigo bakoraria ogotooreka, batebia Sayoni: “Nyasae oo nere okogamba.”
english: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of those who bring good news, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation, who say to Zion, "Your God reigns!"

ekegusii: Husai akairaneria Abisalomu, “Ogosemia okwo Ahitofeli abaeire tikori okuya ase ekero eke.”
english: Hushai replied to Absalom, "The advice Ahithophel has given is not good this time.

ekegusii: Akarosia emegwekano y’amakomomanga, akayebeka ase chindwaro ibere igoro y’ebichanga biarenge ase ebisure biria.
english: He made pomegranates in two rows encircling each network to decorate the capitals on top of the pillars. He did the same for each capital.

ekegusii: Korende Zadoki omokuani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Nathani omobani, na Simei, na Rei, na abarwani chituoni ba Daudi, barabwo tibabwatanete n’Adonia.
english: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei and Rei and David's special guard did not join Adonijah.

ekegusii: Okonyire Israeli, omosomba oye, ase okoinyora amabera aye,
english: He has helped his servant Israel, remembering to be merciful

ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Abaisraeli, akabatebia amang’ana ayio, na abaraai bonsi be chiamate chia kera egesaku bakamoa chinyimbo chiabo, chinyimbo ikomi na ibere, na enyimbo ya Haroni nigo yarenge ase egati ye chinyimbo chiria.
english: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and their leaders gave him twelve staffs, one for the leader of each of their ancestral tribes, and Aaron's staff was among them.

ekegusii: Musa akaimokia okoboko kwaye gochia igoro, na omosunte ekerima okaba ase ense ya Misiri engaki y’amatuko atato.
english: So Moses stretched out his hand toward the sky, and total darkness covered all Egypt for three days.

ekegusii: Ase igo bagenda komenya ase amakuruma are ase amagoko, na ase chingoro inse y’ense, na ase ebitare.
english: They were forced to live in the dry stream beds, among the rocks and in holes in the ground.

ekegusii: Korende kera oyomo oeirwe okomaanorerwa kw’Omoika, erinde bonsi bakonywe.
english: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.

ekegusii: The disciples were even more amazed, and said to each other, "Who then can be saved?"
english: Barabwo bagaichana mono, bakaborania, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”

ekegusii: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
english: na Lakisi, na Bosikati, na Egiloni,

ekegusii: Ase ayio bono totomere intwe, abasomba bao, engano, na esairi, na amaguta ’amazeituni, na edivai, ebinto biria aye, omonene one, gwatebete ng’a nototomere.
english: "Now let my lord send his servants the wheat and barley and the olive oil and wine he promised,

ekegusii: Ero nekore okobwatana amo naye, ng’a ebe omosomba oo kogendera botambe?
english: Will he make an agreement with you for you to take him as your slave for life?

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are chinguru ase abanto baye, na obotamero bw’ogotooreka ase omoakwa amaguta oye.
english: The LORD is the strength of his people, a fortress of salvation for his anointed one.

ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi bakaegwa Ramoti agwo Gileadi, na Mahanaimu,
english: and from the tribe of Gad they received Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,

ekegusii: Ekerengero ki’oborito ki’obong’ainereria nigo kere okogechia ase Omonene, korende egi’ekeene nigo gekomogokia.
english: The LORD abhors dishonest scales, but accurate weights are his delight.

ekegusii: Omoika bw’oboremu nigo okogera omonto oremereria ogochandeka, korende omoika ore nomoichano ning’o orayoremererie.
english: A man's spirit sustains him in sickness, but a crushed spirit who can bear?

ekegusii: Tiga enkoro yane ebe etari na komocha ase emeroberio yao echikire, erinde timbaisa konyora obosooku.
english: May my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be put to shame.

ekegusii: Igwera ogosemigwa naende bwanche okworokererigwa, igo nario oranyore obong’aini boragokonye ase chingaki chire bosio.
english: Listen to advice and accept instruction, and in the end you will be wise.

ekegusii: Naende agantebia, “Aikire gokoreka. Inche n’Alifa na Omega, Omochakano na Omoerio. Oyore nerang’o nimoe bosa anywe korwa ase ensoko y’amache ’obogima.
english: He said to me: "It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To him who is thirsty I will give to drink without cost from the spring of the water of life.

ekegusii: Erio omosomba oo tata agatotebia: Momanyete ng’a omokungu one nigo anyiborerete abana abamura babere boka.
english: "Your servant my father said to us, 'You know that my wife bore me two sons.

ekegusii: Bakarenta chigari korwa Misiri ase ogoakanera kera eyemo chisekeli amagana atano na rimo chie chifeta, na ebarasi eyemo nigo yare goakanerwa chisekeli rigana erimo, na emerongo etano; boigo abaruoti bonsi b’Abahiti na ab’Abasiiria nigo barenge kogora chigari ne chibarasi goetera ase abaonchoreria ba Sulemani.
english: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. They also exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and of the Arameans.

ekegusii: "Here I will make a horn grow for David and set up a lamp for my anointed one.
english: Aroro agwo nimererie Daudi orogunchara, ekiagera naroiseirie omoakwa amaguta one etaya ekomoreka.

ekegusii: Aye omoriakari one, ebikoba biao nigo bikonyororokia obooke; obooke na amabeere nigo bire inse y’oromeme rwao. Rimisu rie chianga chiao nigo ringa eria Lebanoni.
english: Your lips drop sweetness as the honeycomb, my bride; milk and honey are under your tongue. The fragrance of your garments is like that of Lebanon.

ekegusii: and mirrors, and the linen garments and tiaras and shawls.
english: na ebirore, ne chianga chi’egatani chie rigori rinene, na ebigogwa, na ebietubo.

ekegusii: Ninsiarere gochia ase chinsemo chionsi abanto bonsi abamoetanaine ase okomokonya, na abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi boigo, naende nimbabwatie nomoro one.
english: I will scatter to the winds all those around him-- his staff and all his troops-- and I will pursue them with drawn sword.

ekegusii: bwatoirwe na Nyasae ng’a n’Omokuani Omonene, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.
english: and was designated by God to be high priest in the order of Melchizedek.

ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya irianyi n’Abareuben, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri, nere orabe omotang’ani obo,
english: On the south will be the divisions of the camp of Reuben under their standard. The leader of the people of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.

ekegusii: Korende aborokigwa bande bagacha ase obwato, bagakurura ekeonga geichire chinswe, ekiagera tibarenge are ase ense enyomo, ang’e chifuti amagana atato.
english: The other disciples followed in the boat, towing the net full of fish, for they were not far from shore, about a hundred yards.

ekegusii: Yeso Kristo, nere oyo ochete ase amache na amanyinga, tari ase amache oka, korende ase amache na amanyinga.
english: This is the one who came by water and blood-- Jesus Christ. He did not come by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

ekegusii: Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki ekenene babwate amachiko amaronge na emeroberio emeronge, buna amachiko aya onsi inche naborokereirie rero?
english: And what other nation is so great as to have such righteous decrees and laws as this body of laws I am setting before you today?

ekegusii: Chianga chiaye chikameka‐meka, chikaba chindabu mono, buna omoroisia bw’ense atanyare gochikora chibe chindabu.
english: His clothes became dazzling white, whiter than anyone in the world could bleach them.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire emereng’anio eyio, akarua aroro, akagenda aase aande.
english: When Jesus had finished these parables, he moved on from there.

ekegusii: Mwerende! Morende chinkoro chiaino, erinde timobaisa kweba aya mwarorire namaiso aino, gose koyatiga arue ase chinkoro chiaino ase amatuko onsi more moyo. Boigo moyorokererie abana baino na abachokoro baino,
english: Only be careful, and watch yourselves closely so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen or let them slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and to their children after them.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi mbamoreere na komotindeka. Omwana oria bweka ase eamate ya Yeroboamu, nere oratindekwe ase embeera ime, ekiagera asere oyio Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ororire egento kiamogokirie korwa ase enyomba ya Yeroboamu.
english: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. He is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will be buried, because he is the only one in the house of Jeroboam in whom the LORD, the God of Israel, has found anything good.

ekegusii: Ekero Anania achia koigwa amang’ana aya, agaaka inse, agakwa. Omoondoko omonene okanyora abanto bonsi abaigwete aya.
english: When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. And great fear seized all who heard what had happened.

ekegusii: Naende nkarora omomalaika bwe chinguru okoraria neriogi rinene, ogoteba, “Ning’o ogwenerete koigora ebuku, na gosansora ebimanyererio biaye?”
english: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, "Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?"

ekegusii: Abwo baikire konyora omobaso, na koigwa ekeegwa gekorwa igoro, na babeire ababwatani b’Omoika Omochenu,
english: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,

ekegusii: akamosorora mono, akabora, “Omonene, omoiseke one omoke oisire gokwa. Nagosabire, oche obeke okoboko kwao igoro yaye, anyare kogwena, abe moyo.”
english: and pleaded earnestly with him, "My little daughter is dying. Please come and put your hands on her so that she will be healed and live."

ekegusii: na ise karaigwe igoro y’eira eria y’omoiseke oye, korende takwana ring’ana, eira eria negenderere kobao. Kera egento omoiseke oria akwanire goika ageikeranie.
english: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all her vows and every pledge by which she obligated herself will stand.

ekegusii: Tiga barusie korwa asende obonyaka bwabo bw’ogosasima emegwekano, na emebere ekwete y’abaruoti babo, erio nario ndamenye ase egati yabo kogenderera botambe.
english: Now let them put away from me their prostitution and the lifeless idols of their kings, and I will live among them forever.

ekegusii: Ase ayio timokogenderera korora amaroro ay’obong’ainereria, gose kwenaria oboringoria. Nindusie abanto baane korwa ase amaboko aino. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will save my people from your hands. And then you will know that I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaba okorenta ebiegwa biaye, ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitahabu, ne chianga, na ebirwanero, na ebinsari, ne chibarasi, ne chiyombo, ebinto ebinge mono, omwaka ase omwaka.
english: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift-- articles of silver and gold, robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.

ekegusii: Rora narengeo omonto Yerusalemu, erieta riaye Simeoni. Oyio nomonto omoronge orenge, osigete Nyasae, oganyete ogosemeria kw’Abaisraeli; na Omoika Omochenu nigo orenge igoro asare.
english: Now there was a man in Jerusalem called Simeon, who was righteous and devout. He was waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was upon him.

ekegusii: Naki nonya tomenyete ase ense eye, titori korwana esegi y’okogania gw’ense eye.
english: For though we live in the world, we do not wage war as the world does.

ekegusii: Amaiso ’Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ebirero biabo.
english: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their cry;

ekegusii: Oria omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inche tinyisaini aye orasoe inse y’ekerama kiane; korende kwana ring’ana rioka, na omosomba one nagwene.
english: The centurion replied, "Lord, I do not deserve to have you come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, imosesenirie! Inwe nabanto mwatoorigwe n’Omonene. Nere enguba yaino ekobakengera; Nere omoro oino okobarentera obobui! Ababisa baino mbebeke inse asemore, nainwe motaare moete ebigoro biabo.”
english: Blessed are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD? He is your shield and helper and your glorious sword. Your enemies will cower before you, and you will trample down their high places."

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Asaria, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Azariah's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Monunguno O Barema (February) 22, 2011. Kobanga chinkomoro Nomanyete similes buna chikorokwa ase Ekegusii? Eee bono. Nigo chikorokwa chinkomoro. Rero tiga torakwana ingo igoro ye chinkomoro ibere na amo ne emebayeno ebere: CHINKOMORO: 1.Kora emerondo buna eye ekeguye. Yaani nigo andama bono? Engecho ende omonto obwate amagoro amanyerere mono. Aya nigo agotumeka ekero okorama oyonde gose abande bateba ekenyamerondo. 2.Omwororo buna riruma. Abaminto nonya korwa emuma ime riruma nigo rigotebekana rire riororo, riitongo, ndibwati mangana. Bono amangana aya nigo agotumeka ekero ogokwana igoro yo omonto omoitongo gose omwororo. EMEBAYENO: 1.Moeta mono onyora mara are iiga. Bakoro mbaroche aya onsi. Kona goeta kera ase nabo gokorenta chindwari chinyinge. Kera omonto nigo agokurerwa aya tiga obonyaka gose tagotwara abasani abange mogosanga kemobere ekiagera korakore obonyaka mara are iiga nakonyora endwari. 2.Tuga ntakana a ngombe, totuga ntakana a monto. Nabo orakonye omonto korwa emechando ime magega yaye nonya mbuya mono tagotebia, naende agokorere ogochaya na takoa esiko eria kwamokonyete ekero achandegete.
english: Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. February 22, 2011. The hyena's riddle Is there anyone who knows the proverbs of Ekegusii well? Yes indeed. It is a difficult riddle. Therefore, let us examine this riddle carefully so that those who know it can explain it clearly: HYENA: 1.It chases gazelles even when they have already fallen. What does this mean? It means that a greedy person always seeks more possessions even when he has enough. This is why people say that a person who is constantly looking for things will never be satisfied. 2.A coward runs away. People say that if a coward is wounded while running, he will stumble, fall, and become helpless. These sayings are used to describe a person who is afraid and unable to defend himself. LESSONS: 1.Don't speak ill of someone while they are still alive. Our ancestors said this. Don't try to destroy someone's reputation while they are still around. Because a person may recover from illness and then punish those who spoke badly about them while they were sick and vulnerable. 2.We don't quarrel over cattle, we don't quarrel over people. Our ancestors also said that people should not fight over material possessions because they are temporary, and instead focus on building good relationships and maintaining peace among themselves.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo ore omonyene oboronge, korende gwatotigairie intwe tore abake boka abatwatoorekire, buna tore aiga rero. Rora, nigo tore aa ase obosio bwao tokoorokia okomocha gwaito, na monto tari oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwao ase engencho y’okomocha buna oko.”
english: O LORD, God of Israel, you are righteous! We are left this day as a remnant. Here we are before you in our guilt, though because of it not one of us can stand in your presence."

ekegusii: Nonya Yuda obete ne chinguru ase egati y’abamura bamwabo, na korwa asare nao omogambi arwete, omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi nigo obete oyo o Yusufu.)
english: and though Judah was the strongest of his brothers and a ruler came from him, the rights of the firstborn belonged to Joseph)--

ekegusii: Inee! Omoetiopia nanyare koonchora ekieni kie risankwa riaye, gose engo nenyare koonchora amatonto aye? Onye naboigo, inwe aba mwanarire gokora ebibe rirorio monyare gokora amaya.
english: Can the Ethiopian change his skin or the leopard its spots? Neither can you do good who are accustomed to doing evil.

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Kwairaneirie buya. Kora iga, nario orachie kare.”
english: "You have answered correctly," Jesus replied. "Do this and you will live."

ekegusii: Onye Abamakedonia bande bagocha amo nainche na tobanyore timorebeka ang’e, titocha gosooka, ekero tobasemeretie inwe. Titokwana igoro y’obosooku bwaino.
english: For if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we-- not to say anything about you-- would be ashamed of having been so confident.

ekegusii: Intwe nigo tonga buna abaiborwa igoro totamanyeti kende, naki amatuko aito tomenyete ase ense nigo anga buna omorengari ogosira.
english: for we were born only yesterday and know nothing, and our days on earth are but a shadow.

ekegusii: Holon, Debir,
english: na Holoni, na Debiri,

ekegusii: Toimoke totiire kogenda Beteli, erinde ing’agachere Nyasae egesasimero aroro, Nyasae oyonyigwete ekero keria narenge nobokong’u, akaba amo nainche ase orogendo rwane rwonsi.”
english: Then come, let us go up to Bethel, where I will build an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress and who has been with me wherever I have gone."

ekegusii: Naki oyore na gento naegwe, nere namenteranigwe; korende oyotabwati gento naurwe nonya nekio abwate.
english: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken from him.

ekegusii: Tinkobaa egesusuro konde nendamwamu egwoka, gose tingosiria Abaefraimu naende, ekiagera inche nigo inde Nyasae, tindi mwanyabanto. Inche nigo inde Omochenu imenyete ase egati yaino, na tingocha asemore inde nekeririanda.
english: I will not carry out my fierce anger, nor will I turn and devastate Ephraim. For I am God, and not man-- the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.

ekegusii: Na abaringoria bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo, bakarenta ebioto igoro ase ense ya Misiri.
english: But the magicians did the same things by their secret arts; they also made frogs come up on the land of Egypt.

ekegusii: Erio akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase Abamisiri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: and brought Israel out from among them His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Timoakana omonto obobe ase obobe, tang’ania ayere amaya ase amasio ’abanto bonsi.
english: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Be careful to do what is right in the eyes of everybody.

ekegusii: Abanto baria abaango bairete amarube bakagenda ase kera omochie ase ense y’Efraimu na eya Manase, na goika eya Sabuloni, korende abanto bakabachecheria na kobachaya.
english: The couriers went from town to town in Ephraim and Manasseh, as far as Zebulun, but the people scorned and ridiculed them.

ekegusii: Beni‐Hadadi akaigwera Asa omoruoti, agatoma abatang’ani b’abarwani baye, bakagenda bakarwania emechie y’Abaisraeli, bakabua Iyoni, na Dani, na Abeli‐Maimu, na emechie yonsi ase ebinto biagachire agwo ase orogongo rwa Nafutali.
english: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. They conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim and all the store cities of Naphtali.

ekegusii: Na barabwo bakamobua ase chinguru chi’amanyinga ’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi, na ase amang’ana ’oborori bwabo; tibancha obogima bwabo nonya ngoika ogokwa.
english: They overcame him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.

ekegusii: Nigo ngokora ayio, erinde abanto bamenyete moocha na bosongo banyare komanya ng’a onde tari otatiga inche bweka. Inche ninche Omonene, na onde tari.
english: so that from the rising of the sun to the place of its setting men may know there is none besides me. I am the LORD, and there is no other.

ekegusii: "'These are the regulations for the guilt offering, which is most holy:
english: “Oko nakwo ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha. Ekio nekeng’wanso egechenu mono.

ekegusii: But Jesus kept looking around to see who had done it.
english: Akarigereria chinsemo chionsi, erinde arore oria okora ring’ana erio.

ekegusii: Erio bakaa Rebeka ribaga amo nomoreri oye bagende nomosomba o Ibrahimu na abanto baye.
english: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham's servant and his men.

ekegusii: Erio Esteri agakwana naende nomoruoti, agatung’ama inse ase amagoro aye, akamosorora mono ase ogoitekia amariga ng’a asarie omoroberio bw’ogosiria Abayahudi, oria Hamani Omoagagi aruete.
english: Esther again pleaded with the king, falling at his feet and weeping. She begged him to put an end to the evil plan of Haman the Agagite, which he had devised against the Jews.

ekegusii: Nase ki chianga chiao chire chimbariri burure, buna echi’oyo ogotacha egeteera gi’okomita emesabibu?
english: Why are your garments red, like those of one treading the winepress?

ekegusii: Omonene akamotindeka agwo ase rikura ri’ense ya Moabu kororia Beti‐Peori; korende goika rero iga monto onde tari omanyete embeera yaye.
english: He buried him in Moab, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, but to this day no one knows where his grave is.

ekegusii: Obeke egesasimero ekio bosio bw’etoto eria ekengete aase aria esanduku egachire, eria ere ne chibao chirikire oborori amo n’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera igoro yaye. Aase agwo ndabe nkoumerana naye.
english: Put the altar in front of the curtain that is before the ark of the Testimony-- before the atonement cover that is over the Testimony-- where I will meet with you.

ekegusii: Rebeka nabwate momura omwabo ore korokwa Labani. Ekero Labani aroche ekegera na ebitange ase amaboko ’omoiseke omwabo, na kaigure amang’ana omonto oria atebetie Rebeka, agasoka, akaminyoka gochia ase ensoko ase omonto oria arenge, akamorora oteneine ase chingamia chiaye,
english: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he hurried out to the man at the spring.

ekegusii: “Omoruoti oria nigo arakore buna anchete. Ase obomwenu bwaye neimokererie igoro ase kera enyasae, nakwane amang’ana ’ogokumia mamincha ya Nyasae oyobuete chinyasae chionsi. Nagenderere konyora chinguru goika ekeririanda kia Nyasae geikeranigwe. Aria aroberetigwe ng’a nabe goika aikeranigwe.
english: "The king will do as he pleases. He will exalt and magnify himself above every god and will say unheard-of things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been determined must take place.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, nonya aye Konia omoruoti bw’Abayuda, kore mosinto o Yehoyakimu, kwarenge koba ebonyi ere nekemanyererio kiane ebekire ase okoboko kwane gw’okorio, nabo nare kogosomora.
english: "As surely as I live," declares the LORD, "even if you, Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a signet ring on my right hand, I would still pull you off.

ekegusii: Nigo ngotogia Omonene oyo ogonsemia, ase obotuko enkoro yane nigo egontebereria gokora igo.
english: I will praise the LORD, who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.

ekegusii: Ekero akorua chibesa chiaye singo tari kogania ebitoki, omonto oyio tari koira riaaki kogera omonto otari nokomocha agambigwe. Omonto ogokora oboronge ase amang’ana ayio onsi namenye ase obotoereru kare na kare.
english: who lends his money without usury and does not accept a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.

ekegusii: Timoiroka abagoita omobere, abatanyare goita omoyo; kobua moiroke oyo oranyare goita omobere na omoyo ase omorero o kare na kare.
english: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Rather, be afraid of the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

ekegusii: Igwera amorokererio! Ancha obong’aini, timobwanga!
english: Listen to my instruction and be wise; do not ignore it.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamotebia, “Genda nomorembe.” Ase igo Abisalomu akaimoka, akagenda Heburoni.
english: The king said to him, "Go in peace." So he went to Hebron.

ekegusii: Genda, osangererie abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a: Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo nang’orokera, agantebia ng’a mbatebie: Amaene, narorire aya Abamisiri bakobakorera,
english: "Go, assemble the elders of Israel and say to them, 'The LORD, the God of your fathers-- the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob-- appeared to me and said: I have watched over you and have seen what has been done to you in Egypt.

ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria Amasia atigete Omonene, abanto ba Yerusalemu bagakora omoroberio bw’okomoita. Ere agatama gochia Lakisi, na abanto bagatomwa aroro, bakamoita.
english: From the time that Amaziah turned away from following the LORD, they conspired against him in Jerusalem and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.

ekegusii: Omonene, ng’ai obwanchani bwao bwa kare na kare bore, obwo ase obwegenwa bwao kwarierete Daudi eira?
english: O Lord, where is your former great love, which in your faithfulness you swore to David?

ekegusii: Na abatigari b’enyomba ya Yuda abaratooreke mbaame babe buna ebimeri biirete emeri inse mono na gokina gochia igoro, bikwama amatunda,
english: Once more a remnant of the house of Judah will take root below and bear fruit above.

ekegusii: Inwe abagambi ba Sodomu, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene! Inwe abanto ba Gomora, tegerera moigwe amorokererio a Nyasae oito!
english: Hear the word of the LORD, you rulers of Sodom; listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

ekegusii: na inche kondairane ase omochie o tata nomorembe, erio Omonene nabe Nyasae one;
english: so that I return safely to my father's house, then the LORD will be my God

ekegusii: Ase ayio, netogwenerete gotegerera mono kobua na kobwata ayatwaigure, titocha gosira.
english: We must pay more careful attention, therefore, to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away.

ekegusii: “Erio nkabatebia: Timoiroka gose goichanigwa ase abanto baria.
english: Then I said to you, "Do not be terrified; do not be afraid of them.

ekegusii: Ase emechie y’ense y’ebigoro, na ey’ense omweya, na eya Irianyi, na ey’orogongo rwa Benjamin, na ase chinsemo chionsi chia Yerusalemu, na ase emechie y’Abayuda, amaicho nabe agoeta inse y’okoboko kw’oyomo okoyabara.” Nabo Omonene agoteba.
english: In the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah, flocks will again pass under the hand of the one who counts them,' says the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene akaba nendamwamu entindi ase Abaisraeli, akababeka ase amaboko ’abanto abaurereria. Naende akababeka ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, baria babaetanaine, na Abaisraeli bakabugwa nababisa baria.
english: In his anger against Israel the LORD handed them over to raiders who plundered them. He sold them to their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.

ekegusii: Naboigo ring’ana ri’Omonene rikarentwa nomobani Yehu, mosinto o Hanani, igoro ya Baasa na abanto b’enyomba yaye, ase engencho y’amabe onsi akorete ase amaiso ’Omonene. Omonene akagechigwa goika akaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’ayio onsi Baasa akorete ase okoba buna abanto b’enyomba ya Yeroboamu; boigo ekiagera asiretie abanto abwo.
english: Moreover, the word of the LORD came through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani to Baasha and his house, because of all the evil he had done in the eyes of the LORD, provoking him to anger by the things he did, and becoming like the house of Jeroboam-- and also because he destroyed it.

ekegusii: Nonya more abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro, namosirigwe motigare more abake mono, ekiagera motaigwerete Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left but few in number, because you did not obey the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Ee, nigo agoeta bwango buna obwato obonyerere bw’ebirigisa, buna ensoti egotaboria ebiekoria biaye.
english: They skim past like boats of papyrus, like eagles swooping down on their prey.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ring’ana riao nigo riteneine bokong’u aaria igoro goika kare na kare.
english: Your word, O LORD, is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens.

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Babeli nigo ateneine ase amatabekania e chinchera chiria ibere ogokora oboringoria; nigo agotierania chinsara, na okoboria korwa ase ebinyasae biaye, naende nigo akorigereria riini.
english: For the king of Babylon will stop at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen: He will cast lots with arrows, he will consult his idols, he will examine the liver.

ekegusii: Tiga abansoeri baboigwe ogochaywa, tiga obosooku obwo bobatube buna egetambaa gi’okwambara.
english: My accusers will be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.

ekegusii: Kera ebao ase echio ibere ekabwatanigwa ne chibao chie chinsinyo, korwa inse goika igoro ase ebonyi entang’ani ere; naboigo bakorete ase chibao echio ibere echiabegetwe ase chikoona ibere.
english: At these two corners the frames were double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both were made alike.

ekegusii: Akabitebia, “Genda!” Bigasoka, bigasoa ase chimbeche. Na rora, riicho rionsi rigatirimboka, rigasoa enyancha ime, rigasirera aroro.
english: He said to them, "Go!" So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and died in the water.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, amaboko ’abanto bonsi nigo araborwe chinguru, ne chinkoro chiabo chirianyeke ase obwoba.
english: Because of this, all hands will go limp, every man's heart will melt.

ekegusii: Enchera morayerie nero eye: Mweboyie chinkini chiaino, mokong’e, mobeke ebikoroto ase amagoro aino, mobwate chinyimbo maboko aino, moyerie nomoayerero. Naki eyio n’Epasaka y’Omonene.
english: This is how you are to eat it: with your cloak tucked into your belt, your sandals on your feet and your staff in your hand. Eat it in haste; it is the LORD's Passover.

ekegusii: “Gose tari barabwo boka nasabeire, korende na baria baranyegene ase engencho ye ring’ana riabo,
english: "My prayer is not for them alone. I pray also for those who will believe in me through their message,

ekegusii: Korende inwe na abanto be chinderia chiaino komoreonchore na montige, naende timorenda amachiko aane na emeroberio yane nabaeire, korende mogende gokorera chinyasae chinde na gochisasima,
english: "But if you or your sons turn away from me and do not observe the commands and decrees I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,

ekegusii: Obotambe bwaye nigo boetanetie obw’ense, na obogare bwaye mboetanetie obw’enyancha.
english: Their measure is longer than the earth and wider than the sea.

ekegusii: Nigo nyanchete abwo banyanchete; na abwo bakondigia nomokia mbanyore.
english: I love those who love me, and those who seek me find me.

ekegusii: Omonene tari gotokorera aya togwenerete ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, gose tari gotoa egesusuro koreng’ana nobobe bwaito.
english: he does not treat us as our sins deserve or repay us according to our iniquities.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’abagisangio baane ababe, abwo bagosaria omwando oria naeire Abaisraeli: “Nimbarusie barue ase ense yabo, naende nindusie Abayuda barue ase egati yabo.
english: This is what the LORD says: "As for all my wicked neighbors who seize the inheritance I gave my people Israel, I will uproot them from their lands and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them.

ekegusii: Nebusaradani, omoteneneri bw’abarendi, akababwata, akabaira ase omoruoti o Babeli agwo Ribula.
english: Nebuzaradan the commander took them all and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Farao agachika abwo abachandi amo nabateneneri, akabatebia,
english: That same day Pharaoh gave this order to the slave drivers and foremen in charge of the people:

ekegusii: Noriere ebinto ebio aase gete are aachenu mono. Kera omonto omosacha ore asemore nanyare koria ebinto ebio. Ebio nebinto ebichenu asore.
english: Eat it as something most holy; every male shall eat it. You must regard it as holy.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ngoteba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, ningokorere koreng’ana nendamwamu yao, ne ribero riao, erio kwaorogetie, ekiagera ogechete Abaisraeli. Ekero ndakonachere ekina, nimanyekane ase egati yabo.
english: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will treat you in accordance with the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred of them and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

ekegusii: Inee! Inwe nigo more nogwanchereria asare? Nigo moganetie korwanerera Nyasae?
english: Will you show him partiality? Will you argue the case for God?

ekegusii: Naboigo erikire, “Omonto bwe ritang’ani Adamu akaba omonto ore moyo”, Adamu bw’omoerio akaba omoika bw’okoa obogima.
english: So it is written: "The first man Adam became a living being"; the last Adam, a life-giving spirit.

ekegusii: “Korende omosomba oria karatebe ng’a tatageti kogotiga agende, ekiagera ogwanchire aye, amo neamate yao, naende igo aisanegete komenya bwoo,
english: But if your servant says to you, "I do not want to leave you," because he loves you and your family and is well off with you,

ekegusii: Na abaonchoreria b’ense bakorera na komweumeria, ekiagera onde tari oragore ebinto biabo naende:
english: "The merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her because no one buys their cargoes any more--

ekegusii: korende tibabua, nonya naase abo tanyorekana igoro naende.
english: But he was not strong enough, and they lost their place in heaven.

ekegusii: Naboigo naye nore nabanto babwatete okworokereria kw’Abanikolaiti.
english: Likewise you also have those who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

ekegusii: Korende abanto bagakira‐kiri, tibamoiraneria nonya ne ring’ana erimo, ekiagera omoruoti konya ochikire iga: “Timobaisa komoiraneria.”
english: But the people remained silent and said nothing in reply, because the king had commanded, "Do not answer him."

ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Yusufu nigo rwarenge ebisaku bibere: Manase na Efraimu. Abalawi tibaetwe orogongo, otatiga baetwe emechie bakomenya, amo nebitii ase chitugo chiabo chiare korisia na ase baare kobeka ebinto biabo.
english: for the sons of Joseph had become two tribes-- Manasseh and Ephraim. The Levites received no share of the land but only towns to live in, with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.

ekegusii: Nigo asemeretie Nyasae, tiga Nyasae amotoorie bono, onye omoganetie, ekiagera natebete: Inche n’Omwana o Nyasae.”
english: He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him, for he said, 'I am the Son of God.'"

ekegusii: Ase ayio nonyare korora ense eria ere bosio bwao, korende tokonyara kogenda aroro na gosoa ase ense eria ngochia koa Abaisraeli.”
english: Therefore, you will see the land only from a distance; you will not enter the land I am giving to the people of Israel."

ekegusii: Ning’iranie abanto baane Abaisraeli korwa ase obosomba. Barabwo mbaagache naende emechie eyio yasiretigwe bamenyeo, mbasimeke emesabibu na konywa edivai yaye; boigo mbareme emegondo, basimeke chindagera na koria okwama kw’emegondo eyio.
english: I will bring back my exiled people Israel; they will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.

ekegusii: Naki ogwetogia gwaito nakwo oko, ng’a chinkoro chiaito ime nigo chigotworokia, ng’a ase obogima bwaito ase ense eye na mono kobua ase egati yaino, nigo tware kogamberwa nobochenu na oborabu bw’omoyo bokorwa ase Nyasae, tari ase obong’aini bwa mwanyabanto, korende ase obuya bwa Nyasae.
english: Now this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in our relations with you, in the holiness and sincerity that are from God. We have done so not according to worldly wisdom but according to God's grace.

ekegusii: Omwana one, ancha amang’ana aane, ogache amachiko aane ase enkoro yao,
english: My son, if you accept my words and store up my commands within you,

ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akamotebia, “Taibo, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, koranche obwate ekeegwa eke korwa ase okoboko kwane; naki okorora obosio bwao nigo enga buna okorora obosio bwa Nyasae, ase ogwanchera kwanyancheire inche.
english: "No, please!" said Jacob. "If I have found favor in your eyes, accept this gift from me. For to see your face is like seeing the face of God, now that you have received me favorably.

ekegusii: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.
english: Riachia koba mogoroba agacha amo na baria ikomi na babere.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Genda bwesibie ase ritibo ria Siloamu” (okoonchorwa kwaye, oyotomirwe). Erio akagenda agesibia, akairana okorora.
english: "Go," he told him, "wash in the Pool of Siloam" (this word means Sent). So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.

ekegusii: Obomera obotang’ani bokagwera Yusufu ase eamate y’Asafu. Obwa kabere bokagwera Gedalia; ere amo nabamwabo na abana baye abamura nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: The first lot, which was for Asaph, fell to Joseph, his sons and relatives, 12 the second to Gedaliah, he and his relatives and sons, 12

ekegusii: Bakamoiroka Omonene, korende boigo bagakorera chinyasae chiabo abanyene, bagakora buna abanto b’ebisaku biria, ase bang’anyetigwe korwa, barenge gokora.
english: They worshiped the LORD, but they also served their own gods in accordance with the customs of the nations from which they had been brought.

ekegusii: Naki obereirwe kirori ng’a. “Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”
english: For it is declared: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

ekegusii: Moinyore Yeso Kristo, oyobogete korwa ase abakure, oyo bw’ororeria rwa Daudi, koreng’ana nenchili eye nkorandia inche.
english: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David. This is my gospel,

ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bakwerageria embeo, babwatia embeo ya moocha. Kera rituko nigo bakomenta gokwana oborimo, na gokora ay’obotindi. Nigo bakobwatana n’Abaasuri, babe bakoira amaguta ’amazeituni ase ense ya Misiri.
english: Ephraim feeds on the wind; he pursues the east wind all day and multiplies lies and violence. He makes a treaty with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.

ekegusii: “Orogongo roratigare robebekaine na roria orochenu amo norw’omochie ase kera ensemo nigo rorabe orw’omogambi. Chingongo echio nigo chirachakere iga: Oromo korwa ase orogongo roria orochenu rw’ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere, na isano (25,000), rogenderere gochia moocha koreng’ana ne chingongo chiria chi’ebisaku, na oronde gochia bosongo koreng’ana ne chingongo chiria chi’ebisaku. Chingongo echio nigo chirabe echi’omogambi. Orogongo orwo orochenu ase Hekalu erabe nigo rorabe gati‐gati.
english: "What remains on both sides of the area formed by the sacred portion and the city property will belong to the prince. It will extend eastward from the 25,000 cubits of the sacred portion to the eastern border, and westward from the 25,000 cubits to the western border. Both these areas running the length of the tribal portions will belong to the prince, and the sacred portion with the temple sanctuary will be in the center of them.

ekegusii: Obwa emerongo ebere na rimo bokagwera Yakini, na obwa emerongo ebere na kabere Gamuli;
english: the twenty-first to Jakin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

ekegusii: Ekero egari eria yaigete ase omogondo o Yoshua o Beti‐Semesi egatenenao, ase rigena rinene riarenge. Abanto bagaatia chibao chi’egari eria, erio bakarua chiombe chiria chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene.
english: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and there it stopped beside a large rock. The people chopped up the wood of the cart and sacrificed the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.

ekegusii: bakaba botambe ime ase Hekalu, bakomotogia Nyasae.
english: And they stayed continually at the temple, praising God.

ekegusii: Igo aya onsi ay’okomokorera Omonene nigo akoretwe ase rituko riria; nigo barendete Epasaka bakarua okoruegwa kw’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase egesasimero ki’Omonene, buna Yosia omoruoti achigete.
english: So at that time the entire service of the LORD was carried out for the celebration of the Passover and the offering of burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD, as King Josiah had ordered.

ekegusii: korende nigo agokirie nabanto abwo bamoirogete, abwo basemeretie obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe.
english: the LORD delights in those who fear him, who put their hope in his unfailing love.

ekegusii: Abamura aba ba Haroni nabwo baagetwe amaguta na gwatananwa ase emeremo y’obokuani.
english: Those were the names of Aaron's sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.

ekegusii: bakabaa baire rirube ririkire iga, “Ase abaminto b’Ebisaku abamore ase Antiokia, na Siiria, na Kilikia. Intwe abamino, abatomwa na abagaaka, twabakwanirie.
english: With them they sent the following letter: The apostles and elders, your brothers, To the Gentile believers in Antioch, Syria and Cilicia: Greetings.

ekegusii: Omonto okoba kirori bw’oborimo ase omonto onde nigo anga buna enungu y’esegi, gose omoro, gose ensara enyonge.
english: Like a club or a sword or a sharp arrow is the man who gives false testimony against his neighbor.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba kwa Hosea, mosinto o Ela, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Hezekia, mosinto bw’Ahasi, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agachaka kogamba.
english: In the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo o Nyasae agacha ase Eli, akamotebia, “Amang’ana aya naro Omonene akwanire: Inee! Inche tineorogetie ase sokororia yao na ase ororeria rwaye, ekero barenge abasomba ba Farao agwo ase ense ya Misiri?
english: Now a man of God came to Eli and said to him, "This is what the LORD says: 'Did I not clearly reveal myself to your father's house when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh?

ekegusii: Ase obokonyi bwane abaruoti nigo bakogamba, na abagambi nigo bakobeka amachiko ay’ekeene.
english: By me kings reign and rulers make laws that are just;

ekegusii: Inee! Ninche ngwenerete kogambia abare isiko? Na inwe timogwenereti kogambia abare ime?
english: What business is it of mine to judge those outside the church? Are you not to judge those inside?

ekegusii: “Nyuma konaeire Baruku, mosinto o Neria, okobwatana koria gw’okogorana kw’oboremo ngasaba Omonene nkabora:
english: "After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD:

ekegusii: Tibakogenderera gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogosasima emegwekano yabo, gose ase ogokora kwabo gw’okogechia, gose ase ogosaria kwabo konde gwonsi. Nimbatoorie korwa ase obomenyo bwabo bwonsi agwo aase bakorerete ebibe, nimbachene. Erio mbabe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo.
english: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols and vile images or with any of their offenses, for I will save them from all their sinful backsliding, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

ekegusii: Musa agatenenia Obomenyo boria, akabeka chinterekerero aase abo, agatenenia ne chibao chiaye, agasoyia emeriibo, na gotenenia chisiiro.
english: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he put the bases in place, erected the frames, inserted the crossbars and set up the posts.

ekegusii: Agatochika toranderie abanto, na tobe birori ng’a nere ochoretwe na Nyasae abe omogambi bw’abare moyo na abakure.
english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one whom God appointed as judge of the living and the dead.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano, mambia chuni, akaimoka agachaka kogenda. Korende ise omosubati oria akamotebia, “Karie endagera onyore chinguru. Ganya goika omobaso orakenda.” Ase ayio bakaragera amo bonsi babere.
english: On the morning of the fifth day, when he rose to go, the girl's father said, "Refresh yourself. Wait till afternoon!" So the two of them ate together.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia goika aase aria, akarigereria igoro, akamotebia, “Zakayo, ika bwango, ekiagera rero ningwenerete goikaransa nyomba mwao.”
english: When Jesus reached the spot, he looked up and said to him, "Zacchaeus, come down immediately. I must stay at your house today."

ekegusii: Kerabe ng’a iso tandochi ase omoyega oyio, omotebie: Daudi nigo ansaba ribaga ng’a aminyoke gochia Bethlehemu, omochie oye, ase okorua ekeng’wanso ki’omwaka amo neamate yaye yonsi.
english: If your father misses me at all, tell him, 'David earnestly asked my permission to hurry to Bethlehem, his hometown, because an annual sacrifice is being made there for his whole clan.'

ekegusii: Ere goika amenteke, korende inche nkee.
english: He must become greater; I must become less.

ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa nigo gokobeera ase omotwe bw’omonyene oboronge, korende obochege nigo boichire ase emenwa y’abakori amabe.
english: Blessings crown the head of the righteous, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.

ekegusii: Naki oyio nere otebetwe nomobani Isaya, ekero atebete, “Eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro: Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.”
english: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: "A voice of one calling in the desert, 'Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.'"

ekegusii: Nonya Abaisraeli bare abange buna omokenye ore nyancha, abatigari boka nabwo barairane. Ogosirigwa gwachikirwe ogokong’u nigo korache buna eooro kore noboronge.
english: Though your people, O Israel, be like the sand by the sea, only a remnant will return. Destruction has been decreed, overwhelming and righteous.

ekegusii: Erio Balaki, omoruoti o Moabu, mosinto o Sipori, akaimoka kobarwania inwe Abaisraeli. Akarangeria Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, achiche kobaragereria,
english: When Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, prepared to fight against Israel, he sent for Balaam son of Beor to put a curse on you.

ekegusii: Gidioni, mosinto o Yoashi, agakwa ore nobogotu obuya, agatindekwa ase embeera ya Yoashi ise yarenge agwo Ofura, omochie bw’egesaku ki’Abieseri.
english: Gideon son of Joash died at a good old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

ekegusii: Obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Rora, ninyimokie enyimbo y’enyomba ya Yusufu (eyio ere ase okoboko gwa Efraimu) amo nebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, ebio biabwatanire nero; erio inyebwateranie amo nenyimbo y’Abayuda, erinde chibe enyimbo eyemo ere ase okoboko kwane.
english: say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am going to take the stick of Joseph-- which is in Ephraim's hand-- and of the Israelite tribes associated with him, and join it to Judah's stick, making them a single stick of wood, and they will become one in my hand.'

ekegusii: Naende karakore ebibe asore ara gatano na kabere ase rituko erimo, karakoiranere ara gatano na kabere na goteba: Naonchokire, mwabere.”
english: If he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times comes back to you and says, 'I repent,' forgive him."

ekegusii: Aroro agwo omwana takobao orakoore amatuko amake oka, gose omonto omogotu takobao otaikeranie amatuko ’obogima bwaye. Oyo orakwe ase oboke bwaye goika abe okoorire emiaka rigana erimo, na omonyabibe takoragererigwa goika abe okoorire emiaka rigana erimo.
english: "Never again will there be in it an infant who lives but a few days, or an old man who does not live out his years; he who dies at a hundred will be thought a mere youth; he who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.

ekegusii: Ekero baria ikomi bachia koigwa aya, bakabea ase abamura baria babere ba ise omo.
english: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye igoro, chenga, na inwe abamomenyete imeo. Korende obobe nobwaino, ense na enyancha, ekiagera omosoeri oria oikire asemore ore nendamwamu enyinge, ekiagera amanyete ng’a engaki yaye nenke!”
english: Therefore rejoice, you heavens and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has gone down to you! He is filled with fury, because he knows that his time is short."

ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali bakaegwa Kedesi agwo Galili, na Hamoni, na Kiriataimu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
english: and from the tribe of Naphtali they received Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.

ekegusii: Emechie yonsi y’Abalawi eyarenge ase egati y’omwando bw’Abaisraeli nigo yarenge emerongo ene, na etano na etato, amo namarisio arengeo.
english: The towns of the Levites in the territory held by the Israelites were forty-eight in all, together with their pasturelands.

ekegusii: Ekero gwatotigete, nigo twaroche emechando emenge, korende nonyare gotokora abayia naende; torusie, ototiirie korwa ase chiirima chire ase ense.
english: Though you have made me see troubles, many and bitter, you will restore my life again; from the depths of the earth you will again bring me up.

ekegusii: Nkabasiarera gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, bakaba besiarerete ase chinse ao ao. Nkabanachera ekina koreng’ana norogendo rwabo, na ogokora kwabo.
english: I dispersed them among the nations, and they were scattered through the countries; I judged them according to their conduct and their actions.

ekegusii: abanto ba Beteli na Ai: amagana abere, na emerongo ebere, na batato (223);
english: of Bethel and Ai 223

ekegusii: Nimbatugute abatigari b’omwando one, imbabeke ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na barabwo babe abooswa bairwe nababisa babo,
english: I will forsake the remnant of my inheritance and hand them over to their enemies. They will be looted and plundered by all their foes,

ekegusii: Ningosibe ne chingori, erinde tonyara koonchoka gochia ensemo ende yonsi goika obe gwakoorire amatuko ao ay’okoyoboera.
english: I will tie you up with ropes so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have finished the days of your siege.

ekegusii: Have I not written thirty sayings for you, sayings of counsel and knowledge,
