english: Inee! Tinkorikereti amang’ana amanene ay’ogosemia na ay’amorokererio?

ekegusii: Yehoyada omokuani agachika abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi amagana, akabatebia, “Mosokie isiko, momobeke ase egati y’abarendi, na moite nomoro onde bwensi okomotunyana.” Omokuani tanchete omokungu oria aiterwe ime ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops: "Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her." For the priest had said, "She must not be put to death in the temple of the LORD."

ekegusii: Korende nabatebirie inwe, nebe aororo ase Turo na Sidoni ase rituko ri’ekina kobua asemore.
english: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

ekegusii: Yeso agaetanana emechie yonsi na ebichie, okworokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, okorandia amang’ana amaya ay’oboruoti na kogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi.
english: Jesus went through all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the good news of the kingdom and healing every disease and sickness.

ekegusii: Naki kare nigo mwarenge omosunte, korende bono mwabeire omobaso ase Omonene. Mogenderere buna abana b’omobaso
english: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Live as children of light

ekegusii: otebe: “Nyoko naki arenge? Nigo arenge endo eaberi! Nigo arenge korara na koramama ase egati ye chindo, akaba okorera abana baye ase egati ye chindo chire ne chinguru.
english: and say: "'What a lioness was your mother among the lions! She lay down among the young lions and reared her cubs.

ekegusii: Aiga nao abachenu barabe nokoremereria, abwo babwatete amachiko a Nyasae na koba abegenwa ase Yeso.
english: This calls for patient endurance on the part of the saints who obey God's commandments and remain faithful to Jesus.

ekegusii: Akaara eema igoro y’Obomenyo boria, na kobeka egietubo kiaye buna Omonene konya amochikire.
english: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, as the LORD commanded him.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamotebia, “Intwe nigo toraete ase enchera enene yoka, na gatoranywe amache ao, intwe gose chitugo chiaito, rirorio natoakane amache ayio. Toe ribaga toete rioka namagoro, titokogania gento kende goetania ekio.”
english: The Israelites replied: "We will go along the main road, and if we or our livestock drink any of your water, we will pay for it. We only want to pass through on foot-- nothing else."

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakondigia kera rituko, na nigo bagokirie bamanye chinchera chiane. Nigo banga buna egesaku kegokora oboronge getana gotiga amachiko a Nyasae obo. Barabwo nigo bakomboria mbagambie ebina bi’oboronge, nigo baganetie Nyasae abaike ang’e.”
english: For day after day they seek me out; they seem eager to know my ways, as if they were a nation that does what is right and has not forsaken the commands of its God. They ask me for just decisions and seem eager for God to come near them.

ekegusii: Ekero chibarasi chiria chiarenge ne chinguru mono chiasogete chikagania kogenda goetanana ase ense yonsi. Omomalaika oria agachitebia, “Genda moetanane ase ense yonsi.” Nachirochio chigakora bo.
english: When the powerful horses went out, they were straining to go throughout the earth. And he said, "Go throughout the earth!" So they went throughout the earth.

ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika bw’Omonene atebetie Abaisraeli bonsi amang’ana ayio, barabwo bagachaka korera.
english: When the angel of the LORD had spoken these things to all the Israelites, the people wept aloud,

ekegusii: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
english: Akabaacha emiaro y’emekonge, akayeooma netahabu.

ekegusii: Mokemurungania ekero mwamenyete ase chiema chiaino, mogateba: Omonene nigo atogechete, nakio kiagerete agatorusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde atobeke ase amaboko ’Abaamori, nabarabwo batoite na gotosiria.”
english: You grumbled in your tents and said, "The LORD hates us; so he brought us out of Egypt to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us.

ekegusii: Otebie Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteba: Aye gwasambire ebuku eye na koboria Yeremia ng’a nase ki arikire amang’ana imeo ng’a omoruoti o Babeli nachiche asarie ense eye na gosiria abanto bonsi ne ching’iti chionsi.
english: Also tell Jehoiakim king of Judah, 'This is what the LORD says: You burned that scroll and said, "Why did you write on it that the king of Babylon would certainly come and destroy this land and cut off both men and animals from it?"

ekegusii: Inwe ancha rioka ng’a nabamochi more, naende ng’a mwasaririe asende inche Omonene, Nyasae oino; mwabeire mokogenda gochia aaria na aaria inse y’emete yonsi emebese mogosasima chinyasae ching’ao, timwaigwerete eriogi riane.” Omonene otebire ayio.
english: Only acknowledge your guilt-- you have rebelled against the LORD your God, you have scattered your favors to foreign gods under every spreading tree, and have not obeyed me,'" declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero abana abwo bakinire, Esau akaba omotwari bwe ching’iti, korende Yakobo nigo arenge omonto omotoereru, ore kobeera ase chiema.
english: The boys grew up, and Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the open country, while Jacob was a quiet man, staying among the tents.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora abakerubi baria bakorambora chimbaba chiabo na koimokerera igoro korwa ase riroba ekero bagendete, na amagoro aria naro akagenda amo nabarabwo. Bagatenena ase egesoero ki’egeita kia moocha kegochia ase enyomba y’Omonene, na obonene bwa Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli nigo bwarenge igoro yabo.
english: While I watched, the cherubim spread their wings and rose from the ground, and as they went, the wheels went with them. They stopped at the entrance to the east gate of the LORD's house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiagosemeretie, ee, nigo chiagosemeretie, naye ogachitooria.
english: In you our fathers put their trust; they trusted and you delivered them.

ekegusii: and Abram (that is, Abraham).
english: na Aburamu nere Ibrahimu.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Usieli nabwo aba: Mishaeli na Elisafani, na Sitiri.
english: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan and Sithri.

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bakarua agwo ase omoganda oria, bakagenda ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama agwo ase egesoero. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokabaorokera.
english: Moses and Aaron went from the assembly to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.

english: At Barak's advance, the LORD routed Sisera and all his chariots and army by the sword, and Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled on foot.

english: Belonging to the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

english: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.

ekegusii: Ekero Baalamu aroche ng’a Omonene nigo amoganetie asesenie Abaisraeli tagendete naende ase okorigia oboringoria buna chingaki chiria chie ritang’ani, korende akaonchora obosio bwaye gochia ase erooro.
english: Now when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he did not resort to sorcery as at other times, but turned his face toward the desert.

ekegusii: Farao akaboria abasomba baye, “Inee! Ng’ai toranyore omonto onga buna oyo ore n’Omoika o Nyasae ime yaye?”
english: So Pharaoh asked them, "Can we find anyone like this man, one in whom is the spirit of God?"

ekegusii: These, then, are the things you should teach. Encourage and rebuke with all authority. Do not let anyone despise you.
english: Kwana amang’ana aya, kurera, na gotogonyera nokobua gwonsi. Monto onde bwensi tagochaya.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Omong'ina magokoro baba ominto nantebetie buna abwo ase chingaki chia kare kare, amaiga y' omogaka narengeo. Bono amaiga y' omogaka ninki? Naende nabo oraborie. Magokoro nigo antebetie buna ase amatuko amakoro, nigo abagaka bare koriseria chiombe chiabo ase oboamo, naende nigo chiare korara ase ayamo. Nigo baba antebetie buna nigo abagaka aba bare korosia egesa gekorokwa gesarate, erinde babera na korara aroro. Bono abaminto manya buna gesarate n' ase abagaka bare komenya, ayio arenge aare na sobo, na nigo bare kong'anya ne chiombe chiabo. Ase boigo, nigo omong'ina antebetie buna abang'ina mbarenge kobera gesarate. Yaya. Abasae n' abagaka, nabwo boka barenge kobera aaiga gesarate. Bono ekero omong'ina arenge koigwa amaiga y' ogokwania omogaka oye, nigo omong'ina oyo are kwebwatesia, orosia endagera egotonontera, buna obokima amo n' ching'eni chiri omogaka oye ancheete. Tingocha kona kobeera nyombaa nche bweka: Omosubati nyakieni nkorengereria are, okweboria buna n' chinyeni ki gose, agocha koiyekera omogaka oye, erinde amoirere aaria gesarate. Ase Abagusii, amaiga y' omogaka narengeo. Korwa abwo, omanya gwetema igo, goika gesarate na kobairera endagera eyio eng'ansu. Bono omong'ina oyo gaikire abwo egesarate, nigo abagaka aba bande bare komanya buna omong'ina oyo nigo are n' amaiga y' omogaka oye, bamanya koa omogaka bw' omong'ina oyo ribaga, erinde ogenda bwoye! Kobwatekana n' omongina magokoro baba ominto, aya naro arenge gokwanerwa buna amaiga y' omogaka, n' Abagusii abakoro. Abaminto, obo nabwo obosemi bwaito bw' Ekegusii ase rero. Monywe mache maya, and thank you for listening.
english: These are the words: The story is about a person who greatly loved his family and friends, and he had a lot of wealth. But did he have enough wealth? I also want to share with you. The story is about a person who had many possessions, and people respected him because of his generosity, but he still wanted more. He greatly loved his family and people respected him because of his great achievements, and they were happy and satisfied. But some people didn't understand why he was so successful, they were jealous of him, and they tried to ruin his reputation. Because of this, the story is about how important it is to be successful. Yes. His children and relatives, they too wanted to achieve success. But what does this story mean when someone wants to acquire the wealth of another person, and that person refuses, causing conflict and problems, and ultimately leading to destruction? Consider this carefully and remember well: The advisor told the king, saying that it is important to listen to advice, and to respect others, and to help those in need, so that things will turn out well. And the Gusii people, they have a lot of wealth. Therefore, know this truth, it is good to work hard, to strive for success and to protect your property from thieves. But this story teaches us that if people try to take your success, then those people should understand that this success comes from the wealth of another person, they should also understand how that person feels, and then leave it alone! Connecting with the story of a person who greatly loved his family, these words also teach us about the wealth of our ancestors, and the ancient Gusii people. People, this is our heritage of Ekegusii forever. Thank you very much, and thank you for listening.

ekegusii: Rituko rie ritang’ani Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu bw’egesaku kia Yuda, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: The one who brought his offering on the first day was Nahshon son of Amminadab of the tribe of Judah.

ekegusii: Naende Yehosafati agatebia omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, “Ritang’ani toborie Omonene igoro y’amang’ana aya.”
english: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, "First seek the counsel of the LORD."

ekegusii: Abarenge emeuko nkorora bare, abarenge amagata ngotaara bare, abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma basibekire, abarenge emetino nkoigwa bare, abare ebitondo nkobokigwa bare, na abataka nkoranderigwa bare amang’ana amaya.
english: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, those who have leprosy are cured, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.

ekegusii: Na Yeso konya taraika omochie ime, korende nigo arenge aase aria arototeretwe na Martha.
english: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met him.

ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo akong’aina omogisangio oye; nonya noyomo tari gokwana ekeene, ekiagera banaririe chimeme chiabo gokwana oborimo. Nigo bagokwana oborimo goika berosirie ase ogokora amabe.
english: Friend deceives friend, and no one speaks the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they weary themselves with sinning.

english: On the seventh day the priest is to examine him, and if it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infectious skin disease.

ekegusii: Erio gaetire chinsemo chiria na gokwana amang’ana amange ase okobaremia, agaika Bogiriki.
english: He traveled through that area, speaking many words of encouragement to the people, and finally arrived in Greece,

english: were the doorways of the rooms on the south. There was a doorway at the beginning of the passageway that was parallel to the corresponding wall extending eastward, by which one enters the rooms.

ekegusii: Naende Omomalaika bw’Omonene akamotebia, “Rora, morito ore, noibore omwana omoisia; nomoroke Isumaeli, ekiagera Omonene oigure ekerero ki’emechando yao.
english: The angel of the LORD also said to her: "You are now with child and you will have a son. You shall name him Ishmael, for the LORD has heard of your misery.

ekegusii: Erio abagambi bonsi bare ase ense ere enyancha mbarabare mbarue ase ebirogo biabo bi’obonene, barusie emiambaro yabo, naende barusie chianga chiabo chire nebieni ao ao. Barabwo mbabe bakoiguswa, nigo baraikaranse inse ase amaroba, babe bakona‐koiguswa na goichana igoro yao.
english: Then all the princes of the coast will step down from their thrones and lay aside their robes and take off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled at you.

english: At this, the administrators and the satraps tried to find grounds for charges against Daniel in his conduct of government affairs, but they were unable to do so. They could find no corruption in him, because he was trustworthy and neither corrupt nor negligent.

english: When I shoot at you with my deadly and destructive arrows of famine, I will shoot to destroy you. I will bring more and more famine upon you and cut off your supply of food.

english: "Tell the people: 'Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, when you will eat meat. The LORD heard you when you wailed, "If only we had meat to eat! We were better off in Egypt!" Now the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat it.

english: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

english: "Are you really my son Esau?" he asked. "I am," he replied.

english: When the LORD saw that Leah was not loved, he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

english: And he passed in front of Moses, proclaiming, "The LORD, the LORD, the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness,

english: "If a fire breaks out and spreads into thornbushes so that it burns shocks of grain or standing grain or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make restitution.

english: The LORD wrote on these tablets what he had written before, the Ten Commandments he had proclaimed to you on the mountain, out of the fire, on the day of the assembly. And the LORD gave them to me.

ekegusii: Omosasoko oyo kwang’eire ase enkoro yane ime nigo are omuya kobua oyo abanto bande bakonyora, abwo bare nobonge bw’endagera na edivai.
english: You have filled my heart with greater joy than when their grain and new wine abound.

ekegusii: Hilen, Debir,
english: Hileni na Debiri amo namarisio aetanaineo;

ekegusii: Kera omonto arue ebinto koreng’ana buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, amosesenirie.
english: Each of you must bring a gift in proportion to the way the LORD your God has blessed you.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abamura ikomi na babere, abana b’omonto oyomo, ase ense ya Kanani; na bono omoke ominto tari aa, inka akare ase tata, na oyomo ere takaiyo.”
english: But they replied, "Your servants were twelve brothers, the sons of one man, who lives in the land of Canaan. The youngest is now with our father, and one is no more."

ekegusii: Erio agatiirera egetunwa gia Salimoni amo nabanto baye bonsi, akaimokia egesire, akagecha chinsagia chi’emete, agachibeka ase amareko aye. Naende agatebia abanto baye, “Aya morarore inche ngokora, nainwe mokore boigo, na moyakore bwango!”
english: he and all his men went up Mount Zalmon. He took an ax and cut off some branches, which he lifted to his shoulders. He ordered the men with him, "Quick! Do what you have seen me do!"

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio nindutere kera ebarasi omoondoko, na omonto oyeriinete abe ebarimo. Korende nimbe ndigereretie na korenda Abayuda, ekero ndaukorie chibarasi chi’abanto b’ebisaku.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: On that day I will strike every horse with panic and its rider with madness," declares the LORD. "I will keep a watchful eye over the house of Judah, but I will blind all the horses of the nations.

ekegusii: “Ase chibesa, esekeli eyemo nigo ebwate chigera emerongo ebere; emina eyemo nigo ebwate chisekeli emerongo etano nomo (emerongo ebere, na emerongo ebere na isano, na ikomi na isano).
english: The shekel is to consist of twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels equal one mina.

english: When the trumpets sounded, the people shouted, and at the sound of the trumpet, when the people gave a loud shout, the wall collapsed; so every man charged straight in, and they took the city.

english: During the night the men of Gibeah came after me and surrounded the house, intending to kill me. They raped my concubine, and she died.

english: Praise the LORD. Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who finds great delight in his commands.

english: "If a man gives his neighbor silver or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor's house, the thief, if he is caught, must pay back double.

english: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.

english: Be completely humble and gentle; be patient, bearing with one another in love.

ekegusii: Nimbaire ase ense ere entenenku y’amabeere na amooke. Inche omonyene tinkogenda amo nainwe, mbaise kobaitera inchera, ekiagera inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u.”
english: Go up to the land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people and I might destroy you on the way."

ekegusii: Rituko riria baagetwe amaguta inche ngachika ng’a egetari ekio korwa ase Abaisraeli kebe ekiabo kogenderera botambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
english: On the day they were anointed, the LORD commanded that the Israelites give this to them as their regular share for the generations to come.

ekegusii: erinde bakore aya okoboko kwao na omoroberio oo biare goteba korwa kare akoreke.
english: They did what your power and will had decided beforehand should happen.

ekegusii: Ere akaba nokogania okobe ase abatomani baria baare nokogania kw’omobere buna chitigere chire, naende bagasokia oroiboro buna chibarasi chigosokia orwabo.
english: There she lusted after her lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of horses.

english: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, "Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother when he sins against me? Up to seven times?"

ekegusii: Ase ayio natianire ase eamate ya Eli ng’a okobwatanigwa tigokoba nonya ng’ake ase ebibe biabo ase enchera y’ebing’wanso gose okoruegwa konde gwonsi.”
english: Therefore, I swore to the house of Eli, 'The guilt of Eli's house will never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.'"

ekegusii: Ase ayio agatoma abanto ase Rahabu komotebia, “Abanto abwo basoire mwao, nigo bachire koroota ense engima. Ase igo, basokie gocha asetore.”
english: So the king of Jericho sent this message to Rahab: "Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, because they have come to spy out the whole land."

english: The next day, when Pashhur released him from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, "The LORD's name for you is not Pashhur, but Magor-Missabib.

english: About that time there arose a great disturbance about the Way.

ekegusii: Gomeri amo nomoganda oye bwonsi bw’esegi, na egesaku gia Togarima kemenyete aare, ensemo ya sugusu, amo nemeganda yaye yonsi, ee, abanto abange mbache amo naye.
english: also Gomer with all its troops, and Beth Togarmah from the far north with all its troops-- the many nations with you.

ekegusii: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
english: na Eberi, na Pelegi, na Reu,

ekegusii: Nabo bakarigia Yeso, bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, bagotenena ase Hekalu, “Naki moroche? Tagocha‐gocha ase rituko rinene nonya ng’ake?”
english: They kept looking for Jesus, and as they stood in the temple area they asked one another, "What do you think? Isn't he coming to the Feast at all?"

ekegusii: You have broken through all his walls and reduced his strongholds to ruins.
english: Gwatagoire chindwaki chiaye chionsi gwatagoire amaagacho aye onsi are amakong’u abeire amatombe.

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamotebia, “Timomokania, ekiagera oyo otari mamincha yaino nigo are ensemo yaino.”
english: "Do not stop him," Jesus said, "for whoever is not against you is for you."

ekegusii: Naboigo ase amatuko ayio nimbaiterere abasomba baane, abasacha na abakungu, Omoika one.
english: Even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days.

ekegusii: Namanyire ng’a gento kende tikeri kere ekiya kerabagwenere otatiga babe nomogoko, naende bakore ayare amaya ekero bare moyo.
english: I know that there is nothing better for men than to be happy and do good while they live.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, tingokora amaya ayio ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino; momanye amang’ana ayio buya kegima. Inwe goika mosookigwe ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: I want you to know that I am not doing this for your sake, declares the Sovereign LORD. Be ashamed and disgraced for your conduct, O house of Israel!

ekegusii: Inyora ng’a nere emenwa ere ne chingencho chinyinge ase ense, gose onde tari nonya noyomo, otari nengencho yaye.
english: Undoubtedly there are all sorts of languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.

ekegusii: Osunge etoto eria y’egetambaa ase chisiiro inye chi’emekonge chioomire netahabu, chire nebigobanio bie chitahabu, chiratenene ase chinterekerero inye chie chifeta.
english: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.

ekegusii: Nigo mwarenge kominyoka buya; ning’o obatangete timoigwera ekeene?
english: You were running a good race. Who cut in on you and kept you from obeying the truth?

ekegusii: Bagatura ebao y’etahabu echenire, na buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio, bakamang’a amang’ana aya: “Achenirwe ase Omonene”.
english: They made the plate, the sacred diadem, out of pure gold and engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.

ekegusii: Nintoore asore ngoetanane, ng’agache chiburi chi’okoboera na gokorwania.
english: I will encamp against you all around; I will encircle you with towers and set up my siege works against you.

ekegusii: Abarisia mbachiche aroro namaicho abo, batenenie chiema chiabo chinsemo chiaye chionsi; kera omorisia nenyorere aroro aase aye akorisia ching’ondi chiaye.
english: Shepherds with their flocks will come against her; they will pitch their tents around her, each tending his own portion."

ekegusii: ande nabo arabe nendamwamu, akoborie: Naki mwakorete mokagenda ang’e nomochie? Inee! Timwamanyete ng’a abanto nigo bakoruta emegwe korwa ase orwaki?
english: the king's anger may flare up, and he may ask you, 'Why did you get so close to the city to fight? Didn't you know they would shoot arrows from the wall?

english: where they got into a boat and set off across the lake for Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet joined them.

ekegusii: Tegerera oigwe ekerero kiane, ekiagera nachandekire mono! Ntoorie korwa ase abanto abwo bagonchanda, ekiagera nigo babwate chinguru kombua.
english: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need; rescue me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.

ekegusii: Onye takoboorigwa ase enchera eyemo y’echio, rirorio ere na abana baye batigwe babe abasibore ase Omwaka bw’Omochengo.

english: He remembers his covenant forever, the word he commanded, for a thousand generations,

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aya amange timwatigete Abaisraeli bamino goika rero iga. Mwarendire mono na koigwera aya Omonene, Nyasae oino abachigete mokore.
english: For a long time now-- to this very day-- you have not deserted your brothers but have carried out the mission the LORD your God gave you.

english: May your priests be clothed with righteousness; may your saints sing for joy."

english: The sister of Tahpenes bore him a son named Genubath, whom Tahpenes brought up in the royal palace. There Genubath lived with Pharaoh's own children.

english: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city. It opened for them by itself, and they went through it. When they had walked the length of one street, suddenly the angel left him.

english: They will devour your harvests and food, devour your sons and daughters; they will devour your flocks and herds, devour your vines and fig trees. With the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust.

english: so she said to Abram, "The LORD has kept me from having children. Go, sleep with my maidservant; perhaps I can build a family through her." Abram agreed to what Sarai said.

english: Turn and flee, hide in deep caves, you who live in Dedan, for I will bring disaster on Esau at the time I punish him.

ekegusii: Omonto ore omong’aini ase enkoro yaye narokwe omomanyi, ne chinkwana chingiya nigo chikomenta chisemi.
english: The wise in heart are called discerning, and pleasant words promote instruction.

ekegusii: Bono aye nigo okobara amatambokero aane, gose tori korigereria ebibe biane.
english: Surely then you will count my steps but not keep track of my sin.

ekegusii: Omoyo one nokobwaterere mono, ekiagera aye nonsiirete nokoboko kwao gw’okorio.
english: My soul clings to you; your right hand upholds me.

ekegusii: Mwanyabanto onde bwensi nigo arakumbwe, na abanto abanene bakeeigwe gocha inse, na amaiso ’obomwenu nigo arakanywe.
english: So man will be brought low and mankind humbled, the eyes of the arrogant humbled.

ekegusii: Ise bw’omonto ore omonyene oboronge nigo akoba nomogoko omonene. Ere oyoiboire omwana omomura omong’aini nagokigwe nere.
english: The father of a righteous man has great joy; he who has a wise son delights in him.

english: For the LORD gives wisdom, and from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

english: The goal of this command is love, which comes from a pure heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith.

ekegusii: Inche nerikonde, tindi omonto, nigo ngochecherigwa nabanto na gochaywa.
english: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.

ekegusii: Ere nigo abwatetie chinchera chia Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, agakora ebibe buna ebiaye, boigo akagera Abaisraeli bakabikora. Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akagechigwa, akaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’emegwekano yabo bagosasima.
english: He walked in all the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat and in his sin, which he had caused Israel to commit, so that they provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger by their worthless idols.

english: Naki mbarabi baria bamogechetie ekero baigwete? Tari baria bonsi barwete Misiri, baare koraagwa na Musa?

english: Those officials of Pharaoh who feared the word of the LORD hurried to bring their slaves and their livestock inside.

ekegusii: Ekero barabe bagosoa ase ebiita bigosoerwa ase eraaro ya ime, babeke chianga chiroisirie korwa ase egatani. Tibabaisa kobeka chianga chiroisirie korwa ase amarionya, ekero bagendererete gokora emeremo agwo ase amaagacho are egeita kegosoerwa ase eraaro ya ime, na ime ase enyomba.
english: "'When they enter the gates of the inner court, they are to wear linen clothes; they must not wear any woolen garment while ministering at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.

english: As it is, you boast and brag. All such boasting is evil.

ekegusii: Barabwo baroisirie aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agwo ase Tofeti, aaria ase Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu. Agwo basambire abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, nomorero, amang’ana inche ntachigete gose atana koba ase ebirengererio biane.
english: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to burn their sons and daughters in the fire-- something I did not command, nor did it enter my mind.

ekegusii: Okoboko kw’Omonene gokaba amo n’Elija, ere agesiba ekenema norokini rwaye, akaminyoka agatang’ana bosio bw’Ahabu goika akagenda ase omochie o Yesireeli.
english: The power of the LORD came upon Elijah and, tucking his cloak into his belt, he ran ahead of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.

ekegusii: Agasangereria abakuani na Abalawi, akabatebia, “Kera omwaka, genda ase emechie y’Abayuda, mosangererie chibesa korwa ase Abaisraeli bonsi, chibe ase okoroiseria enyomba ya Nyasae oino; mokore ayio ase obwango.” Korende Abalawi tibakorete ring’ana erio ase obwango.
english: He called together the priests and Levites and said to them, "Go to the towns of Judah and collect the money due annually from all Israel, to repair the temple of your God. Do it now." But the Levites did not act at once.

ekegusii: Korende omosomba oyio karagenderere koba moyo rituko erimo gose abere, omonto oyio takoegwa egesusuro, ekiagera omosomba oyio nenibo yaye.

ekegusii: “Echio nachio chindoto inche Nebukadinesaro omoruoti narota. Aye Beli‐Tesasari, intebie engencho yaye, ekiagera abanto abang’aini bonsi bare ase oboruoti bwane basinyirwe gontebia engencho yaye, korende aye nonyare, ekiagera omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu nigo ore ime yao.”
english: "This is the dream that I, King Nebuchadnezzar, had. Now, Belteshazzar, tell me what it means, for none of the wise men in my kingdom can interpret it for me. But you can, because the spirit of the holy gods is in you."

english: Then the officers who were over the units of the army-- the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds-- went to Moses
