english: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio oromeme rwane ndogenderere koraria oboronge bwao, na ogotogigwa kwao, omobaso boira.
english: My tongue will speak of your righteousness and of your praises all day long.

ekegusii: Ere aise koirania omoika oye, ee, airanie gochia asare omoika bw’obogima,
english: If it were his intention and he withdrew his spirit and breath,

ekegusii: Erio Saitani akairaneria, agatebia Omonene, “Inee! Ayubu nigo agosigete aye Nyasae ngencho etaiyo?
english: "Does Job fear God for nothing?" Satan replied.

ekegusii: Naende abaratoore ensemo yabo n’Abanafutali. Ahira, mosinto bw’Enani, nere orabe omotang’ani obo,
english: The tribe of Naphtali will be next. The leader of the people of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan.

ekegusii: Ching’iti chionsi chire ase ense chiboboe na kobairoka inwe: chinyoni chia igoro, ne ching’iti chikwagura igoro ase ense, ne chinswe chionsi chi’enyancha; echio chionsi chiabekirwe ase amaboko aino.
english: The fear and dread of you will fall upon all the beasts of the earth and all the birds of the air, upon every creature that moves along the ground, and upon all the fish of the sea; they are given into your hands.

ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto korwa ase erooro ya Parani, buna Omonene amochigete. Abanto abwo bonsi nigo barenge abatang’ani ase Abaisraeli.
english: So at the LORD's command Moses sent them out from the Desert of Paran. All of them were leaders of the Israelites.

ekegusii: Tibakoba nenchara, gose erang’o, eguru‐gura na omobaso tibikobasamba, ekiagera Omonene oria obaroreire amabera nabaraae, nabatang’ane gochia ase chinsoko chi’amache.
english: They will neither hunger nor thirst, nor will the desert heat or the sun beat upon them. He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.

ekegusii: Akarenta ase enyomba ya Nyasae ebiegwa ebi ise na ere omonyene baatananete koba ebichenu, chifeta, ne chitahabu, na ebikorero.
english: He brought into the temple of God the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.

ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a ere oyobogetie Omonene Yeso natobokie naintwe amo na Yeso, na atorente amo nainwe ase obosio bwaye.
english: because we know that the one who raised the Lord Jesus from the dead will also raise us with Jesus and present us with you in his presence.

ekegusii: Adamu nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etato (930), erio agakwa.
english: Altogether, Adam lived 930 years, and then he died.

ekegusii: Naki ning’o asemore, onye origetie koagacha oboagacho, otaikaranse ritang’ani kobara rigori ri’oboagacho obo, gose nabwate ebinto biisaine kobokoora?
english: "Suppose one of you wants to build a tower. Will he not first sit down and estimate the cost to see if he has enough money to complete it?

ekegusii: Ninyeruserie egesiomba ase abanto b’ebisaku, abwo batari koigwera, inde nendamwamu na ekeririanda.”
english: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed me."

ekegusii: “Ababani na abakuani tibamoirogeti Nyasae. Nonya nase enyomba yane obobe bwabo bwarorekanire.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "Both prophet and priest are godless; even in my temple I find their wickedness," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Nigo kwagendererete koba nobobisa ime ase enkoro yao igoro y’Abaisraeli, okabarua bagaitwa nemioro ase engaki y’emechando yabo, ekero baikerete engaki y’egesusuro ki’ebibe biabo.
english: "'Because you harbored an ancient hostility and delivered the Israelites over to the sword at the time of their calamity, the time their punishment reached its climax,

ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria, “Nigo naigwa eriogi riao kogotaara ase omogondo, noboa ekiagera ngetirianda nare; ase ayio nebisa.”
english: He answered, "I heard you in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid."

ekegusii: Naki nekeene, aye gwatogirie buya, korende oria oyonde taagachiri.
english: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other man is not edified.

ekegusii: Natebigwe ring’ana n’Omonene, oria ontongete ase enda ya baba ng’a nimbe omosomba oye, erinde ng’iranie ororeria rwa Yakobo gochia asare, na nsangererie Abaisraeli gochia asare. Inche nanyorire amasikani ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae one obeire chinguru chiane.
english: And now the LORD says-- he who formed me in the womb to be his servant to bring Jacob back to him and gather Israel to himself, for I am honored in the eyes of the LORD and my God has been my strength--

ekegusii: Ntomere oborabu bwao, na ekeene kiao, binyare kondaa, na kong’ikia ase egetunwa kiao egechenu kere obomenyo bwao.
english: Send forth your light and your truth, let them guide me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano bw’okogamba kwa Rehoboamu, Sisaki, omoruoti o Misiri, agacha, akarwania Yerusalemu.
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.

ekegusii: ayebeke ase omorero igoro, agwo ase obosio bwane, erinde erioki ria ubani eyio ritube Oboikaranso bw’Amabera obore ekemumeko gi’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori. Atakoreti bo, nigo arakwe.
english: He is to put the incense on the fire before the LORD, and the smoke of the incense will conceal the atonement cover above the Testimony, so that he will not die.

ekegusii: So Jacob's sons did as he had commanded them:
english: Naboigo basinto ba Yakobo bakorete buna ise abachigete.

ekegusii: Ekero gwatogonyerete amache ayio, nigo atamete, na ekero aigwete eriogi riao ri’okogukura, nigo aayererete agatama.
english: But at your rebuke the waters fled, at the sound of your thunder they took to flight;

ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria Taritani, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani b’Abaasuri, atometwe na Sarigoni, omoruoti obo, agende ase omochie bw’Asidodi; ere akayorwania esegi, akayobua.
english: In the year that the supreme commander, sent by Sargon king of Assyria, came to Ashdod and attacked and captured it--

ekegusii: Ngakora emeremo emenene; nkeagachera chinyomba na gwesimekera emesabibu ase emegondo.
english: I undertook great projects: I built houses for myself and planted vineyards.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rora kwabereire ang’e gochia gokwa na ogende gotimoka ase chisokoro chiao chitimogete; nyuma y’ayio abanto aba nigo baratige koba abegenwa asende, bakorere chinyasae chingeni chi’ense eria ase bakogenda komenya; barabwo mbantige, naende basarie okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete amo nabarabwo.
english: And the LORD said to Moses: "You are going to rest with your fathers, and these people will soon prostitute themselves to the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake me and break the covenant I made with them.

ekegusii: Ense eyio nesarigwe ebe bosa ase egati ye chinse chinde chisaregete chikaba bosa, na emechie yaye nesarigwe ebe bosa ase egati y’emechie ende esaregete ekaba bosa.
english: "'They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo abatebetie ng’a morere na kobokia amagombo, na mokigite chitukia chi’emetwe yaino, na kweboyia chigunia.
english: The Lord, the LORD Almighty, called you on that day to weep and to wail, to tear out your hair and put on sackcloth.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Abamoabu bachete ase egetwori ki’Abaisraeli, Abaisraeli bakaimoka, bakabarwania goika abanto abwo bagatama korwa asebare. Abaisraeli bakagenderera kobatunyana gochia ase ense yabo bakabaita.
english: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and fought them until they fled. And the Israelites invaded the land and slaughtered the Moabites.

ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene akarora Hagari ase erooro ase ensoko y’amache yarenge ase enchera ekogenda Suri.
english: The angel of the LORD found Hagar near a spring in the desert; it was the spring that is beside the road to Shur.

ekegusii: Bakamochiera, bakamotura, bakabora, “Omonene, Omonene, ngosira tore.” Akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga na emerindo y’amache, na birobio bigakira, gokaba ogotoerera.
english: The disciples went and woke him, saying, "Master, Master, we're going to drown!" He got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters; the storm subsided, and all was calm.

ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omoteneneri bw’Abakereti, na Abapeleti, na basinto ba Daudi nabwo barenge abakuani.
english: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David's sons were royal advisers.

ekegusii: Aye gwasoirie amagoro aane ase rikorogoto, nigo origereretie orogendo rwane rwonsi; aye kwabekire orobebe ase chimbaratero chiane chigotacha.
english: You fasten my feet in shackles; you keep close watch on all my paths by putting marks on the soles of my feet.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akameria omobono ogakina, na Yona agakenderera inse yaye, agatimoka korwa ase okorosa kwaye. Ase ayio akagokigwa mono nomobono oria.
english: Then the LORD God provided a vine and made it grow up over Jonah to give shade for his head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was very happy about the vine.

ekegusii: Naki mwamanyire buna tware gosemia kera oyomo oino buna ise agosemia abana baye, na tokabaremia, na kobasorora, na kobakurera,
english: For you know that we dealt with each of you as a father deals with his own children,

ekegusii: Abayahudi abarenge Susa bagasangerereka amo naende, ase rituko ria ikomi na kane, omotienyi bw’Adari, bagaita abanto amagana atato aroro, korende tibakunete ebinto biabo kobisakora.
english: The Jews in Susa came together on the fourteenth day of the month of Adar, and they put to death in Susa three hundred men, but they did not lay their hands on the plunder.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obachike: Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kanani, eyio nero ense erabe omwando oino, chimbebe chiaye nigo chirabe iga:
english: "Command the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter Canaan, the land that will be allotted to you as an inheritance will have these boundaries:

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, moiranere oria mwasaretie asare mokamotiga.
english: Return to him you have so greatly revolted against, O Israelites.

ekegusii: Erio Yehoahasi agasaba Omonene, na Omonene akamoigwa, ekiagera aroche ogochandwa kw’Abaisraeli, buna omoruoti bw’Abasiiria abachandete.
english: Then Jehoahaz sought the LORD's favor, and the LORD listened to him, for he saw how severely the king of Aram was oppressing Israel.

ekegusii: naye mwanche Omonene Nyasae oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi.
english: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.'

ekegusii: Baalamu akaimoka mambia rituko ria kabere, akaberekia etigere yaye egeikaransero, akagenda amo nabanene baria ba Moabu.
english: Balaam got up in the morning, saddled his donkey and went with the princes of Moab.

ekegusii: Korende ekero amang’ana ayio araikeranigwe (ekiagera goika aikeranigwe), erio nario baramanye ng’a omobani narenge ase egati yabo.”
english: "When all this comes true-- and it surely will-- then they will know that a prophet has been among them."

ekegusii: Osoyie emesa, na obeke ebinto biaye igoro yaye; osoyie na ekebekerero gie chitaya, na obeke chitaya igoro yaye.
english: Bring in the table and set out what belongs on it. Then bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.

ekegusii: Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki bare ase ense, bare buna abanto bao Abaisraeli, abwo aye Nyasae kwabooretie babe abanto bao, okenyorera erieta ase engencho y’amang’ana amanene na ay’ogokumia ase ogoseria abanto b’ebisaku bakarua ase obosio bw’abanto bao baria kwabooretie korwa Misiri?
english: And who is like your people Israel-- the one nation on earth whose God went out to redeem a people for himself, and to make a name for yourself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?

ekegusii: “Nkobatebia nde inwe: Ekorere abasani nenibo y’ense eye etari boronge, erinde ekero egochia gokea, babaroisie inwe ase obomenyo bwa kare na kare.
english: I tell you, use worldly wealth to gain friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, you will be welcomed into eternal dwellings.

ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao korwa agwo igoro, ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amache aya amange, na korwa ase amaboko ’abanto be chinse chingeni,
english: Reach down your hand from on high; deliver me and rescue me from the mighty waters, from the hands of foreigners

ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akaminyoka bwango gochia komorotota, akamosaba, “Koranche, ong’e amache inywe.”
english: The servant hurried to meet her and said, "Please give me a little water from your jar."

ekegusii: Agasoyia emiaro eria ase chibonyi chire chinsemo chi’egesasimero, erinde kenyare kobogorerigwa. Agakeagacha ne chibao, akagetiga giasaime.
english: They inserted the poles into the rings so they would be on the sides of the altar for carrying it. They made it hollow, out of boards.

ekegusii: Inee! Egetureri gi’esegi nkebugigwe ase omochie, na abanto tibaba nobwoba? Amang’ana amabe nabe ase omochie, Omonene atayatometi?
english: When a trumpet sounds in a city, do not the people tremble? When disaster comes to a city, has not the LORD caused it?

ekegusii: Emebere yaino ekw ete nebe endagera ye chinyoni chia igoro, na eye ching’iti chi’orosana, na onde tari orachiserie achioboyie.
english: Your carcasses will be food for all the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to frighten them away.

ekegusii: Abwo basimekire ase enyomba y’Omonene, nigo baragenderere koreereta ase chigoora chia Nyasae oito.
english: planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.

ekegusii: Erio Eli nigo arenge koba ogosesenia Elikana na mokaye, atebia Elikana, “Omonene asesenie omokungu oyo akoiborere abana bande babe ribaga ri’omwana oyo gwatananete ase Omonene.” Erio baba bakoirana gochia nka.
english: Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, saying, "May the LORD give you children by this woman to take the place of the one she prayed for and gave to the LORD." Then they would go home.

ekegusii: korwa ase orw’Adonikamu, abachete nyuma y’abande nabwo aba: Elifeleti, na Yeueli, na Semaya, na amo nabarabwo abasacha emerongo etano nomo (60);
english: of the descendants of Adonikam, the last ones, whose names were Eliphelet, Jeuel and Shemaiah, and with them 60 men;

ekegusii: Oborito bw’e bigera biria asabete aegwe nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro emerongo ebere. Amo nebio akaira chisonoi, na ebigera, ne chianga chimonyinga, ebinto abaruoti b’Abamidiani barenge kobeka, amo ne chisonoi chiria chiarenge ase amagoti e chingamia chiabo.
english: The weight of the gold rings he asked for came to seventeen hundred shekels, not counting the ornaments, the pendants and the purple garments worn by the kings of Midian or the chains that were on their camels' necks.

ekegusii: “Gaki, timwechandera ay’ankio, ekiagera ankio nariechande rinyene. Kera rituko ndiisaine nogwechanda kwaye.
english: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.

ekegusii: Naki amatuko nache ekero abanto baratebe: Mbasesenirie abare abagomba, ne chinda chitaiboreti, ne chimbeere chitana kogonkwa!
english: For the time will come when you will say, 'Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!'

ekegusii: Aya agakoreka. Bakarusia abaruoti baria batano korwa ase rikuruma: omoruoti o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni, na oyo o Yerimuti, na oyo o Lakisi, na oyo bw’Egiloni, bakabarenta ase Yoshua.
english: So they brought the five kings out of the cave-- the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon.

ekegusii: Ekero atongete igoro chionsi nao narenge, boigo nekero abekerete amache chimbebe.
english: I was there when he set the heavens in place, when he marked out the horizon on the face of the deep,

ekegusii: “Omonene agantebia: Rora, nachakire kobeka Sihoni amo nense yaye ase amaboko aino. Ase ayio, chaka koira ense yaye ebe eyaino.
english: The LORD said to me, "See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his country over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land."

ekegusii: Abatamoirogeti Omonene nigo banchayete na gonchecheria, bakangecha bakaba bakondiananeria amaino.
english: Like the ungodly they maliciously mocked; they gnashed their teeth at me.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Sanibalati korwa Beti-Horoni, na Tobia, omonene bw’orogongo rw’Abaamoni, baigwete ng’a omonto gete ochire gokorera Abaisraeli amaya, bakagechigwa bakaba nekeririanda ekenene mono.
english: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about this, they were very much disturbed that someone had come to promote the welfare of the Israelites.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani: Chiamate chia Sotai, na Hasofereti, na Peruda;
english: The descendants of the servants of Solomon: the descendants of Sotai, Hassophereth, Peruda,

ekegusii: Korende tinegenete amang’ana ayio nare koigwa goika ekero nachicha aa na kwerorera namaiso aane inche omonyene. Bono narorire ng’a tinatebetigwe nonya nekeng’ese ki’amang’ana aya. Obong’aini bwao, na obotenenku bwao biaetanirie amang’ana konya nkoigwa.
english: But I did not believe these things until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half was told me; in wisdom and wealth you have far exceeded the report I heard.

ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene akabatiga bakabugwa na Yabini, omoruoti o Kanani, oyorenge kogambera omochie o Hasori. Omotang’ani bw’emeganda yaye y’esegi nigo are korokwa Sisera. Ere nigo amenyete Haroseti, omochie bw’Ebisaku.
english: So the LORD sold them into the hands of Jabin, a king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. The commander of his army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth Haggoyim.

ekegusii: Omonene, kumba igoro chiao ochiche inse aa! Kuna ebitunwa, erinde bisokie erioki.
english: Part your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, so that they smoke.

ekegusii: chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri; egatani engiya na amanya e chimbori;
english: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;

ekegusii: Agripa agatebia Paulo, “Ase amang’ana amake norigetie gonkora imbe Omokristo.”
english: Then Agrippa said to Paul, "Do you think that in such a short time you can persuade me to be a Christian?"

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekero nkoamererania naye, nigo okonyorekana kore omonyene oboronge. Nonya nabo, ngokwana inde naye igoro y’amang’ana ’oboronge. Nase ki chinchera chi’abakori amabe chikoba nogosesenigwa? Nase ki abanto abang’ainereria bagendererete koba buya?
english: You are always righteous, O LORD, when I bring a case before you. Yet I would speak with you about your justice: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?

ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri, chinguru chiabo nigo chire buna echi’eng’era. Barabwo mbasirie abanto abare mamincha yabo, babune amauga ’emebere y’ababisa babo, na babarase ne chinsara chiabo.
english: "God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox. They devour hostile nations and break their bones in pieces; with their arrows they pierce them.

ekegusii: Ime ase ebio nigo mwabigenderete kare ase ogotunyana chingencho chi’ense eye, na gotunyana omogambi bw’okobua kwa igoro gati, oyore omoika oria ogokora emeremo ase abanto bataigwereti Nyasae.
english: in which you used to live when you followed the ways of this world and of the ruler of the kingdom of the air, the spirit who is now at work in those who are disobedient.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Aaria Nyamache, Bobasi ime ya Kisii County, obokongu mbwabete. Omosacha oyomo nigo aitete omwana na mokaye, nere gweeita ase eng'encho abaibori b' omokungu bakanete buna enywomo gati ya aba baere tekoba ase eng'encho bare ab' enyomba eyemo. Abrahama Moseti amo n' Alice Okemwa nigo baumeranete aaria Nairobi, bakamenya aamo n' konyora omwana oyomo. Bono ekero aba bagenda sobo omokungu erinde komanya abaibori ba mokaye, abaibori bakabatebia buna nigo ere chimuma ase aba babere konywomana ekiagera nigo bare ab' enyomba eyemo. Gotebigwa iga, Abraham Moseti akaigwa obororo kegima na gosamba enyomba yaye. Omwana ere nigo asirerete abwo abo. Korwa abwo, mokaye, omosubati Alice Okemwa nere agasirera aaria Kenyatta National Hospital, abwo ase aminyogetigwe gochia kobwenigwa. Omosacha oyo ere nigo akwerete nchera, gakominyokigwa gochia ase enyagitari kobwenigwa. Kobwatekana n' Ekegusii, Omometobo amo n' Omokiama tibari konywomerana, ekigera aba n' abana bare ab' enyomba eyemo. Igwa bono courtesy of NTV, Nyamache, Kisii County.
english: These are the details: Aaria Nyamache, Bobasi within Kisii County, a very sad incident. The old man and his wife, they say he took his child and went, truly speaking, he went with his children to bury them because the pain of those people was too much, they said he went to join them in death. Abraham Moseti and Alice Okemwa were married in Nairobi, they planned and decided to have a child. Truly this matter, the people went to seek help from their relatives, the relatives tried to stop him, but it was difficult to prevent those people from dying together. It is reported that Abraham Moseti fell ill and destroyed his house. The child is the one who survived all of this. After this, the wife, Alice Okemwa went to Kenyatta National Hospital, where she received treatment and recovered. The old man also got sick, and he was treated and recovered. According to Ekegusii tradition, grandfathers and grandmothers do not agree, which leads to the deaths of their grandchildren. This news courtesy of NTV, Nyamache, Kisii County.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato agatiga abanto bakagenda, na barabwo bagasesenia omoruoti, bakagenda chinka chiabo bare nomogoko na omosasoko ase chinkoro chiabo ase engencho y’obuya bwonsi boria Omonene akorerete Daudi, omosomba oye, na Abaisraeli, abanto baye.
english: On the following day he sent the people away. They blessed the king and then went home, joyful and glad in heart for all the good things the LORD had done for his servant David and his people Israel.

ekegusii: Inee! Musa tabaete amachiko? Korende onde oino tari oyobwatete amachiko. Nase ki mokorigia kong’ita?”
english: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill me?"

ekegusii: ekiagera ase engencho y’emeremo ya Kristo akaba ang’e ase ogokwa, tarendete obogima bwaye ase ogoisanera ayaremete ase ogokora kwaino asende.
english: because he almost died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for the help you could not give me.

ekegusii: Ebinyomba biaye bi’oborendi, ne chisiiro, na egesona, nigo biareng’aine nebi’amaagacho ande. Ebibao nigo biarenge ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.
english: as did its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico, and it had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

ekegusii: Naigure amang’ana korwa ase Omonene; omonto otomirwe ase egati y’ebisaku, kobitebia: “Sangererekana amo, mochiche korwania omochie o Bosira, imoka moyorwanie!
english: I have heard a message from the LORD: An envoy was sent to the nations to say, "Assemble yourselves to attack it! Rise up for battle!"

ekegusii: Abaefraimu mbasirigwe kegima ase rituko riria ri’egesusuro. Ase egati y’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli inche nararirie, ayarache goikeranigwa ekeene.
english: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of reckoning. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.

ekegusii: Nonya nekero Elinatani, na Delaya, na Gemaria basororete omoruoti ng’a tabaisa gosamba ebuku eria, tabaigwerete.
english: Even though Elnathan, Delaiah and Gemariah urged the king not to burn the scroll, he would not listen to them.

ekegusii: Rituko riria riarenge kobwatia akaba omoremu mono gouta omorero erinde anyare koigwa riberera. Gotatiga rende anyuotete ime yekerongo keria omorangu oria gosiekire – erio anyare koba tu ase omorembe. “Ninde nobomaene buna kende tikeiyo kerakorekane ing’ise gosamba akanyama gake igo. Nigo erabe buya koria endagera eiyekire.”
kiswahili: Kesho yake alipata ukakamavu, akawasha moto ili kuondoa baridi. Lakini aliwasha moto huo ndani ya pango kwa kuogopa majitu. Aliufunga mlango kabisa. “Nina hakika hakuna hatari nikichoma nyama kwa moto huu. Chakula cha kuchomwa ni kitamu.”

ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene! Omonene, Nyasae one, aye nigo ore omonene mono; nigo bweboetie ogosikwa na obonene.
english: Praise the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ngokoinyoria, oigererie ekeegwa ekiarure ase Nyasae, ekere ime yao, ekio kwaetwe ekero nakobekerete amaboko aane,
english: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

ekegusii: Na barabwo nigo baare gotera ogotera kwa Musa, omosomba o Nyasae, na ogotera kw’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi, bagoteba, “Ogokora kwao nokonene na okw’ogokumia, aye Omonene Nyasae Omobui! Chinchera chiao nechi’oboronge na echi’ekeene, aye omoruoti bw’abanto b’ebisaku.
english: and sang the song of Moses the servant of God and the song of the Lamb: "Great and marvelous are your deeds, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of the ages.

ekegusii: Nyasae akabasesenia, akabatebia, “Moibore, momenteke, moichore ase ense, na moyegambere. Mogambere ne chinswe chia nyancha, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka, na kera egetongwa kere moyo kegotaara igoro ase ense,”
english: God blessed them and said to them, "Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and over every living creature that moves on the ground."

ekegusii: Omonene, naki gwatotigire togosaria na gotiga chinchera chiao? Aye gwakorire chinkoro chiaito chiabeire chinkong’u chitari gokoiroka. Toiranere ase engencho y’abasomba bao, na ase engencho y’ebisaku bire omwando oo.
english: Why, O LORD, do you make us wander from your ways and harden our hearts so we do not revere you? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes that are your inheritance.

ekegusii: Na barabwo nabamorore obosio bwaye, na erieta riaye naribe ase amasio abo igoro.
english: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

ekegusii: "See, I have chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
english: “Rora, nachorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri, bw’egesaku kia Yuda.

ekegusii: Ase obogima bwane bwonsi nabeire inde nemechando; na ase emiaka yane yonsi nabeire inde nomoichano; chinguru chiane chiaerire ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane; amauga ’omobere one omire pa.
english: My life is consumed by anguish and my years by groaning; my strength fails because of my affliction, and my bones grow weak.

ekegusii: Laban also said to Jacob, "Here is this heap, and here is this pillar I have set up between you and me.
english: Erio Labani agatebia Yakobo, “Rigereria etui eye na esiiro eye, natenenirie egati yao nainche.

ekegusii: and his firstborn son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
english: Omwana oye omomura omotangi nere Abidoni; na abande nabwo aba: Suri na Kisi, Baali na Nadabu,

ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titori gokwana boronge ng’a aye nigo ore Omosamaria, naende nigo obwatire nekerecha?”
english: The Jews answered him, "Aren't we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?"

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia akaboria Zedekia omoruoti, “Mang’ana ki amabe nakorire asore, gose ase abasomba bao, gose ase abanto aba goika kwambekire ase echela?
english: Then Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, "What crime have I committed against you or your officials or this people, that you have put me in prison?

ekegusii: Then Job replied:
english: Ayubu akairaneria, akabora,

ekegusii: Daudi akaboria Abagibeoni, “Ninki nkobakorera? Nindigetie gokora okobwatanigwa ase engencho y’obobe mwakoreretwe, erinde mosesenie abanto b’Omonene.”
english: David asked the Gibeonites, "What shall I do for you? How shall I make amends so that you will bless the LORD's inheritance?"

ekegusii: Ahasi akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa aase chiatindegetwe, ase Omochie o Daudi; na Hezekia, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo inde buna aye ase obosio bwa Nyasae; inche boigo nigo natongetwe korwa ase riroba.
english: I am just like you before God; I too have been taken from clay.

ekegusii: Hodiah, Bani and Beninu.
english: Hodia, na Bani, na Beninu.

ekegusii: Gidioni oyio nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etano na ebere, ekiagera nigo abwate abakungu abange.
english: He had seventy sons of his own, for he had many wives.

ekegusii: “Nimbae abanto baane ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’Abamisiri; ekero moragende, timokogenda more namaboko amasa.
english: "And I will make the Egyptians favorably disposed toward this people, so that when you leave you will not go empty-handed.

ekegusii: Abana ba Shemu nabwo aba: Elamu, na Asuri, na Arifaksadi, na Ludi, na Aramu.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram.

ekegusii: Oboremo oboyia bw’omonto omotaka nigo bokwama endagera enyinge, korende enyinge nigo egosiara‐siarerwa yasira ase engencho y’obobe.
english: A poor man's field may produce abundant food, but injustice sweeps it away.

ekegusii: Ase omosangererekano omonene narandirie amang’ana amaya ay’oboronge; aye Omonene, nomanyete ng’a tingotanga ebikoba biane tibiyakwana.
english: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; I do not seal my lips, as you know, O LORD.

ekegusii: Motige gokorera bobe omonto omomenyi ore asemore, ne chintakana, na ababoraka, gose aase aiga timoitera amanyinga ’abanto batari na komocha, naende motige gosasima chinyasae ching’ao chiria chirabarentere ogosirigwa.
english: if you do not oppress the alien, the fatherless or the widow and do not shed innocent blood in this place, and if you do not follow other gods to your own harm,

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, engereria abanto abwo bakoengererania nainche, rwania abwo bakondwania!
english: Of David. Contend, O LORD, with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.

ekegusii: Ning’inyorete okwegena ore nakorokwo, ogotari nobong’ainereria, okwo kwarenge ritang’ani ase nyagokoro Lois na ase nyoko Yunuke, na inche ninde nobomaene ng’a naye nokobwate boigo.
english: I have been reminded of your sincere faith, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, now lives in you also.

ekegusii: Mbuya toria eira kobua koria eira na toyeikerania.
english: It is better not to vow than to make a vow and not fulfill it.

ekegusii: Nairane agende ase chiburi chi’ense yaye omonyene, korende nagochwe agwe, takonyorekana naende.
english: After this, he will turn back toward the fortresses of his own country but will stumble and fall, to be seen no more.

ekegusii: Nyasae akairaneria Sulemani, “Ekiagera okogania okwo kore ime ase enkoro yao, naende toboreti oegwe obotenenku, gose obonda, gose ogosikwa, gose ogosirigwa kw’obogima bw’abanto baria bakogechete, gose toboreti oegwe obogima obotambe, korende kwaboririe oegwe obong’aini ne chisemi, erinde omanye kogambera abanto baane abwo nakobekire obe omoruoti obo,
english: God said to Solomon, "Since this is your heart's desire and you have not asked for wealth, riches or honor, nor for the death of your enemies, and since you have not asked for a long life but for wisdom and knowledge to govern my people over whom I have made you king,

ekegusii: Ase ayio irana ogende nomorembe, erinde tobaisa gokora gento ase okogechia abanene b’Abafilisti.”
english: Turn back and go in peace; do nothing to displease the Philistine rulers."

ekegusii: “Mobe mokorenda Epasaka y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ase omotienyi bw’Abibu, ekiagera ase obotuko obomo bw’omotienyi oyio, nario Omonene, Nyasae oino abarusetie Misiri.
english: Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover of the LORD your God, because in the month of Abib he brought you out of Egypt by night.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogokuna kende gionsi getachenegeti, korabe omobere okwete bw’eng’iti y’orosana etachenegeti, gose oyo bw’eng’iti etugire etachenegeti, gose oyo bw’akang’iti agake gatechenegeti, nonya amang’ana ayio abisekanete, ere nabe oyotachenegeti, abarerwe obobe bwaye.
english: "'Or if a person touches anything ceremonially unclean-- whether the carcasses of unclean wild animals or of unclean livestock or of unclean creatures that move along the ground-- even though he is unaware of it, he has become unclean and is guilty.

ekegusii: Aase bagoutera omorero na gosambera ebing’wanso igoro y’egesasimero nigo arenge ay’ekerengo ki’amaboko ane gochia igoro, na korwa aroro emegwekano ene ye chingunchara yaroisirie yarochie igoro.
english: The altar hearth is four cubits high, and four horns project upward from the hearth.

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti bw’Abayuda oikaransete ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Daudi, aye amo nabasomba bao, na abanto bao mogosoera ebiita ebi, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
english: 'Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, you who sit on David's throne-- you, your officials and your people who come through these gates.

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Renda na koigwera amang’ana onsi aya nabekire abe kirori asemore ase rituko ria rero, mochike abana baino babwate na gokora amang’ana onsi ay’amachiko ayio.
english: he said to them, "Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to obey carefully all the words of this law.

ekegusii: omokuani akore rigori ri’oboremo boria koreng’ana nemiaka etigarete goika Omwaka bw’Omochengo. Ase rituko riria kegima omonto oria aakane rigori riria ribekire, ne chibesa echi chibe chiatananirwe ase Omonene.
english: the priest will determine its value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the man must pay its value on that day as something holy to the LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Sayoni nigo bakoigwa ayio bagoka, na ab’emechie ya Yuda bachenga, ekiagera aye Nyasae kwanachire ebina.
english: Zion hears and rejoices and the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments, O LORD.

ekegusii: Ido, mosinto o Zakaria, ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, keria kiarenge agwo Gileadi; Yaasieli, mosinto bw’Abineri ase Ababenjamin;
english: over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead: Iddo son of Zechariah; over Benjamin: Jaasiel son of Abner;

ekegusii: Obwa ikomi bokagwera Simei; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Bwachia koba mobaso gati, Elija akabachecheria, akabatebia, “Aka eriogi rinene kobua, ekiagera ere nenyasae. Ande nigo akare namang’ana akorengereria, gose ngotimoka akare, gose norogendo akare, gose nigo araire, goika aturwe.”
english: At noon Elijah began to taunt them. "Shout louder!" he said. "Surely he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or busy, or traveling. Maybe he is sleeping and must be awakened."

ekegusii: Korende Musa akabatebia, “Nase ki bono mogosaria ogochika kw’Omonene. Timokonyara konyora ogosesenigwa ase okogendao.
english: But Moses said, "Why are you disobeying the LORD's command? This will not succeed!

ekegusii: Timobaisa gotegerera amang’ana a Hezekia. Aya naro omoruoti bw’Abaasuri agoteba: Kora omorembe nainche, moche asende. Erio kera omonto asemore narie okwama kw’emesabibu na okw’emeko yaye omonyene, na kera oyomo oino nanywe amache ’ensoko yaye omonyene,
english: "Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and fig tree and drink water from his own cistern,

ekegusii: ekiagera tigekomosoa enkoro, otatiga ase enda yoka, erio kiagwa kebaara?” (Ase ogoteba igo, osibirie chindagera chionsi.)
english: For it doesn't go into his heart but into his stomach, and then out of his body." (In saying this, Jesus declared all foods "clean.")

ekegusii: buna abaruoti b’ense amo nabasemia babo bakaraire, abwo beagacherete amaagacho ’obosareku.
english: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built for themselves places now lying in ruins,

ekegusii: Ekiagera Abaedomu barinete Abaisraeli ribaga goeta ase ense yabo, Abaisraeli bakarua asebare, bagaeta ensemo eng’ao.
english: Since Edom refused to let them go through their territory, Israel turned away from them.

ekegusii: “Timontiga na koonchokera emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, gose timwekorera chinyasae korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa. Inche ninche Nyasae oino.
english: "'Do not turn to idols or make gods of cast metal for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Omosabibu oyio ogakinia chinsagia chinkong’u, chiaisanete gokorwa chinyimbo chi’abagambi. Ritina riaye rigatambea gochia igoro ase egati ye chinsagia chiaye chinyinge mono. Omote oyio okarorekana gochia aare ore ritutu rinene.
english: Its branches were strong, fit for a ruler's scepter. It towered high above the thick foliage, conspicuous for its height and for its many branches.

ekegusii: Eke nakio kiagerete nkabarikera, erinde mbateeme na komanya gose mwabeire abaigweri ase amang’ana onsi.
english: The reason I wrote you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.

ekegusii: Eng’iti ende yonsi ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, naende ekoria eng’ang’ura, nero morarie.
english: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof completely divided and that chews the cud.

ekegusii: aumore amache amachenu ase egetaabo ki’amaroba, naende aimokie amaroba korwa inse agwo ase Obomenyo Obochenu, ayabeke ime ase amache aria.
english: Then he shall take some holy water in a clay jar and put some dust from the tabernacle floor into the water.

ekegusii: Motaigwereti eriogi ri’Omonene, korende mokwanga koigwera amachiko aya, rirorio okoboko kwaye nigo korabe mamincha yaino buna kwarenge mamincha ye chisokoro chiaino.
english: But if you do not obey the LORD, and if you rebel against his commands, his hand will be against you, as it was against your fathers.

ekegusii: Amariogi ay’okorangerania koria agatengechia oboroso bw’emetobwa ya inse y’ebisieri bie Hekalu, na erioki rigaichora ime ase enyomba eria.
english: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook and the temple was filled with smoke.

ekegusii: Ning’o onga buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, oria omenyete aaria igoro mono,
english: Who is like the LORD our God, the One who sits enthroned on high,

ekegusii: na igo momanye gwatanana ebichenegete korwa ase ebitachenegeti, ne ching’iti chire moyo chiancheire koriegwa korwa ase echitancheiri koriegwa.
english: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean, between living creatures that may be eaten and those that may not be eaten.'"

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekero barenge nemechando nigo bakorigetie, ekero kwabaete egesusuro, nigo bagosabete mono.
english: LORD, they came to you in their distress; when you disciplined them, they could barely whisper a prayer.

ekegusii: Ekaba Daudi gaikire Mahanaimu, akanyorana na Sobi, mosinto o Nahasi, korwa Raba, ase ense y’Abaamoni, na Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, korwa Lo‐Debari, na Barisilai Omogileadi korwa Rogelimu.
english: When David came to Mahanaim, Shobi son of Nahash from Rabbah of the Ammonites, and Makir son of Ammiel from Lo Debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim

ekegusii: Omonene nigo asinyetwe koira abanto aba ase ense eria konya arire eira akobaa; ase ayio obaiteire ase erooro.
english: 'The LORD was not able to bring these people into the land he promised them on oath; so he slaughtered them in the desert.'

ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na abagaaka b’abanto bagasangererekana ase egoora y’omokuani omonene oyore korokwa Kayafa;
english: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people assembled in the palace of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,

ekegusii: Oyomo ase aborokia b’amariko agacha akabaigwa bakoamererania nere, akamanya ng’a obairaneirie buya, akamoboria, “Ase amachiko onsi ndiriri rire rie ritang’ani?”
english: One of the teachers of the law came and heard them debating. Noticing that Jesus had given them a good answer, he asked him, "Of all the commandments, which is the most important?"

ekegusii: Ekero oyomo ase abwo baikaransete ase endagera amo nere achia koyaigwa akamotebia, “Nasesenirie oyoranyare koria omogati ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae!”
english: When one of those at the table with him heard this, he said to Jesus, "Blessed is the man who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God."

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia agakwana nabanene bonsi b’oboruoti, na abanto bonsi, akabatebia, “Omonene nere ontoma kobana mamincha y’enyomba eye na omochie oyo amang’ana ayio onsi mwaigwa.
english: Then Jeremiah said to all the officials and all the people: "The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and this city all the things you have heard.

ekegusii: "Simeon and Levi are brothers-- their swords are weapons of violence.
english: “Simeoni na Lawi naba ng’ina omo, ebirwanero biabo nebi’obotindi.

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mbatiso ki mwabatisetwe?” Bakamoiraneria, “Ase ebatiso ya Yohana.”
english: So Paul asked, "Then what baptism did you receive?" "John's baptism," they replied.

ekegusii: Ng’ai ngochia goeta nobosooku obo? Naye nigo orabe buna oyomo, bw’abakayayu bare ase Abaisraeli. Bono, koranche oborie omoruoti akoe ribaga onyuome.”
english: What about me? Where could I get rid of my disgrace? And what about you? You would be like one of the wicked fools in Israel. Please speak to the king; he will not keep me from being married to you."

ekegusii: Morue chieri ikomi na isato, ne chimingichi ibore, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari ne kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echio nchibe ekengw’anso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
english: Present an offering made by fire as an aroma pleasing to the LORD, a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: Motebereranie ase chizaburi, na amatera, ne chingero chi’omoika; motere na kobugia amariogi ase Omonene ase chinkoro chiaino,
english: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your heart to the Lord,

ekegusii: erinde anyare kwenyorera ekanisa y’obonene, etari na kemoa gose omonia, gose rinde rionsi buna aya, korende ebe enchenu etari na komocha.
english: and to present her to himself as a radiant church, without stain or wrinkle or any other blemish, but holy and blameless.

ekegusii: Erio Paulo akaira abasacha baria, ne rituko ria kabere agakora buna engencho yare y’ogwesibia amo nabarabwo. Erio agasoa Hekalu ime, ase okoraria amang’ana ’ogwesibia na engaki y’okorua esadaka ase engencho ya kera oyomo obo.
english: The next day Paul took the men and purified himself along with them. Then he went to the temple to give notice of the date when the days of purification would end and the offering would be made for each of them.

ekegusii: Nonya mbwate amang’ana amange nanga nabarikera, tindigeti koyarika ase ekaratasi na ewino, korende ninsemeretie gocha asemore gokwana nainwe obosio ase obosio, erinde omogoko oito oikeranigwe.
english: I have much to write to you, but I do not want to use paper and ink. Instead, I hope to visit you and talk with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.

ekegusii: Inse y’obochiki bwabo nigo barenge abanto chilifu amagana atato na isano na ibere, na amagana atano (307,500). Barabwo nigo barenge korwana esegi ne chinguru na oboremu, gokonya omoruoti ase okorwania ababisa baye.
english: Under their command was an army of 307,500 men trained for war, a powerful force to support the king against his enemies.

ekegusii: Nigo gwatebete ase enkoro yao ime: Inche nintiire gochia igoro aaria, ngende ng’etanie ching’enang’eni chia Nyasae, nimbeke ekerogo kiane ki’obonene aaria igoro. Ning’ikaranse ase egetunwa ki’omosangererekano aaria sugusu aare.
english: You said in your heart, "I will ascend to heaven; I will raise my throne above the stars of God; I will sit enthroned on the mount of assembly, on the utmost heights of the sacred mountain.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omonto oyio ogokwana: “Ninyeagachere enyomba enene, enachanire chiero chinene ase rirongo riaye. Nigo akobochora chitirisa chingare ase enyomba eria, naende ochabera chinyasi nemecharake na oyeaka erangi embariri ye rigori rinene.
english: He says, 'I will build myself a great palace with spacious upper rooms.' So he makes large windows in it, panels it with cedar and decorates it in red.

ekegusii: Boigo oire chifeta ne chitahabu chionsi, echio oranyore korwa ase ense yonsi ya Babeli, oire nokoruegwa kw’ogwancha okwo abanto na abakuani bararue ase enyomba ya Nyasae obo ere Yerusalemu.
english: together with all the silver and gold you may obtain from the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests for the temple of their God in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ekero gavuna achia korora ayakoreka, akeegena, agakumia ase okworokereria kw’Omonene.
english: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was amazed at the teaching about the Lord.

ekegusii: Kera omote nigo okomanyekana ase amatunda aye. Naki ase emetobo abanto tibari gotwa amako, gose ase emenyenya tibari gotwa amasabibu.
english: Each tree is recognized by its own fruit. People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.

ekegusii: “Emechando eye nigo yarure ase Omonene. Ninki rende nganyete inyore korwa ase Omonene?”
english: While he was still talking to them, the messenger came down to him. And [the king] said, "This disaster is from the LORD. Why should I wait for the LORD any longer?"

ekegusii: Igo ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete goetera ase Yeremia rigaikeranigwa, na ense eria nigo yatimogete. Ekero ense eria yatigarete ere amatongo, nigo yarendete Esabato, goika emiaka emerongo etano na ebere ekaera.
english: The land enjoyed its sabbath rests; all the time of its desolation it rested, until the seventy years were completed in fulfillment of the word of the LORD spoken by Jeremiah.

ekegusii: “Onye omokuani oyoakire amaguta ogokora ebibe, na igo arentere abanto bonsi okomocha, goika arue eeri ensae etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ase engencho y’ebibe ebio akorire, ayerue asende ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye.
english: "'If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the LORD a young bull without defect as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.

ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoa Hekalu ime na kworokereria, agachierwa nabakuani abanene na abagaaka b’abanto, bakamoboria, “Nase okobua ki ogokora amang’ana aya? Ning’o okoete okobua oko?”
english: Jesus entered the temple courts, and, while he was teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him. "By what authority are you doing these things?" they asked. "And who gave you this authority?"

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, tibeatananete korwa ase ebibe bi’enyomba ya Yeroboamu, biria ere akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe, korende bakaba bakogenderera kobikora. Boigo omote bw’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, ogatigara agwo Samaria.
english: But they did not turn away from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit; they continued in them. Also, the Asherah pole remained standing in Samaria.

ekegusii: “Inche omoruoti, amo nabasemia baane batano na babere, twagotomire ogende komanya amang’ana ’ense y’Abayuda, na aya Yerusalemu, kobwatekana namachiko a Nyasae oo, ayio obwate ase okoboko kwao.
english: You are sent by the king and his seven advisers to inquire about Judah and Jerusalem with regard to the Law of your God, which is in your hand.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria barabwo bagachanda Abaisraeli na kobakorera bobe. Ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi, na etano na etato, bagachanda Abaisraeli bonsi abamenyete moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodan ase ense y’Abaamori ase Gileadi.
english: who that year shattered and crushed them. For eighteen years they oppressed all the Israelites on the east side of the Jordan in Gilead, the land of the Amorites.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simeoni. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana abere (22,200).
english: These were the clans of Simeon; there were 22,200 men.

ekegusii: Ekiagera mwatenenkigwe ase ebinto bionsi monyare koba nokorua gwonsi gokogera Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono goetera ase emeremo yaito.
english: You will be made rich in every way so that you can be generous on every occasion, and through us your generosity will result in thanksgiving to God.

ekegusii: Ninki morakore ekero Rituko Rinene ri’omoyega bw’Omonene riraike?
english: What will you do on the day of your appointed feasts, on the festival days of the LORD?

ekegusii: Ekeene, aba bonsi baganetie koba ne chingencho chi’obonyasae ase Kristo Yeso nabachandwe.
english: In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,

ekegusii: Buna mwabeire mokonywera igoro ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, naboigo nabanto b’ebisaku bionsi baragenderere konywa botambe, ee, mbanywe bakoore nonya neturubo yonsi, na babe buna tibarengeo.”
english: Just as you drank on my holy hill, so all the nations will drink continually; they will drink and drink and be as if they had never been.

ekegusii: Moyarike ase emetobwa na ase emeriibo y’ebisieri bie chinyomba chiaino, na ase ebiita biaino.
english: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates,

ekegusii: Naki monto onde tari ogokora ring’ana bobisi onye ere omonyene origetie komanyekana. Kogokora aya eorokie ase ense.”
english: No one who wants to become a public figure acts in secret. Since you are doing these things, show yourself to the world."

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oo, atogigwe, oria ogokigwe asore na gokobeka ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, obe omoruoti ase obosio bwaye, ere Omonene, Nyasae oo! Ekiagera ere anchete Abaisraeli botambe, na akabakong’ia bakaba ne chinguru kare na kare, ogokorire aye koba omoruoti igoro asebare, erinde onyare konacha ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge.”
english: Praise be to the LORD your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on his throne as king to rule for the LORD your God. Because of the love of your God for Israel and his desire to uphold them forever, he has made you king over them, to maintain justice and righteousness."

ekegusii: Nigoro gwacha aa. Nase ki ndagotige ontunyane na kona‐koong’anya amo nainche, nainche timanyeti nonya naase ngochia? Irana amo nabamino, na Omonene akoorokerie obwanchani bwaye botari koera na obwegenwa bwaye.”
english: You came only yesterday. And today shall I make you wander about with us, when I do not know where I am going? Go back, and take your countrymen. May kindness and faithfulness be with you."

ekegusii: “Mbarabi aba bagoeta buna amare agoeta igoro, aba banga buna amaruma akoiruruka gochia ase ebiswa biabo?
english: "Who are these that fly along like clouds, like doves to their nests?

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakobekana chinguru ase ogokora ebibe ebio barobeirie; nigo bagokwana amo igoro y’ogotegera abande oboreba bobisi, bagotebania, “Ning’o otoroche?”
english: They encourage each other in evil plans, they talk about hiding their snares; they say, "Who will see them?"

ekegusii: na ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o kabere bagasangereria omoganda bwonsi bw’abanto amo. Bakarika amarieta ’abanto abwo konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba, na omonto ase omonto.
english: and they called the whole community together on the first day of the second month. The people indicated their ancestry by their clans and families, and the men twenty years old or more were listed by name, one by one,

ekegusii: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes food?
english: Inee! Amang’ana ogoto gokoigwa, tikori koyateema buna oromeme rokomena rwaigwa endagera?”

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nere onyorokirie amang’ana ayio na gontebia, “Ekeene, timokwaberwa ebibe ebio nonya ng’ake.” Omonene bw’Emeganda otebire ayio.
english: The LORD Almighty has revealed this in my hearing: "Till your dying day this sin will not be atoned for," says the Lord, the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Okwama nkorua nigo kore okuya kobua etahabu, ee, kobua etahabu engiya, na ebitoki nkorua mbibuete efeta enchore.
english: My fruit is better than fine gold; what I yield surpasses choice silver.

ekegusii: Egesaku gi’Aseri keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Dani korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "Asher will have one portion; it will border the territory of Dan from east to west.

ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae rikagenderera komentekana.
english: But the word of God continued to increase and spread.

ekegusii: Naama! Inche ngoseegeta nde omoganda bw’ebisaku ebinene, korwa ase ense ya sugusu, na barabwo bebeke ang’e korwania Babeli bayobue korwa ensemo eria ya sugusu. Chinsara chiabo nigo chinga buna omorwani omong’aini ore neganga otari koirana bosa.
english: For I will stir up and bring against Babylon an alliance of great nations from the land of the north. They will take up their positions against her, and from the north she will be captured. Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed.

ekegusii: “Amachiko narengeo, na ababani boigo, goika ekero kia Yohana. Korwa ekero keria amang’ana amaya ay’oboruoti bwa Nyasae nkorandigwa are, na kera omonto nigo akobosoa ne chinguru.
english: "The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the good news of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

ekegusii: Omonto terigeria kwenyorera ebiya, korende arigerie omogisangio oye ebiya.
english: Nobody should seek his own good, but the good of others.

ekegusii: My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.
english: Omonwa one noichorigwe nogotogigwa kwao, na omobaso boira ninkobake.

ekegusii: Akamorigereria mono, akairoka, akamoboria, “Naki Omonene?” Akamoiraneria, “Ogosaba kwao na ebiegwa biao biaikire igoro, na biabeire ekeinyorio ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: Cornelius stared at him in fear. "What is it, Lord?" he asked. The angel answered, "Your prayers and gifts to the poor have come up as a memorial offering before God.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ing’a inche, omosomba oo, okomanya kw’obong’aini gw’okogambera abanto bao, erio nario ndamanye gwatanana amaya na amabe. Naki ning’o oranyare kogambera abanto aba bao abange?”
english: So give your servant a discerning heart to govern your people and to distinguish between right and wrong. For who is able to govern this great people of yours?"

ekegusii: “Naama! Rituko riria ngocha rire! Ngocha rire! Egeku nkobachera kere! Enyimbo y’okobaaka yasebokire, na obomwenu bwareeretire.
english: "The day is here! It has come! Doom has burst forth, the rod has budded, arrogance has blossomed!

ekegusii: “Imoka obare, ekiagera omobaso oo ochire, na obonene bw’Omonene bwakobareire.
english: "Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.

ekegusii: Obaboerie chinkini ebinema biabo, Haroni na abamura baye, na obabekere ebigogwa emetwe yabo. Ase enchera eyio bwatanane Haroni amo nabamura baye babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani kogenderera botambe.
english: and put headbands on them. Then tie sashes on Aaron and his sons. The priesthood is theirs by a lasting ordinance. In this way you shall ordain Aaron and his sons.

ekegusii: Ekero ekoimoka gotenena, abanto chituoni nigo bakwoboa mono; ekero ekorindoka gocha nigo bagotang’ang’a.
english: When he rises up, the mighty are terrified; they retreat before his thrashing.

ekegusii: Ritang’ani naakeire Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono ase Yeso Kristo ase engencho yaino inwe mwensi, ekiagera okwegena kwaino kwamanyekanire ase ense yonsi.
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is being reported all over the world.

ekegusii: Aaria chisokoro chiaino nigo chianteemete, nonya chiaroche emeremo yane nigo chiandengete.
english: where your fathers tested and tried me, though they had seen what I did.

ekegusii: Naende inche ninsabe Tata, na ere nabae Omokonyi onde oyoramenye amo nainwe goika kare na kare,
english: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Counselor to be with you forever--

ekegusii: Kanywe amache okobucha korwa ase egesima kiao, na aya agosoka korwa ase ensoko yao.
english: Drink water from your own cistern, running water from your own well.

ekegusii: Abana abake, nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe. Namondigie; korende buna natebetie Abayahudi, ng’a aase ngochia inche, inwe timokonyara gochao, bono nabatebirie nainwe.
english: "My children, I will be with you only a little longer. You will look for me, and just as I told the Jews, so I tell you now: Where I am going, you cannot come.

ekegusii: Obo nigo bogotworokereria okwanga amang’ana atari ay’obonyasae, na okogania okobe gw’ense eye, erinde tonyare kwerenda ase onsi, na koba noboronge amo ne chingencho chi’obonyasae ase ense eye ya bono,
english: It teaches us to say "No" to ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright and godly lives in this present age,

ekegusii: The son of Uzziel: Micah; from the sons of Micah: Shamir.
english: Mika bw’ororeria rwa Usieli, na Samiri bw’ororeria rwa Mika;

ekegusii: korende buna erikire, “Aya eriso ritaroche, gose ogoto gotaigwete, gose aya atarengereirie ase enkoro y’omonto, ayio Nyasae aroiseretie abamwanchete.”
english: However, as it is written: "No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no mind has conceived what God has prepared for those who love him"--

ekegusii: Nigo nanga nakorentete mwa baba, obe gokonyorokereria. Nigo nare gocha gokoa onywe edivai yochoganirie ebinsari, naende nkoe amache amitire korwa ase amakomomanga aane.
english: I would lead you and bring you to my mother's house-- she who has taught me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the nectar of my pomegranates.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakoroka ayare amabe amaya, na ayare amaya amabe, na babeka omosunte ase oborabu bore, na oborabu ase omosunte ore, na babeka obororo ribaga ri’obwansu, na obwansu ribaga ri’obororo.
english: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter.

ekegusii: Abarwani esegi b’Abakalidayo bakabwatia Zedekia omoruoti, bakamoikeera agwo ase ense omweya ya Yeriko ekero abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi konya bamotigire baserebekanire.
english: but the Babylonian army pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,

ekegusii: But the Egyptians mistreated us and made us suffer, putting us to hard labor.
english: Abamisiri bagatokora bobe, bakaba bagotochanda na gotokoria emeremo emekong’u.

ekegusii: naende, “Omonene nigo amanyete okorengereria kw’abare nobong’aini ng’a nokwa bosa.”
english: and again, "The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile."

ekegusii: Korende omogondo bw’emesabibu oyore oyone bori ninche omonyene nyorendete. Aye Sulemani, ira chilifu chiao, na abarendi b’amatunda baire amagana abere.
english: But my own vineyard is mine to give; the thousand shekels are for you, O Solomon, and two hundred are for those who tend its fruit.

ekegusii: Onye okomoa omomura oye abe mokaye, rirorio amwanche buna omwana oye omoiseke.
english: If he selects her for his son, he must grant her the rights of a daughter.

ekegusii: Chiema chiaito chiasarekire; Chingori chi’ogochisibera chiabutoirwe. Abana baito basirire, tibari aande. Omonto tari ogotenenia chiema naende. Onde tari oratosungere ebitambaa bie chiema chiaito.
english: My tent is destroyed; all its ropes are snapped. My sons are gone from me and are no more; no one is left now to pitch my tent or to set up my shelter.

ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ngokwana ase emenwa kobua inwe mwensi;
english: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.

ekegusii: na Abayasubu, abarwete ase Yasubu, na Abashimuroni, abarwete ase Shimuroni.
english: through Jashub, the Jashubite clan; through Shimron, the Shimronite clan.

ekegusii: (Ogotera kw’obwanchani korikire na basinto ba Kora) Enkoro yane nigo eichire namang’ana amaya, engero yane nigo ere igoro y’omoruoti; oromeme rwane nigo rore buna ekaramu y’omoriki omuya.
english: For the director of music. To [the tune of] "Lilies." Of the Sons of Korah. A maskil. A wedding song. My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.

ekegusii: Nyasae akarora ng’a ense yasarekire, ekiagera kera omonto obwatirie chinchera chi’obosareku ase ense.
english: God saw how corrupt the earth had become, for all the people on earth had corrupted their ways.

ekegusii: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,
english: Ibrahimu konya obeire nemiaka emerongo kianda, na kianda (99), ekero akebetwe, risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa gwekorera omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, omogwekano o getongwa kende gionsi kere igoro, gose ase ense, gose ime ase amache inse y’ense.
english: "You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.

ekegusii: Ekero Akisi arenge koboria Daudi, “Insemo ki gwachiete korwania rituko ria rero?” “Daudi aba okomoiraneria,” “Ense ya Irianyi ere ey’Abayuda,” gose “Ense ya Irianyi ere eya Yerameeli,” gose “Ense ya Irianyi ere ey’Abakeni,”
english: When Achish asked, "Where did you go raiding today?" David would say, "Against the Negev of Judah" or "Against the Negev of Jerahmeel" or "Against the Negev of the Kenites."

ekegusii: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he returned to Galilee.
english: Ekero Yeso achia koigwa ng’a Yohana osibirwe echela, akaimoka, akagenda Galili.

ekegusii: Ebioro bigacha bigaichora ase ense yabo nonya nase ebinyomba bi’okorara bi’abagambi babo.
english: Their land teemed with frogs, which went up into the bedrooms of their rulers.

ekegusii: Isaka akamoboria, “Omwana one, naki gwakora kwanyora ching’iti iga bwango?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, Nyasae oo, nere ochindetera.”
english: Isaac asked his son, "How did you find it so quickly, my son?" "The LORD your God gave me success," he replied.

ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa ase endagera, akabeka chianga chiaye ensemo, akabogoria egetambaa, akeboyia.
english: so he got up from the meal, took off his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

ekegusii: bagotebia ebigoro na ebitare, “Togwere, otobise korwa ase obosio bwaye ere oyoikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene, gose titorora endamwamu y’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi,
english: They called to the mountains and the rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!

ekegusii: Keros, Sia, Padon,
english: Kerosi, na Sia, na Padoni;

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, Hosea, mosinto o Nuni;
english: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;

ekegusii: The Passover lambs were slaughtered, and the priests sprinkled the blood handed to them, while the Levites skinned the animals.
english: Bakanyenya chimanwa chie ching’ondi chi’Epasaka, erio abakuani bakaegwa amanyinga e chimanwa chiria, bakayanyororokia ekero Abalawi bagendererete korusia amasankwa.

ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamotebia,
english: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:

ekegusii: Yehoyada omokuani agasokia abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi b’amagana, akabatebia, “Mosokie isiko, mobeke ase egati y’abarendi, na moite nomoro onde bwensi okomotunyana.” Omokuani nigo atebete ng’a tibabaisa komoitera ime ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Jehoiada the priest sent out the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops, and said to them: "Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her." For the priest had said, "Do not put her to death at the temple of the LORD."

ekegusii: Eriogi rigantebia eria kabere korwa igoro: Eki Nyasae achenire tokeroka ng’a tikeri egechenu.
english: "The voice spoke from heaven a second time, 'Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.'

ekegusii: ekiagera ebirengererio biabo nigo bikoroberia ay’ogosiria, na ebikoba biabo nigo bigokwama ayakorenta emechando.
english: for their hearts plot violence, and their lips talk about making trouble.

ekegusii: Ekero Paulo achire, Abayahudi abarwete Yerusalemu bagatenena, bakamoetanana, bakarenta amasoero amange amarito igoro yaye, ayabatanyare koorokia oboene ng’a mboronge are.
english: When Paul appeared, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing many serious charges against him, which they could not prove.

ekegusii: Korende ring’ana eri tiricha gosiarerwa egati y’abanto; tiga tobagose, tibakwana na monto onde bwensi ase erieta eri.”
english: But to stop this thing from spreading any further among the people, we must warn these men to speak no longer to anyone in this name."

ekegusii: Kobaikire aase aria atebetigwe na Nyasae, Ibrahimu akaagacha egesasimero agwo, akaara chinko igoro yaye, agasiba Isaka omwana oye, akamwareria igoro ye chinko chiria.
english: When they reached the place God had told him about, Abraham built an altar there and arranged the wood on it. He bound his son Isaac and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Omonene one, tombarera obobe, gose toinyora aria nagokorerete ase rituko riria kwaruete Yerusalemu.
english: and said to him, "May my lord not hold me guilty. Do not remember how your servant did wrong on the day my lord the king left Jerusalem. May the king put it out of his mind.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Omonto oyio goika aitwe akwe: asokigwe isiko y’egetwori, erio omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena.”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "The man must die. The whole assembly must stone him outside the camp."

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo kwaigwete abanto baria, nigo kwarenge Nyasae, kwarenge kobaabera, nonya naboigo nigo kwarenge kobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe.
english: O LORD our God, you answered them; you were to Israel a forgiving God, though you punished their misdeeds.

ekegusii: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.
english: Naba nabwo basinto b’Eseri: Bilihani, na Sawani, na Akani.

ekegusii: Korende Samison agateba, “Engaki eye tinkoba nokomocha igoro y’Abafilisti, ekero ndabakorere amabe.”
english: Samson said to them, "This time I have a right to get even with the Philistines; I will really harm them."

ekegusii: Ekero Asika achete bw’Otinieli, akamoboria asabe ise amoe oboremo. Asika akaayerera goika korwa ase etigere igoro. Erio Kalebu akamoboria, “Inki otagete?”
english: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"

ekegusii: Yusufu akarusia abana korwa ase amagoro a ise, agatung’ama inse.
english: Then Joseph removed them from Israel's knees and bowed down with his face to the ground.

ekegusii: Bakamoboria, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a nigo ogokwana na kworokereria ayare boronge, gose tori koyiera monto, korende ase ekeene nigo okworokereria enchera ya Nyasae.
english: So the spies questioned him: "Teacher, we know that you speak and teach what is right, and that you do not show partiality but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.

ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bagasaria asende, agwo ase erooro; tibabwatetie emeroberio yane echikire, korende bakaanga amachiko aane ayio omonto karayabwate nabe moyo goetera asaro. Bagasaria mono Chisabato chiane, bagachikora chikaba echitachenegeti. Erio nkarengereria kobaumorera endamwamu yane agwo ase erooro, mbasirie kegima.
english: "'Yet the people of Israel rebelled against me in the desert. They did not follow my decrees but rejected my laws-- although the man who obeys them will live by them-- and they utterly desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and destroy them in the desert.

ekegusii: Baasa akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete agatindekwa agwo Tirisa, na Ela omwana oye omomura akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Baasha rested with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah. And Elah his son succeeded him as king.

english: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now, who is willing to consecrate himself today to the LORD?"

english: I will surely gather them from all the lands where I banish them in my furious anger and great wrath; I will bring them back to this place and let them live in safety.

english: When we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.

ekegusii: Korende onye omonto orentire ogoichania, tang’ichaneti inche bweka, korende ase ensemo obaichanirie nainwe mwensi. Ase ogokwana igo, tinkoyakong’ia mono.
english: If anyone has caused grief, he has not so much grieved me as he has grieved all of you, to some extent-- not to put it too severely.

english: “Emerindo y’amakweri konya yang’etananire, chiooro chi’obobe chikandetera obwoba.

ekegusii: Can he who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the just and mighty One?
english: Inee! Omonto ogechete ekeene nanyare kogamba? Nonachere ekina omonyene oboronge oyore nokobua?

english: Then the LORD said to him, "Know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.

english: The letter that he took to the king of Israel read: "With this letter I am sending my servant Naaman to you so that you may cure him of his leprosy."

english: Does he not see my ways and count my every step?

english: After David had constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.

ekegusii: Naende nkabatebia ng’a okoboko kwa Nyasae one nigo kwarenge amo nainche gonkorera amaya, boigo nkabatebia amang’ana ’Aritasasita omoruoti antebetie. Barabwo bakabora, “Tochake koagacha omochie naende.” Ase ayio bakabekana chinguru gokora emeremo eyio emiya.
english: I also told them about the gracious hand of my God upon me and what the king had said to me. They replied, "Let us start rebuilding." So they began this good work.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagateba ase eriogi rinene, “Emanwa y’Eng’ondi oyonyenyetwe igo ogweneire konyora okobua, na obonda, na obong’aini, ne chinguru, na ogosikwa, na obonene, na ogotogigwa.”
english: In a loud voice they sang: "Worthy is the Lamb, who was slain, to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and praise!"

ekegusii: Omonto ogotama korwa bwoye nigo anga buna enyoni ekong’anya korwa ase egeswa kiaye.
english: Like a bird that strays from its nest is a man who strays from his home.

ekegusii: Erio Mariamu akabogoria ekerengo ki’eratili eyemo y’amanukato e rigori rinene, agaaka Yeso amagoro, akayatinyia netukia yaye; enyomba egaichora rimisu ri’amaguta aria.
english: Then Mary took about a pint of pure nard, an expensive perfume; she poured it on Jesus' feet and wiped his feet with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.

ekegusii: Abayuda mbamenye ase emechie yabo yonsi amo. Boigo abaremi na abarisia baria bakona‐koong’anya mbamenyeo.
english: People will live together in Judah and all its towns-- farmers and those who move about with their flocks.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Paulo a kamenta komenya agwo amatuko amange, erio agatigana nabamwabo, akamanora agasoa emeeri, akagenda Siiria, na Priskila na Akwila bakagenda amo nere. Ase Kenkrea agakigita etukia yaye, ekiagera ariete eira gete.
english: Paul stayed on in Corinth for some time. Then he left the brothers and sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila. Before he sailed, he had his hair cut off at Cenchrea because of a vow he had taken.

ekegusii: "See, it is I who created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its work. And it is I who have created the destroyer to work havoc;
english: “Naama! Natongire omoturi bw’ebioma, oyio ogoutera omorero bw’amakara na aroisie ebirwanero buna bigwenerete koba. Boigo natongire omosaria bw’okobisaria.

ekegusii: Na amaiso abo bonsi babere akaramokigwa, bakamanya ng’a ngetirianda bare; bagatabora amato ’omoko, bakayabwatania, bakeboyia.
english: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they realized they were naked; so they sewed fig leaves together and made coverings for themselves.

ekegusii: Gose baria ikomi na batano na batato bagweretwe norwaki orotambe ase Siloam, rokabaita, mokagete ng’a nigo barenge abasaria kobua abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu?
english: Or those eighteen who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them-- do you think they were more guilty than all the others living in Jerusalem?
