Pastor Dr. Samuel Makori President, East Kenya Union Conference (SDA) met with Evans Makori of Minto FM and discussed Minto Bwakire's program for listeners sharing about salvation which will strengthen their faith.

ekegusii: Goika erierwe nyomba ime, timobaisa gosokia chinyama chinde isiko; timobuna riuga riaye rinde rionsi.
english: "It must be eaten inside one house; take none of the meat outside the house. Do not break any of the bones.

ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai, ekero bachia koigwa ng’a Yeso obakiririe Abasadukai, bagasangererekana amo.
english: Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.

ekegusii: Ekero Yehoyakimu, mosinto o Yosia, arenge omoruoti bw’Abayuda, ring’ana rigacha ase Yeremia korwa ase Omonene, rikamotebia,
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD during the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:

ekegusii: Abarwaire bagwenie, abakure babokie, abare noborwaire bwa ukoma basibie, na ebirecha birusie. Mwaeirwe bosa, nainwe karue bosa.
english: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse those who have leprosy, drive out demons. Freely you have received, freely give.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, aye Omonene oito, erieta riao naki rire nobonene obonge ase ense yonsi! Obonene bwao nigo bogotogigwa nonya ngoika igoro.
english: For the director of music. According to gittith. A psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Gileadi bakabwata ebiambokero bia Yorodan, bagatanga abanto b’Efraimu. Na ekero Omoefraimu onde bwensi oyorenge gotama are gosaba ribaga kwamboka, abanto ba Gileadi nigo baare komoboria, “Aye n’Omoefraimu ore?” Onye omonto oria orenge gokana oteba, “Yaya”,
english: The Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan leading to Ephraim, and whenever a survivor of Ephraim said, "Let me cross over," the men of Gilead asked him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" If he replied, "No,"

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Rero, ase obotuko obo, ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga ara kabere, nonkane ara gatato.”
english: "I tell you the truth," Jesus answered, "today-- yes, tonight-- before the rooster crows twice you yourself will disown me three times."

ekegusii: Tiga twetuke intwe abanyene na toteeme chinchera chiaito, erio tomoiranere Omonene!
english: Let us examine our ways and test them, and let us return to the LORD.

ekegusii: Riruma riria rikairana chinsa chia mogoroba, na rora, ndiabwate rito ribese ri’omozeituni ase omonwa oye. Ase ayio Nuhu akamanya ng’a amache akamokire korwa ase ense.
english: When the dove returned to him in the evening, there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf! Then Noah knew that the water had receded from the earth.

ekegusii: Erio agwo omworokigwa oria onde orenge bwe ritang’ani goika ase oboina agasoa, akarora, akeegena.
english: Finally the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.

ekegusii: Though they found no proper ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have him executed.
english: Nonya tibanyorete engencho y’okomoita, bagasaba Pilato aitwe.

ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Ayubu korwa ase ekembugu‐mbugu ime, akamotebia:
english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the storm. He said:

ekegusii: Morigie Omonene, nario morabe moyo; motakoreti bo, Omonene nigo arachere ororeria rwa Yusufu arosirie buna omorero ogosiria, na onde tari orayorimie atoorie Beteli.
english: Seek the LORD and live, or he will sweep through the house of Joseph like a fire; it will devour, and Bethel will have no one to quench it.

ekegusii: Omonto oria Yeroboamu nigo arenge omonto ore nomokia mono, na ekero Sulemani amoroche ng’a nigo arenge omokong’u ase emeremo yaye, akamobeka akaba omoteneneri igoro ase emeremo eria abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu barenge kobetererigwa gokora.
english: Now Jeroboam was a man of standing, and when Solomon saw how well the young man did his work, he put him in charge of the whole labor force of the house of Joseph.

ekegusii: “Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Haroni omokuani, nere ogera endamwamu yane yatigire Abaisraeli, ekiagera ere aba ne risemi buna inche inde ne risemi ase egati y’abanto aba. Ase ayio tinasiretie bonsi ase risemi riane.
english: "Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, has turned my anger away from the Israelites; for he was as zealous as I am for my honor among them, so that in my zeal I did not put an end to them.

ekegusii: “Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria. Ere n’Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, tiga aike bono korwa ase omosalaba, na intwe rirorio ntomwegene.
english: "He saved others," they said, "but he can't save himself! He's the King of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.

ekegusii: "If someone ventures a word with you, will you be impatient? But who can keep from speaking?
english: “Inee! Omonto arateema gokwana naye, nogechigwe nere? Nonya naboigo, monto ki oranyare gokira‐kiri takwana?

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe! Aye Omonene, rigereria orore! Oigwe amang’ana onsi a Senakeribu, aya atomire ase ogokorama aye Nyasae ore moyo.
english: Give ear, O LORD, and hear; open your eyes, O LORD, and see; listen to all the words Sennacherib has sent to insult the living God.

ekegusii: Naboigo ebi Nyasae abwatanirie, mwanyabanto tabiatanana.”
english: Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate."

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaeyanera basira, na ase okogusa kw’endamwamu yaye baerigwa.
english: At the breath of God they are destroyed; at the blast of his anger they perish.

ekegusii: Intwe ntore ne ring’ana riria ri’obobani riteneine bokong’u kobua, na inwe inamokore buya komorategerere na koribwata buna etaya ekomoreka aase omosunte ore, goika ekero bogokia, na eng’enang’eni ya mambia eoroke ase chinkoro chiaino ime.
english: And we have the word of the prophets made more certain, and you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a light shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio, Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, oria onaaretie Lakisi amo nabarwani baye bonsi b’esegi, agatoma abasomba baye Yerusalemu ase Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, na ase Abayuda bonsi abwo barenge Yerusalemu, agateba,
english: Later, when Sennacherib king of Assyria and all his forces were laying siege to Lachish, he sent his officers to Jerusalem with this message for Hezekiah king of Judah and for all the people of Judah who were there:

ekegusii: Ekero omokubinyongo okoba ase amare, na inche nkoyorigereria, ning’inyore okobwatana kwane gwa kare na kare, okwo nakorire egati yane, inche Nyasae, na kera egetongwa kere moyo ase ense.”
english: Whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and all living creatures of every kind on the earth."

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inwe nigo mwaagete chinkobi, naende mogatinera amagoro aino inse, mokagoka ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi ase engencho y’amabe anyorete ense y’Abaisraeli.
english: For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet, rejoicing with all the malice of your heart against the land of Israel,

ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa Nazareti, akagenda, akamenya Kapernaumu, omochie ore ang’e nenyancha ase chimbebe chia Sabuloni na Nafutali,
english: Leaving Nazareth, he went and lived in Capernaum, which was by the lake in the area of Zebulun and Naphtali--

ekegusii: Tari omonto okobonduera, korende ninche omonyene naborure. Ninde nokobua koborua; naende ninde nokobua koboirania. Ogochika oko nigo nakonyorire ase Tata one.”
english: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This command I received from my Father."

ekegusii: Erio gekabutora nenkoro y’omote oria mesia, gekayeira gochia ase ense y’oboonchoreria, gekayebeka ase omochie bw’abaonchoreria.
english: he broke off its topmost shoot and carried it away to a land of merchants, where he planted it in a city of traders.

ekegusii: Kwamokorire omoke kobua abamalaika ase ekero egeke, kwamobekeire egutwa y’obonene na amasikani. [Kwamobekire igoro ase emeremo y’amaboko ao.]
english: You made him a little lower than the angels; you crowned him with glory and honor

ekegusii: Hana akaria eira, agakwana, “Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, ondigererie inche omosomba oo ase emechando yane! Tonyeba! Korang’e omwana omomura, nigo ndamorue abe oyoo, aye Omonene; ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwaye takogingirwa etukia yaye.”
english: And she made a vow, saying, "O LORD Almighty, if you will only look upon your servant's misery and remember me, and not forget your servant but give her a son, then I will give him to the LORD for all the days of his life, and no razor will ever be used on his head."

ekegusii: Korende ase abanto aba, omoruoti gose abasomba baye, abwo baigwete amang’ana aria agosomwa, onde tabete nobwoba, gose tibatandorete chianga chiabo.
english: The king and all his attendants who heard all these words showed no fear, nor did they tear their clothes.

ekegusii: “Timobaisa koria enyama ende yonsi ebwate amanyinga ime yaye. Timobaisa gwancha oboragori, gose oborogi bonde bwonsi.
english: "'Do not eat any meat with the blood still in it. "'Do not practice divination or sorcery.

ekegusii: Naki onye ndigetie gwetogia anga tinaba omoriri, ekiagera nintebe ekeene. Korende ninyetange, omonto tambarera kobua aya aroche asende, gose koyaigwa korwa asende.
english: Even if I should choose to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will think more of me than is warranted by what I do or say.

ekegusii: My son, keep my words and store up my commands within you.
english: Omwana one, renda amang’ana aane, na obeke amachiko aane abeere ime yao.

ekegusii: Abamura b’Ayubu nigo banarete gokora emeyega ase chibisi, kera oyomo ase rituko riaye. Nigo barenge korangeria abaiseke bamwabo baria batato bacha koragera na konywa amo nabarabwo.
english: His sons used to take turns holding feasts in their homes, and they would invite their three sisters to eat and drink with them.

english: The officials did not know where I had gone or what I was doing, because as yet I had said nothing to the Jews or the priests or nobles or officials or any others who would be doing the work.

ekegusii: Aye kwang’eire enguba yao ase ogontooria, okoboko kwao gw’okorio kogansiira; na ogokonywa kwao gwankorire nabeire omonene.
english: You give me your shield of victory, and your right hand sustains me; you stoop down to make me great.

ekegusii: Aburamu nigo amwegenete Omonene, na ase engencho eyio akabarwa koba omonyene oboronge.
english: Abram believed the LORD, and he credited it to him as righteousness.

ekegusii: Agachika omoganda oikaranse inse, akabogoria emegati eria etano na ebere. Kayesesenirie, akayesamunyora, akaa aborokigwa baye bayetereke, na barabwo bakayeterekera omoganda.
english: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground. When he had taken the seven loaves and given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to set before the people, and they did so.

ekegusii: Agachaka gokwana noboremu ase esinagogi. Korende ekero Priskila na Akwila bachia komoigwa bakamoira mwabo, bakamworokia enchera ya Nyasae boronge kegima.
english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they invited him to their home and explained to him the way of God more adequately.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, naki yare gocha koba buya onye ngwaita abakori amabe, onye abagoitera amanyinga mbarua asende.
english: If only you would slay the wicked, O God! Away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo egotiesana, omoondoko ombwatire; engaki ya mogoroba eyio naganyete yang’onchokeire na kondetera obwoba.
english: My heart falters, fear makes me tremble; the twilight I longed for has become a horror to me.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio agatoma omwana oye asebare, ogoteba: Inabasike omwana one.
english: Last of all, he sent his son to them. 'They will respect my son,' he said.

Bono Yona ere konya otirimbokire gochia nyaro ime y’emeeri, na aroro nigo araire chitoro chinene mono.
english: All the sailors were afraid and each cried out to his own god. And they threw the cargo into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone below deck, where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.

ekegusii: Moyiaterane ase ogoaka obomera, ebe emiando yaino na ey’abamenyi bare ase egati yaino baiborerete abana ase egati yaino. Abwo babe asemore buna ababiare b’Abaisraeli, baegwe emiando ase egati y’ebisaku biaino inwe Abaisraeli.
english: You are to allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the aliens who have settled among you and who have children. You are to consider them as native-born Israelites; along with you they are to be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo arakoreke onye mokoigwera Omonene, Nyasae oino, na kobwata amachiko aye onsi, aya inche nabaeire ase rituko ria rero, na komorakore ayare amaronge ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: because you obey the LORD your God, keeping all his commands that I am giving you today and doing what is right in his eyes.

ekegusii: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
english: o Yohana, o Resa, o Serubabeli, o Salatieli, o Neri,

ekegusii: Tamari, moka momura o Yuda, akaiborera Yuda Peresi na Zera. Yuda nigo abwate abana abamura batano.
english: Tamar, Judah's daughter-in-law, bore him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.

ekegusii: Totiga obuya na ekeene birue asore; obisibe ase rigoti riao, na obirike ase enkoro yao.
english: Let love and faithfulness never leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.

ekegusii: Tiga endagera yame enyinge ase ense, nonya nase ebitunwa igoro. Chindagera echio tiga china‐konyegerigwa buna emete ya Lebanoni. Abanto b’emechie tiga babuche babe buna obonyansi bw’ense.
english: Let grain abound throughout the land; on the tops of the hills may it sway. Let its fruit flourish like Lebanon; let it thrive like the grass of the field.

ekegusii: Korende ekero baria basangererekanete amo basogetigwe isiko, agasoa ime, akamobwata okoboko, na omoiseke oria akaimoka.
english: After the crowd had been put outside, he went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.

ekegusii: Aya abwo bakondwania bagokwana na korengereria, nigo bare mamincha yane omobaso boira.
english: what my enemies whisper and mutter against me all day long.

ekegusii: Goika agachia kweirana kweboria ere omonyene, akabora: Abasomba b’eng’eria ba tata mbarenga bakare koria endagera na gotigaria, na inche aiga ngokwa nenchara!
english: "When he came to his senses, he said, 'How many of my father's hired men have food to spare, and here I am starving to death!

ekegusii: Nyasae taganeti engaki entambe korigereria, goika abeke omonto ase ekina.
english: God has no need to examine men further, that they should come before him for judgment.

ekegusii: Nigo tore nebiegwa ao ao koreng’ana ase obuya twaeirwe; onye nobobani tobane koreng’ana ase okwegena gwaito;
english: We have different gifts, according to the grace given us. If a man's gift is prophesying, let him use it in proportion to his faith.

ekegusii: Uzzi the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah the father of Meraioth,
english: Usi akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Merayoti;

ekegusii: Erio ngateba: “Inche tinkobarisia inwe rinde. Oyo ogokwa, tiga akwe, na oyo ogosirigwa, tiga asirigwe, na abatigari babe bakorianana.”
english: and said, "I will not be your shepherd. Let the dying die, and the perishing perish. Let those who are left eat one another's flesh."

ekegusii: "I would like to reply to you and to your friends with you.
english: Bono ngokoiraneria nde aye amo nabasani bao abamore komo.”

ekegusii: Ekioma nigo kegotieria ekioma kende, naboigo nomonto agotieria omonto onde.
english: As iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another.

ekegusii: Bagatenena kera oyomo aase aye, na Ebuku eria y’Amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae obo, ekaba egosomwa asebare ase egeka gie chinsa isato, naende bakaba bakoorokia ebibe biabo na komosasima Omonene, Nyasae obo, ase egeka kende gie chinsa isato, ase rituko erio.
english: They stood where they were and read from the Book of the Law of the LORD their God for a quarter of the day, and spent another quarter in confession and in worshiping the LORD their God.

ekegusii: Naki iga mokoremereria nomonto, karabakore mobe abasomba, kararie ebiaino, abasakore, kareimokererie igoro, karabaake inwe ase obosio.
english: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or pushes himself forward or slaps you in the face.

ekegusii: Ring’ana rikarwa ase Omonene rigacha asende inche Yeremia, rigantebia,
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Parosi: chilifu ibere, ne rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na ebere, na babere (2,172);
english: the descendants of Parosh 2,172

ekegusii: “Igo nabo Omonene ankoreire ase amatuko aya andigereretie, na konduseria obosooku bwane ase amasio ’abanto.”
english: "The Lord has done this for me," she said. "In these days he has shown his favor and taken away my disgrace among the people."

ekegusii: Agwo nkabaa emeroberio yane echikire, na nkaborokereria amachiko aane, na omonto orayabwate nabe moyo goetera asaro.
english: I gave them my decrees and made known to them my laws, for the man who obeys them will live by them.

ekegusii: Naki gwatwebire kogenderera botambe? Naki gwatotigire ase engaki entambe iga?
english: Why do you always forget us? Why do you forsake us so long?

ekegusii: Korende aase gete omonto oyomo naorogetie oborori, agateba, “Omonto inki aisaine aye ogendererete komorengereria? Mwanyabanto inki aisaine aye okomorenda?
english: But there is a place where someone has testified: "What is man that you are mindful of him, the son of man that you care for him?

ekegusii: Onye chinkoro chiaito chigotogambia, Nyasae nomonene kobua chinkoro chiaito, na ere nigo amanyete onsi.
english: whenever our hearts condemn us. For God is greater than our hearts, and he knows everything.

ekegusii: erinde ching’iti chi’orosana amo nebibwe ne chisagero chinywe chintogie. Ekero ekio nintubokie amache ase erooro, ne chindooche ase ense enyomo, ng’ee abanto baane, abwo nachorire, amache banywe,
english: The wild animals honor me, the jackals and the owls, because I provide water in the desert and streams in the wasteland, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’ebisaku bagoke na gotera nomochengo; ekiagera aye nigo okonachera abanto ebina ase oboronge. Aye naye okoraa ebisaku bire ase ense.
english: May the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you rule the peoples justly and guide the nations of the earth. Selah

ekegusii: Nekeene nabatebirie: Ande onsi morasibe ase ense, nabe asibirwe na igoro; na ande onsi morasibore ase ense, nabe asiboirwe na igoro.
english: "I tell you the truth, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na kabere bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Ahaswero, omotienyi bwe ritang’ani okorokwa Nisani, abanto bakaba bagoaka obomera bware korokwa Puri, agwo ase obosio bwa Hamani, igoro ya kera rituko, na kera omotienyi, bagaikera omotienyi o ikomi na kabere okorokwa Adari.
english: In the twelfth year of King Xerxes, in the first month, the month of Nisan, they cast the pur (that is, the lot) in the presence of Haman to select a day and month. And the lot fell on the twelfth month, the month of Adar.

ekegusii: Oyomo bwa baria abasaria babambetwe akamorama, akabora, “Inee! Tari aye Kristo? Etoorie aye omonyene, naintwe ototoorie.”
english: One of the criminals who hung there hurled insults at him: "Aren't you the Christ? Save yourself and us!"

ekegusii: Elisha akabora, “Ekeene, buna Omonene bw’Emeganda are moyo, oria inche ngokorera, onye ntasigeti Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, anga tinarenge gwancha gokorora, gose gokorigereria.
english: Elisha said, "As surely as the LORD Almighty lives, whom I serve, if I did not have respect for the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not look at you or even notice you.

ekegusii: Ere oyoikaranseteo nigo agwekaine rigena rie rigori ria yasipi na ria saridio, na ekerogo keria ki’obonene nigo giaetananire nomokubinyongo bw’embura, okororekana buna rigena ria sumaridi.
english: And the one who sat there had the appearance of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow, resembling an emerald, encircled the throne.

ekegusii: ekiagera Adamu nere otongetwe ritang’ani, na nyuma yaye Hawa.
english: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

ekegusii: Nyasae one nigo agoteba iga: “Omokori amabe tari nomorembe.”
english: "There is no peace," says my God, "for the wicked."

ekegusii: Naara akamoiborera Ahusamu na Heferi, Temeni na Hahasitari. Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Naara.
english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.

ekegusii: Nabo ase rituko rinene nigo anarete kobasiborera omosibwa oyomo, oyobarigetie.
english: Now it was the custom at the Feast to release a prisoner whom the people requested.

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Sulemani, rikamotebia,
english: The word of the LORD came to Solomon:

ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Aya naro Mika ankoreire: Nigo andigete, akong’a eng’eria, na inche nigo inde omokuani oye.”
english: He told them what Micah had done for him, and said, "He has hired me and I am his priest."

ekegusii: Oboroso bwe Hekalu bokabekwa ase omotienyi o Sivu, ase omwaka o kane bw’okogamba gwa Sulemani.
english: The foundation of the temple of the LORD was laid in the fourth year, in the month of Ziv.

ekegusii: Erio Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka ase erooro, okorandia, okobatebia, “Onchoka, mobatiswe, monyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe.”
english: And so John came, baptizing in the desert region and preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

ekegusii: Baalamu akagenderera gokwana obobani bwaye: “Obee! Ning’o oranyare koba moyo ekero Nyasae arakore aya?
english: Then he uttered his oracle: "Ah, who can live when God does this?

ekegusii: Erio akarangeria abasira b’omonene oye, oyomo ase oyomo, akaboria oyo bwe ritang’ani: Ninki oriete ki’omonene one?
english: "So he called in each one of his master's debtors. He asked the first, 'How much do you owe my master?'

ekegusii: Twaigure amang’ana igoro y’esegi eyio, amaboko aito aborirwe chinguru; twasoirwe nomoondoko, na obororo buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore bwatosoire.
english: We have heard reports about them, and our hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped us, pain like that of a woman in labor.

ekegusii: Sara nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere (127); eye nero emiaka y’obogima bwa Sara.
english: Sarah lived to be a hundred and twenty-seven years old.

ekegusii: Ekero Labani aikeereire Yakobo ang’e, Yakobo nere konya otenenirie eema yaye agwo ase ebitunwa bia Gileadi. Labani nere amo nabamwabo bagatenenia chiema chiabo agwo.
english: Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there too.

ekegusii: Erio Adoni‐Bezeki agateba, “Abaruoti emerongo etano na ebere, abwo ebiara biabo ebinene bi’amaboko na ebi’amagoro biabutoretwe, barenge gochora amatori korwa nyaro y’emesa yane. Na bono Nyasae onkoreire inche buna inche nabakorerete barabwo.” Akarentwa Yerusalemu, agakwera aroro.
english: Then Adoni-Bezek said, "Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have picked up scraps under my table. Now God has paid me back for what I did to them." They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

ekegusii: korende Paulo agachora Sila. Na ekero baria bamwabo bamobekire ase obuya bw’Omonene, akaimoka akagenda.
english: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the brothers to the grace of the Lord.

ekegusii: “Komoraigwere amachiko aya nabaeire rituko ria rero, erinde mwanche Omonene, Nyasae oino, na komokorera ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi,
english: So if you faithfully obey the commands I am giving you today-- to love the LORD your God and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul--

ekegusii: Ninchirisie ase oborisia obuya. Ee, nchibe chikorisia ase oborisia obonoru bw’ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli.
english: I will tend them in a good pasture, and the mountain heights of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in good grazing land, and there they will feed in a rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

ekegusii: Gaki bono, totiga amanyinga aane aiteke aare korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene. Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli ochire kondigia inche inde ensona, buna omonto okorigia chinkware ase ebitunwa.”
english: Now do not let my blood fall to the ground far from the presence of the LORD. The king of Israel has come out to look for a flea-- as one hunts a partridge in the mountains."

ekegusii: erinde bikorende korwa ase omokungu omonyaka ogokwana amang’ana ay’okoebereria.
english: they will keep you from the adulteress, from the wayward wife with her seductive words.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atamire na gwetooria, akagenda ase Samweli agwo Rama, akamotebia amang’ana onsi Saulo konya amokoreire. Erio Samweli na Daudi bakagenda Nayoti, bakamenyao.
english: When David had fled and made his escape, he went to Samuel at Ramah and told him all that Saul had done to him. Then he and Samuel went to Naioth and stayed there.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Abagambi Ba Abagusii Ekero Omosongo Aigete Nka Gusii Ase orogendo amo n' okong'anya gwaito, Abagusii ntwaigete ase tokwebaka amarieta y' ching'iti ao ao. Ase okoboria, ntoratebigwa buna ninki kiagerete tokeebaka iga. Ninki gose? Mbuya ki twaroche ase chingiti echi ekagera tokeebaka amarieta abo? Buna togotebigwa, Abagusii mbebagete amarieta ayio akobwatia: (I). Ababasi nigo bebagete, Enchage (Zebra ase Ekenyamorero). Komenta nayio, nigo togotebigwa buna Omobasi n' omongaini! Omobasi nere oorogeti Omogusii buna eng'ombe ekobaswa korwa ebigoti! Abagusii bande nigo barenge konyenya eng'ombe korwa omogongo! Nonya nabo igo, abande nigo bagoteba buna Ababasi nigo babasete eng'era korua omogong'o rika rie ritana, erio bakarokwa Ababasi! (II). Abagirango. Engo (leopard ase Ekenyamorero). Omogirango nigo agirete koria engo. Oyo nere naende omomura okabere ase Omogusii, naende okorokwa Omogirango Omosweta! (III). Abanyaribari. Aba nabwo naende bamanyire buna Abasweta ((Baboon ase Ekenyamorero). Komenta nayio, naende bamanyire buna Abanyaribari Amang'eng'a! Aba nabwo bagatangire esegi ko yatindiire korwa Bomanyi, buna togotebigwa. Tari igo rioka. Omonyaribari nere obarete, gose kobaga Omogusii bwensi ase abeta ritangani. Abagambi bari babarete Abagusii ritangani nao barwete Nyaribari. (IV). Abamachoge. Tari Abanyaribari boka barenge kweroka Abasweta. Abamachoge nabarabwo nigo bebagete Abasweta (Baboon ase Ekenyamorero). (V). Abanchari. Engubo. Omonchari nere Engubo Y' Ndiba chia Bokendu! Engubo nigo yanchete komenya aase amache amakendu ime. Ntwe ntomanyeti gose eke nakio kiagerete Abanchari bakeeroka erieta eri. (VI). Abagetutu. Aba nabwo Abasweta abatang'ani (Baboon ase Ekenyamorero). Omogetutu nere omomura omonene. Oyo nere naende okorokwa Enda Y' Enchogu nyabana bange! Korwa ase omongina magokoro Kwamboka Mireri amo na abagaka chisokoro Samuel Omare Nyambisa amo n' Kenyanya Marube, mbuya mono and thank you for listening. english: These are their stories: The Clans of the Gusii People, the Council of Elders, they speak like the Gusii. They travel far and gather little things, the Gusii people don't understand how to save small amounts of money at all. They are wasteful, but traditions remain strong so they can save something. What is this? My mother tells us about the tradition of saving small amounts of money from time immemorial? But it is said, the Gusii people have forgotten those old ways of saving: (I). The Herdsmen, they save, Zebras and Wild Animals. Comment on this, it is said that the Herdsmen and the Farmers! The Herdsman who herds cattle is like a Gusii man whose cow has calves! The Gusii people today no longer bother to milk cows until their udders are full! Despite this, they say that the Herdsmen saved enough wealth to buy things: (II). The Hunters. Leopards and Wild Animals. The Hunter hunts for leopards. This one also goes to the forest to become a Gusii, and is feared by the Leopard Clan! (III). The Gatherers. These ones also know that the Baboons and Wild Animals. Comment on this, they also know that the Gatherers are skilled! These ones collect firewood to cook food for the elders, but it is said. It is not always easy. The Gatherer is respected, what does it mean to be a Gusii person among those who are knowledgeable? The clans were respected by the Gusii people and they fought against the Gatherers. (IV). The Machoge Clan. It is not the Gatherers who bother to fear the Baboons. The Machoge clan also respect the Baboons and Wild Animals. (V). The Chari Clan. The Shield. The Chari person is the Shield of the Bokendu family! The shield protects the entire Bokendu homestead. I don't know what makes them think that the Chari people will abandon their inheritance. (VI). The Getutu Clan. These ones are the Baboons who fight (Wild Animals). The Getutu person is a very large man. This one also fears the Land of the Enchogu people, his relatives! From the hearts of our ancestors Kwamboka Mireri and the elder Samuel Omare Nyambisa and Kenyanya Marube, my mother says and thank you for listening. ekegusii: Abalawi baria barenge Abakohati na Abakora bagatenena gotogia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ase eriogi rinene mono.
english: Then some Levites from the Kohathites and Korahites stood up and praised the LORD, the God of Israel, with very loud voice.

ekegusii: Saulo akaimoka korwa inse, korende ekero achia koramokia amaiso aye tarora gento. Bakamobwata okoboko, bakamoira Damesiki.
english: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could see nothing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu.
english: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;

ekegusii: Barabwo tibari gosookigwa ase chingaki chi’amabe, ase chingaki chi’enchara nigo bakoigota.
english: In times of disaster they will not wither; in days of famine they will enjoy plenty.

ekegusii: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,
english: na Selemia, Nathani na Adaya,

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, toiranie gocha asore, erinde toiranigwe, onchora amatuko aito oyakore abe amayia, abe buna aria a kare!
english: Restore us to yourself, O LORD, that we may return; renew our days as of old

ekegusii: obachike baimokie amagena ikomi na abere, korwa agwo gati‐gati ya Yorodan aase abakuani bateneine namagoro abo, bayaire na bayabeke amo ase moratoore obotuko obo.”
english: and tell them to take up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan from right where the priests stood and to carry them over with you and put them down at the place where you stay tonight."

ekegusii: Erio abanto abamenyete ase emechie y’Abaisraeli mbagende basangererie ebirwanero; chinguba, ne ching’aya, na amata, ne chinsara, ne chisimisi, na amatimo, babikore chinko bagoutera omorero ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere.
english: "'Then those who live in the towns of Israel will go out and use the weapons for fuel and burn them up-- the small and large shields, the bows and arrows, the war clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them for fuel.

ekegusii: Oonchoranire chinchera chiane na kombutorana ebing’ese, ontigire ntang’ang’ete bosa.
english: he dragged me from the path and mangled me and left me without help.

ekegusii: Agwo Ribula omoruoti o Babeli agaita abana abamura ba Zedekia; agaita nabanene bonsi b’Abayuda.
english: There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes and also killed all the nobles of Judah.

ekegusii: “Nenyare koba ng’a omonto onyuomire omokungu bamenyane, na nyuma y’ayio amwange,
english: If a man takes a wife and, after lying with her, dislikes her

ekegusii: Asare boigo mwarokigwe okwaroka gotakoriri namaboko, ase okorusia okobua kw’ebibe ase omobere, engencho yaye okwaroka gokorwa ase Kristo,
english: In him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of the sinful nature, not with a circumcision done by the hands of men but with the circumcision done by Christ,

ekegusii: Komoraikeo mwerende mono, timobaisa kweba Omonene oria obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase mwarenge abasomba.
english: be careful that you do not forget the LORD, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

ekegusii: Erioba, na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni mbisirigwe; igoro neringwe buna amakaratasi, ee, ebitongwa ebio bia igoro mbiiyerigwe inse buna amato amomo ay’emesabibu na ay’emeko akogwa.
english: All the stars of the heavens will be dissolved and the sky rolled up like a scroll; all the starry host will fall like withered leaves from the vine, like shriveled figs from the fig tree.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Musa, omosomba one, okure. Imoka, bwamboke orooche oro rwa Yorodan, aye na Abaisraeli aba bonsi, mosoe ase ense eria ngochia kobaa.
english: "Moses my servant is dead. Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them-- to the Israelites.

ekegusii: Ogotamoiroka Nyasae tigokoagacha omonto na komokong’ia, korende omori bw’omonyaboronge tokonyegerigwa.
english: A man cannot be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.

ekegusii: Ere akamoboria, “Ase amachiko inki kerikire? Naki ogosoma?”
english: "What is written in the Law?" he replied. "How do you read it?"

ekegusii: Agasaria aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, na agatagora chisiiro chigosasimerwa amo nomote bw’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu. Akabutorana ebing’ese eng’iti y’etaai eria Musa aroisetie, ekiagera goika ase amatuko aria Abaisraeli igo bagendererete koyesambera ubani; bakayeroka Nehusitani.
english: He removed the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles. He broke into pieces the bronze snake Moses had made, for up to that time the Israelites had been burning incense to it. (It was called Nehushtan.)

ekegusii: rirorio ere nabatwerie embura ase ense yaino ase engaki egwenerete, embura ye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera nainwe monyore endagera, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni.
english: then I will send rain on your land in its season, both autumn and spring rains, so that you may gather in your grain, new wine and oil.

ekegusii: (Ogotera kwa basinto ba Kora) Inwe abanto bonsi, aka chinkobi, moterere Nyasae amatera ’omogoko neriogi rinene!
english: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.

ekegusii: Ekero baigwete amang’ana ayio, bakaonchoka bakarigererania bare nobwoba, bagatebia Baruku, “Goika totebie omoruoti amang’ana aya.”
english: When they heard all these words, they looked at each other in fear and said to Baruch, "We must report all these words to the king."

ekegusii: Boazi kariire na konywa akaigwa buya, akagenda ang’e netui y’esairi, akarara aroro. Erio Rutu agachoba ng’ora‐ng’ora, agatubora ekiebisio korwa ase amagoro a Boazi, akarara aroro.
english: When Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went over to lie down at the far end of the grain pile. Ruth approached quietly, uncovered his feet and lay down.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli arenge gotaara ase orwaki igoro, omokungu oyomo akarera asare, agateba, “Aye omoruoti, omonene one, inkonye!”
english: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, "Help me, my lord the king!"

ekegusii: Musa akaa Haroni amo nabamura baye chibesa chiria chi’okobooria, buna Omonene amochigete.
english: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, as he was commanded by the word of the LORD.

ekegusii: Nabo akaraagwa n’Omoika gocha ase Hekalu ime; na ekero abaibori bachia korenta omwana Yeso, bamokorere buna yarenge engencho y’amachiko,
english: Moved by the Spirit, he went into the temple courts. When the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for him what the custom of the Law required,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli otebire iga: “Inwe mwachayire ring’ana eri, mwanchire amang’ana ’obobe na obong’ainereria, naro mosemeretie.
english: Therefore, this is what the Holy One of Israel says: "Because you have rejected this message, relied on oppression and depended on deceit,

ekegusii: Nyasae oo nigo agoteba iga: “Inche Omonene nakorangeirie aye ore buna omokungu bwangetwe, oichanete ase omoyo oye, ee, nakorangeirie aye ore buna omokungu oseretigwe ekero arenge omoriakari.
english: The LORD will call you back as if you were a wife deserted and distressed in spirit-- a wife who married young, only to be rejected," says your God.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Agripa agacha amo na Bereniki ase obonene obonge, bagasoa ase ekegambero amo nabatang’ani b’abarwani elifu na abanto abanene b’omochie. Festo akarua ogochika ng’a Paulo arentwe ime.
english: The next day Agrippa and Bernice came with great pomp and entered the audience room with the high ranking officers and the leading men of the city. At the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.

ekegusii: Mosimeke emesabibu ase emegondo y’ebitunwa bia Samaria. Abwo barasimeke nabarie okwama okwo.
english: Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; the farmers will plant them and enjoy their fruit.

ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria akaegwa chimbaba ibere buna echi’ensoti enene, anyare koiruruka korwa ase eng’iti eria gochia ase erooro aase agochia korendwa ase engaki y’emiaka etato na ekeng’ese.
english: The woman was given the two wings of a great eagle, so that she might fly to the place prepared for her in the desert, where she would be taken care of for a time, times and half a time, out of the serpent's reach.

ekegusii: Daudi konya onyuomire Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli; ase igo abwo babere bakaba abakungu baye.
english: David had also married Ahinoam of Jezreel, and they both were his wives.

ekegusii: Naende rituko ria kabere Yohana nigo arenge oteneine amo na babere b’aborokigwa baye.
english: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.

ekegusii: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
english: Oyoregene na kobatiswa, natooreke, ko oyotegeneti, nagambigwe.

ekegusii: Inche ninkoe aye, na ororeria rwao rorache korwa nyuma yao, ense eye omenyete bono buna omomenyi, ense yonsi ya Kanani, ebe eyaino kare na kare, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo.”
english: The whole land of Canaan, where you are now an alien, I will give as an everlasting possession to you and your descendants after you; and I will be their God."

ekegusii: Na inwe abaise, timochegia abana baino, babaise gokwa emioyo.
english: Fathers, do not embitter your children, or they will become discouraged.

ekegusii: Erio Paulo akaimoka akabatiga.
english: At that, Paul left the Council.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aye onsi eatananete koba Omwerwa taria gento kende gionsi gekoroisigwa korwa ase emesabibu. Taria nonya ne chimbusururo gose amasabo ’amasabibu.
english: As long as he is a Nazirite, he must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or skins.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Edomu, inwe abamomenyete ase ense ya Usi, goka na gochenga! Nonya nasemore egekombe nkebaikere, monywe motinde goika motigare getirianda.
english: Rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, you who live in the land of Uz. But to you also the cup will be passed; you will be drunk and stripped naked.

ekegusii: Okore boigo egechungi gi’etaai na obeke chibonyi inye chie chitaai ase chikoona chiaye inye.
english: Make a grating for it, a bronze network, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the network.

ekegusii: Abachandi baito nigo baare abaango kobua chinsoti chikoiruruka, nigo batoseretie gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, bagatoboera ase erooro
english: Our pursuers were swifter than eagles in the sky; they chased us over the mountains and lay in wait for us in the desert.

ekegusii: Ase amagoro aye nigo anaarete ebitange bi’etaai, boigo nabwate esimisi y’etaai abegete ireko.
english: on his legs he wore bronze greaves, and a bronze javelin was slung on his back.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora obosani nomonto ore omwango ase okobeea gose tobaisa kogenda amo nomonto ore nekeririanda.
english: Do not make friends with a hot-tempered man, do not associate with one easily angered,

ekegusii: bakeba Omonene, Nyasae obo, oyobatooretie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo babaetanaine.
english: did not remember the LORD their God, who had rescued them from the hands of all their enemies on every side.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo barenge koria endagera engiya mono bakwereire ase chinchera; na abwo barenge kweboyia chianga chimonyinga, nigo baraire ase chitui chie ribu.
english: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets. Those nurtured in purple now lie on ash heaps.

ekegusii: “Oroisie eraaro y’Obomenyo. Ase ensemo ya irianyi oroisie ebitambaa bie chiusi chindabu chi’egatani chisisire, bibe ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, bibe bigokenga eraaro ensemo eyemo.
english: "Make a courtyard for the tabernacle. The south side shall be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains of finely twisted linen,

ekegusii: Rora, oyo okweimokereria igoro, omoyo oye tori omoronge, korende omonyene oboronge nabe moyo goetera ase okwegena kwaye.
english: "See, he is puffed up; his desires are not upright-- but the righteous will live by his faith--

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nario Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, aroche igoro y’Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu:
english: This is what Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem:

ekegusii: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
english: Ahasi akaibora Yehoada, na Yehoada akaibora Alemeti na Asimaweti, na Simuri, na Simuri akaibora Moza.

ekegusii: From the descendants of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth and Elijah.
english: ab’eamate ya Elamu: Matania na Zakaria, Yehieli na Abidi, Yeremoti na Elija;

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatebia Siba, “Rigereria, kera egento ekiarenge ekia Mefiboseti nebiao.” Siba akamotebia, “Nebekire inse asore. Koranche inyore ogwancherwa asore, aye omoruoti, omonene one.”
english: Then the king said to Ziba, "All that belonged to Mephibosheth is now yours." "I humbly bow," Ziba said. "May I find favor in your eyes, my lord the king."

ekegusii: Na abanto be chiamate chinde chi’Abakohati bakaegwa emechie korwa ase orogongo rw’egesaku gi’Efraimu.
english: Some of the Kohathite clans were given as their territory towns from the tribe of Ephraim.

ekegusii: Inee! Nenyare gokoboria amang’ana amange ase oboitongo? Gose nenyare gokwana naye amang’ana amororo?
english: Will he keep begging you for mercy? Will he speak to you with gentle words?

ekegusii: Ase ense y’Abayuda okoboko kwa Nyasae nao kwarenge kobaa ebirengererio ebimo gokora ogwancha kw’Omonene, buna omoruoti na abagambi baria bachigete.
english: Also in Judah the hand of God was on the people to give them unity of mind to carry out what the king and his officials had ordered, following the word of the LORD.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbasoe ase enyomba yane enchenu, bache ang’e nemesa yane bankorere, naende bagenderere korenda amang’ana aane nachikire.
english: They alone are to enter my sanctuary; they alone are to come near my table to minister before me and perform my service.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Tari igoro yaino komanya ebiro gose chingaki. Tata obibekire ase okobua kwaye omonyene.
english: He said to them: "It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority.

ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika, oria okwanete nere, aimoka korwa aroro, Kornelio akarangeria abasomba baye babere na omorwani oyomo osigete Nyasae korwa ase baria bare komokorera botambe,
english: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier who was one of his attendants.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoboria, “Naki oranyare goteba ng’a nonyanchete, ekero enkoro yao etari amo nainche? Gwankoreire echeche chintunda isato na torantebia obobisi bwe chinguru chiao.”
english: Then she said to him, "How can you say, 'I love you,' when you won't confide in me? This is the third time you have made a fool of me and haven't told me the secret of your great strength."

ekegusii: Abakuani bonsi abarenge aroro ekero keria konya bechenire abanyene, nonya barenge b’ekeombe kende gionsi. Bono ekero abakuani bonsi basogete korwa ase Aase Aachenu,
english: The priests then withdrew from the Holy Place. All the priests who were there had consecrated themselves, regardless of their divisions.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, omoyo one nogenderere kogotogia, togokira. Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, ninkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera kare na kare.
english: that my heart may sing to you and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give you thanks forever.

ekegusii: Riko riaye nigo riarenge ase chianga chiaye, torengereretie igoro y’omoerio oye. Ase ayio okogwa kwaye gokaba ogw’okoondokia, torenge nonde okoyoremia. “Aye Omonene, rigereria emechando yane, ekiagera omobisa one ngwetogia are!”
english: Her filthiness clung to her skirts; she did not consider her future. Her fall was astounding; there was none to comfort her. "Look, O LORD, on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed."

ekegusii: Nkabaaka inse nkabasenyenta, tibanyara koimoka, bakagwa inse y’amagoro aane, bakabugwa.
english: I crushed them so that they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia akarangeria Baruku, mosinto o Neria, akamotebia amang’ana onsi ere omonyene atebetigwe n’Omonene, na Baruku akaba okoyarika ase ebuku ekero Yeremia arenge koyakwana.
english: So Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, and while Jeremiah dictated all the words the LORD had spoken to him, Baruch wrote them on the scroll.

ekegusii: Erieta ri’Omonene ritogigwe korwa bono goika kare na kare!
english: Let the name of the LORD be praised, both now and forevermore.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Zera nabwo aba: Simuri na Etani, Hemani na Kalikuli, na Dara, bonsi mbatano.
english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol and Darda--five in all.

ekegusii: Inwe soa ase egetare ime, moreme chingoro mwebiseo, motame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene.
english: Go into the rocks, hide in the ground from dread of the LORD and the splendor of his majesty!

ekegusii: These double calamities have come upon you-- who can comfort you?--ruin and destruction, famine and sword-- who can console you?
english: Amang’ana aya abere akonyorire: Ogosirigwa na ogotigwa bosa, ogoitwa nenchara na emioro. Ning’o orakororere amabeebe? Gose ning’o orakoremie?

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akagenda bwoye ore nomoichano na obororo bw’endamwamu, agaika Samaria.
english: Sullen and angry, the king of Israel went to his palace in Samaria.

ekegusii: Omoika okanyimokereria igoro, okang’ira ase egeita ki’enyomba y’Omonene kiarochie moocha. Na rora, agwo ase egesieri ki’egeita mbarengeo abasacha emerongo ebere, na batano, na ase egati yabo nkarora Yasania, mosinto bw’Asuri, na Peletia, mosinto o Benaya, abwo barenge abagambi b’abanto.
english: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the LORD that faces east. There at the entrance to the gate were twenty-five men, and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.

ekegusii: Na omonto oria obwatire nekerecha ekebe akabarindokera, akabanyara, akababua, goika bagatama korwa ase enyomba eria getirianda, bare ne chingoma baakirwe.
english: Then the man who had the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. He gave them such a beating that they ran out of the house naked and bleeding.

ekegusii: Naki ing’ana tiriri ritanyarekane ase Nyasae.”
english: For nothing is impossible with God."

ekegusii: Ekero arenge ase emechando emenene, agasaba Omonene Nyasae oye, akamosorora; agekeyia ase oboitongo obonene ase obosio bwa Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaye.
english: In his distress he sought the favor of the LORD his God and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

ekegusii: Oboronge bwane nigo bore ang’e, ogotooreka kwane ngocha kore, amaboko aane nagambie abanto bonsi ekina kia boronge; abanto bamenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha nigo banganyete, basemerie okoboko kwane.
english: My righteousness draws near speedily, my salvation is on the way, and my arm will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look to me and wait in hope for my arm.

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi Yehoyakimu akorete, na okogechia akorete, na okomocha kwanyorekanete asare, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli na ab’Abayuda, na Yehoyakini, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: The other events of Jehoiakim's reign, the detestable things he did and all that was found against him, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. And Jehoiachin his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Abineri agatebia Daudi, “Nkogenda inde nsangererie Abaisraeli bonsi ase ensemo yao, aye omoruoti, omonene one, erio bakore okobwatana amo naye, erinde onyore eki kwaganetie, obagambere bonsi pi.” Ase igo Daudi akaa Abineri ribaga, na Abineri akagenda nomorembe.
english: Then Abner said to David, "Let me go at once and assemble all Israel for my lord the king, so that they may make a compact with you, and that you may rule over all that your heart desires." So David sent Abner away, and he went in peace.

ekegusii: Orogongo rwaino nigo rorachakere erooro ya irianyi, roikere Lebanoni ensemo ya sugusu, naende rochakere orooche oronene rw’Eufarati, robwateranie ense yonsi y’Abahiti roikere Enyancha Enene ya bosongo.
english: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the great river, the Euphrates-- all the Hittite country-- to the Great Sea on the west.

ekegusii: Onye nase obogima obo bwoka tosemeretie Kristo, rirorio intwe nabataka tore kobua abanto bonsi.
english: If only for this life we have hope in Christ, we are to be pitied more than all men.

ekegusii: korende ntomanyete ng’a omonto takonyora oboronge ase ogokora kw’amachiko, korende ase okomwegena Kristo Yeso. Nonya nintwe twamwegenire Kristo Yeso, erinde tonyore oboronge ase okomwegena Kristo, tari ase ogokora kw’amachiko, ekiagera ase ogokora kw’amachiko onde tari ase mwanyabanto oranyare konyora oboronge.
english: know that a man is not justified by observing the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have put our faith in Christ Jesus that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by observing the law, because by observing the law no one will be justified.

ekegusii: Erio nebe ng’a kera omonto otigarete ase Sayoni, na ase Yerusalemu, narokwe omochenu, kera oyomo oyorikire ase egati y’abwo bare moyo ase Yerusalemu.
english: Those who are left in Zion, who remain in Jerusalem, will be called holy, all who are recorded among the living in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omogati oikire korwa igoro ng’a monto onde bwensi orayorie, tagokwa.
english: But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which a man may eat and not die.

ekegusii: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians, and opened wide our hearts to you.
english: Twakwanire maiso marore nainwe, Abakorinto; chinkoro chiaito chiagareigwe.

ekegusii: Naende korwa ase egetonga keria kiarenge agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene akarusia omogati oyomo otabekiri memera, ne rindasi erimo, na omogati oyomo omoo, erio akabibeka igoro ase ebitinya ebio na ekenama ekio kia borio.
english: Then from the basket of bread made without yeast, which was before the LORD, he took a cake of bread, and one made with oil, and a wafer; he put these on the fat portions and on the right thigh.

ekegusii: Aroro akaagacha obomenyo bwaye obochenu bobeere igoro mono, nabobe obokong’u buna ense ekong’irie kogenderera botambe.
english: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that he established forever.

ekegusii: Bono baminto, mwamanyire ng’a abanto ba nyomba mwa Stefana nigo barenge abe ritang’ani koonchoka agwo Akaya; na barabwo bebekire ase emeremo y’ogokorera abachenu.
english: You know that the household of Stephanas were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. I urge you, brothers,

ekegusii: Ase ekero ekio Labani akarua omosomba oye omoiseke okorokwa Silpa, abe ogokorera Lea, omwana oye.
english: And Laban gave his servant girl Zilpah to his daughter as her maidservant.

ekegusii: Iraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase amang’ana onsi! Naki oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae asemore ase Kristo Yeso.
english: give thanks in all circumstances, for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Ekero omoika orure ase omonto, ere nigo akoirana ase amaroba, ase arwete. Ase rituko erio erio emeroberio yaye nigo egosira.
english: When their spirit departs, they return to the ground; on that very day their plans come to nothing.

ekegusii: Motogie inwe abaruoti b’ense na abanto bonsi, nainwe abagambi na abanachi ebina mwensi,
english: kings of the earth and all nations, you princes and all rulers on earth,

ekegusii: esagero na omoyaye, na enyakoboke, na enyautuutu, na ebisaku biamwabo;
english: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

ekegusii: Ekero omonto arentete amang’ana ng’a emetwe y’abana b’omoruoti yarentirwe, Yehu agateba, “Yebeke amo ase chitui ibere agwo ase egesoero ki’egeita, ebeereo goika mambia.”
english: When the messenger arrived, he told Jehu, "They have brought the heads of the princes." Then Jehu ordered, "Put them in two piles at the entrance of the city gate until morning."

ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring’ana eri Omoika ogotebia chikanisa. Ere oyorabue takonyora obororo bw’amakweri a kabere nonya ng’ake.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. He who overcomes will not be hurt at all by the second death.

ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene nobeere igoro asare; omoika bw’obong’aini na okomanya, omoika bw’ogosemia na okobua; omoika bwe chisemi na okomoiroka Omonene.
english: The Spirit of the LORD will rest on him-- the Spirit of wisdom and of understanding, the Spirit of counsel and of power, the Spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD--

ekegusii: Bakamorentera abana ebing’werere, erinde abakune; korende aborokigwa baye bagachia kobarora, bakabatanga.
english: People were also bringing babies to Jesus to have him touch them. When the disciples saw this, they rebuked them.

ekegusii: “Inche Omonene nigo nyanchete oboronge, nigo ngechete obourereria na ogokora okobe. Nimbe omwegenwa, erinde ng’ee abanto baane eng’eria yabo, na ninkore nabarabwo okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwa kare na kare.
english: "For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and iniquity. In my faithfulness I will reward them and make an everlasting covenant with them.

ekegusii: Ombekire imenye ase omosunte, buna abanto baria bakwete kare.
english: He has made me dwell in darkness like those long dead.

ekegusii: When the brothers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
english: Ekero abamwabo bachia konyora amang’ana aya, bakamoira goika Kaisaria, bakamotoma agende Tariso.

ekegusii: Naki baria baikire gotama ogotacheneka gw’ense ase okomomanya Omonene na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo, korende kobakobwatwa naende na kobugwa nero, okoba kwabo kw’omoerio nkobe okobe kobua koria kwe ritang’ani.
english: If they have escaped the corruption of the world by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ and are again entangled in it and overcome, they are worse off at the end than they were at the beginning.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titogokoaka amagena ase emeremo emiya, korende nase okorama, ekiagera aye nomonto ogwekora omonyene ng’a naye Nyasae.”
english: "We are not stoning you for any of these," replied the Jews, "but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, claim to be God."

ekegusii: Omonto okororera omotaka amabera, oyio nigo akorua singo ase Omonene, na Omonene namoakane ase ogokora okwo kwaye.
english: He who is kind to the poor lends to the LORD, and he will reward him for what he has done.

ekegusii: Abisalomu nigo aiboreretwe abamura batato, na omoiseke oyomo ore korokwa Tamari. Ere nigo arenge omoiseke omonyakieni.
english: Three sons and a daughter were born to Absalom. The daughter's name was Tamar, and she became a beautiful woman.

ekegusii: Mefiboseti akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, nomanyete ng’a nekerema inde. Nigo natebetie omosomba one, ng’a abekere etigere yane egeikaransero, nainche ndiine ngende nomoruoti, korende ere akang’aina.
english: He said, "My lord the king, since I your servant am lame, I said, 'I will have my donkey saddled and will ride on it, so I can go with the king.' But Ziba my servant betrayed me.

ekegusii: But he gave them strict orders not to tell who he was.
english: Akabikania mono tibimoorokia.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, notorentere omorembe, ekiagera emeremo twabeire togokora, naye kwabeire gokoyetokorera.
english: LORD, you establish peace for us; all that we have accomplished you have done for us.

ekegusii: Naende Musa agateba, “Abanto b’ebisaku ebio mogochia goseria nigo bakoigwera abarogi na abariori, korende inwe Omonene, Nyasae oino, obakanirie ng’a timobaisa gokora ebinto ebio.
english: The nations you will dispossess listen to those who practice sorcery or divination. But as for you, the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so.

Omorero oyio orenge ekebemberia nigo obete ase rituko ria Tichi kabere botuko amo na igoro Tichi Gatato. Omwoorokia Omonene bw' esukuru eyio, Principal Zachary Nyariki nigo atebete buna esukuru eyio yasiekirwe, kobwatekana n' omobasokano oyio bw' omorero. Abaorokigwa baria konyora bataramanya igoro y' omorero oyo naende barenge koirana gocha ase esukuru eyio, nigo bairanete gochia ase chinka chiabo. "Nigo togokagera buna chinyomba echi nigo chiasambetwe, korende ntwe nigo totagete abanyanyimbo bakore obotuko bwabo, erinde gototebia ekeene" Nabo Principal Nyariki atebete. Esukuru eyio yachagetwe amo na Abakatholiki, nigo ebwate abaorokigwa goetania 1100. Gati ya abaorokigwa abwo, 250 bono mbabwati oboraro. Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho, Kisii County Chinyomba ibere nigo chiasambwa ase rituko ria Tichi Kabere morogoba ekero abana b' esukuru eyio basangererekanete ase ebaredi, gotebigwa amatangaso amo n' Principal. Enyomba y' gatato nigo yayiete igoro mogaso, ekero abanyanyimbo baria barendete enkore eyio, barwete aroro na kogenda korigia ganto babeke mboto. Enyomba yende y' Cardinal Otunga nigo yayiete omwaka oyo oera, korende obotuki tibwanya gochia aande. Kisii Central Division Criminal Investigation Officer, Paul Wambugu amo na Marani OCPD Benjamin Kimwale mbatarerete esukuru eyio na koria chiira buna obotuki boikeranete, mboche bokorwe.
english: Aaria Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho: The incident with stones and sticks, the students were disturbed and scattered. These are the details: Report from Standard Media: The incident of stones being thrown is said to have occurred at Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho. This morning, the school was closed indefinitely following a student strike on Tuesday afternoon. The Headteacher of that school, Principal Zachary Nyariki, stated that the school was closed due to the chaos caused by the strike. Students who spoke did not know the cause of the strike but said they found themselves running away from the school, fearing harm. “It is regrettable that this incident happened, because now students will not be able to continue with their studies, and it will delay their education” Also Principal Nyariki stated. The school which was founded by Catholics, can accommodate 1100 students. Out of those students, 250 are boarders. Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho, Kisii County This first incident happened during the Tichi Kabere holiday when the students were gathering in the field, and were addressed by the Principal. Yesterday afternoon, it was reported that the students who had attended that meeting, woke up angry and started causing trouble. Today’s meeting of Cardinal Otunga has been postponed until further notice, so that investigations can be carried out. Kisii Central Division Criminal Investigation Officer, Paul Wambugu and Marani OCPD Benjamin Kimwale visited the school and promised to investigate the matter thoroughly, and arrest those involved.

english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, as the house of Ahab had done, for after his father's death they became his advisers, to his undoing.

ekegusii: Ekero morabusure chindagera ase emegondo yaino ase omwaka o gatano na gatato mogenderere koria endagera eria enkoro, goika endagera y’omwaka o kianda egeswe.
english: While you plant during the eighth year, you will eat from the old crop and will continue to eat from it until the harvest of the ninth year comes in.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarangeria abakuani Zadoki na Abiatari, naende Abalawi: Urieli na Asaia, Yoeli na Semaya, Elieli na Aminadabu,
english: Then David summoned Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel and Amminadab the Levites.

ekegusii: Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaimokerera igoro, bokarua ase omokerubi oria, bokagenda ase omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba eria; enyomba eria egaichorwa ne riire, na eraaro egaichorwa nobomeka‐meku bw’obonene bw’Omonene.
english: Then the glory of the LORD rose from above the cherubim and moved to the threshold of the temple. The cloud filled the temple, and the court was full of the radiance of the glory of the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene nomwegenwa, nere orababeke chinguru na kobarenda korwa ase oria omobe.
english: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen and protect you from the evil one.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya achia koera, Paulo akarengereria ase omoika oye ime goeta egati ya Makedonia na Akaya gochia Yerusalemu, ogoteba, “Nyuma konabeire agwo ningwenerete korora Rumi noro.”
english: After all this had happened, Paul decided to go to Jerusalem, passing through Macedonia and Achaia. "After I have been there," he said, "I must visit Rome also."

ekegusii: Ase igo Elifasi Omotemani, na Bilidadi Omosua, na Sofari Omonama, bakagenda bagakora buna Omonene abachigete, na Omonene aganchera ogosaba kw’Ayubu.
english: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite did what the LORD told them; and the LORD accepted Job's prayer.

ekegusii: Na bono ninteneine aiga ngambigwe ase engencho y’ogosemeria kw’eira eria chisokoro chiaito chiaetwe na Nyasae,
english: And now it is because of my hope in what God has promised our fathers that I am on trial today.

ekegusii: Elija nigo arenge omonto bwe chingencho echimo naintwe, agasaba nomokia ng’a embura tetwa. Na embura tiyatwa igoro ase ense ase engaki y’emiaka etato na emetienyi etano nomo.
english: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase ense yonsi y’Abayuda, bagasangereria Abalawi korwa ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda amo nabateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bakagenda Yerusalemu.
english: They went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites and the heads of Israelite families from all the towns. When they came to Jerusalem,

ekegusii: Omokungu ore omwereria mono naende ore bw’enyomba y’amasikani ase egati yaino, oria otarenge konyara gotacha inse namagoro aye agende aande, ekiagera igo are omwereria narorere omosacha oye anchete mono ribero, narorere nabana baye, abamura na abaiseke, ribero boigo.
english: The most gentle and sensitive woman among you-- so sensitive and gentle that she would not venture to touch the ground with the sole of her foot-- will begrudge the husband she loves and her own son or daughter

english: Who of all the gods of these countries has been able to save his land from me? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?"

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Hezekia akarwara, akaba ang’e nogokwa. Isaya omobani, mosinto bw’Amosi, agacha asare, akamotebia, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ebeke ang’e, amo nenyomba yao, ekiagera aye goika okwe, tokogwena.”
english: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to him and said, "This is what the LORD says: Put your house in order, because you are going to die; you will not recover."

english: The woman conceived and sent word to David, saying, "I am pregnant."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio momokoobe gocha aiga nka asende, nere aikaranse ase ekerogo kiane ki’oboruoti, ekiagera nere orabe omoruoti ase ribaga riane; nere nachorire agambere Abaisraeli na Abayuda.”
english: Then you are to go up with him, and he is to come and sit on my throne and reign in my place. I have appointed him ruler over Israel and Judah."

ekegusii: Abanto baria babere bagaikaransa aroro, bakaria na konywa amo. Erio ise omosubati oria agatebia omonto oria, “Koranche, orare aiga naende ase obotuko bwa rero, oigwe buya.”
english: So the two of them sat down to eat and drink together. Afterward the girl's father said, "Please stay tonight and enjoy yourself."

ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Tobaisa kogenda amo nabarabwo gose gochia koragereria Abaisraeli. Barabwo nigo basesenirie.”
english: But God said to Balaam, "Do not go with them. You must not put a curse on those people, because they are blessed."

ekegusii: Korende ekero omoruoti atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, akarua ogochika ase amarube ng’a omoroberio oria Hamani akorete mamincha y’Abayahudi omoiraneire ere omonyene, na ere na abamura baye bagatongwa ase chimbambo igoro.
english: But when the plot came to the king's attention, he issued written orders that the evil scheme Haman had devised against the Jews should come back onto his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

ekegusii: Omonto nigo are buna omooki, amatuko aye nigo anga buna omorengari ogoeta.
english: Man is like a breath; his days are like a fleeting shadow.

ekegusii: Enyomba eria omoruoti Sulemani aagacherete Omonene nigo yarenge iga: Obotambe bwaye nobw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato.
english: The temple that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty wide and thirty high.

ekegusii: Omoiseke o Farao agatebia omokungu oria, “Moire omwana oyo, omongonkerie, na inche ninkoe eng’eria yao.” Erio omokungu oria akaira omwana, akamorera.
english: Pharaoh's daughter said to her, "Take this baby and nurse him for me, and I will pay you." So the woman took the baby and nursed him.

ekegusii: Agachia koimoka korwa ase ogosaba agachiera aborokigwa baye, akabanyora bararire ase ogoichana.
english: When he rose from prayer and went back to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.

ekegusii: Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Egetamo (March) 5, 2011. Konyora Omosongo atarareta echae Kericho, intwe Abagusii konyora twaikire aroro. Imomanyete inga Abasigisi na abaminto? Ingai erieta ria Kabianga riarwete? Esegi yo Osao Sao (diarrhea) rende? Ase e semesta ya rero, ingoitona tore omochakano bwe erieta Kabianga, Gamama amo ne Esegi yo Osao Sao buna yare. Buna ebisaku binde ebinge, Abagusii nigo twarenge konganya na korigia ase agiya ase obomenyo. Kabianga Ase okona konganya, Omogusii nigo aigete na komenya aaria an'ge na Kericho. Nigo twabebekaine na Abanyamato gose Abasigisi. Korende ebisaku ebi bibere mbiamenyete na morembe nonya ne entune eyemo. Nigo bare koiberana etugo, barwara botambe ne chingaki chie ebiro chikaba chimbe. Tari igo rioka. Ndagera ekaba terikwama. Ebinto bikaba biangire aiga ase bamenyete. Nario erio Omogusii atebete inga Kabianga rende, titokorwa aaiga......... Bakarwa abwo ase ensemo eyio Kabianga aiga na koyaroka erieta erio (Kabianga) na kogenda gochia Ikonge, Metamaywa na Keroka gochaka komenya korende. Ase okonganya korwa Kabianga, Omogusii agatamboka oroche rware korokwa Emogori rakini ase rero rero rokorokwa Isonto. Morembe tochia koba aiga. Abasigisi bakaba bagooncherera Omogusii. Aiga nao ebiranya bia abakoro biarigetigwe egere gokonya Omogusii korwa ase omobisa. Abagaka abakoro bagatebigwa inga goika babeke ebiranya ebi na koganya ababisa bache. Abasigisi bagachaka esegi korende Abagusii bakaemotia. Abasigisi bagatirimboka inse batagete goita Abagusii. Abagusii bakaeboia buna abanyamato. Bakamanya kobarongera chinsinyo chiosi na kobabeka gati. Osao Sao Gaki bagaita emeganda ya Abasigisi enamba etare kobareka abwo ase oroche rwe Emogori impaka rokaba amanyinga oka. Abagere baria bamenyete ase ensemo ya Sondu bagakumia na goteba buna esegi yasairi Abasigisi. Ekio nakio kiagerete esegi eye ekarokwa esegi yo Osao Sao. Tari igo rioka. Abasacha abange ba Bosigisi nigo baitetwe. Sigisi ekaba etabwati abasacha gekogera nigo baitetwe ekero gie esegi eyio yo Osao Sao na Abagusii. Renta Abamura Ebisore Korwa Gusii Na Gamama Abamura ebisora korwa Gusii bagachi Sigisi na kobiaria abakungu ba Bosigisi. Korwa ase engaki eye, nario bono Omosigisi achagete korangeria Omogusii okomoroka Gamama engencho yaye oyo obiareti mama. Impaka rero nabo Omosigisi akorangeria Omogusii inga Gamama. Ase boigo intobwate a town ekorokwa Kabianga. Nabo magokoro atebete igo impaka naende ase esemesta yende. Next In This Series: Abagusii Customs VII: Abageka (Enyomba Ya Ababani Ase Abagusii).
english: Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. March 5, 2011. When people from Kericho die, we, the Abagusii, mourn them greatly. Do you know the Basigisi and the Baminto? Has the Kabianga river burst its banks? Does diarrhea bother you? Yes, in those days, when the Kabianga river overflowed, Gamama and also diarrhea were severe. Because diseases spread quickly, the Abagusii used to gather and consult about how to deal with illnesses. Kabianga During this consultation, the Omogusii would meet and discuss things concerning Kericho. We interacted with both the Banyamato and the Basigisi. These diseases caused much suffering and hardship, especially with the accompanying pain. They said they should offer sacrifices, the sick should be treated with medicine and herbs. It was a difficult time. My grandmother used to say that things happened because people did not understand. The Omogusii thought that what happened in Kabianga was strange, it wasn't understood by anyone... Those who survived the disease in Kabianga went and settled in Ikonge, Metamaywa and Keroka to find relief and comfort. During the consultation regarding Kabianga, the Omogusii started a ritual involving Emogori rocks, which were repeatedly thrown towards Isonto. Hardship continued to persist. The Basigisi despised the Omogusii. They also had their own traditions that they guarded jealously against the Omogusii during times of trouble. The elders among them would prevent young men from sharing information with others. The Basigisi mocked these events while the Abagusii suffered. The Basigisi believed they could overpower the Abagusii. The Abagusii realized they needed to increase their strength and unity. Osao Sao Some people went to the land of the Basigisi hoping to find a way to stop the ritual of Emogori before it caused further harm. Others who knew the customs of Sondu gathered and agreed that the situation facing the Basigisi was dire. This matter became known as the event of Osao Sao. It was a difficult time. Many children of the Bosigisi were orphaned. The Basigisi, having lost their children, blamed the Osao Sao event on the Abagusii. Rent For Land From Gusii And Gamama People seeking land from Gusii approached the Basigisi and negotiated with the chiefs of Bosigisi. Regarding this issue, a man named Omosigisi volunteered to help the Omogusii settle in Gamama, offering his mother's land. Even then, Omosigisi helped the Omogusii settle in Gamama. Because of this, a town grew up near Kabianga. Their hearts were troubled, and this continued until today. Next In This Series: Abagusii Customs VII: Abageka (The Wealth Of The Abagusii Men).

ekegusii: Inwe mweroreire aya onsi Omonene, Nyasae oino, akorire ase abanto aba bonsi b’ebisaku ebi ase engencho yaino. Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere obeire okobarwanera.
english: You yourselves have seen everything the LORD your God has done to all these nations for your sake; it was the LORD your God who fought for you.

ekegusii: Nkabarenta ase ense eyio nabarierete eira ng’a nimbayee. Na aase aande onsi baroche aimokererete igoro, gose emete yabwate chinsagia chinyinge, nao barenge koruera ebing’wanso biabo na okoruegwa konde, ebio biarenge okogechia asende. Aroro agwo bakaruera ebing’wanso bire ne rimisu rigiya, na bakaumora okoruegwa kwabo kw’ebinyugwa.
english: When I brought them into the land I had sworn to give them and they saw any high hill or any leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, made offerings that provoked me to anger, presented their fragrant incense and poured out their drink offerings.

ekegusii: Nigo bare abang’ainereria ase chinkoro chiabo; ase ayio goika baegwe egesusuro gi’okomocha kwabo. Omonene natagore ebisasimero biabo, atagore ne chisiiro chiabo bagosasima.
english: Their heart is deceitful, and now they must bear their guilt. The LORD will demolish their altars and destroy their sacred stones.

ekegusii: Bakabora, “Mborori ki torigetie goetania obo? Naki intwe abanyene twaigure amang’ana korwa ase omonwa oye.”
english: Then they said, "Why do we need any more testimony? We have heard it from his own lips."

Intwe nigo toraete ase enchera enene yoka, titokogobera gochia ensemo ya borio, gose eya bomosi, goika tobe twaetanirie ense yao.”
english: Please let us pass through your country. We will not go through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the king's highway and not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory."

ekegusii: Then Jesus declared, "I who speak to you am he."
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Inche, oyo ngokwana naye, nere.”

english: So the Pharisees and teachers of the law asked Jesus, "Why don't your disciples live according to the tradition of the elders instead of eating their food with 'unclean' hands?"

english: What grieved them most was his statement that they would never see his face again. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

english: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and relatives, 12

english: Even as he walks along the road, the fool lacks sense and shows everyone how stupid he is.

english: At once he began to preach in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God.

english: After they had gone through the entire land, they came back to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

english: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.'"

english: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built the temple of the LORD and his own palace,

english: Then the Israelites, all the people, went up to Bethel, and there they sat weeping before the LORD. They fasted that day until evening and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to the LORD.

ekegusii: Intwe twabarasire emegwe; Abahesiboni basirigwe, twabaitire goika Diboni. Tokabasiria goika Nofa na korwa Nofa goika Medeba.”
english: "But we have overthrown them; Heshbon is destroyed all the way to Dibon. We have demolished them as far as Nophah, which extends to Medeba."

ekegusii: Ekiagera omonto oyomo ore korokwa Demeterio, omoturi bwe chifeta, oyorenge gokora ebihekalu bie chifeta bi’Aritemi, nigo arenge konyorera abaroisia enibo enyinge.
english: A silversmith named Demetrius, who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought in no little business for the craftsmen.

english: "'A tithe of everything from the land, whether grain from the soil or fruit from the trees, belongs to the LORD; it is holy to the LORD.

english: some people standing there asked, "What are you doing, untying that colt?"

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatiana ase engencho y’omokungu oria, agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, aye tokonyora egesusuro ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio.”
english: Saul swore to her by the LORD, "As surely as the LORD lives, you will not be punished for this."

english: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, "But perhaps you live near us. How then can we make a treaty with you?"

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba, oyio ore Omonene, Nyasae oo, okorwanerera abanto baye: “Naama, narusirie korwa ase amaboko ao egekombe ekio okonywera na gotinda, egekombe ki’endamwamu yane togokenywera naende.

english: So in everything, do to others what you would have them do to you, for this sums up the Law and the Prophets.

english: These were the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob-- fourteen in all.

english: When the LORD heard them, he was very angry; his fire broke out against Jacob, and his wrath rose against Israel,
