ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria bagakora omogwekano bw’emori, bakarenta ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano oria basasimete, bakagokera emeremo y’amaboko abo.
english: That was the time they made an idol in the form of a calf. They brought sacrifices to it and held a celebration in honor of what their hands had made.

ekegusii: Bagechorera abanyene orogongo rwarenge oruya, ekiagera agwo nao egetari ki’omogambi kiagachetwe. Bakaba amo nabatang’ani b’abanto, bakaba bagokora oboronge bw’Omonene na konacha ebina bi’ekeene ase Abaisraeli.”
english: He chose the best land for himself; the leader's portion was kept for him. When the heads of the people assembled, he carried out the LORD's righteous will, and his judgments concerning Israel."

ekegusii: Abanchani, nabasoroire inwe, ekiagera more abaeti ase ense engeni eatanane korwa ase okogania okobe kw’omobere okwo gokorwana nomoyo.
english: Dear friends, I urge you, as aliens and strangers in the world, to abstain from sinful desires, which war against your soul.

ekegusii: “Buna koreng’ana omoibi akoba nobosooku ekero abwatirwe, naboigo n’Abaisraeli bararore obosooku barabwo amo nabaruoti babo, na abanene b’oboruoti bwabo, na ababani babo.
english: "As a thief is disgraced when he is caught, so the house of Israel is disgraced-- they, their kings and their officials, their priests and their prophets.

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Tiga abana baigote ritang’ani, ekiagera tari buya kobogoria obokima bw’abana, gotugutera chisese.”
english: "First let the children eat all they want," he told her, "for it is not right to take the children's bread and toss it to their dogs."

ekegusii: Eeri gose emanwa y’eng’ondi ebwate ekiimo egetambe goetania ekende, gose ekieng’e mono, nabo oranyare koyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogwancha, korende ase okoyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogoikerania eira kwariete, tegwancherwa nainche.
english: You may, however, present as a freewill offering an ox or a sheep that is deformed or stunted, but it will not be accepted in fulfillment of a vow.

ekegusii: Korende onye intwe tore ase emechando, nigo ere ase okobanyorera inwe okoremigwa na ogotooreka, na onye intwe tokoremigwa, nigo ere ase okobanyorera inwe okoremigwa, erinde monyore chinguru na okoremereria gw’okobogoria emechando eria eria tobogoretie intwe.
english: If we are distressed, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we suffer.

ekegusii: Minto FM: Demokrasi ya USA negwenerete kobwatigwa nechinse chinde Omoegereri bwe Ekima kia Democractic ase obochori bwaeta ime ya Texas ase ime y’ Ense ya America Job Nyangenya Omanga, otebire Demokrasi yaorokigwa ime yense eyio mbogwenerete koegwa nechinse chinde.Nigo arenge koyakwana aya iga ase omoroberio o’minto Bwakire ekero basanga na Evans Mak ori eng’era ya inani.
english: Minto FM: The democracy of the USA is being challenged due to recent events The spokesperson for the Democratic Party, concerning the election in Texas and the election in the United States, Job Nyangenya Omanga, stated that democracy is threatened in all these elections and needs to be defended against these challenges. He also mentioned that there is a need for unity among people and cooperation between Bwakire elders and Evans Makori regarding this matter.

ekegusii: Silpa, omosomba o Lea, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o kabere.
english: Leah's servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaranda ase ense eria yonsi.
english: The word of the Lord spread through the whole region.

ekegusii: Nigo okobabisa agwo asore, ase okobarenda korwa ase emeroberio emebe y’abanto; nigo okobarenda ase ekiriri kiao korwa ase abanto abang’achi.
english: In the shelter of your presence you hide them from the intrigues of men; in your dwelling you keep them safe from accusing tongues.

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaimokia rigena, akaritenenia gati ya Misipa na Seni, akariroka Ebeni‐Eseri, akabora, “Omonene otokonyire twaikire aiga.”
english: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer, saying, "Thus far has the LORD helped us."

ekegusii: bakamotebia, “Rora bono aye kwagotire, na abamura bao tibari kobwatia chinchera chiao. Ase ayio tochorere omoruoti oranyare gotogambera buna ebisaku binde bionsi bibwate abaruoti.”
english: They said to him, "You are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways; now appoint a king to lead us, such as all the other nations have."

ekegusii: Abagambi ba Soani babeire abariri, na aba Memifisi bang’ainirwe. Abwo bare buna amagena e chikoona ase ebisaku biabo batantanirie ense ya Misiri.
english: The officials of Zoan have become fools, the leaders of Memphis are deceived; the cornerstones of her peoples have led Egypt astray.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inche nigo nkorera asore, ekiagera eguru‐gura enga buna omorero yomirie amarisio ’erooro, na eyio enga buna chimeme chi’omorero yasambire emete yonsi y’orosana.
english: To you, O LORD, I call, for fire has devoured the open pastures and flames have burned up all the trees of the field.

ekegusii: “Intwe togakora buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, atochigete; tokarua Horebu, tokagenda, togaeta ase egati y’erooro enene ekwoboyia mono, eria mwaroche ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Abaamori; erio togaika Kadeshi‐Barinea.
english: Then, as the LORD our God commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites through all that vast and dreadful desert that you have seen, and so we reached Kadesh Barnea.

ekegusii: Ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe Nyasae oino. Inche ninche Omonene.”
english: and who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the LORD."

ekegusii: Omonene nabae obotenenku, nabuchie oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino, nabuchie ne chitugo chiaino, naende nabae okwama okonge kwe riroba agwo ase ense eria arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabayee inwe.
english: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity-- in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your ground-- in the land he swore to your forefathers to give you.

ekegusii: Korende abwo bakogobera gochia ase chinchera chiabo chi’obosiru, Omonene nabarusieo amo nabagokora amabe. Omorembe obe ase Abaisraeli!
english: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatebia Nyasae, “Nakorire ebibe ebinene ase aya nakorire. Korende bono nagosabire, onyabere inche, omosomba oo, ogosaria kwane, naki nigo nakorire egento ki’oboriri obonene.”
english: Then David said to God, "I have sinned greatly by doing this. Now, I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing."

ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano na rimo bokagwera chiamate ch’egesaku kia Nafutali.
english: The sixth lot came out for Naphtali, clan by clan:

ekegusii: Ee, ayio namaene. Barabwo mbabunegete ase ogotegena kwabo, korende aye nigo oteneine ase okwegena kwao. Ase igo toenena, korende oiroke.
english: Granted. But they were broken off because of unbelief, and you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but be afraid.

ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bakagenderera goeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku, amache akaba ateneine buna orwaki ensemo ya borio na ensemo ya bomosi asebare.
english: But the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya goika abe ekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao na ase obosio bwao, ekiagera Omonene natorusetie korwa Misiri nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru.”
english: And it will be like a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead that the LORD brought us out of Egypt with his mighty hand."

ekegusii: Nyasae, Ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, atogigwe, ere oyotosesenetie ase Kristo nogosesenigwa gwonsi kw’omoika aase aaria igoro,
english: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in the heavenly realms with every spiritual blessing in Christ.

ekegusii: Na ase engencho y’Okwearigania kw’Abayahudi bakabeka Yeso aroro, ekiagera oboina boria bwarenge ang’e.
english: Because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.

ekegusii: Erio agwo agakuna amaiso abo, akabatebia, “Koreng’ana nokwegena kwaino abe asemore.”
english: Then he touched their eyes and said, "According to your faith will it be done to you";

ekegusii: Boigo nase abakuani aba: Abanto be chiamate chia Habaya, na Hakosi, na Barisilai, oyio onyuomete oyomo bw’abaiseke ba Barisilai Omogileadi na akarokwa ase erieta riabo Barisilai.
english: And from among the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah, Hakkoz and Barzillai (a man who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by that name).

ekegusii: Naende Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe ase obosio bw’Omonene; bagasasima chinyasae chiria chiare korokwa Baali, na echinde chiare korokwa Asitaroti, amo ne chinyasae chi’Abasiiria na Abasidoni, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafilisti; naende bagatiga komokorera Omonene.
english: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD. They served the Baals and the Ashtoreths, and the gods of Aram, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the Ammonites and the gods of the Philistines. And because the Israelites forsook the LORD and no longer served him,

ekegusii: Rora Nyasae nigo are amo naintwe, nere ototang’aine, na abakuani baye nigo babwate ebirombeta biabo bi’esegi bakobibugia, bagotorangeria tobarwanie inwe esegi. Inwe Abaisraeli, timobaisa korwana n’Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, ekiagera timokonyara kobua.”
english: God is with us; he is our leader. His priests with their trumpets will sound the battle cry against you. Men of Israel, do not fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers, for you will not succeed."

ekegusii: Abaasuri tibakonyara gototooria; titokoriina chibarasi gose titokogenderera koroka emeremo y’amaboko aito Nyasae oito. Aye Omonene nigo okoorokia amabera ase oyore entakana.”
english: Assyria cannot save us; we will not mount war-horses. We will never again say 'Our gods' to what our own hands have made, for in you the fatherless find compassion."

ekegusii: Inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ngoteba iga: Agwo ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, egetunwa egetambe ki’Abaisraeli, nao Abaisraeli bonsi bare ase ense barabe bagonkorera. Aroro agwo nimbanchere, na aroro agwo ninyanchere okoruegwa kwaino, na ebiegwa biaino bire ebiya mono, amo nebinto bionsi morabe mogwatanana bibe ebichenu.
english: For on my holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD, there in the land the entire house of Israel will serve me, and there I will accept them. There I will require your offerings and your choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.

ekegusii: “Na bono baminto, namanyire ng’a nigo mwakorete aya ase ogotamanya kwaino, buna abanene baino bakorete.
english: "Now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.

ekegusii: Ase Abaisraeli obonene bokarorekana buna omorero ogosiria, ase egetunwa igoro.
english: To the Israelites the glory of the LORD looked like a consuming fire on top of the mountain.

ekegusii: Ekero baare gosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano, gose goika ang’e ase egesasimero, baba bagwesibia, buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: They washed whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o kabere, ekero Dario arenge omoruoti, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigatomwa goetera ase Hagai omobani, rigacha ase Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, oyorenge omogavuna bw’Abayuda, na ase Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki.
english: In the second year of King Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the LORD came through the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest:

ekegusii: Abana baito na abakungu barabwo tiga batigare amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiaito aiga ase emechie ya Gileadi.
english: Our children and wives, our flocks and herds will remain here in the cities of Gilead.

ekegusii: “Tiira gochia ase ebitunwa bi’Abarimu, ase egetunwa kia Nebo, kere ase ense ya Moabu, kororia Yeriko, erio origererie ense ya Kanani eyio ngochia koa Abaisraeli ebe eyabo.
english: "Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo in Moab, across from Jericho, and view Canaan, the land I am giving the Israelites as their own possession.

ekegusii: Kera egento kere ime ase chinyancha ne chindooche getabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaba, na amagoocho, ekio nokogechia asemore.”
english: Anything living in the water that does not have fins and scales is to be detestable to you.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatomera Elija omotang’ani bw’abarwani esegi emerongo etano, amo nabarwani baye emerongo etano. Omotang’ani oria akanyora Elija oikaransete ase egechuria ki’egetunwa, akamotebia, “Aye omonto o Nyasae, omoruoti otebire ng’a otirimboke ogende asare.”
english: Then he sent to Elijah a captain with his company of fifty men. The captain went up to Elijah, who was sitting on the top of a hill, and said to him, "Man of God, the king says, 'Come down!'"

ekegusii: Obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bore obonene asetore, na obwegenwa bwaye nigo bogenderete goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!
english: For great is his love toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio agatebia Yeso, “Yeso, ong’inyore ekero ogocha ase oboruoti bwao!”
english: Then he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom."

ekegusii: Erio Hagari akaiborera Aburamu omwana omoisia; nere akaroka omwana oria oye, Isumaeli.
english: So Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateba, “Eke nakio ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nakorire egati yane nainwe, na kera egetongwa kere moyo amo nainwe, na ase ebiaare bigochigocha:
english: And God said, "This is the sign of the covenant I am making between me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:

ekegusii: Na ere omonyene naborokie akanyomba akanene ka irongo igoro, karoisigwe kabeire ang’e; agwo motoroiserie.”
english: He will show you a large upper room, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there."

ekegusii: Ninche ase okobua kwane ne chinguru chiane, natongete ense, na mwanyabanto, ne ching’iti chionsi chire ase ense. Ninche nkoyea omonto onde bwensi nanchire koa.
english: With my great power and outstretched arm I made the earth and its people and the animals that are on it, and I give it to anyone I please.

ekegusii: “Inee! Mbanto ba gesaku ki ekenene babwate enyasae ere ang’e nabarabwo buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, are ang’e naintwe? Nigo agotoigwa kero kende gionsi tokomorangeria atokonye.
english: What other nation is so great as to have their gods near them the way the LORD our God is near us whenever we pray to him?

ekegusii: Naende Haroni arente Abalawi ase obosio bwane, babe buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa korwa ase Abaisraeli. Naboigo Abalawi baatananwe, babe ekeegwa ase ogonkorera inche Omonene.
english: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the Israelites, so that they may be ready to do the work of the LORD.

ekegusii: Nonyare gotoma chinkoba chigende aase gete, erio chigotebie: Ee, nao tore aa?
english: Do you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, 'Here we are'?

ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria, “Omworokia, ntwarora omonto ogoseria ebirecha ase erieta riao, tokamokania, ekiagera tabwataini naintwe.”
english: "Master," said John, "we saw a man driving out demons in your name and we tried to stop him, because he is not one of us."

ekegusii: “Oroisie egesasimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ubani egosamberwa.
english: "Make an altar of acacia wood for burning incense.

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nareo obeire okoigwa Nyasae ore moyo kagokwana korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, buna intwe twamoigure, na omonto oyio ogendererete koba moyo?
english: For what mortal man has ever heard the voice of the living God speaking out of fire, as we have, and survived?

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yafileti nabwo aba: Pasaki, na Bimuhali, na Asiwati. Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Yafileti.
english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal and Ashvath. These were Japhlet's sons.

ekegusii: Omonene akarentera omoruoti oborwaire bwa ukoma bokaba bomoriete goika rituko ri’ogokwa kwaye. Ase igo omoruoti akamenya enyomba ere bweka ao. Yotamu, omwana oye omomura, akaba omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’obogambi, akagambera abanto b’ense eria.
english: The LORD afflicted the king with leprosy until the day he died, and he lived in a separate house. Jotham the king's son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.

ekegusii: Gose moruoti ki, gakogenda korwana nomoruoti onde, otaikaranse ritang’ani na korengereria onye ere amo nabanto chilifu ikomi nanyare koumerana nere oyokomochera nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere?
english: "Or suppose a king is about to go to war against another king. Will he not first sit down and consider whether he is able with ten thousand men to oppose the one coming against him with twenty thousand?

ekegusii: Omonto kare namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”
english: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear."

ekegusii: Tobaisa gwetogeria rituko ri’ankio, ekiagera tomanyeti aya rituko rikorenta.
english: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring forth.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gomeri nabwo aba: Asikenasi na Rifati, na Togarima.
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.

ekegusii: Erio amaiso ’abanto abwo bakorora tagoukora, na amato ’abanto abwo bakoigwa naigwe.
english: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

ekegusii: Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur,
english: Bakibuki, na Hakufa, na Harihuri;

ekegusii: Abayuda na Abaisraeli nigo bamenyete nomorembe korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba; kera omonto nigo arenge nemezeituni yaye na emeko yaye, ase emiaka yonsi Sulemani abagamberete.
english: During Solomon's lifetime Judah and Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, lived in safety, each man under his own vine and fig tree.

ekegusii: Ase enchera ekogenda Yerusalemu Yeso ngoeta arenge egati ya Samaria na Galili.
english: Now on his way to Jerusalem, Jesus traveled along the border between Samaria and Galilee.

ekegusii: Na ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe akarua chieri ibere, ne chimingichi isano, ne chigoree isano, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano chiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okorua kw’Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai.
english: and two oxen, five rams, five male goats and five male lambs a year old, to be sacrificed as a fellowship offering. This was the offering of Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

ekegusii: Bakabogoria omobere oye ne chibarasi, bakayoira Yerusalemu, bakayotindeka aroro ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe, ase Omochie o Daudi.
english: He was brought back by horse and was buried in Jerusalem with his fathers, in the City of David.

ekegusii: Ase chitaai chiria akaroisia chinterekerero chi’egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na egesasimero gi’etaai amo negechungi kiaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi,
english: They used it to make the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar with its bronze grating and all its utensils,

ekegusii: ogetebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba:” “Aye Egetunwa gia Seiri, inche nigo inde mamincha yao, nindambore okoboko kwane igoro yao, ngosarie obe bosa.
english: and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you and make you a desolate waste.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatebia abasomba baye, “Timomanyeti ng’a rero omonto omonene, omogambi bw’Abaisraeli, okure?
english: Then the king said to his men, "Do you not realize that a prince and a great man has fallen in Israel this day?

ekegusii: Rituko rigotunya erio bagasoa Kaisaria. Na Kornelio nigo arenge obaganyete, konya osangereirie eamate yaye amo nabanchi baye.
english: The following day he arrived in Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.

ekegusii: bakararia okweng’ata, na bakabeka Naboti ase amasio ’abanto ase okomoa amasikani.
english: They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth in a prominent place among the people.

ekegusii: Ninche Omonene nigo narenge omotang’ani gotebia Sayoni: Rigereria, morore abwo! Ninche narenterete Yerusalemu abwo bararetie amang’ana amaya.
english: I was the first to tell Zion, 'Look, here they are!' I gave to Jerusalem a messenger of good tidings.

ekegusii: Amauga onsi ay’omobere one natebe, “Aye Omonene, ning’o onga buna aye? Aye ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru korwa ase oyore ne chinguru komobua, ee, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru naende omoremerwa, korwa ase oyo okomochanda.”
english: My whole being will exclaim, "Who is like you, O LORD? You rescue the poor from those too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them."

ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi nabimokorere, naende bikorere omwana oye omomura, na omochokoro oye omomura, nabigenderere gokora boigo goika ekero engaki y’okogwa gw’ense yaye eraike; nyuma y’ayio ense yaye nebe ensomba ekorere ebisaku ebinge na abaruoti abanene bare ne chinguru.
english: All nations will serve him and his son and his grandson until the time for his land comes; then many nations and great kings will subjugate him.

ekegusii: omokuani arenge egesambo ekio. Onye gekorete engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, naende onye amarionya areo are monuri na konyererea, erio omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Erio nerichoncho ri’oborwaire bwa ukoma ase omotwe oye, gose ase ekenyonyobu.
english: the priest is to examine the sore, and if it appears to be more than skin deep and the hair in it is yellow and thin, the priest shall pronounce that person unclean; it is an itch, an infectious disease of the head or chin.

ekegusii: Omoturi ebioma nigo akobogoria enturago yaye otura ekioma. Nigo agokebeka igoro ase omorero bw’amakara, ogesamba, erio okebomba ase ogokebaraga nokoboko kwaye kore ne chinguru. Ekero agendererete koroisia omogwekano oyio, nigo akoba nenchara na erang’o ogoya.
english: The blacksmith takes a tool and works with it in the coals; he shapes an idol with hammers, he forges it with the might of his arm. He gets hungry and loses his strength; he drinks no water and grows faint.
